title: Dual-Channel Current Controller Design
desc: Seeking an independent embedded hardware/firmware engineer to design, build, program, test and deliver one complete dual-channel low-voltage electrode controller and matching owned manufacturing files. This is original development from written functional requirements; no existing…
full: Seeking an independent embedded hardware/firmware engineer to design, build, program, test and deliver one complete dual-channel low-voltage electrode controller and matching owned manufacturing files. This is original development from written functional requirements; no existing schematic, PCB or firmware. External nominal 12 V supply. Two electrode pairs operate simultaneously in shared water, with current/voltage limits, controlled polarity reversal, retained polarity state, manual timed dosing, simple buttons/selector and actual-current indication. No wireless, app, display or production batch. Engineer must procure and receive the prototype, program and debug it at their own or managed facility, obtain an agreed representative electrode test fixture, perform documented shared-water and enclosed thermal validation, correct agreed-scope design errors including necessary hardware/re-spins/retesting, and ship a verified complete controller with external supply to Toledo, Ohio. Owner will not test or troubleshoot unfinished hardware. Deliver native schematic/PCB CAD, Gerbers/drills, BOM/CPL, full firmware source/build files and binaries, enclosure cutout/DXF drawings, faceplate artwork, complete assembly/wiring documentation, finished-controller BOM and factory test procedure matching the tested unit, with IP ownership and freedom to manufacture elsewhere. Please provide fixed/capped total with labor, prototype hardware, test setup and shipping itemized, timeline, payment/acceptance milestones, relevant power/current-controller work you personally tested, lab arrangements and exceptions. Full detailed Revision C RFQ and numerical acceptance criteria will be supplied privately to suitable bidders. No treatment-efficacy, chemistry, electrode-life or certification studies requested.

Brevato Brand & Retail Support Executive
We have an exciting role being part of a dynamic team while building BWGs Coffee Brand in a rapidly growing coffee industry. The Brevato coffee Brand & Retail Support executive role is responsible for maintaining and developing the Brevato coffee brand across retailer locations and Brevato-operated coffee shops. Working closely with retailers, suppliers and internal teams, the role supports brand standards, commercial performance and the ongoing growth of the Brevato proposition.
Key Responsibilities
• Brand & Retailer Support

• Maintain Brevato brand standards across retailer locations, ensuring a consistent customer experience.

• Conduct quarterly store audits, providing feedback, reporting and recommendations to retailers.

• Support retailers with issue resolution, POS requirements, product launches and promotional activity.

• Build strong retailer relationships, acting as a key point of contact for brand-related support.

• Capture content and retailer feedback to support marketing initiatives.

• Identify opportunities to grow coffee, bakery and associated category sales.

2. Commercial Performance & Retailer Growth

• Establish performance benchmarks and monitor retailer performance against targets.

• Analyse sales, margin and operational data to identify growth opportunities and trends.

• Work with retailers to implement action plans that improve commercial performance.

• Support retailers in maximising category sales through product mix, premiumisation and cross-selling opportunities.

• Share best practice and successful initiatives across the retailer network.

3. Pipeline Development

• Support the management of the Brevato retailer pipeline.

• Work closely with the Sales and Coffee teams to identify opportunities and maintain accurate pipeline information.

• Help ensure retailer opportunities progress effectively through the sales process.

4. Brevato Coffee Shop Operations

• Support the day-to-day operation of Brevato coffee shops, ensuring brand standards are maintained.

• Monitor sales and profitability, identifying opportunities to improve performance.

• Support the implementation of new products, seasonal programmes and promotional activity.

• Gather operational insights and share learnings that can be applied across the wider retailer network.

5. Brand Development & Market Insight

• Gather retailer and market feedback to support ongoing brand development.

• Support the delivery of marketing and brand initiatives.

• Conduct competitor reviews and monitor industry trends.

• Recommend improvements to products, promotions, POS materials and customer activation initiatives.

Requirements
Role Requirements
Required

• Strong IT aptitude, advanced Excel skills and experience producing performance reports.

• Excellent organisational, communication and stakeholder management skills.

Experience
• Experience within the coffee industry is desirable. Candidates with transferable experience from hospitality, foodservice, retail or other beverage sectors will also be considered.

Attributes

• Commercially minded, proactive and results focused.

• Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and maintain high standards in a fast-paced environment.

desc: Complete Existing Android Application – End-to-End Development & Google Play Store Publishing Project Overview I am looking for an experienced Android developer to complete my existing Android application and deliver a fully functional, production-ready application published on t…
full:
Complete Existing Android Application – End-to-End Development & Google Play Store Publishing

Project Overview

I am looking for an experienced Android developer to complete my existing Android application and deliver a fully functional, production-ready application published on the Google Play Store.

The existing project is already developed to a significant extent using:

- Native Android
- Kotlin
- Jetpack Compose
- MVVM architecture
- Existing navigation and ViewModels
- Backend/API integration

I will provide the existing Android Studio project source code and related project files to the selected developer.

Important: This is an existing project continuation. I do not want the application rebuilt from scratch.

1. Existing Project Audit & Build Fixing

- Audit the complete existing source code.
- Fix Gradle and dependency issues.
- Fix compilation errors and runtime crashes.
- Resolve incomplete screens, routes and missing classes.
- Ensure the project builds successfully in Android Studio.
- Preserve all existing completed work.

2. UI/UX Development

Improve the existing application UI with a modern, premium and professional design.

Important requirements:

- Work only on the specified Live Train Status screen for the requested UI redesign.
- Implement exactly 8 API-based sections:
 1. Train Details
 2. Current Train Status
 3. Journey Progress
 4. Next Station
 5. Station Timeline
 6. Non-Stop Stations
 7. Location Messages
 8. Alerts & Disclaimer
- Use actual API response fields only.
- No fake data, dummy stations, hardcoded timings or fake locations.
- Hide missing, null and unavailable values.
- Do not unnecessarily change any other screen.

3. API Integration & Functionality

Audit and complete all pending integrations in the existing project.

Required features:

- PNR Status
- Live Train Status
- Train Search with Autocomplete
- Train Schedule
- Trains Between Stations
- Seat Availability
- Fare Enquiry
- Live Station Information
- Train Classes

Requirements:

- Use real API responses and provided credentials.
- Fix incomplete API calls and response parsing.
- Implement proper loading, error and empty states.
- Do not use mock APIs or hardcoded results.
- Preserve working integrations.

4. Train Alerts & Notifications

Complete and test:

- Saved train alerts and persistence.
- Station-based alarm scheduling.
- Notification permissions.
- Background notification behavior.
- Alert handling and notification reliability.

5. Backend & Security

- Audit and complete the existing backend/API proxy.
- Keep API keys and secret credentials on the server.
- Configure secure API requests.
- Implement proper error handling and caching where required.
- Ensure the Android app does not expose private API credentials.

6. Other Existing Features

Verify and preserve:

- Saved/Favourite Trains.
- Existing navigation.
- English and Hindi language support.
- Dark mode.
- App settings.
- Existing screens and functionality.

Do not remove or break completed features.

7. Testing & Quality Assurance

- Build and run the complete Android project.
- Test all major screens and functions.
- Verify API responses using real data.
- Test alerts and notifications on an Android device.
- Fix crashes and functional bugs.
- Perform regression testing after UI changes.

8. Google Play Store Publishing – End to End

The developer must prepare the application for production release.

Deliverables:

- Final working Android application.
- Updated complete source code.
- Debug/testing APK.
- Signed production release AAB.
- App icon and required graphics.
- Play Store screenshots.
- App description and listing content.
- Privacy Policy and Terms.
- Required Play Console declarations.
- Version code and release configuration.
- Internal/closed testing support as required.
- Production submission.
- Review correction support.
- Assistance until the application is approved and published on Google Play Store.

I already have a Google Play Console personal account.

The developer must coordinate the complete release process. Google Play approval is subject to Google's review.

9. Final Deliverables

1. Complete updated Android Studio project.
2. Working APK.
3. Signed release AAB.
4. Verified API integrations.
5. Working notifications and alerts.
6. Testing report.
7. Play Store listing materials.
8. Production submission and publishing assistance.

10. Strict Project Conditions

- Continue from my existing project.
- Do not rebuild from scratch.
- Do not damage existing functionality.
- Do not replace real API integrations with mock data.
- Do not make unrelated UI changes.
- Do not claim features are complete without testing.
- Share progress updates and modified-file details.
- All source code and release deliverables must be handed over.

Budget: ₹5,000 maximum fixed price.

Please inspect the existing project before bidding. Clearly state what you can complete within this budget, your estimated timeline, and your Android development experience.

Only developers experienced in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, API integration, backend security and Google Play Store publishing should apply.

The priority now is not fresh installs—it’s keeping current players excited so they log in, compete, and spend more time in-game. I need someone who understands both gaming culture and Instagram’s latest features—Reels, Stories, polls, close-friends lists, giveaways—and can turn them into daily touchpoints that drive players back into the app. Think creative short-form videos highlighting new challenges, behind-the-scenes art drops, meme-style posts that celebrate top player moments, and real-time story interactions during limited-time events. Core deliverables:
• A two-week content calendar (renewable) detailing post concepts, captions, hashtags, and publishing times 
• Production of all visual assets (static and motion) sized correctly for feed, Stories, and Reels 
• Community management: prompt replies to comments and DMs during peak hours, plus active engagement with relevant gaming hashtags to expand reach 
• Weekly analytics summary showing engagement rates, click-throughs to the game, and actionable tweaks for the next sprint 

If you’ve grown active player communities on Instagram before—or taken a dormant page and turned it into a busy hub—share a quick case study in your bid. I’m ready to start as soon as we align on a calendar and creative direction.

full:
Title: AI & Motion Graphics Documentary Editor (Fern / Neo / Lume Style) — Script, VoiceOver & Prompts Ready ($110 USD Fixed)

Overview:
I am looking for a fast, detail-oriented video editor to handle the visuals, clean 2.5D motion graphics, and sound design for a 15–20 minute investigative YouTube documentary about the October 2026 Binance cryptocurrency heist.

Because my budget is $110 USD fixed, I have already completed 100% of the heavy creative prep so you can move quickly without guesswork.

WHAT I AM BRINGING (100% Ready on Day 1):
1. Finalized Script & Visual Notes: A complete 15–20 minute documentary script with scene-by-scene cues.
2. Segmented Voiceover: Clean, studio-quality narration already split into numbered chapter files (Cold Open + Acts I–IV) ready to drop onto your timeline.
3. Complete Editor Spec Sheet: Exact hex color codes (#0A0D12 background, #00D2FF cyan, #E63946 crimson), typography rules, audio levels, and clear guidelines.
4. 34 Pre-Written AI Visual Prompts: Scene-by-scene, copy-pasteable prompts built with a single "style-lock" suffix (minimalist 3D isometric diorama, matte clay & dark glass, Blender Cycles aesthetic) so you don't waste time prompt-engineering.

WHAT I WANT FROM YOU (Your Deliverables):
1. Cohesive AI Visuals & Subtle Motion: Generate the 34 provided isometric prompts (via Midjourney, Flux, Ideogram, etc.) and keep them dynamic using slow camera push-ins, parallax, or subtle AI motion—no static frames sitting still for more than 4–5 seconds.
2. Clean 2.5D Motion Graphics: Minimalist map animations, simple chat/UI popups, data counters, and clean sans-serif text callouts matching the Spec Sheet.
3. Strict Aesthetic Discipline: Follow the Fern / Neo / Lume investigative look. Strictly NO cheesy "hacker in a hoodie" stock footage, NO green Matrix code, NO bright red arrows, and NO meme sound effects.
4. Atmospheric Sound Design: Dark, minimal ambient synth music (Mr. Robot / Social Network vibe), subtle risers, mechanical UI clicks, and clean music dropouts before major hooks—preserving the natural pauses already in the voiceover.

HOW TO APPLY:
1. Start your proposal with the word "CYCLES" so I know you read the full brief.
2. Share 1–2 links to documentary, finance, or explainer videos you have edited (ideally showing dark aesthetics, clean typography, or AI-assisted visuals).
3. Let me know which AI tools and editing software (CapCut Pro, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve) you use and your estimated delivery time.

title: Industrial / Product Designer Needed — Premium 3D-Printed Table Lamps (FDM / Parametric CAD)
desc: I am building a premium table-lamp brand in Saudi Arabia. The lamps will use ready-made electrical bases with E27 lamp holders, while the decorative lamp bodies/shades will be manufactured by professional FDM 3D-printing services in Riyadh. I am looking for a talented Industrial/…
full:
I am building a premium table-lamp brand in Saudi Arabia. The lamps will use ready-made electrical bases with E27 lamp holders, while the decorative lamp bodies/shades will be manufactured by professional FDM 3D-printing services in Riyadh.

I am looking for a talented Industrial/Product Designer who can create original sculptural and manufacturable products, not only photorealistic renders.

The design language will include ribbed, twisted, geometric, architectural, arabesque and translucent forms. A strong sense of premium home-product aesthetics is essential.

You should have real experience designing parts for FDM printing and understand wall thickness, tolerances, overhangs, supports, print orientation, part splitting, assembly and material efficiency.

The lamp will use a standardized mechanical interface around an E27 shade-ring holder. The current approximately 42 mm dimension is provisional; final dimensions will be supplied from measurements of the actual base sample.

Required final deliverables: editable native/parametric CAD source; STEP where appropriate; watertight STL/3MF; interface dimensions and tolerances; recommended wall thickness; printing orientation/support guidance; approximate slicer material/time estimate; and revisions after the first physical prototype.

Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Rhino/Grasshopper or equivalent professional workflows are welcome. Blender is also welcome when combined with a reliable workflow for precise, manufacturable geometry.

Please send 3–5 examples of physical products you personally designed, preferably designs that were actually 3D printed. Show photographs of printed prototypes when available. Lamp, furniture, home décor, lighting or consumer-product experience is especially relevant.

This is a long term cooperation and if successfully tested demand, this would probably be 20+ 3d designs. 

All accepted commercial designs must be original and delivered with agreed exclusive commercial IP rights. Please state your hourly rate and your preferred fixed fee per production-ready lamp model.

Director, Enterprise Applications

Position Profile

Function: Business Technology — Enterprise Applications

Reporting line: Chief Security and Business Technology Officer

Role Purpose

Lead the strategy, delivery and continuous improvement of 6sense’s enterprise applications, turning business priorities into secure, scalable platforms and measurable outcomes. This is a business transformation leadership role—not simply an application administration or project delivery role.

The Director will partner with Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Finance, Legal and Partner Operations to simplify processes, strengthen data quality and controls, and improve how work gets done. AI fluency and applied AI delivery are core requirements: the role must identify where AI creates value, where conventional automation is better, and where human judgment must remain accountable.

Responsibilities & Accountabilities

1. Enterprise Strategy & Business Partnership

• Own a business-aligned application roadmap and investment portfolio, balancing growth, operational efficiency, risk, user experience and technical debt.

• Partner with functional leaders to define business problems, accountable process owners, funding, expected benefits and adoption commitments before delivery begins.

• Run transparent prioritization and portfolio reviews; challenge low-value requests and communicate trade-offs, dependencies and decisions clearly.

2. AI-Enabled Business Transformation

• Build a prioritized portfolio of AI and automation opportunities across business workflows, starting with process redesign and data readiness rather than tool selection.

• Lead build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions with Enterprise AI Engineering, application owners, Security, Legal and Finance.

• Set standards for discovery, prototypes, evaluation, user acceptance testing, rollout and value realization. Require evidence before moving pilots into production.

• Champion practical AI adoption through training, workflow changes and feedback loops; distinguish estimated benefits from validated outcomes.

• Ensure AI-enabled workflows have defined permissions, human approval points, monitoring, escalation and safe fallback paths.

3. Application Architecture, Delivery & Reliability

• Lead business solutions partners, delivery leaders, engineers and administrators through clear ownership, shared standards and sustainable delivery practices.

• Guide architecture for Salesforce and connected GTM and Finance systems, prioritizing maintainability, reusable integrations and trusted data flows.

• Establish disciplined release management, testing, documentation, incident response and recovery practices for business-critical applications.

• Reduce redundant tools, fragile integrations, legacy customizations and unsupported components; manage lifecycle and vendor dependencies.

4. Governance, Security & Financial Stewardship

• Partner with Security, Privacy and Legal to embed access controls, segregation of duties, auditability, data protection and risk reviews into delivery and operations.

• Align application AI use cases with 6sense’s AI Management System and applicable approval processes; document risks, controls and ownership before deployment.

• Own application budgets, license utilization, vendor performance and total cost of ownership; consider AI usage costs as well as subscription and integration costs.

5. Leadership & Operating Model

• Develop an accountable, learning-oriented team with strong business consulting, application engineering and applied AI capabilities.

• Build capacity plans and effective partnerships across distributed teams and service providers.

• Establish a product-oriented operating model that owns outcomes after launch, not just project completion.

• Provide executive-ready reporting on portfolio health, delivered value, reliability, spend, adoption and risk.

• Create quarterly OKRs.

Required Skills & Experience

AI Competency — Essential, Not Optional

• Applied delivery: Demonstrated experience taking an AI-enabled business workflow from discovery through production, adoption and measured results—not only personal use of AI tools.

• Solution judgment: Explain the trade-offs among deterministic automation, embedded SaaS AI, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic workflows; know when AI should not be used.

• Technical fluency: Understand large language model limitations, grounding, context design, APIs, integration platforms and permission-aware tool access. Be able to review prototypes and challenge architecture with engineering partners; model research expertise is not required.

• Evaluation and economics: Define representative test cases, quality thresholds, failure modes, human review requirements and production monitoring. Compare business value with implementation, usage, maintenance and oversight costs.

• Responsible AI: Recognize risks including inaccurate outputs, sensitive-data exposure, prompt injection, excessive permissions and overreliance. Translate risk findings into controls and deployment decisions with the appropriate specialists.

desc: I'm looking for an experienced lead generation specialist to identify potential clients for my music production services. The goal is to build a carefully researched list of individuals, creators, and businesses that have a genuine potential need for custom ambient, focus, backgr…
full:
I'm looking for an experienced lead generation specialist to identify potential clients for my music production services.

The goal is to build a carefully researched list of individuals, creators, and businesses that have a genuine potential need for custom ambient, focus, background, or original instrumental music.

I'm looking for qualified prospects with identifiable business activity and potential buying intent, not a generic database of companies and email addresses.

1. Target Audience (Priority Order)

Please focus on small and medium-sized creators, independent businesses, and studios rather than major corporations.

Target distribution for 50 leads:

1. Ambient, lo-fi, focus and study music YouTube channels — 15 leads.
2. Indie game developers and independent game studios — 20 leads.
3. Independent video creators and content production agencies — 10 leads.
4. Marketing and advertising agencies producing video campaigns — 5 leads.

If a particular category does not provide enough genuinely qualified prospects, prioritize quality over filling the quota and explain the shortage.

2. Services I'm Offering

- Custom ambient and atmospheric music.
- Focus and study music production.
- Background music for videos and digital content.
- Original instrumental soundtracks for indie games.
- Custom music compositions for creative projects.
- Exclusive music production tailored to specific projects.

3. Required Information for Each Lead

Please include the following information for every prospect:

1. Contact person's full name.
2. Professional role and decision-making position.
3. Company, channel, studio, or project name.
4. Industry and niche.
5. Direct professional email address.
6. Email verification status and verification source/tool.
7. Website, YouTube channel, LinkedIn profile, or other relevant professional link.
8. Country and time zone.
9. Short explanation of why the prospect is relevant.
10. Specific service they might need.
11. Evidence of potential demand or buying signals.
12. Link to the source supporting the buying signal.
13. Date when the prospect's activity or buying signal was last verified.

Decision-Maker Identification

Please prioritize people who can make or influence purchasing decisions.

Examples:

- Indie game studios: Founder, Game Director, Audio Director, Producer.
- YouTube channels: Channel Owner, Content Director, Producer.
- Production agencies: Creative Director, Video Producer, Agency Founder.
- Marketing agencies: Creative Director, Campaign Producer, Marketing Director.

Avoid listing employees who have no apparent connection to commissioning or purchasing music.

4. Lead Qualification & Purchase Likelihood

Each prospect must receive one of the following ratings:

HIGH
- Explicitly looking for a composer, music producer, or custom soundtrack.
- Has published a job listing or request for original music.
- Has an upcoming project with a clear need for custom music.
- Demonstrates strong, recent evidence of actively commissioning music.

MEDIUM
- Regularly produces content or develops projects requiring music.
- Has a consistent publishing schedule or active development pipeline.
- Uses background music regularly but has no confirmed current intention to purchase custom music.
- Shows a reasonable potential need for the services offered.

LOW
- Has only a general connection to the music or creative industry.
- No identifiable evidence of a current or recurring need for custom music.

Low-rated prospects should not be included in the final list of 50 qualified leads. Please replace them with better candidates.

For each prospect, explain the rating and provide supporting evidence rather than assigning arbitrary purchase probability percentages.

5. Buying Signals & Recent Activity

All prospects must have demonstrable activity within the last 30 days before the research is delivered.

Please look for:

- Recent content uploads or regular publishing activity.
- Upcoming game releases, development announcements, or project updates.
- Open calls for composers, music producers, or audio professionals.
- Recent hiring activity.
- Requests for custom music or soundtrack commissions.
- New video campaigns or active creative projects.
- Other publicly available indicators of potential demand.

For each prospect:

- Include the date of the latest relevant activity.
- Provide a direct link to the evidence.
- Briefly explain why this activity suggests potential demand.

Do not treat an account as active merely because its website or social media profile is still accessible.

6. Email Verification & Contact Accuracy

At least 90% of submitted email addresses should be verified using Hunter, NeverBounce, ZeroBounce, Apollo, or an equivalent email verification service.

Please follow these requirements:

- Prioritize direct professional email addresses.
- Do not fabricate or guess email addresses.
- Do not present unverified addresses as verified.
- Clearly distinguish between Valid, Accept-all, Unknown, and Invalid statuses.
- Include the verification tool or source used.
- Leave the email field empty if no reliable professional email can be found rather than inserting a generic or speculative address.

Generic addresses such as info@ or contact@ should only be included when no direct professional contact is publicly available, and must be clearly labeled as generic.

The 90% target applies to the submitted email addresses, not to prospects for whom no reliable email could be found.

7. Recommended Outreach Strategy

For each prospect, include a short recommendation explaining:

- Which of my services would be most relevant.
- What specific aspect of their content or project I should reference.
- What kind of personalized opening message could attract their attention.
- Why they might consider working with an independent music producer.

Avoid generic recommendations such as "offer music production services."

The goal is to make the information immediately use…

Project Description
We are looking for native Traditional Chinese speakers or experienced document sourcing specialists to help us source authentic, publicly available documents written in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文).

The collected documents will be used for AI training and language-related research. We are looking for genuine, real-world documents with meaningful content, natural language, and varied document layouts.

Native Traditional Chinese language knowledge is preferred to ensure accuracy and quality.
Document Requirements
- Must be written in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文).
- Each document should contain at least 300 words.
- Must contain meaningful, natural, and readable content.
- Each document must include at least 2 structural elements, such as:
 - Tables
 - Key-value fields
 - Signatures
 - Figures or images
 - Clickable fields
 - Text sections or headings
 - Lists, columns, or form fields
- Documents must be authentic and publicly available online.
- The original source URL must be provided.
- Submit the actual downloadable document (PDF, JPG, PNG, or another suitable format).
- Screenshots or captures of webpages are not accepted.
- The language must be clearly identifiable as Traditional Chinese, not Simplified Chinese.
- Documents must be complete, legible, and of reasonable quality.
Preferred Document Types
1. Loan and mortgage documents
2. Newspapers and news articles
3. Legal documents and notices
4. Contracts and agreements
5. Financial and environmental reports
6. Tax-related documents
7. Handwritten doctor's notes and applications
8. Receipts and invoices
9. Certificates of analysis
10. Insurance documents
11. Hospital claims and patient forms
12. Checks and deposit slips
13. Educational documents and reports
14. Government forms and public administration documents
15. Business letters and correspondence
16. Manuals, guides, and brochures
Domain-Based Sourcing
- We will provide a list of specific domains for document sourcing.
- You must source documents from the assigned domains only, unless otherwise approved.
- Verify the language, word count, document structure, authenticity, and quality before submission.
- Submit the original downloadable file along with its source URL.
Important Guidelines
- Only genuine, publicly available documents are accepted.
- Do not create, translate, recreate, or manually assemble documents.
- Documents must come from legitimate public sources or repositories.
- Do not combine multiple documents to meet the 300-word requirement.
- A single self-contained page from a multi-page document is acceptable only if it independently meets all requirements.
- Documents must be readable and written in Traditional Chinese.
- Do not submit documents containing private, confidential, or sensitive personal information.
- Duplicate documents will not be accepted.
Payment Details
- Payment: $2 per approved document.
- Payment will be made only for documents that meet all project requirements and pass quality review.
- Rejected or non-compliant documents will not be eligible for payment.
- Accuracy, authenticity, language quality, and compliance with the guidelines are essential.
Project Duration
This is an ongoing project with recurring document-sourcing batches. Freelancers who consistently submit high-quality documents may be invited to participate in future batches.

title: 3D Gear-Driven Model Train Racetrack
desc: I am a fashion designer working on a custom shirt inspired by Formula 1 racing, specifically the Monaco Grand Prix. I am looking to hire a professional 3D modeler to create a miniature, functional version of the Monaco racetrack that will be attached vertically to the back of the…
full:
I am a fashion designer working on a custom shirt inspired by Formula 1 racing, specifically the Monaco Grand Prix. I am looking to hire a professional 3D modeler to create a miniature, functional version of the Monaco racetrack that will be attached vertically to the back of the shirt.

The available installation area is approximately 25 inches long by 17 inches wide. I have attached reference images showing the desired racetrack orientation and the intended placement on the shirt.

What I Need:

I only need two primary components designed and 3D printed:

Hollow Racetrack Structure: An open-bottom, hollow 3D-printed version of the Monaco circuit. The track will house the chain and mechanical components internally, with an upper surface for the toy F1 cars to travel along. The underside should remain accessible for installation and maintenance.

Gear Mechanism: A compatible set of 3D-printed gears designed to guide and drive the chain continuously around the racetrack using my existing DC motor. An appropriate motor mount should also be incorporated into the design.

What I Already Have

I will supply the following components:

DC Motor: 13 mm x 24 mm (0.51 x 0.94 inches)
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0G65132VB

Chain: Already purchased. The gears and internal track mechanism should be designed to accommodate it. Attached below

Magnets: 0.19 x 0.07 inches
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BLSLZ8JN

Toy F1 Cars: 3.5 x 1.5 x 1.5 inches
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DB49GCXL

Intended Functionality

The chain will run inside the hollow racetrack and be driven by the motor and gears. Magnets attached to the chain will magnetically couple with magnets attached to the bottoms of the toy F1 cars, allowing the cars to move continuously around the circuit.

In summary, I already have the motor, chain, magnets, and cars. I am looking for someone to design and 3D print the hollow Monaco racetrack structure and the compatible gears needed to make the system work.

title: YouTube Weather News Video Edit

I'm looking for a creative and reliable YouTube video editor to work on a faceless weather and natural-disaster news channel called EventScope News.

Reference style: https://youtu.be/A2YFKELd1lI?si=OUwFgBNpM67kh08u

The goal is to create engaging, fast-paced YouTube videos that combine the presentation style of broadcast news with the visual storytelling and editing pace of popular science and documentary channels.

Project Overview

Each project will begin with a single weather-related topic or event. I will provide the subject and the angle I want the video to explore.

You will be responsible for bringing the story to life visually and editorially.

This includes sourcing suitable royalty-free or properly licensed stock footage, finding relevant images and video clips, developing engaging visual sequences, and creating graphics that help explain the story.

Topics may include:

- Extreme storms and hurricanes
- Flash floods and devastating rainfall
- Tornadoes and severe thunderstorms
- Heatwaves and extreme temperatures
- Blizzards and unusual winter weather
- Volcanic eruptions and earthquakes
- Other extraordinary weather and natural disasters

Editing Style and Expectations

I want videos that feel like professional weather reports but move at the pace of modern YouTube content.

The editing should include:

- Strong, attention-grabbing opening sequences.
- Fast-paced cuts and smooth transitions.
- Relevant weather footage and disaster visuals.
- Bold on-screen headlines and animated text.
- Professional lower thirds and location labels.
- Dynamic maps, weather graphics and data visualisations.
- Accurate captions and subtitles.
- Background music and sound effects that complement the story.
- A consistent visual identity that matches the EventScope News brand.

The overall presentation should be modern, polished, informative and visually engaging.

I don't want a simple slideshow or a basic compilation of random clips. Every visual should contribute to the story being told.

Video Structure

The typical video should run approximately 3–5 minutes, following this general structure:

1. Opening hook: Grab attention immediately with compelling visuals and a strong introduction.
2. Context: Introduce the event, location and important background information.
3. Main story: Explain what happened using relevant footage, graphics and narration.
4. Key facts: Highlight important figures, developments and verified information.
5. Conclusion: Deliver a satisfying ending and encourage audience engagement.

Responsibilities

The editor will be responsible for:

- Sourcing appropriate royalty-free or commercially licensed footage.
- Selecting relevant images, clips and supporting visuals.
- Creating engaging on-screen graphics and animations.
- Editing and arranging the complete video.
- Adding captions, music and sound effects.
- Maintaining accurate visual context and professional presentation.
- Providing a simple media-credit sheet listing third-party assets and their sources.

I will provide the topic and creative direction. The editor should be capable of independently developing the visual presentation and editing approach.

Deliverables

For every completed video, I expect:

- Final video: 1920 × 1080 Full HD MP4 (H.264), ready for YouTube upload.
- Subtitle file: Separate SRT file.
- Project file: Organised editable project in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro.
- Media credits: A simple document listing all third-party footage, images and other assets, including licence or permission details.

Turnaround and Revisions

- First draft: Within 3 days of receiving the topic and creative brief.
- Revisions: Up to 2 rounds of revisions included.
- Final delivery: After feedback and approval.

Ideal Editor

I'm looking for someone who:

- Has experience editing YouTube documentaries, news explainers or science videos.
- Understands modern YouTube pacing and audience retention.
- Can create attractive graphics, headlines and data visualisations.
- Knows how to source properly licensed footage.
- Has a good sense of storytelling and visual composition.
- Can consistently deliver high-quality work within agreed deadlines.

When applying, please provide:

1. Examples of similar YouTube videos you have edited.
2. Your preferred editing software.
3. Your price per completed video.
4. Your typical turnaround time.

I'm interested in building a long-term working relationship with the right editor as EventScope News grows.

# FoodShare – Turning Surplus Food into Hope!

**Every meal matters. Every small act of kindness counts. **

Food waste is a major global challenge, while many people still struggle to access food. With this thought, I developed **FoodShare**, a web-based platform designed to connect food donors with people who need food.

### Project Overview
FoodShare allows individuals and organisations to share surplus food with recipients, making food donation easier, more accessible, and better organised.

### Key Features
- User Registration and Secure Login.
- Role-Based Access for Donors and Recipients.
- Add and Manage Food Donations.
- Browse Available Food Donations.
- Request Food from Donors.
- Location-Based Food Discovery.
- Interactive Maps for Pickup Locations.
- Manage Donation Availability and Status.
- Responsive and User-Friendly Interface.
- Database Integration for Managing Users and Donations.

### Technology Stack
- **Frontend:** HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap.
- **Backend:** Python, Flask.
- **Database:** MySQL.
- **Additional Tools:** PyMySQL, Leaflet Maps, Geolocation API, Git, GitHub.
- **Deployment:** Render.

### Key Learnings
- Full Stack Web Application Development.
- Python Flask Backend Development.
- MySQL Database Design and Integration.
- Authentication and Session Management.
- CRUD Operations and API Development.
- Location-Based Services Integration.
- Real-World Problem-Solving and Deployment.

### Project Links
**Live Demo:** https://foodshare-81o9.onrender.com/

**GitHub:** https://github.com/chaudhari2004/FoodShare

### My Vision
I believe technology is most powerful when it solves real-world problems. FoodShare is my initiative to explore how web technology can help reduce food waste, encourage food sharing, and create a more responsible community.

**Built with Python, creativity, and a purpose to make a difference! **

title: 3D Miner & Worm Sprite Sheets
desc: I need a 3D character artist to create animated characters for a finished retro-style arcade game for PC (Steam). The game is friendly and suitable for children. The backgrounds are done; this job is the characters only. THE LOOK Rendered 3D cartoon characters, like a character f…
full:
I need a 3D character artist to create animated characters for a finished retro-style arcade game for PC (Steam). The game is friendly and suitable for children. The backgrounds are done; this job is the characters only.

THE LOOK
Rendered 3D cartoon characters, like a character from a modern animated film or a collectible toy figure: rounded volumes, soft lighting, real shading. Not flat 2D illustration and not pixel art.

THE METHOD
The game displays flat images, so you will model, rig and animate each character in 3D and then render every frame to PNG sprite sheets, using a fixed orthographic side camera and templates I supply. The game engine is not 3D: I need the rendered frames, plus your 3D source files at the end.

THE WORK
- Miner: a bearded miner with hard hat and pickaxe. 7 animations, 36 frames: walk, idle, dig, fill, climb from behind, caught, jump. Also rendered as separate parts (body, helmet, beard, pickaxe head) in a few colors, so players can change his look.
- Inchworm: 4 animations, 16 frames: inching walk, trapped, stunned, falling. Rendered in 5 body colors.
- 4 special inchworms: the same worm with added features (spikes, band, drill nose, stripes).
- 2 boss worms: a Queen and an Empress, larger, with crowns.
- Store art: one key illustration rendered from the same models, and a logo, exported in the sizes Steam requires.

DELIVERY
- PNG sprite sheets with transparent backgrounds, on a fixed grid, using my templates. Characters face right and animate in place. No ground shadow in the render.
- The 3D source files at the end: models, textures, rigs, animations and the render scene (Blender preferred, or FBX with textures).
- A short GIF or video of each animation for review.
Shortlisted artists receive a detailed specification with exact frame sizes, the camera and lighting setup, templates and reference images.

HOW THIS WILL RUN
- Milestone 1 is a small paid style test: still renders of the miner model and the worm model, plus a turntable of each. I approve the style before any animation starts.
- Then milestone payments as each group of characters is delivered.

TERMS
- Work made for hire: all rights in the models and artwork, including copyright, transfer to me on payment.
- No AI-generated models, textures or images at any stage. All work must be made by you. No purchased, stock or third-party models.
- The project is confidential.

TO BID, PLEASE INCLUDE
1. The word PICKAXE as the first word of your bid, so I know you read this.
2. Links to 2 or 3 stylized 3D characters that you modeled and animated yourself (video, turntable or rendered sprite sheets).
3. The software you would use.
4. One total price and one total delivery time for the whole job.
5. Confirmation that you accept the terms above.

Bids without these will not be considered.

title: Build Calm Hinglish Venting App Prototype
desc: Build a mobile-first web app prototype (responsive on desktop inside a centered mobile frame or full mobile layout) for a daily check-in and vent-out app in India called "Unpack" (or "Halka"). It is a private, calm, non-clinical decompression space—not a therapy or medical app—su…
full:
Build a mobile-first web app prototype (responsive on desktop inside a centered mobile frame or full mobile layout) for a daily check-in and vent-out app in India called "Unpack" (or "Halka"). It is a private, calm, non-clinical decompression space—not a therapy or medical app—supporting Hinglish, English, or a mix of both.

Design & Aesthetic:
- Warm, calm, low-stimulation UI with soft neutral surfaces (warm off-white/stone background, subtle cards, muted sage/slate/terracotta accents—no harsh neon or heavy clinical blues).
- Clear typography, generous spacing, zero clutter, and an unhurried feel.
- Include a subtle non-clinical disclaimer footer ("A private space to unpack everyday thoughts—not medical advice or therapy") and a quick "Need urgent support?" button that opens a calm crisis resources modal with Indian helplines: Tele-MANAS

Core Screens & Interactive Flows (Working Mock/Demo State + Optional Local Persistence):
1. Vent-First Onboarding (4 quick steps, no forced sign-up wall):
 - Screen 1: Warm headline ("A quiet space to let out what's sitting heavy today."), brief subcopy ("No judgment. No therapy jargon. Just a place to unpack your head and take a breath."), language vibe selector ("Hinglish", "English", "Mix of both"), and primary CTA "Start a quick vent".
 - Screen 2: Instant first check-in & vent—"How's your head right now?" with 1-tap mood pills ("Overwhelmed", "Drained", "Restless", "Mixed", "Okay") and optional 1-tap context tags ("Work", "Family", "Studies/Exams", "Money", "Relationships", "Sleep"). Include a large text area with placeholder "Type whatever is on your mind—messy, half-finished, or in Hinglish is totally fine." plus a simulated Voice Note button (records/simulates a 15–30s voice vent with a waveform timer and sample transcript option so the user can test it in the demo).
 - Screen 3: Calm Mirror + Tiny Reset card—displays a grounded, non-preachy 2–4 sentence reflection matching the user's selected language (Hinglish or English) and mood/tag, followed by one tiny 1-minute reset suggestion (e.g., "Put the phone face-down for 5 minutes and drink a glass of water") and a "Save & Continue" button.
 - Screen 4: Soft Privacy & Save step—let the user toggle a simulated 4-digit PIN lock, pick a daily check-in reminder time ("Night wind-down" or "Morning check-in"), and enter the main app.

2. Main Daily Check-In & Vent Hub:
 - Top bar with language toggle ("Hinglish" / "English" / "Mix"), privacy lock toggle, and Crisis Help button.
 - Rotating contextual prompt banner based on time of day / topic (include examples like "Aaj din bhar ka sabse heavy ya frustrating moment kya tha? Bilkul unfiltered likh do.", "Ghar ya rishton mein koi baat andar hi andar chubh rahi hai? Yahan sirf apne liye bol sakte ho.", "What's still replaying in your head from today that you didn't get to say out loud?", and "Low energy today? Drop just a line—or even a single word—on how today felt.").
 - Quick mood check-in + tag selector + vent composer with a "Burn / Ephemeral" toggle ("Wipe after reflection—don't save to history") and a "Save to Journal" option.
 - When submitted, generate a realistic mock reflection in the chosen tone (warm, concise, non-clinical, no toxic positivity, mirrors Hinglish naturally when selected). Also include a keyword check in the demo so typing self-harm/crisis keywords immediately triggers the crisis support modal.

3. Recent Vents & Gentle Pattern Mirror Tab/View:
 - Show saved vent entries (pre-populated with 3–4 realistic Indian sample entries in Hinglish and English across Work, Family, and Exams so the demo feels alive immediately) with mood/tag badges, ability to delete an individual entry or "Wipe All Data".
 - Include a "Gentle Patterns" card showing simple, non-clinical observations (e.g., frequency of tags like Family/Work/Exams and a "Close the loop" follow-up prompt like "Kal tumne [topic] ka zikr kiya tha—aaj scene thoda halka hua ya wahi atka hai?").

Make all buttons, toggles, language switches, voice-note simulation, burn mode, entry creation/deletion, and modals smoothly interactive with realistic sample data.

full:
I have an outdoor area that I want transformed into a striking, contemporary landscape. The space should immediately impress guests yet feel cohesive and low-maintenance once installed. A signature water element—a sleek fountain or still pond—must sit at the heart of the design and set the tone for the rest of the garden. 

Here’s how I picture the collaboration working: 
• Concept development: mood boards or rough sketches that capture the overall geometry, planting palette, lighting ideas, and the central water feature. 
• Detailed plan set: scaled drawings (SketchUp, AutoCAD, or similar) showing hard-scaping, plant placement, lighting points, and full construction details for the fountain/pond, including pumps and filtration. 
• Visuals: at least two high-resolution renderings or a short walkthrough animation to help me visualise the space before build. 
• Materials & plant list: quantities, sizes, and recommended suppliers where possible so I can source locally. 

I’ll provide current site photos and measurements as soon as we start. Two rounds of revisions are included so the final package feels just right. When everything is approved, deliver the files in PDF plus editable formats. 

If you love minimalist lines, understand modern outdoor lighting, and can make a water feature the undeniable focal point, I’m ready to get started right away.

# Digital Marketing Specialist Needed – Bottled Water Brand (UAE)

**Project Budget: AED 1,500 per Month (Fixed Price)**

We are looking for a creative, experienced, and results-driven Marketing Specialist to promote and market our bottled water products across the United Arab Emirates.

The goal is to increase brand awareness, attract potential customers, generate sales leads, and establish our water brand in the UAE market.

### Scope of Work & Responsibilities

 - Create engaging marketing content, posts, stories, and reels.
 - Develop a monthly social media marketing strategy.

2. **Brand Awareness & Promotion**
 - Promote our bottled water products across the UAE.
 - Identify and target potential customers and business opportunities.
 - Build brand visibility and engagement.

3. **Lead Generation**

 - Generate inquiries and potential sales leads.

4. **Digital Advertising**

5. **Monthly Reporting**

### Requirements
- Previous experience in digital marketing and social media management.
- Knowledge of the UAE market is highly preferred.
- Experience promoting FMCG, bottled water, beverages, or consumer products is an advantage.
- Creative content creation and marketing skills.
- Ability to generate genuine business leads.

### Budget & Payment

We are looking for a freelancer interested in a monthly working arrangement, with the possibility of long-term cooperation based on performance.

**When applying, please provide:**
- Your previous marketing experience.
- Examples of social media accounts or brands you have managed.
- Your proposed marketing strategy for our bottled water in the UAE.
- What deliverables you can provide within the AED 1,500 monthly budget.

We look forward to working with a motivated marketing professional who can help grow our bottled water business in the UAE.

title: Prototype Patented Electronic Lock Design -- 2
desc: I hold the provisional patent for a new electronic lock and now need a tangible, working prototype that demonstrates the concept end-to-end. Your role spans the full journey from engineering the electronics and firmware to shaping a robust outer casing and shipping a fully assemb…
full:
I hold the provisional patent for a new electronic lock and now need a tangible, working prototype that demonstrates the concept end-to-end. Your role spans the full journey from engineering the electronics and firmware to shaping a robust outer casing and shipping a fully assembled unit I can test in real-world conditions.

The core idea is already locked into the patent drawings and claims; what’s missing is the practical build. You’ll translate my sketches and legal diagrams into detailed CAD files, select and source components, lay out the PCB, write the control firmware, and integrate everything inside a sleek, durable enclosure. I am open on final materials—metal, plastic, or a hybrid—so long as the finishing feels premium and stands up to daily use.

While the patent text outlines baseline behaviour, I’m willing to explore value-adding features such as fingerprint recognition, keypad or app-based remote access if they can be delivered within a single prototype iteration. I’m relying on your experience to recommend the best microcontroller, sensors, and power strategy to keep the lock compact yet secure.

Deliverables
• Complete mechanical CAD of the lock body and internal mounts 
• Production-ready PCB layout, Gerber files, and BOM 
• Firmware source code with inline documentation 
• Assembled, fully functioning prototype shipped to me 
• Short video demo and a test report confirming the lock’s main functions match the patent description

Acceptance criteria: once the prototype arrives, it must power on, actuate reliably, and respond to the chosen authentication method at least 50 consecutive times without failure.

If you’ve taken similar concepts from patent to prototype before—especially in consumer security devices—let’s talk timelines and the best way to break the work into milestones.

The Company
Serving the People Who Serve the People
Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

I run a small but growing YouTube channel focused on home-style cooking and I’m looking for a reliable editor who can turn my raw kitchen footage into clean, recipe-centred videos. The finished pieces should feel straightforward and uncluttered—viewers need to follow each step easily without flashy transitions or fast cuts taking the spotlight away from the food.

For every episode I will provide the raw video files, separate voice-over recordings when needed, and any still images of the finished dish. Your job is to trim the clips, arrange them logically, and add simple graphics so that each recipe is crystal clear. The essentials I need in every upload are:

• Ingredient list and step-by-step cooking instructions 
• Voice-over or spoken instructions synced correctly 
• On-screen recipe text with accurate measurements 

I edit in Premiere Pro myself occasionally, so if you work in the Adobe suite that’s a plus, but any platform that delivers a high-quality 1080p file in YouTube-ready format is fine. Typical raw footage runs 15–20 minutes and final videos land around 8–10 minutes, though this can vary with the recipe.

Please share one or two sample cooking or instructional edits that show you can keep things neat, focused, and easy to follow. Let me know how quickly you can turn around an average video once the files are in your hands. Looking forward to collaborating and serving up great content together!

I need a clear, engaging animated diagram that follows seawater from intake through every treatment stage inside a 20 000 L-per-day, 20-ft shipping-container plant, finishing with the clean-water outlet. The piece will be shown to potential customers and investors, so it has to balance technical accuracy with easy-to-grasp visuals.

Visual approach
The style is an animated diagram, not photorealistic 3D. Think simplified equipment shapes, colour-coded pipes, arrows that show flow direction, and concise labels that appear at each step. Subtle motion—pumps spinning, valves opening, membranes glowing as salt is removed—will make the process intuitive without overwhelming viewers.

Content flow
• Intake and pre-filtration
• High-pressure pumping
• Reverse-osmosis rack
• Brine discharge
• Post-treatment and remineralisation
• Fresh-water tank and outlet connection

Each stage should briefly call out key performance data (flow rate, pressure or salinity drop) so a non-engineer can grasp the value.

Deliverables
• A 90–120 second HD video in MP4 (H.264) ready for web and pitch decks
• A version with and without on-screen text captions
• Editable project file (After Effects, Blender or equivalent) so we can update specs later
• Still frame of the full container layout for brochures

Acceptance criteria
The walkthrough must match the sequence above, keep equipment proportions consistent with a standard 20-ft container, and remain legible when played on a laptop screen in a meeting room.

The plant is designed for remote locations without supporting infrastructure. It must include a small 20 kW solar system for power, a computer panel, and a standalone Starlink system for remote access. The unit should also enable performance monitoring through its connection.

Timeline is not flexible require within a one week, but please indicate how many iterations you include for tweaks on labels, colours, or pacing.

I have two small (18 × 9 inch) differential-drive robots already moving under their own power—one on a C++ stack, the other on ROS 2. Both share the same hardware core: an Arduino Mega tied to a Cytron MDD2A motor driver, 12 V Li-Po packs, IMU, wheel encoders and a long-range data radio. 

Before I build the next iteration I want a qualified electronics engineer to comb through every part of the electrical design. The priority is a comprehensive review, with special emphasis on power handling, battery protection and, most critically, a rock-solid grounding scheme. 

Here’s what you will have to work with: 
• Current circuit and wiring diagrams 
• High-resolution photos of the robots, interior and exterior 
• Written notes that list every part, gauge, and connection 

What I need back: 
1. Annotated copy of a new schematic and wiring diagram highlighting risks, weak points or rule-of-thumb violations. 
2. Clear, actionable fixes for grounding and battery safety (fusing, reverse-polarity, cell balancing, etc.). 
3. Recommendations for modern, vibration-resistant wire-to-board and wire-to-wire connectors and an outline of a tidy wiring harness (crimp style, pin count, locking features). 
4. A short bill of materials change list so I can order everything in one shot. 

Feel free to use KiCad, Altium, or any other tool you prefer for mark-ups, but deliver the final notes in PDF plus the native file. Once I’ve implemented your suggestions I’ll power up under load; success is no voltage sag, no unexpected resets, and safe thermal behaviour. 

If that scope matches your expertise, let’s get started—I can share the full package the moment we agree on milestones.

We are a small development team working on AI-powered products and software solutions. We are looking for a creative and strategic marketing professional to collaborate with our team on brand storytelling, content strategy, and digital marketing initiatives.

The collaboration will involve working closely with our development team to promote AI-powered products, identify market opportunities, and develop effective marketing strategies.

Compensation and collaboration terms will be discussed and agreed upon before work begins. We are open to discussing performance-based compensation where appropriate.

### How to Apply

Please introduce yourself, describe your experience in marketing and storytelling, and share examples of previous marketing campaigns, brand narratives, content strategies, or writing projects.

We would also appreciate hearing how you approach building a brand story and attracting potential customers for a technology-based business.

We look forward to collaborating with someone creative, strategic, reliable, and interested in long-term cooperation.

title: Modern Professional Brand Logo Design
desc: We're looking for a graphic designer to create a professional logo for our company, Northline Studio. We want a clean, modern, and recognizable logo that looks equally good on a website, social media profiles, business documents, and other digital materials. The design should fee…
full:
We're looking for a graphic designer to create a professional logo for our company, Northline Studio.

We want a clean, modern, and recognizable logo that looks equally good on a website, social media profiles, business documents, and other digital materials. The design should feel professional and well-balanced, without unnecessary decorative elements or overly complicated graphics.

The main focus should be on the company name. We're interested in a strong wordmark design where typography plays the leading role. You may explore subtle geometric details or a small abstract element if it helps make the logo more distinctive, but the company name must remain the central part of the design.

Visual direction and colors

We would like to use a sophisticated combination of deep navy blue, warm copper, and off-white:

Deep Navy: #172A45 – the primary color, representing stability and professionalism.

Warm Copper: #C47A52 – an accent color that adds character and visual distinction.

Soft Ivory: #F5F2EA – a light background option.

Charcoal: #292D32 – an alternative dark neutral for text and secondary applications.

The overall appearance should be elegant, contemporary, and understated. Please avoid excessive gradients, shadows, 3D effects, and overly decorative fonts. We prefer a design that will remain relevant for years rather than follow a short-term trend.

Technical requirements

The logo should be designed as a vector graphic and remain sharp at any size. We need:

Original editable vector file in AI or SVG format.

EPS or PDF vector export.

High-resolution PNG with transparent background.

JPG version on a light background.

Full-color, monochrome, and reversed versions.

Horizontal and compact versions suitable for different placements.

A square version suitable for social media profile images.

The logo must work on both light and dark backgrounds. Please make sure the typography remains readable even when the logo is displayed at a relatively small size.

We will provide the exact company name and any additional feedback during the project. The designer should present 2–3 initial design concepts, after which we'll select one direction for refinement and final delivery.

We're looking for someone with experience in typography-based logo design, vector graphics, and professional brand marks. Adobe Illustrator or an equivalent vector design tool is expected.

Please include examples of logos you've personally designed in your proposal. We'd especially like to see clean wordmarks and modern corporate identities.

Budget: $250–$400 for the complete logo design.

Timeline: 5–7 days from the start of the project.

All communication, project discussions, agreements, and payments must remain within Freelancer.com. Payment will be handled exclusively through Freelancer Milestone Payments or Freelancer Time Tracker, depending on the agreed arrangement. No external payments or off-platform communication.

We're looking for a designer who can create something simple, distinctive, and professionally executed rather than just another generic logo.

I already have a complete 2-D floor plan for a small prefabricated mosque that includes the minaret, parapet wall, ablution and toilet blocks, plus a shaded gathering area. • Front entrance perspective 
• Side and rear perspectives (enough to understand service areas and shaded zone) 
• Aerial or bird’s-eye angle that captures the full site footprint, including the minaret and surrounding open space 

Deliverables 
• Four-sided architectural elevation drawings (DWG or PDF) scaled and annotated 
• High-resolution, photo-realistic 3-D renders for each of the three views above (JPEG/PNG + source file) 
• Native model file (Revit, SketchUp, or 3ds Max—whichever you use) so we can generate future sections if needed 

Acceptance criteria 
• Massing and dimensions must match the supplied 2-D plan exactly 
• Colors and textures clearly reflect the beige/ivory scheme 
• Minaret, parapet wall, and ablution/toilet blocks are all visible in at least one render 
• Final images sized for both presentation (300 dpi) and quick review (compressed web version) 

I will provide the DWG/PDF plans immediately on award. Feel free to work in Revit, SketchUp + V-Ray, Lumion, or similar—just specify your toolchain so we can open the native file later. Looking forward to seeing a crisp, contemporary interpretation of the design.

2. **AI Clinical Chart Review** – Automatically review OASIS assessments, physician orders, face-to-face encounters, Plan of Care (CMS-485), nursing notes, and therapy documentation.
3. **OASIS Quality Assurance** – Detect incomplete assessments, inconsistencies, potential coding errors, and documentation deficiencies.
4. **Intelligent Medical Coding** – AI-assisted ICD-10 diagnosis coding, sequencing, HCPCS review, and PDGM-related validation.
5. **Medicare Compliance & RCD Review** – Evaluate homebound status, skilled necessity, medical necessity, physician certification, and pre-claim review readiness.
6. **Recertification & Discharge Assistant** – Track certification periods, evaluate clinical documentation, and generate draft recertification justifications.
7. **Authorization Management** – Review payer requirements, prepare authorization packets, identify missing records, and draft appeal letters.
8. **Denial Prevention & Billing Readiness** – Cross-check orders, eligibility, documentation, and coding to identify potential claim denials.
9. **Clinical Documentation Improvement** – Identify inconsistencies, missing signatures, incorrect orders, and weak clinical documentation.
10. **AI Clinical Assistant** – Suggest patient-specific goals, interventions, patient education, and documentation improvements for clinician review.
11. **Scheduling & Field Operations** – Assist with clinician assignments, scheduling, route optimization, and travel-time planning.
12. **Analytics & Reporting Dashboard** – Display compliance scores, audit findings, patient status trends performance graphs downloadable reports.
13. **Document & Patient Management** – Secure PDF uploads document classification organized patient charts AI-powered document search.
14. **Security & Administration** – HIPAA-compliant architecture role-based access audit logs secure cloud storage data protection.

Additionally:
- We are particularly interested in developers who have built similar platforms before and can showcase their work or provide a demo of relevant past projects to demonstrate their expertise in this domain.

**Technical Requirements:**

- Integration with an existing advanced AI model through API.
- Ability to analyze multiple clinical documents together.
- Findings supported by document/page references and applicable CMS guidance.
- Human review and approval of clinical and coding recommendations.
- Clean modern responsive interface scalable architecture for additional modules future EHR integration full ownership of source code database application.

Sales Freelancer Wanted – Sell One Website

We are looking for a sales freelancer to acquire one paying client interested in developing a professional website or an online store (e-commerce).

1. Project Details

- Objective: Acquire one client and close one website sale.
- Website price: €1,500 + VAT.
- Sales commission: €125.
- Target market: Preferably Portugal.
- Services: Business websites, institutional websites and online stores.
- Delivery timeframe: Up to 2 months following approval of the requirements document and receipt of the initial payment.

2. Website Scope and Commercial Conditions

- Maximum of 10 website pages.
- For online stores, our team will upload up to 10 products using the product information and images provided by the client. Uploading additional products will be the client's responsibility.
- Domain registration and web hosting are not included in the price and must be paid separately by the client.
- Website maintenance is not included but can be contracted separately.
- Any additional functionalities or requirements beyond those agreed upon during the requirements definition meeting will require a separate quotation.

3. Client Payment Terms

The client will pay for the website in two instalments:

- 50% (€750 + VAT) upon finalisation and approval of the requirements document.
- 50% (€750 + VAT) upon delivery of the completed website.

4. Freelancer Commission and Payment Structure

The €125 sales commission will be paid in two milestones:

- 50% (€62.50) upon signing the contract with the client.
- 50% (€62.50) upon receiving the client's final payment.

This is a commission-based opportunity. The freelancer will only be paid if the client purchases the service.

No payment will be made for leads, prospecting activities, meetings or other activities that do not result in a successful sale.

5. Our Portfolio

Examples of websites we have already developed:

- https://macieiradoce.pt/
- https://donaantonia.pt/
- https://mercadinhodavila.pt/
- https://trustmotors.pt/
- https://minhoagricola.pt/

6. Sales and Development Process

- Step 1: The freelancer identifies and approaches potential clients.
- Step 2: The freelancer presents our website development services, price and commercial conditions.
- Step 3: The freelancer confirms that the client genuinely intends to purchase the service and agrees to the price and payment terms.
- Step 4: Our technical team conducts a requirements meeting directly with the qualified client to define:
 - Website template and design.
 - Number of pages.
 - Content and images.
 - Required functionalities.
 - Specific business requirements.
- Step 5: The requirements document is finalised and approved, and the contract is signed.
- Step 6: The client makes the initial payment of 50%.
- Step 7: Our technical team develops and delivers the website within the agreed timeframe.
- Step 8: The client pays the remaining 50%.

Important: The requirements meeting will only take place once the client has expressed a clear intention to purchase the service and agreed to the price and commercial conditions. We are not looking for exploratory meetings with unqualified prospects.

7. Freelancer Responsibilities

- Identify and contact potential clients.
- Present and promote our website development services.
- Qualify potential clients.
- Communicate the price, payment terms and commercial conditions.
- Confirm the client's intention to purchase.
- Facilitate the successful closure of the sale.

The freelancer is free to choose their own sales and prospecting channels, including LinkedIn, email, telephone, social media, professional networks or direct business outreach.

No website development, technical knowledge or requirements gathering is required from the freelancer. Our team will handle all technical activities.

8. Long-Term Collaboration Opportunity

Our initial goal is to start with one client and one website sale to establish a successful working relationship.

Once the freelancer successfully closes the first sale, we intend to extend the collaboration to acquire additional clients and generate further sales.

We are looking for a reliable, results-oriented sales partner with whom we can establish a long-term collaboration. However, at this stage, the scope of this project is limited to one website sale.

One client. One website sale. €125 commission. Potential for long-term collaboration.

We are looking for an experienced **Figma UI/UX Designer** to completely redesign our existing salon website, creating a modern, elegant and premium online experience.

**Business:** Fruition for Hair – Aroha Glow Hair & Beauty 
**Location:** Auckland, New Zealand

### Project Scope

We want to redesign our existing website from scratch in Figma, including a refreshed visual identity, improved user experience and a complete set of website page designs.

Our preferred style is modern, luxurious, elegant and minimal, inspired by premium hair and beauty salon websites.

### Required Website Pages

1. Home
2. About Us
3. Hair Services
4. Hair Colour & Highlights
5. Keratin, Nanoplasty & Hair Treatments
6. Beauty Services
7. Facial & Skincare
8. Nail Spa & Nail Art
9. Eyelash Extensions
10. Waxing
11. Our Gallery / Portfolio
12. Shop / Online Store
13. Individual Product Pages
14. Promotions & Special Offers
15. Contact Us
16. FAQs

- Complete UI/UX design in Figma.
- Premium and luxury salon-inspired design.
- Fully responsive desktop, tablet and mobile layouts.

- Clear online booking and appointment call-to-action buttons.
- Ecommerce-friendly layouts for beauty and haircare products.
- Easy navigation and user-friendly page structure.
- SEO-friendly page layout and content hierarchy.

We also plan to introduce an online store with salon pickup and delivery options.

### What We Expect

- Complete Figma design for all agreed website pages.
- Desktop and mobile versions.
- Reusable components and design system.
- Properly organised Figma source file.
- Developer-ready designs with specifications and assets.

- Your portfolio of previous website UI/UX projects.
- Examples of luxury salon, beauty or ecommerce website designs.
- Your proposed timeline.
- Your fixed project price.
- Confirmation that you will provide the complete editable Figma source file.

**We are looking for someone with a strong design sense who can transform our existing website into a premium hair and beauty brand experience.**

- Precio cerrado por todo el desarrollo

title: Low-Poly Soccer Pinball Cabinet Artist
desc: 3D Low-Poly & Texture Artist (Blender -> Three.js / Rapier3D) for Arcade Pinball Cabinet ("Golero - Pambolero") Project Overview: We are developing Golero - Pambolero, a 60fps web/mobile skill-based arcade game inspired by traditional Mexican soccer pinball machines ("5, 6, 7" ca…
full:
3D Low-Poly & Texture Artist (Blender -> Three.js / Rapier3D) for Arcade Pinball Cabinet ("Golero - Pambolero")
Project Overview:
We are developing Golero - Pambolero, a 60fps web/mobile skill-based arcade game inspired by traditional Mexican soccer pinball machines ("5, 6, 7" cabinets, see attached reference photos).
Our tech stack runs on Three.js, Vite, Rapier3D (physics), and GSAP (camera presets). We are looking for a 3D Artist to create exclusively the 3D arcade cabinet and its embedded graphic artwork (note: 2D app menus and HUD interfaces are handled separately by our UI team).
During gameplay, GSAP camera presets will zoom and orbit around the cabinet to highlight key moments—such as framing the top backglass/buttons, panning to the coin slot on credit insert, or zooming into the bottom dispenser tray to watch prize coins drop via physics.
Scope of Work & Technical Deliverables:
1. Lightweight Low-Poly 3D Cabinet (Blender -> .glb):
 • Stylized, clean low-poly 3D model of the arcade machine with baked lighting / Ambient Occlusion (AO) so it looks rich and vibrant without heavy real-time shadows.
 • Performance Budget: Optimized for 60fps mobile browsers (under 15k–25k triangles total and < 8 MB final .glb size).
 • Separate Pivot-Ready Meshes & Naming Convention: All interactive and physics-enabled parts must be separated, cleanly named (e.g., btn_start, plunger_rod, coin_slot_led, dispense_tray, playfield_collider), and have accurate local origin/pivot points for GSAP animations and Rapier3D colliders:
 • Top arcade push buttons (Start, Multipliers).
 • Side spring/plunger launch mechanism.
 • Coin acceptor bezel & a standalone 3D coin mesh (for coin-insert and payout animations).
 • Slanted playfield board, metallic rails, bumpers, scoring holes, and transparent glass cover.
2. Cabinet 2D Graphic Artwork & Atlased Textures (.webp / .ktx2):
 • Texture Atlasing: Pack materials efficiently into shared texture atlases (max 1024x1024 or 2048x2048) to minimize WebGL draw calls.
 • Upper Backglass / Scoreboard: Custom 2D vector/illustrated soccer artwork mapped to the upper display, including multiplier rings, roulette lights, and separate emissive maps/materials for the LED score counters so Three.js can toggle lights on/off via code.
 • Playfield Surface Texture: Crisp, high-contrast 2D board artwork (stadium turf, pitch lines, hole numbers, and original soccer badges).
 • Cabinet Side Art & Control Panel Decals: Custom branding ("Golero - Pambolero") and physical button labels.
 • Strict Legal Requirement: All player illustrations and team emblems must be 100% original and copyright-free (do not copy real players or club logos from the reference photos).
Ideal Candidate Requirements:
• Proven experience in Blender (low-poly modeling, UV unwrapping, texture baking, PBR/emissive materials).
• Strong understanding of the Blender-to-Three.js pipeline (.glb/.gltf export, Draco compression, clean node hierarchy, origin points, low draw calls).
• 2D vector/illustration skills (Illustrator/Photoshop) to design the vibrant soccer-themed cabinet decals and playfield board.
To Apply, Please Include:
1. Portfolio links showing low-poly 3D assets/machines and 2D texture artwork (live Three.js/WebGL demos are a huge plus).
2. A brief note on how you bake lighting and structure .glb hierarchies for Three.js developers.
3. Estimated timeline and fixed/milestone quote for this 3D cabinet + texture package
