full:
# Travel Photo & Video Editor – Insta360 X5, DJI & Underwater Footage

We are a Canadian travel company looking for an experienced and creative photo and video editor to help us process content from a recent Windstar cruise in French Polynesia, including Tahiti, Bora Bora and several other beautiful islands.

We have a collection of photos and videos captured using an Insta360 X5, a DJI camera and smartphones. The footage includes beautiful landscapes, underwater marine life, snorkelling, island excursions, local culture, dining experiences and life on board the cruise ship.

The content will be used for our company's travel blog, YouTube channel, social media, future destination marketing and our personal photo and video collections.

## Scope of Work

- Review the original photos and videos and identify the best content.
- Process, edit, reframe and enhance native Insta360 360-degree footage.
- Improve underwater footage, including colour correction, distortion and stitching issues, where technically possible.
- Extract high-quality still photographs from Insta360 and other video footage, selecting the best angles and moments.
- Edit and enhance existing photographs, including colour correction, lighting, sharpness and composition.
- Edit and enhance DJI and smartphone video footage.
- Create engaging travel highlight videos and short promotional videos.
- Organize the edited material by destination and experience.

**Important:** The underwater Insta360 X5 footage was recorded without a dedicated dive enclosure. We understand that this may create distortion and stitching issues. We are looking for someone who understands these technical challenges and can maximize the quality of the usable footage, including working with individual lens views if necessary.

## Expected Deliverables

- High-resolution edited photographs suitable for our website, marketing materials, personal photo albums and printing, where source quality permits.
- High-quality still photographs extracted from video footage.
- Individual edited and reframed video clips that our marketing team can reuse for future projects.
- Finished travel highlight and promotional videos suitable for YouTube and our travel blog.
- Short vertical videos suitable for Instagram Reels and other social media platforms.
- Edited photographs and videos for our personal collection.
- Organized, full-quality edited files and relevant editable project files.

The exact number and length of the videos and photographs will be determined after reviewing the original material and discussing recommendations with our marketing team.

Our immediate priority is receiving high-quality photos and videos for our upcoming travel blog. We would appreciate receiving completed material progressively rather than waiting until the entire project is finished.

## Editing Style

We are looking for a natural, authentic and cinematic editing style.

We want to showcase the incredible beauty of French Polynesia, its landscapes, turquoise waters, underwater marine life, local culture and the luxury small-ship cruise experience.

We prefer:

- Natural and realistic colours.
- Smooth and professional editing.
- Creative framing and composition.
- Appropriate background music and natural environmental sounds.
- Minimal and tasteful transitions and effects.
- Authentic storytelling rather than overly commercial or artificial-looking content.

## Required Experience

- Insta360 Studio or equivalent professional 360-degree editing software.
- Experience working directly with native Insta360 INSV files.
- 360-degree video reframing and editing.
- Underwater photo and video editing.
- Underwater colour correction and distortion management.
- DJI camera footage.
- High-quality still image extraction from video footage.
- Photo editing and enhancement.
- Travel, tourism or lifestyle video editing.

## Ownership and Confidentiality

All delivered content must be suitable for commercial marketing use, including properly licensed music where applicable.

All original and edited material must remain confidential and must not be published, shared with third parties or used in portfolios without our permission.

We must retain ownership and unrestricted usage rights to the commissioned deliverables, excluding any separately licensed third-party assets.

## When Applying

Please provide:

- Examples of your previous Insta360 editing work.
- Examples of underwater footage you have corrected or enhanced, preferably before-and-after examples.
- Examples of travel photography and video editing.
- Your experience extracting high-quality photographs from video footage.
- How you would approach underwater Insta360 footage recorded without a dive enclosure.
- Your hourly rate and availability.

We are open to creative suggestions and recommendations. We are looking for someone who can work independently, identify the best material and deliver high-quality results without requiring detailed instructions for every photo or video.

There is potential for ongoing work involving future travel experiences and destinations if we are happy with the results of this project.

full:
TikTok Video Editor Needed – Editing Ready-Made Footage into Engaging Short Videos

I'm looking for a creative and reliable video editor who can help us turn existing video footage into polished, engaging TikTok videos. We already have the raw recordings, so this is strictly an editing position. You won't need to film anything, appear on camera, or create video concepts from scratch.

The main idea is to take our ready-made footage and turn it into short videos that people actually want to watch. We need someone who understands TikTok's pace, knows how to keep viewers interested during the first few seconds, and can make even simple footage look professional and dynamic.

The work will involve cutting and arranging existing clips, removing unnecessary pauses, improving the overall rhythm, adding captions and subtitles, using suitable transitions, adding background music and sound effects where appropriate, and making sure the final video feels natural rather than overedited. Some videos may also need animated text, simple motion graphics, zoom-ins, highlighted words, or other visual details that help emphasize important moments.

We are not looking for someone who simply puts clips together and adds automatic subtitles. We want an editor who pays attention to timing, storytelling, visual consistency, and the overall viewing experience. The first few seconds are particularly important, so you should know how to make an opening more interesting without making it look artificial or clickbait-heavy.

All videos should be edited in a vertical 9:16 format, preferably 1080 × 1920 resolution, and optimized for TikTok. You should be comfortable working with different video lengths, depending on the original material and the topic. Most videos will be approximately 15–60 seconds long, although some may be slightly longer.

What we'll provide

We'll supply the original recorded footage, basic information about each video, and any necessary instructions regarding the message or important moments that should be included. If we have reference videos, examples of editing styles, logos, brand assets, or specific visual preferences, we'll share those as well.

You won't have to search for footage or shoot additional material. Your responsibility is to work with what we provide and deliver finished videos that are ready to publish.

Who we're looking for

You should have practical experience editing short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts. Please be comfortable using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or another professional editing tool.

A good understanding of subtitles, typography, pacing, sound design, and vertical video composition is important. You should also be able to follow references while bringing your own editing judgment to the project.

Reliability matters just as much as editing skills. We need someone who communicates clearly, respects agreed deadlines, responds to feedback, and can make reasonable revisions when needed.

When applying, please include a few examples of TikTok-style videos you've edited yourself. We'd especially like to see examples where you worked with existing footage rather than creating videos entirely from scratch. Also, briefly tell us which editing software you normally use and how many short videos you can realistically complete per week.

**Budget and timeline**

Our initial budget is $150–$300 for the first batch of approximately 10 edited videos, depending on their complexity and your experience. We are open to discussing a suitable fixed price before starting.

We would like the first batch completed within 5–7 days after receiving all the footage and instructions. If the collaboration goes well, there is an opportunity for regular weekly work with additional batches of videos.

Communication and payment

All communication, file-related discussions, project agreements, and payments must remain within Freelancer.com. Payments will be handled exclusively through Freelancer Milestone Payments or Freelancer's Time Tracker, depending on the agreed project arrangement. We do not use external payment methods or off-platform communication.

I'm looking for someone who can become a reliable editing partner rather than just complete one isolated task. If you enjoy making short videos more engaging and know how to work with ready-made footage, I'd be happy to hear from you.

desc: I'm developing an original anime-inspired sci-fi mystery series titled **“11:11 — AFTER TOMORROW.”** I need an experienced screenplay writer to write and professionally structure **Episode 1: “THE RED CARD”**, a cinematic short film of approximately 5 minutes. The story is set in…
full:
I'm developing an original anime-inspired sci-fi mystery series titled **“11:11 — AFTER TOMORROW.”**

I need an experienced screenplay writer to write and professionally structure **Episode 1: “THE RED CARD”**, a cinematic short film of approximately 5 minutes.

The story is set in Japan and follows high-school students during a mysterious phenomenon where people suddenly disappear, often around 11:11. The protagonist, Ren, discovers a mysterious red card connected to a girl named Mika and a strange telephone booth. This booth is connected to a future world where the missing people are transported.

I already have the complete story concept, characters, major events, and episode ending planned. I need a writer who can transform my story into a professional screenplay without changing its original vision.

### Production Method

This project will be produced using AI video-generation tools such as **Higgsfield AI, Kling AI, and similar AI image/video generation software**.

We will **not be creating traditional hand-drawn animation**. We will not be manually drawing every frame or animating characters frame by frame.

Our production workflow will primarily involve:
- Generating character and scene images using AI image prompts.
- Creating cinematic video shots from images and text prompts.
- Using AI video-generation tools for camera movements, character actions and scene transitions.
- Editing the generated shots together into the final short film.

Therefore, the screenplay must be specifically suitable for **AI-generated cinematic video production**.

### What I Need From the Writer

- Professional screenplay format.
- Cinematic scene descriptions.
- Natural, engaging dialogue.
- Mystery, suspense and thriller atmosphere.
- Proper pacing for a 5-minute episode.
- Scene-by-scene breakdown.
- Character emotions, actions and expressions.
- Clear visual descriptions that can be converted into AI image prompts.
- Scenes that are achievable using AI image-to-video and text-to-video generation.
- Camera angles and camera movements where appropriate.
- Avoid unnecessarily complex actions that would be difficult to generate consistently with AI.
- Strong cliffhanger ending.

### AI Production-Friendly Writing

Each scene and shot should be visually clear and easy to convert into an AI generation prompt.

For example, rather than describing complicated continuous animation, scenes should be structured around cinematic shots such as:
- Wide establishing shots.
- Close-ups of characters.
- Character reactions.
- Slow camera movements.
- Atmospheric environments.
- Simple, clear character actions.
- Dramatic visual moments.
- Short cinematic sequences that can be generated separately and edited together.

Character appearance and locations must remain consistent throughout the film, as we will use AI reference images and character consistency workflows.

### Creative Direction

Genre: Sci-Fi, Mystery, Thriller and Survival.

Visual style: Cinematic anime with detailed backgrounds, dramatic lighting and atmospheric environments.

The story should feel mysterious, emotionally engaging and cinematic. Avoid generic, predictable or cliché dialogue.

I already have the main story, characters, major events and ending planned. **I am not looking for a completely new story.** I want a professional writer to enhance, structure and polish my existing story while preserving my original vision.

### Deliverables

1. Complete 5-minute screenplay.
2. Scene-by-scene breakdown.
3. Dialogue and character actions.
4. Visual descriptions for every scene.
5. Suggested camera angles and movements.
6. Approximate timing for each scene.
7. AI-production-friendly shot structure.
8. Strong Episode 1 ending/cliffhanger.

Please share your relevant writing samples, experience with sci-fi/mystery/animation scripts, estimated delivery time and quotation.

title: Graphic Designer (Fully Remote)
desc: Metricool is a social media management tool that helps freelancers, agencies, and marketing teams stay on top of their daily work. Behind every calendar, report, and post, there’s someone juggling deadlines and trying to make sense of their numbers—and our job is to make that wor…
full:
Metricool is a social media management tool that helps freelancers, agencies, and marketing teams stay on top of their daily work. Behind every calendar, report, and post, there’s someone juggling deadlines and trying to make sense of their numbers—and our job is to make that work clearer and calmer.
As a Graphic Designer on our Content team, you’ll report to the Content Team Manager and work closely with the people leading Social, YouTube, Lead Magnets, and Emails. Your mission will be to bring design into the process from the very start. You’ll join at the brief, propose formats, push back when something doesn’t add up, and review performance data to see what actually worked. When a format proves itself, you’ll turn it into a reusable template for the rest of the team.
You’ll work 100% remotely as part of an international team publishing in four languages, where good design means clear hierarchy, clean data, and visuals that earn attention without shouting.
Your day-to-day
The design team shares this work and splits it by project:

• Design for social across four markets.You’ll create static posts and carousels for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, and Pinterest in English, Spanish, German and French, adapting to each platform and market. The copy comes from the Social team, so you don’t need to speak all four languages.

• Make thumbnails that earn the click. You’ll design YouTube thumbnails and run A/B tests on key videos to learn what resonates with our audience.

• Turn complex data into clear layouts. You’ll design industry reports, templates, and guides so readers can grasp the numbers at a glance.

• Design the landing pages for our resources.You’ll design the pages behind our resource downloads, focusing on clarity and visual flow.

• Maintain and evolve our design system. Alongside the rest of the design team, you’ll update Content’s templates, components, and usage rules.

• Iterate based on results. You’ll review how your pieces perform with each channel lead and adjust your approach based on real numbers.

What we’re looking for

• Design that starts with a "why".Before opening Figma, you ask what the piece is meant to achieve. You can explain the reasoning behind your layout and typography choices, and your portfolio reflects that.

• An eye on performance. You look at clicks, saves, and downloads, draw your own conclusions, and apply them to your next piece. Experience running A/B tests or design experiments is a plus.

• 3+ years in digital and social design.You understand how different platforms behave and have designed social posts, thumbnails, and landing pages.

• Strong editorial and data skills. You’ve laid out multi-page documents like reports and know how to use typography, hierarchy, and charts to make information easy to scan.

• Fluency in Figma. Components, auto layout, and shared libraries are part of your daily workflow.

• Systems thinking. You’ve built and documented design systems that non-designers can use without breaking brand consistency. Experience with AI-assisted design workflows is a plus.

• Versatility.A YouTube thumbnail, an Instagram carousel, and a 40-page report each require a different approach, and you adapt easily between them. Motion design basics are a bonus.

• Comfort with open briefs. You don’t need every detail locked down before starting. You propose ideas, iterate quickly, and speak up when a brief feels off.

• Openness to feedback. You see feedback as a way to make the work better. You share early drafts, welcome other points of view and give your own with care.

• Organization and autonomy.You can juggle multiple channels and markets at once while keeping your files and process clean.

• Spanish and advanced English. German or French is a big plus.

What your first months will look like

• Month 1: You’ll get familiar with our brand identity, our design system, and the reasoning behind it, along with each channel’s goals and market nuances. You’ll start designing social posts and thumbnails with regular team reviews.

# Project Title: Professional Logo Animation for Rock Band – DRONA

The animation will be used as a background visual on a large LED screen/projector during our live stage performances.

- We will provide our existing band logo.
- Create one complete, professionally animated logo visual.
- Animation duration: Approximately 20–30 seconds.
- The animation must be seamlessly loopable, allowing us to play it continuously throughout an entire live show without any noticeable beginning, ending or interruption.
- Resolution: Minimum 1920 × 1080 (Full HD), preferably 4K.
- Aspect ratio: 16:9 (Landscape).
- Final delivery in high-quality MP4 format.

### Deliverables

1. One completed logo animation, ready for live stage projection.
2. A perfectly seamless looping version.
3. Original project/source files.

We are looking for someone with a strong creative vision and experience in motion graphics, logo animation and visual effects.

I am looking for an experienced Python developer to work on the initial stage of my ASTRA AI cryptocurrency trading system.

I already have an existing project developed in Replit. The first task is to carefully review, audit, and understand the existing codebase before making any changes.

My goal is to build a reliable, professional, clean, and modular trading system foundation that can be expanded in future stages without requiring a complete rebuild.

An important requirement is that ASTRA must be designed from the beginning to support both Binance USDⓈ-M Futures Demo Trading and Live Trading within the same system.

I want to avoid expensive redevelopment when transitioning from Demo Trading to Live Trading in the future.

Initial Stage Scope:
- Review and audit the existing Replit project and its codebase.
- Identify existing bugs, incomplete features, and architectural issues.
- Integrate Binance USDⓈ-M Futures API with support for both Demo and Live environments.
- Build a configurable system that allows switching between Demo and Live trading modes.
- Implement market data collection and cryptocurrency market scanning.
- Implement technical indicators and basic market analysis.
- Develop a paper-trading system for testing strategies without real money.
- Develop the necessary foundation for real-money order execution.
- Design account balance monitoring, position management, and order management components for Live Trading.
- Implement database storage for trades, trading history, market data, and system activity.
- Build a clean, modular, secure, and extendable architecture for future AI development.
- Include proper risk controls and safety mechanisms for both Demo and Live modes.

Future Development Compatibility:
The initial foundation must be designed so that future developers can add advanced AI capabilities without rebuilding the entire system. Future stages may include:
- AI-based market analysis across multiple timeframes.
- Automated selection between scalping and swing trading.
- AI-driven entry, take-profit, and stop-loss decisions.
- Advanced risk management and capital protection.
- Strategy evaluation, learning, and performance optimization.
- Autonomous trading and monitoring.
- Improved AI decision-making and strategy adaptation. These advanced AI features are not required to be fully implemented in this initial stage. However, the architecture must be prepared to support these future capabilities.

Deliverables 
• Fully functional website with source code, design assets, and documentation. 
• Admin credentials plus a short video or PDF walkthrough showing how to manage content and view bookings. 
• One-month post-launch support for bug fixes.

Acceptance criteria 
• Users can complete a booking, receive both email and text confirmations, then reschedule or cancel successfully—all without human intervention. 
• AI assistant answers booking-related questions with an accuracy rate of at least 90 % in testing. 
• Page load time under 2 s on a standard 4G mobile connection.

If you have a proven track record building clean, performant sites with integrated AI chat or booking systems, I’m ready to see your approach and timeline.

desc: About WuMa Matchmaking: WuMa Matchmaking is a New York-based matchmaking company dedicated to helping Western men and Asian women build meaningful, serious, and long-term relationships. We are looking for an experienced affiliate marketing professional, publisher recruitment spec…
full:
About WuMa Matchmaking:

WuMa Matchmaking is a New York-based matchmaking company dedicated to helping Western men and Asian women build meaningful, serious, and long-term relationships.

We are looking for an experienced affiliate marketing professional, publisher recruitment specialist, or agency with an established network of affiliates and publishers to help us acquire genuine users and increase verified registrations on our website.

Project Objectives:

Our primary goal is to attract genuine, relevant users to our website and convert them into completed registrations.

We are particularly interested in reaching Western men, especially in the United States and Canada, who are interested in serious relationships and cross-cultural matchmaking.

Responsibilities:

1. Publisher & Affiliate Recruitment: Identify, recruit, and onboard relevant publishers and affiliates who can promote WuMa Matchmaking through their existing websites, communities, content platforms, email lists, and other marketing channels.

2. Publisher Network Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with publishers, coordinate promotional campaigns, and manage ongoing partnerships.

3. User Acquisition: Develop effective promotional strategies to drive genuine, high-quality traffic and completed registrations to our website.

4. Campaign Optimization: Monitor publisher performance, analyze traffic quality, and continuously optimize campaigns to improve registration conversion rates.

5. Performance Tracking & Reporting: Provide transparent reports covering publisher sources, traffic, clicks, completed registrations, conversion rates, and other relevant performance metrics.

Requirements:

- Proven experience in affiliate marketing, publisher recruitment, or performance-based user acquisition.
- An established network of publishers, affiliates, or relevant media partners is highly preferred.
- Experience working with international markets, particularly the US, Canada, and other Western countries.
- Ability to identify publishers whose audiences match our target users.
- Experience in dating, matchmaking, relationship services, or similar industries is a strong advantage.
- Familiarity with affiliate tracking platforms, CPA/CPL models, and conversion tracking.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to build long-term partnerships.

What We Expect:

- A clear strategy for recruiting and managing publishers.
- Details of your existing publisher network and promotional channels.
- An estimated number of publishers you can onboard.
- A clear plan for generating genuine and completed website registrations.
- Transparent performance reporting and measurable results.

Partnership & Compensation:

We are open to discussing different cooperation models, including:

- Fixed monthly management fees.
- Performance-based payments per qualified registration.
- Hybrid models combining management fees and performance commissions.

Compensation and targets will be discussed based on your experience, network resources, and proposed strategy.

Important: We prioritize genuine, relevant registrations rather than simply clicks, impressions, or low-quality leads. Fake accounts, bots, duplicate registrations, and misleading or incentivized traffic are not acceptable.

How to Apply:

Please include the following in your proposal:
1. Your experience in affiliate marketing and publisher recruitment.
2. The types and approximate number of publishers in your existing network.
3. Your main promotional channels and geographical coverage.
4. Examples of previous user acquisition campaigns and measurable results.
5. Your proposed cooperation model and pricing structure.

We are looking for a reliable long-term partner who can help WuMa Matchmaking build a sustainable publisher network and achieve consistent user growth.

title: Design 20 Fun Notebook Covers – 5 Novelty Concepts, 4 Designs Each (Print-Ready)
desc: We are Paperforce India LLP, a notebook manufacturer and exporter in Mumbai. We are building a range of novelty notebooks for a US retailer. The shoppers are teens and young adults, and the notebooks sell at about $5. Each notebook looks like an everyday object, and the cover mak…
full:
We are Paperforce India LLP, a notebook manufacturer and exporter in Mumbai. We are building a range of novelty notebooks for a US retailer. The shoppers are teens and young adults, and the notebooks sell at about $5.

Each notebook looks like an everyday object, and the cover makes a funny, relatable joke. We have 5 concepts, with rough mockups and copy lines for each. We need a designer to turn them into polished, print-ready artwork.

WHAT WE NEED
4 different cover designs for each of the 5 concepts = 20 designs in total, with front and back covers.

THE 5 CONCEPTS
1. THE RECEIPT
A long, narrow pad (about 10 x 21 cm, top-bound, straight bottom edge) printed like a shop receipt: items, totals and a barcode, for example "TOTAL: 0 REGRETS". The look is 1-colour, black on white.

2. THE CHAT SCREEN
A notebook the exact size of an iPhone 18 Pro Max (163.4 x 78 mm) with rounded die-cut corners. The cover is a funny late-night text thread, for example with "bestie", "mom", "crush" or "group chat".

3. THE SNACK PACK
A5. The front is an invented snack brand (chips, cereal, juice box, noodles). The back has a joke "Nutrition Facts" panel, for example "Overthinking 200%".

4. PASSPORT / BOARDING PASS
Passport size (125 x 88 mm). One cover is a passport for the "Republic of Daydreams". The other is a boarding pass, for example "MON to ANY, Seat: Window, always". It can also be a luggage tag or a postcard.

5. THE TRI-FOLD
A notebook that folds like a tri-fold phone. It is A4 (297 x 210 mm) when fully open, and each of the 3 panels is 99 x 210 mm. Closed, the cover looks like a phone "lock screen" with funny notifications. The inside panel headers are To Do / Notes / Doodle.

We will share a PPT and reference mockups with the shortlisted designers. The mockups are direction only: we want you to improve on them, not copy them.

DELIVERABLES
- 20 cover designs (4 per concept), front and back
- Print-ready files: AI or PDF, CMYK, 300 dpi, 3 mm bleed, text outlined
- Built on our dielines (we will provide them)
- Editable source files
- JPG previews / mockups of each design

RULES
- 100% original artwork
- No real brands, logos, trademarks, celebrities or characters. Brand names must be invented and must not look like real snack, phone or airline brands.
- Only fonts and images that are licensed for commercial print
- Full copyright and ownership pass to Paperforce India LLP on payment

HOW WE WILL WORK
- Milestone 1: 1 design per concept (5 designs) to agree on the style
- Milestone 2: the remaining 15 designs
- Milestone 3: final print-ready files after up to 2 rounds of changes

TO APPLY, PLEASE SHARE
- Your portfolio, especially packaging, stationery or fun illustrated designs
- Your price for all 20 designs and your delivery time
- Which concept you would be most excited to work on, and one quick idea for it

Headquarters: Americas Remote

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Justin Howie, Head of Brand Studio at Customer.io, and I'm looking for a Senior Brand Designer to join our small, close-knit creative team.

Brand Studio is the creative engine behind how Customer.io shows up in the world, from product launches and campaigns to the website and live events. We move fast, care deeply about craft, and operate at the intersection of strategy and production.

Our team is moving from a production function to a systems and platform team, powered by AI and self-serve tooling. AI sits at the center of how we work, and you'll shape how Brand Studio and the wider company use it for ideation, production, and self-serve creation. You'll own brand design execution across our biggest moments, and you'll build the templates, components, and AI-assisted workflows that let the rest of the company create on brand without waiting on us. You'll work closely with our Brand Designers, Motion Designer, Web Engineer, Product Designers, and Marketers.

This is a senior role with a runway. We're looking for a highly seasoned designer with strong business acumen, who manages up well and mentors others, and who we expect to grow into a Staff or Art Director role once you've proven yourself here.

If you lead with Design Craft, live at the frontier of AI for brand and creative, and want to build systems that help a whole company look and sound like one brand, this role is for you.

What we value

• Design Craft with speed — You hold high standards and know how to hit deadlines.

• Curiosity about what's next — You stay on the leading edge of brand and creative, from new AI tools to new techniques, and you share what you learn.

• AI-native by default — You reach for AI first, test what works on real projects, and teach others how.

• Collaboration over silos — You work closely with designers, developers, and marketers, and the output gets better because of it.

• Bias for action — You'd rather ship something great and iterate than wait for perfect, and you're energized by building.

• Clear communication — You ask the right questions, set clear expectations, and keep stakeholders in the loop without being asked.

• Leadership beyond the work — You mentor the people around you, manage up with confidence, and think like an owner of the business.

What you’ll do

• Own brand design execution for product launches, using AI-native workflows to take concepts to launch-ready assets in days

• Design website pages, templates, and components in close collaboration with our Senior Web Engineer

• Develop campaign assets for digital and out-of-home advertising, produced with AI-native workflows so we can test more concepts and ship more variants

• Design branded materials for events and conferences, including signage, stage graphics, and collateral

• Build and maintain brand templates and libraries, including Figma libraries, prompt libraries, and custom tooling that turn our guidelines into on-brand output anyone can use

• Own our AI creative stack: choose the tools, set the standards, and share what you learn with Brand Studio and the wider company

• Enable teams across the org through workshops, playbooks, and guardrails that keep AI-assisted work on brand

• Translate briefs from Product Marketing and Demand Generation into creative concepts, executed end to end

• Partner with Product Design to keep brand and product expression aligned

• Mentor designers on the team, give clear critique, and raise the Design Craft bar across Brand Studio

• Work with Brand Studio leadership and senior stakeholders on priorities, tradeoffs, and the business case for creative investment

What we're looking for

• 7+ years of hands-on brand or visual design experience, ideally in-house at a B2B SaaS or tech company, with a record of senior-level ownership

• A portfolio that shows range: brand systems, campaign work, product launch design, web and landing pages, event and out-of-home, and AI-assisted work with a clear account of your process

• Expert proficiency in Figma, including building and maintaining components and libraries within a brand system, and fluency in Adobe Creative Suite

• Strong typography and layout instincts, and a track record of turning complex technical concepts into clear, compelling visuals

• Business acumen: you connect design decisions to company goals, make the case for creative investment, and communicate fluently with executives

• The ability to manage up and lead without authority: setting expectations, surfacing risks early, and driving alignment across Marketing, Product, and Exec

• Mentorship experience: you've coached other designers and raised the craft bar around you

• Deep, hands-on experience with AI image and design tools in your production workflow, plus fluency across the AI creative stack (image generation, LLMs, prompt design, workflow automation) with examples of workflows, templates, or tools you've built that help others create on brand

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $128k–$160k USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. I need 30 fresh, 20-second Hindi or Hinglish comedy cartoons every month for my channel, TalkOne. Each short must feel like a fast-paced meme, packed with quick visual gags and punchy dialogue that lands in the first few seconds.

Story & tone 
• The humour should stay light-hearted and family-safe while leaning into relatable sarcasm. 
• Most episodes will revolve around husband-wife banter, middle-class family quirks, office life, unemployment jokes, and the occasional relationship or social-media spoof. 

Characters 
The core cast will be reusable: 
– a young middle-class married couple, 
– their extended family (parents, kids, a few nosy relatives),

Make them expressive—hand gestures, body language, facial reactions, and accurate lip-sync are essential.

Technical specs 
I’m after Full-HD vertical (1080 × 1920) at a minimum of 20 fps, delivered as watermark-free MP4s with hard-coded subtitles, background music, and comic SFX already mixed. • 30 shorts supplied every calendar month 
• Consistent art style and character rig so episodes feel like a series 
• You handle scripting, animation, voice, edit, and final mastering 
• Monthly budget is 7,000–8,000 INR (includes any software you use)

full:
## Professional NDIS Marketing Brochure / Capability Booklet Designer Needed – Canva + PDF

We are looking for an experienced graphic designer to create a **high-end, professional marketing and capability booklet** for our NDIS-registered disability support organisation, **Centred Care Solutions Pty Ltd**.

This is not a request for a basic flyer or a generic Canva template.

We want a professionally designed, multi-page marketing document that feels like it has been produced by an experienced branding or creative agency.

### ABOUT OUR ORGANISATION

Centred Care Solutions is a registered NDIS provider delivering disability support services across **Mackay and South East Queensland**.

Our services include:

- Supported Independent Living
- Personal and in-home support
- Community access
- High-intensity and complex supports
- Community nursing
- Daily living and skill development
- Support for participants with complex behavioural and psychosocial needs

Our approach is strongly person-centred. We want the marketing material to communicate that we understand the person first, rather than simply focusing on a diagnosis, disability or funding package.

### WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We want approximately **10–12 professionally designed pages** that work together as one continuous document.

The document should feel like a journey rather than 10 unrelated Canva pages.

We particularly like designs where visual elements continue between pages, for example:

- flowing shapes or lines that begin on one page and continue onto the next
- photography that interacts with page layouts
- consistent typography and spacing
- recurring visual elements used subtly throughout the booklet
- strong use of white space
- full-page or partial-page photography where appropriate
- sections that visually transition into the next section
- subtle page numbering and navigation elements
- strong hierarchy between headings, body text and key statements

The design needs to feel **modern, premium, trustworthy, human and established**.

It must NOT look:

- childish
- overly colourful
- like a generic disability-services Canva template
- overly clinical or hospital-like
- crowded with icons
- like every page was designed separately
- like a basic corporate PowerPoint presentation
- like an AI-generated template with random stock images and text boxes

### DESIGN DIRECTION

Our existing branding uses variations of:

- deep teal / dark green
- soft aqua / mint
- white
- charcoal / dark text
- subtle neutral backgrounds

We want these colours refined into a strong and consistent visual system.

Our logo and branding will be supplied.

We would like the designer to develop the visual style around our existing brand rather than completely changing the identity.

Photography should feel genuine and natural.

Where stock photography is required, it should represent real-life disability support, homes, community participation, families, support workers and everyday life.

Avoid overly staged or stereotypical disability stock photography.

### REFERENCE MATERIAL

We will provide:

1. Our current Centred Care Solutions marketing booklet
2. Another NDIS provider's booklet as a reference for the type of multi-page structure and visual flow we like
3. Our company logo and branding
4. Company information
5. Service information
6. Website details
7. Contact information
8. Any photographs we decide to use

The reference booklet is for **layout inspiration and understanding the level of detail only**.

We do not want another organisation's branding, wording or exact design copied.

The final product must be completely original to Centred Care Solutions.

### CONTENT AND PAGE STRUCTURE

We will provide a **detailed page-by-page brief** explaining what we want each page to communicate.

The booklet is likely to include sections such as:

- strong cover / opening statement
- who Centred Care Solutions is
- our philosophy and approach
- Supported Independent Living
- how we approach matching, transitions and establishing a home
- everyday support and independence
- community access and participation
- complex and high-intensity support
- clinical / Registered Nurse involvement
- what makes Centred Care Solutions different
- our leadership and team
- referrals and contact / call to action

The designer should be confident taking supplied content and creating a strong visual hierarchy rather than simply placing paragraphs onto a page.

### IMPORTANT – THIS IS A MARKETING DOCUMENT

The purpose of this document is to be provided to:

- Support Coordinators
- NDIS participants
- families
- guardians
- nominees
- Public Guardian / Trustee stakeholders
- allied health professionals
- hospitals and discharge teams
- community organisations
- other referral partners

It needs to communicate credibility quickly.

Someone should be able to skim the booklet and understand:

**Who we are. 
Who we support. 
What we provide. 
How we work. 
Why someone would confidently refer a participant to us.**

### DELIVERABLES

We require:

- Final professionally designed multi-page booklet
- Approximately 10–12 pages
- Editable Canva file
- High-resolution PDF for printing
- Optimised PDF for emailing
- Correct bleed / print settings where required
- All pages professionally aligned and formatted
- Consistent typography, spacing and branding
- Clickable website, email and referral links in the digital PDF
- All final images properly licensed for commercial use
- Fonts and graphic assets identified
- Reasonable revisions included

full:
About Jack Westin

Jack Westin is a leading Medical College Admissions Test (MCAT) preparation company which is known for crafting high quality, but free, practice materials. The MCAT tests students on the scientific reasoning skills and scientific knowledge which can be learned during typical undergraduate coursework.

MCAT Psych/Soc Curriculum Designer (Remote, Project-based)

Role Summary

The MCAT Psych/Soc Curriculum Developer is responsible for building lesson materials for Jack Westin's relaunched live MCAT courses, which launch in January 2027 with a new modular curriculum. This project-based role focuses on turning detailed lesson outlines into clear, engaging slide decks and student handouts for four Psych/Soc lessons across two topic blocks: Research Methods & Social Psychology and Neuroscience & Cognition. The Curriculum Developer works independently and collaboratively with our curriculum and instructor teams to deliver high-quality, teachable materials that follow Jack Westin's template and style standards.

Compensation Terms:

• 
$300 per lesson, or $1,200 for all four lessons

• Pay includes one round of revisions after review

• All lessons due by January 1, 2027

• Project-based contract

• Work remotely with flexible scheduling

Primary Responsibilities
We're looking for a contractor to build four Psych/Soc lessons across two blocks.

Research Methods & Social Psychology

• 
• 
RM.1 Research Design & Social Influence: observational vs. experimental research, biases, statistical analysis, and related topics

• 
RM.2 Stress, Identity & Society: mixed P/S topics taught through famous research experiments, with a close look at how those studies were designed

Neuroscience & Cognition

• 
• 
NC.1 Brain, Senses & Learning: a science lesson focused on clinical applications and content connections

• 
NC.2 Memory, Perception & Cognition: a science lesson focused on clinical applications and content connections

Each lesson is a 3-hour live class. It opens with a case study, builds on key concepts from the prep work, shows interdisciplinary connections that are often tested together on the MCAT, and then moves into strategy, practice questions, and an AAMC passage. You'll turn a detailed lesson outline from our Director of Curriculum Design (often 10 to 20 pages per lesson) into clear, teachable material.

Slide & Handout Creation

• Create a "Prep in 15" slide deck for each lesson, giving an overview of foundational and high-yield topics

• Create an in-class slide deck covering the content portion of each live class (about 1.5 hours)

• Build fillable student note handouts for both the Prep in 15 and the in-class lecture once slides are final

• Follow Jack Westin's slide template and style guide throughout

Quality Assurance

• Ensure content is accurate, clear, and aligned with the learning objectives in each lesson outline

• Self-review lessons against Jack Westin's template and style standards before submission

• Complete one round of revisions based on lead instructor feedback before final approval

Collaboration & Communication

• Track all lessons and communicate with the team in ClickUp

• Respond to lead instructor reviews, which are given within 2 business days of submission

• Focus on lesson content only (quiz questions, homework, and passage selection are handled by other teams)

Qualifications

Education & Credentials

• Strong command of MCAT Psych/Soc content, including research methods and neuroscience

• A strong MCAT score is a plus

Experience

• Experience teaching or tutoring the MCAT

• Experience turning detailed outlines into lesson materials or slide-based instruction

Skills & Competencies

• Ability to build clean, clear slides that follow a template and style guide

• Strong understanding of how students learn MCAT Psych/Soc content

• Ability to work independently and meet project deadlines

• Responsive to feedback and comfortable with revision cycles

• Proficiency with slide tools and ClickUp or similar project management tools

Hi!

I'm looking for a talented packaging designer to create a fresh and distinctive packaging concept for a new skincare brand called LUMERA.

The brand will focus on everyday skincare products, including facial cleansers, moisturizers, body lotions, and nourishing creams. I want the packaging to feel modern, elegant, natural, and premium without looking too expensive or overly luxurious.

The idea is to create a recognizable product line that customers would immediately associate with quality, simplicity, and a thoughtful approach to skincare.

Brand identity and visual direction

The brand name is LUMERA.

I'd like to explore a minimal, contemporary design with soft natural elements and carefully selected typography.

The preferred color palette is:

Soft sage green: #A5B49A

Warm ivory: #F5F0E7

Dusty beige: #D8C8B8

Muted clay: #B98270

Dark olive: #41483A

The packaging should have a clean layout, balanced use of color, and enough whitespace. I'm open to creative suggestions if you think another direction would make the brand more recognizable.

What needs to be designed

I'd like to start with packaging concepts for four products:

Facial Cleanser – 150 ml bottle.

Daily Moisturizer – 50 ml jar.

Body Lotion – 250 ml bottle.

Nourishing Face Cream – 50 ml jar.

Each product should have its own visual variation while maintaining a consistent brand identity.

I also need a coordinated design for the product boxes where applicable. Please consider both the front and back packaging, including space for ingredients, product descriptions, usage instructions, barcode placement, and other standard product information.

In addition to the packaging itself, I'd like a simple visual presentation showing how the four products look together as a collection.

Design requirements

The packaging should be suitable for real-world production, not just attractive mockups. Please work with realistic dimensions, proper print margins, bleed areas, and CMYK color considerations.

The final concept should include:

Front and back packaging designs.

Consistent typography and product labeling.

A clear hierarchy for the brand name and product information.

Print-ready artwork.

Realistic 3D packaging mockups for presentation.

I'll provide the product names, ingredient information, descriptions, and any additional details required for the labels. Please don't invent cosmetic claims or ingredient information.

Deliverables

Please also provide the fonts and any linked assets used in the project, where licensing allows.

Timeline: 10–14 days.

Communication: English.

Please include examples of previous packaging, product label, or cosmetic branding projects in your proposal. Experience with skincare, beauty, wellness, or consumer product packaging would be a strong advantage.

# Etsy Product Listing & Image Editing Assistant – Simple Task ($1 Per Listing)

**Job Type:** Remote / Freelance
**Payment:** $1 AUD per completed listing
**Initial Project:** Minimum 500 Etsy Listings
**Potential for Long-Term Work**

### About the Job

I am looking for someone to help me create product listings for my Etsy store, an Australian-based business selling personalised and engraved gifts, wooden homewares, candles and other gift products.

**This is a fairly simple and repetitive job, especially once the initial product images have been created.** I will provide examples of existing Etsy stores and listings that I would like you to use as references. You will not need to come up with completely new product concepts or designs.

The main task is to use the design ideas and presentation styles from the reference stores and adapt them to my own products.

I already have the products and will provide the necessary references and instructions. I simply do not have the time to create all the listings myself.

### Products You Will Be Working With

- **Collection 1:** Candles
- **Collection 2:** Wooden Boards
- **Collection 3:** Coasters
- **Collection 4:** Salad Spoon Sets
- **Collection 5:** Cheese Knife Sets
- **Collection 9:** Spoon Rests

Our store focuses particularly on personalised gifts, including engraved names, messages, designs and customised labels.

### Important – How Simple and Repetitive the Work Will Be

**I want to emphasise that you will NOT need to create 12 completely new product photos from scratch for every single listing.**

The idea is to create a set of approximately 12 professional, realistic product images and a video for each product type initially. Once these base images and templates are ready, they can be reused for the remaining listings.

For example:

**Candles:** Once the initial 12 candle images have been created, you will simply reuse those same images and replace the front sticker or label with a different design, name, message or occasion. The candle itself, background, lighting and overall presentation can remain exactly the same.

**Wooden Boards:** Once the initial 12 images of a particular board have been created, you will simply change the engraving on the board for each new listing. Everything else in the images can remain the same.

**Other Wooden Products:** The same approach applies to coasters, salad spoon sets, cheese knife sets and spoon rests. Once the initial product images are ready, you will mainly be changing the engraving or personalised wording.

**In other words, the majority of the 500 listings will involve reusing the same product images and templates, with only the engraving designs or candle stickers being changed.**

This is why I consider it a relatively straightforward and repetitive task for someone experienced in product mockups and image editing.

### What You Will Need to Do

I will provide links to Etsy stores that have the types of designs, engraving styles, candle labels and product presentations I am looking for.

Your job will be to use these as references and adapt the same style of designs to our own products.

The aim is to create a minimum of **500 attractive Etsy listings** using our existing product range, with different engraving designs, personalised messages, candle labels and gift occasions.

You will not need to constantly create new photography concepts or backgrounds. The focus is on creating the initial templates and then efficiently making the required design changes for subsequent listings.

### Image and Video Requirements

Each completed Etsy listing must include:

- At least **12 high-quality product images**.
- **1 product video**.
- Realistic, professional-looking images that resemble genuine product photography.
- Natural lighting, realistic textures and accurate product details.
- Consistent product appearance across all images.
- Appropriate personalised designs, engraving or labels based on the examples provided.
- A product title, description and relevant Etsy tags.

**Very important:** The images and videos must look natural and realistic. I do not want images that look obviously AI-generated, heavily Photoshopped or artificial.

You may use image-editing or AI tools where appropriate, but the final result must look like a genuine product and accurately represent what customers will receive.

The reference stores will be used for design inspiration, with the final images and artwork adapted for our own products rather than copying another seller's copyrighted photographs or artwork.

### Payment

I am offering **$1 AUD per completed listing**, including the images, video, title, description and tags.

The initial project will involve at least **500 listings**, with the possibility of more work as the store grows.

**Please keep in mind that once the initial 12 images and video templates are created for each product, most of the remaining work will simply involve changing the engraving designs or candle stickers. You will not be creating every listing from scratch.**

I will provide clear examples and instructions to make the process as straightforward as possible.

### Opportunity for Additional Work – Second Etsy Store

If I am happy with your work, I also have another Etsy store that I would like you to manage.

This second store focuses on **digital downloadable printable games**, particularly for occasions such as:

- Bridal showers and hen parties
- Baby showers
- Weddings and engagement parties
- Birthdays
- Couples and date nights
- Family gatherings
- Christmas and other seasonal celebrations

For this store, your responsibilities would include creating attractive, original printable PDF games, designing matching game bundles, preparing answer sheets where required, creating product mockups and uploading the finished digital products to Etsy.

The games should be professionally designed, easy to print, visually appealing and ready for customers to download immediately aft…

title: Luxury Vehicle Storage Website Design
desc: Premium Vehicle Storage & Concierge Website Design & Development Brief Business Overview A high-end vehicle storage and concierge business specialising in the secure storage and care of valuable classic cars, prestige vehicles, supercars, performance vehicles and motorcycles. Bas…
full:
Premium Vehicle Storage & Concierge

Website Design & Development Brief

Business Overview

A high-end vehicle storage and concierge business specialising in the secure storage and care of valuable classic cars, prestige vehicles, supercars, performance vehicles and motorcycles.

Based in the Broxbourne, Nazeing and Hoddesdon area of Hertfordshire, the business will provide a discreet, secure and professionally managed environment for vehicle owners who expect a premium level of care and service.

This is not a conventional self-storage facility. The concept is built around providing a complete vehicle ownership support service, combining secure storage with personal attention, maintenance coordination and vehicle concierge services.

Services

The website should showcase the following services:

* Secure short-term and long-term vehicle storage.
* Premium dry storage.
* Enhanced and temperature-controlled storage options.
* Classic and prestige car storage.
* Motorcycle storage.
* Battery maintenance and vehicle health checks.
* Tyre pressure monitoring and vehicle upkeep.
* MOT and servicing coordination.
* Vehicle collection and delivery arrangements.
* Detailing and specialist maintenance through trusted partners.
* Personal vehicle concierge services.

Brand Positioning

The business should be positioned as an exclusive, high-end British automotive storage and concierge service.

The overall identity should feel sophisticated, discreet, timeless and luxurious.

The website should communicate:

* Exclusivity and premium service.
* Security and peace of mind.
* Professionalism and trust.
* Attention to detail.
* Personal customer relationships.
* A genuine passion for exceptional vehicles.

Avoid the appearance of a conventional industrial storage or self-storage website.

Visual Design

The website should have an elegant, luxury aesthetic inspired by established British automotive and lifestyle brands.

Preferred colour palette:

* Deep black.
* Champagne gold.
* Warm ivory.
* Subtle metallic silver.

Typography should be elegant, refined and spacious, with a combination of sophisticated serif headings and clean modern body text.

Use high-quality photography featuring classic cars, prestigious modern vehicles, exceptional motorcycles and immaculate indoor storage environments.

The website should feel premium without being overly flashy or cluttered.

Target Audience

The target market includes:

* Owners of classic and collectible cars.
* Porsche, Aston Martin, Ferrari, Bentley and other prestige vehicle owners.
* Supercar and performance vehicle owners.
* Collectors of classic and modern motorcycles.
* Owners seeking secure, professionally managed storage and vehicle care.

Website Structure

1. Homepage – Strong luxury imagery, clear messaging and an introduction to the service.
2. Vehicle Storage – Storage options, security and facilities.
3. Vehicle Concierge – Maintenance, vehicle checks, servicing and additional services.
4. Motorcycle Storage – Dedicated section for classic and prestige motorcycles.
5. About Us – Business philosophy, experience and commitment to customer care.
6. Contact & Enquiries – Professional enquiry form and contact information.

Lead Generation

The website should be designed to generate enquiries and build a customer base ahead of the facility opening.

Include:

* Register your interest.
* Request a storage quotation.
* Tell us about your vehicle.
* Preferred storage duration.
* Vehicle collection requirements.
* Contact details.

The website should allow potential customers to register their interest before the facility becomes operational.

Overall Objective

Create a sophisticated, premium website that establishes the business as a trusted destination for luxury classic car, prestige vehicle and motorcycle storage.

The website should sell more than storage. It should sell security, convenience, personal service and complete peace of mind for owners who want their vehicles looked after to an exceptional standard.

My channel has hit a wall: impressions stall, click-through hovers low, and new subscribers barely trickle in. I need an expert who truly understands how the YouTube algorithm surfaces, ranks, and recommends content to step in and show me exactly where the friction lies. 

The end goal is simple—hand me a clear, actionable roadmap that will lift views and steadily convert those views into loyal subscribers. To get there, you’ll dive into my channel analytics, benchmark my performance against competitors, and translate the data into practical steps I can follow straight away. I’m especially interested in insights around watch-time signals, viewer retention, CTR, topic relevance, session-level engagement, and how each of these feeds YouTube’s recommendation engine.

If you’re comfortable dissecting titles, thumbnails, metadata, and audience behavior inside YouTube Studio (plus external tools such as TubeBuddy, vidIQ, or Google Trends where helpful), let’s talk. 

Deliverables I’m expecting: 
• A concise audit report outlining the key bottlenecks holding the channel back 
• A prioritized growth plan detailing specific optimizations, content angles, and scheduling tweaks for the next 60 days 
• A brief follow-up session (video or voice) to walk me through the findings and ensure the plan is crystal clear 

Clarity and practicality are everything—please back every recommendation with logic or data so I understand not just what to do, but why it will work.

We are looking for an experienced UI/UX designer to conduct an independent professional review of an existing online conversion website.

The website provides conversion tools, including measurement units and currencies.

The website URL will be provided only to the freelancer selected for the project.

PROJECT OBJECTIVE

We want an independent and objective assessment of our website's current design, visual appearance and user experience.

We are not necessarily looking for a complete redesign.

Our goal is to understand what works well, what could be improved, and whether a different visual approach would provide a better user experience.

SCOPE OF WORK

1. Evaluate the current website design, including:

- Overall visual appearance and modernity
- Colours and typography
- Page layout and visual hierarchy
- Navigation and ease of use
- Desktop, tablet and mobile experience
- Accessibility and readability
- Simplicity and clarity
- Overall user experience

2. Identify the strengths and weaknesses of the existing interface.

3. Provide practical recommendations for improving the website's design and usability.

4. Explain the reasoning behind each recommendation.

5. If the current design could benefit from significant improvements, propose TWO alternative visual concepts:

CONCEPT A:
An improved and modernised version of the existing design, preserving its main structure where appropriate.

CONCEPT B:
A fresh, original visual direction with a different approach to layout, presentation and user experience.

6. Provide visual mockups illustrating the proposed improvements, including:

- Homepage
- Main conversion interface
- Navigation
- Mobile layout

7. Explain the advantages of each proposed design and how it would improve the user experience.

EXPECTED DELIVERABLES

- A professional UI/UX audit report.
- Identification of strengths and weaknesses.
- A prioritised list of recommended improvements.
- Two alternative visual design concepts, if justified by the audit.
- Before-and-after visual comparisons.
- Desktop and mobile mockups.
- Editable Figma source files.

IMPORTANT

We are looking for an honest and independent professional assessment.

We do not want unnecessary changes simply for the sake of redesigning the website.

If you believe the existing design is already effective, please explain why and recommend only improvements that would genuinely add value.

We expect concrete visual proposals, not just written recommendations.

This project is strictly for design analysis, recommendations and visual concepts.

No coding, development or implementation is required.

FREELANCER PROPOSAL

Please include in your proposal:

- Your relevant UI/UX design experience.
- Examples of previous projects.
- Your portfolio.
- Your proposed approach to this assignment.
- The deliverables you will provide.
- Your proposed total fixed price.
- Your estimated completion time.

Proposals will be evaluated based on professional experience, design quality, proposed approach, deliverables, price and delivery time.

The website URL will be shared only with the selected freelancer.

I am looking for an experienced architect or architectural designer to develop a complete architectural design and floor plan based on the attached Instagram reference photographs.

* Location: Niamey, Niger
* Land size: 200 m²
* Building type: Single-storey bungalow (not a duplex)
* Bedrooms: 3
* Architectural style: Modern minimalist, contemporary flat-roof appearance.

2. Design Inspiration

I want the house to closely capture the architectural appearance of the attached reference photos.

Important exterior features I would like to retain:

* Modern geometric building design.
* Flat-roof appearance with attractive roof projections.
* Dark charcoal/navy blue and white exterior colour combination.
* Large modern glass windows.
* Beautiful entrance façade.
* Warm LED exterior lighting.
* Small landscaped front garden.
* Modern parking space within the compound.
* Clean, premium-looking exterior finishing.

The goal is to achieve this appearance using affordable, locally available construction materials in Niger.

3. Required Interior Layout

The house should include:

* 1 master bedroom with an ensuite bathroom.
* 2 additional bedrooms.
* A shared bathroom.
* Spacious living room.
* Dining area.
* Functional kitchen.
* Small storage/pantry space.
* Practical circulation with minimal wasted space.

Exactly like this 

https://www.instagram.com/p/DfLPeg-jqZj/?img_index=6&cnvx=ejY5c2g3azQ2cDU=

I want a beautiful but economical house.

Please avoid unnecessarily complicated structural designs and expensive architectural features.

* Maximize the use of the 200 m² plot.
* Minimize construction costs without compromising structural safety.
* Use practical room dimensions.
* Consider the hot climate in Niamey.
* Prioritize locally available construction materials.
* Be suitable for construction by local contractors.

5. Deliverables Required

Please provide:

1. Complete 2D architectural floor plan with dimensions.
2. Furniture layout.
3. Front, rear and side elevations.
4. 3D exterior visualization closely matching the reference photos.
5. Interior 3D visualization.
6. Site plan showing the house, parking and garden within the 200 m² plot.
7. Basic construction drawings suitable for further engineering development.

6. Final Objective

I am not looking for a generic three-bedroom house design.

I want the architect to interpret the attached photographs and create a practical three-bedroom bungalow that captures the same modern architectural identity, while adapting the design to my 200 m² plot and keeping construction costs as low as reasonably possible.

# SaaS User Acquisition Specialists – Australia & USA | Pay Per Verified Member Signup

**Project Type:** Ongoing / Long-Term

**Payment:** Performance-based – payment per verified signup

**Target Markets:** Australia and United States

### About Us

CoWorkz is an Australian SaaS platform built for salon owners, beauty professionals, freelancers and growing beauty businesses.

Our platform helps professionals manage their businesses through connected tools for appointments, clients, payments, business operations and growth.

We are expanding our customer base in Australia and the United States and are looking for experienced digital marketers, affiliate marketers, lead generation specialists and user acquisition agencies.

### What We're Looking For

We want experienced individuals or teams who can attract genuine users and get them to **register for a CoWorkz membership**.

**This is a pay-per-result opportunity.**

We are not looking to pay for advertising impressions, website visitors, unqualified leads or hours worked.

We want completed, verified member registrations.

### Your Responsibilities

- Identify and reach potential CoWorkz customers in Australia and the USA.
- Promote our SaaS platform to relevant business owners and professionals.
- Generate interest and encourage users to register.
- Drive genuine member signups through approved marketing campaigns.
- Use trackable referral links or campaign identifiers to attribute each registration.
- Build scalable acquisition strategies that can generate consistent monthly signups.
- Provide transparent reporting on acquisition sources and campaign performance.

### Target Customers

Our ideal customers include:

- Independent hairdressers and stylists.
- Salon owners and managers.
- Barbers and barbershop owners.
- Makeup artists.
- Nail technicians.
- Lash and brow professionals.
- Beauty therapists.
- Other eligible independent beauty professionals and businesses.

### Payment Structure – Pay Per Verified Signup

We want to establish an agreed fixed payment for every successful, qualified member signup you generate.

**A qualifying signup must:**

1. Be a new, genuine CoWorkz member.
2. Be based in Australia or the United States.
3. Be a relevant professional or business in our target market.
4. Complete the required registration and basic account verification.
5. Be attributable to your referral or marketing campaign.
6. Not be a duplicate, fake, automated, fraudulent or incentivised account.

A genuine qualifying free-trial registration can count as a signup, subject to the agreed campaign criteria.

Payments will be based on verified registrations rather than estimated leads or traffic.

We are open to discussing additional performance bonuses for members who subsequently become paying subscribers.

### Marketing Methods

We welcome proposals involving:

- Affiliate and referral marketing.
- Social media marketing.
- Beauty industry communities and professional networks.
- Direct B2B outreach.
- Content and organic search.
- Other legitimate, scalable customer acquisition strategies.

All campaigns must comply with applicable advertising, privacy, anti-spam and platform policies. Marketing materials and any proposed paid advertising must be approved before launch.

### Who Should Apply?

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

- Have successfully acquired users for SaaS products.
- Understand cost-per-acquisition and performance marketing.
- Have experience with Australian and/or US markets.
- Can demonstrate real signup and conversion results.
- Have access to relevant audiences or proven acquisition strategies.
- Can scale campaigns as our business grows.

### How to Apply

Please provide:

1. Your experience acquiring registered SaaS users.
2. Examples of successful campaigns and verified results.
3. Your recommended acquisition strategy for CoWorkz.
4. Your proposed price per verified member signup.
5. How many genuine signups you believe you can deliver monthly.
6. Whether you have existing access to beauty industry audiences.
7. How you will track, verify and report registrations.

**Important:** We are only interested in legitimate customer acquisition. No bots, fake accounts, bulk purchased registrations, misleading incentives or spam.

### Long-Term Opportunity

We are looking for reliable partners who can grow with CoWorkz.

Successful applicants who consistently deliver genuine members may receive larger campaigns, increased acquisition volume and long-term performance-based arrangements.

**If you can reliably deliver real SaaS users in Australia and the United States, we want to hear from you.**

Your role is to rethink the external form, refine textures, explore new finish options, and deliver a cohesive design language that will help the product stand out on shelves and feel great in the hand.

Because the product is already made, I need solutions that can be implemented with minimal tooling changes and realistic manufacturing methods—preferably suggestions I can hand straight to my factory. Proven experience with consumer product styling, CMF (color-material-finish) strategy, and photorealistic rendering will be highly valued.

Deliverables I expect:
• Updated CAD or surface files reflecting the new aesthetic
• High-quality renders that show color and finish options in context
• A concise CMF guide with Pantone or material references the factory can follow

If this sounds like your area of expertise, let’s refine this product’s presence together.

Project Overview
I am looking for an experienced Local SEO and Web Development Specialist to completely optimize, manage, and improve my Google Business Profile (GBP) and build a professional, SEO-friendly business website.

1. Full Google Business Profile Audit & Optimization
Audit my current Google Business Profile and compare it against the top 3 local competitors.
Optimize the business description, primary and secondary categories, services, and attributes using high-intent local keywords.
Ensure Name, Address, and Phone Number (NAP) consistency across the profile.
Identify opportunities to improve local search visibility and Google Maps rankings.
2. Website Design & Development
Build a modern, professional, mobile-friendly, and SEO-optimized business website.

Website requirements:

Professional and visually appealing UI/UX design.
Fully responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
SEO-friendly website structure and URLs.
Integration with Google Business Profile and Google Maps.
Contact forms to generate customer inquiries and leads.
Click-to-call and WhatsApp integration.
Dedicated service pages optimized for local search keywords.
Location-specific landing pages where relevant.
Fast loading speed and Core Web Vitals optimization.
Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console integration.

SSL certificate and basic website security.
Social media integration.

Additional expectations:

Website content should be optimized for both search engines and potential customers.
Clear calls to action (CTAs) to encourage visitors to call, message, or submit inquiries.
Basic website maintenance and technical support.
3. Visual Branding & Content Creation
Design and upload high-converting branded visual assets, including cover photos, logo optimization, and service graphics.
Optimize photos before uploading them.
Create and publish engaging weekly Google Posts (offers, updates, and service highlights) for the first month.
Maintain consistent branding across the website and Google Business Profile.
4. Local SEO & Google Maps Ranking
Build high-authority local citations and directory listings relevant to my industry and location.
Optimize the Q&A section with relevant customer questions and answers.
Conduct local keyword research and competitor analysis.
Develop a local SEO strategy to improve organic rankings and Google Maps visibility.
Optimize website pages for relevant local search terms.
Build relevant, high-quality backlinks using white-hat SEO techniques.
5. Review Growth Strategy
Set up a simple system, QR code, or template to help collect more genuine customer reviews.
Write professional, SEO-friendly responses to existing and new customer reviews.
Develop a strategy to consistently increase authentic customer feedback.
No fake reviews or incentivized review manipulation.
6. Reporting & Performance Tracking
Provide a clear before-and-after ranking report using Local Search Grid/Heat Map tools.
Track Google Business Profile views, website clicks, calls, and direction requests.
Track website traffic, keyword rankings, organic clicks, and conversions.
Provide monthly performance reports with actionable recommendations.
Requirements for Applicants
Proven track record of ranking Google Business Profiles in the Top 3 Local Map Pack.
Please share 2–3 recent case studies or screenshots demonstrating previous results.
Strong knowledge of Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, and Google Maps ranking factors.
Experience in website design and development, including WordPress or modern web technologies.
Knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, schema markup, and website speed optimization.
Strong graphic design skills (Canva/Photoshop) for creating professional GBP posts and banners.
Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and local ranking tracking tools.
Strict adherence to Google's white-hat guidelines. No fake reviews, keyword stuffing in business names, or spam tactics that could risk profile suspension.
Expected Outcome
I am looking for someone who can handle both the website and local SEO requirements end-to-end.

The primary objective is to:

Rank the Google Business Profile among the Top 3 local Map Pack results for relevant keywords.
Build a professional website that attracts visitors and converts them into customers.
Improve organic visibility on Google Search.
Generate consistent calls, WhatsApp messages, and customer inquiries.
Establish a strong and sustainable online presence.

Please include your portfolio, previous SEO results, website development examples, proposed strategy, estimated timeline, and pricing when applying.

title: Custom WordPress Repair Plugin Rebuild
desc: I already run the “repairplugin” on my WordPress site, so all core functions—request intake, job ticket generation, status updates, and customer emails—are proven and live. Now I need a bespoke version that keeps every workflow intact while giving me full control over branding, f…
full:
I already run the “repairplugin” on my WordPress site, so all core functions—request intake, job ticket generation, status updates, and customer emails—are proven and live. Now I need a bespoke version that keeps every workflow intact while giving me full control over branding, form logic, and progress tracking visuals.

Key changes I expect 
• Fresh UI/UX that matches my site colours, fonts, and logo placement. 
• Re-worked request form: customers must enter contact details, device details, a clear fault description, and a preferred appointment time before submission. 
• Streamlined booking flow that feeds those details straight into the existing job-ticket logic. 
• Customisable status labels and a cleaner timeline so customers can follow their repair from “Booked” through to “Ready for Collection” inside their account or via emailed links. 
• Settings panel in the WordPress admin to edit colours, texts, email templates, and status names without touching code.

Acceptance criteria 
1. Plugin installs and activates like any standard .zip. 
2. All current “repairplugin” workflows work exactly as they do now, but with the new design and fields. 
3. No theme conflicts; must follow WordPress coding standards and be PHP 8.x compatible. 
4. Final delivery: production-ready plugin, brief setup guide, and commented source so my in-house dev can extend it later.

The live plugin is available for reference, plus an admin login for staging. I’m ready to supply brand assets, field labels, and test data as soon as we start.

full:
I’m building a local ComfyUI + Chroma pipeline that can reliably generate the same realistic human across multiple scenes. I’ll provide a short written description of a brand-new fictional character; your job is to turn that text into a working workflow that keeps the face, age, hairstyle, and overall look identical while the setting, lighting, and wardrobe change.

What I expect
Two JSON workflow files:
One fully editable normal ComfyUI workflow JSON
One API-format JSON that can be used with the ComfyUI API

A clear inventory of every custom node, model, LoRA, checkpoint, and supporting file the workflow depends on (with exact filenames and recommended download locations) so I can install everything locally without guesswork

5–10 proof images of the character:
A few everyday indoor shots
Some outdoor / street / travel scenes
A set of studio-style portraits with different outfits
All images should look like natural, everyday photos rather than hyper-stylised fashion or cinematic shots.
