Character details I will provide
Age range
Hair colour and style
Eye colour
Build
Any distinctive features (e.g. freckles, scars, etc.)
Optional: 1–2 reference photos if available (text-only is acceptable)

Technical requirements
I already have a stable ComfyUI install and a 4090 24 GB GPU
Keep the graph compact and name nodes sensibly
Use mainstream, actively maintained custom nodes only
Proof images should be at least 768×1024 (higher is fine)
Workflow must run reliably on a 4090 24 GB GPU without constant out-of-memory errors
Out of scope for this milestone
No LoRA training
No video generation
No web UI or phone app
Milestone & payment 

You deliver:
The first character workflow
Both JSON files
The full dependency list
The sample proof images
I will load and run the workflow on my machine. Once I can reproduce the same consistent results, I release the fixed-price payment for this milestone. If you’re confident you can deliver strong face and body consistency with Chroma and ComfyUI, let’s get this first milestone done.

title: RateperSQFT - AI-Powered Real Estate CRM Overhaul
desc: I operate a 20-person real-estate consultancy that already uses a custom PHP + Vue CRM. Leads pour in every day from website forms, landing pages, property portals, social-media ads, phone calls, WhatsApp and even walk-ins, and my call-center and field executives juggle them manu…
full:
I operate a 20-person real-estate consultancy that already uses a custom PHP + Vue CRM. Leads pour in every day from website forms, landing pages, property portals, social-media ads, phone calls, WhatsApp and even walk-ins, and my call-center and field executives juggle them manually. I now want one holistic, AI-enabled platform that takes every contact from first click or call all the way to closed deal, without fragmenting the workflow into separate “modules”.

What the upgraded system must do end-to-end 
• Capture every lead in real time, auto-deduplicate it and route it to the right agent or field executive. 
• Record each inbound and outbound call, transcribe it, summarise key points and schedule next-step reminders automatically. 
• Trigger follow-up calls, WhatsApp messages or emails on an AI-driven schedule until the prospect converts or opts out. 
• Track property visits, geo-stamp each check-in, collect notes and photos on-site and roll them into performance dashboards. 
• Present live dashboards that show individual and team performance, conversion funnels and property-wise insights. 
• Plug seamlessly into (or fully replace) the current PHP + Vue code base without disrupting daily operations.

Acceptance criteria 
1. A working demo handling sample leads from all stated sources. 
2. Automated call summaries and follow-up tasks visible inside the CRM. 
3. Field-visit logs with location and time stamps reflected in reports. 
4. Clear documentation and hand-over of source code, AI models/APIs used, and deployment steps.

I’m open to the specific AI stack you recommend as long as it integrates cleanly with PHP + Vue and scales with the volume we handle.

Creative Videographer Wanted – Inspirational Music Video & Book Promotion
Preferably in Perth, Western Australia

I'm a published author and songwriter seeking a creative videographer/editor to produce a cinematic, uplifting music video for my original, professionally recorded song, I AM Love (approximately 3 minutes 45 seconds).

My book, The Sacred Hum of I AM, is the culmination of 45 years of exploring consciousness, spirituality and the extraordinary connection between human awareness and the universe.

Key Requirements

Inspirational, emotionally engaging storytelling.

Cinematic visuals combining people, nature and spiritual themes.

Creative integration of the book and song.

Ability to incorporate existing footage and potentially new filming.

Professional editing, colour grading and visual effects.

Ideal Experience

Music video production and cinematic editing.

Strong visual storytelling and creative direction.

Experience with inspirational or spiritual content.

Ability to work collaboratively within an agreed budget.

Please share your portfolio, relevant experience, estimated costs and creative ideas.

I'm happy to provide the existing trailer, complete mastered song and book details to shortlisted candidates.

My goal is not simply to promote a book or song, but to share a meaningful message with the world.

Alan Gillanders
Author – The Sacred Hum of I AM
Songwriter – I AM Love

I work comfortably with the usual tools (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve), so feel free to use whichever you prefer as long as assets stay organized and I receive both the export (1080p MP4) and the original project file. Fast turnaround and a willingness to tweak details after feedback are essential, because I like to review drafts quickly and refine together until the video feels just right.

If straightforward storytelling, gentle fades, and music that shifts from energetic to ambient sound like your style, let’s start turning my raw footage into memorable travel vlogs.

The scope covers two VPCs—our primary “INFRA” VPC and a parallel “DR” VPC—deployed simultaneously in the same AWS region and tied back to our campus network that is protected by a Cisco Firepower firewall stack.

On-prem side 
• Cisco Firepower NGFW acting as Customer Gateway 
• IPSec site-to-site VPN into AWS Transit Gateway 
• Remote-access VPN for users that must terminate on the cloud-resident Cisco FTDv appliance

AWS hub 
• Transit Gateway as the routing core for both VPCs 
• Route tables, route propagation, and policy-based routing tuned for least-hop paths

AWS “INFRA” VPC (always-on) and “DR” VPC (managed) – identical layout 
Public subnet 
 – Cisco FTDv (north-south filtering, VPN termination) 
 – F5 Load Balancer 
 – Remote-access VPN endpoint 
Private subnet 
 – Application servers and edge appliances 

Shared services 
 – NAT Gateway for egress from private subnets 
 – Internet Gateway for public endpoints 
 – Route 53 DNS fail-over so users can land directly on the DR site if needed

What I need from you 
• Detailed design documents and diagrams capturing CIDR plans, security zones, and fail-over flows 
• End-to-end build of both VPCs, Transit Gateway, VPN tunnels, and Route 53 records 
• Configuration snippets or templates for the Cisco Firepower/FMCv side so we can drop them straight into production 
• Validation plan demonstrating traffic flow, fail-over to DR, and remote-user VPN access 
• Knowledge-transfer session so my in-house team understands day-to-day operations

If you live and breathe AWS networking, Transit Gateway, and Cisco firewalls—and you’re comfortable owning the work end-to-end—let’s talk.

desc: Category: 3D Animation | 3D Modelling | Video Production About us IMI Design is a marine and engineering design consultancy based in Goa, India. We need a technical 3D animation that explains a short submarine cable installation across a tidal river to clients and approving autho…
full:
Category: 3D Animation | 3D Modelling | Video Production

About us
IMI Design is a marine and engineering design consultancy based in Goa, India. We need a technical 3D animation that explains a short submarine cable installation across a tidal river to clients and approving authorities.

What you will create
A 2.5 to 3 minute 3D animation, near-photorealistic, in the style of offshore contractor videos (for example, jet sled cable trenching animations).

We already have a complete 2D animated storyboard (11 scenes), a riverbed profile, design drawings and dimensions. You will turn these into 3D.

Scenes (the storyboard will be provided)

Aerial view of the river site: shore, garden, river wall, jetty, pontoon and moored vessel, with the cable route drawn in
Survey boat with multibeam and side-scan sonar, showing objects on the seabed
Divers and a crane boat clearing debris from the route corridor
Excavator trenching on the intertidal flat at low tide and laying the cable
Lay barge paying out cable along the route
Jet sled burying the cable in sand, with a cutaway showing the sand fluidised and the cable settling
Precast concrete saddle blocks lowered over the cable, and a diver dropping in the connector keys
Cable pulled up through a J-tube on the pontoon by a deck winch
Monitoring: cameras and an AIS anchor-alert zone, with a boat entering and an alarm
Branded intro and end cards (logo and fonts provided)

Deliverables

Final video: MP4, 1920 × 1080 (4K preferred), 30 fps
A 30-second cut-down version
Versions with captions and without text
6 to 8 high-resolution still renders
Source files (Twinmotion / Blender / 3ds Max project and models)
Optional extra: background music and an English voice-over

What we will provide

2D storyboard animation (MP4) with captions
Site photos 
Brand kit: logo, colours, font

Requirements

A portfolio showing marine, offshore, construction or engineering animation. Please share links.
Skill in Twinmotion, Lumion, Blender, 3ds Max, Cinema 4D or Unreal Engine
Experience with underwater effects: murky water, caustics, sediment plumes, particles
Able to model equipment accurately from drawings
Good English communication, with updates at each milestone

Two rounds of revisions are included at each milestone.
Timeline: 1 weeks from award.

Confidentiality
The project details are confidential. The selected freelancer must sign an NDA. All models, renders and source files become the property of IMI Design, and may not be used in your portfolio without our written permission.

To apply, please send:

Links to 2 or 3 similar animations you have made
Your software and render pipeline
A fixed price, split by milestone
Your delivery time
One question or suggestion about the project, so we know you have read this post

title: Senior OR Staff Product Designer
desc: Headquarters: US or Canada - Remote Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. We’ve built a product that users love, and we plan to keep it that way by continuing to empathize with users and hel…
full:
Headquarters: US or Canada - Remote

Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. We’ve built a product that users love, and we plan to keep it that way by continuing to empathize with users and help them overcome their most significant challenges. Designing at Elation is humbling, challenging, and rewarding. Our users do work that affects human lives, and our tools can make or break that work.

The Role

As a Senior/Staff Product Designer, you'll lead the design for how primary care clinicians work. You’ll develop a deep understanding of their workflows to inspire an AI-native experience while keeping the team grounded in day-to-day clinical practice.

This role is for someone who creates and champions compelling UX strategy and experience visions while guiding work across multiple squads. You'll shape interaction patterns and contribute to visual language development — all while modeling the craft, curiosity, and collaborative ways of working that raise the bar for designers around you.

Clinicians have repeatedly awarded Elation "Best in KLAS" in our category, a recognition that reflects our clinician-first approach to everything we build. Reporting up through our Chief Product Officer, you'll work autonomously within your team while remaining connected to a centralized design group that is deeply collaborative and curious. You'll also find enthusiastic partners in our on-staff physicians, our users, and teams across the organization.

If you want to do complex, meaningful work at the place where design and healthcare intersect, we'd love to hear from you!

What You'll Do (Role and Responsibilities)

• Deeply understand our users — their problems, workflows, and jobs-to-be-done — to ensure we are always solving for the right thing.

• Own and lead the design process from discovery to delivery, making key decisions on solution direction and details.

• Drive the strategic direction of your domain in partnership with Product and Engineering, forecasting the impact of your solutions on users.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver a clear, consistent, and high-quality user experience.

• As an AI-native design leader, you will balance cutting-edge technology with patient safety and accuracy across user-facing and backend experiences. 

• Define and own the user satisfaction and usability metrics for your solutions, ensuring the team is aligned on how to measure success.

• Be a leader on the design team by mentoring other designers, leading design critiques, and driving initiatives that improve our culture, tools, and processes.

What We're Looking For (Experience and Skills)

• 8+ years of experience designing and shipping complex, web-based products in a cross-functional team.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating your ability to navigate ambiguous problem spaces, from research and strategy through to polished, human-centered user experiences. Your portfolio should showcase your strengths in UX, UI, and visual design.

• Proven experience in leading and executing a variety of user research methods.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of building strong partnerships with Product and Engineering.

• Experience in designing for complex workflows is a must; experience in healthcare or with AI-powered experiences is a strong plus.

SALARY RANGE: $145,000 - 185,000 USD

Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/elation-health-senior-or-staff-product-designer

I’m putting together a new children’s entertainment IP and need a talented 3D character artist who can take complete creative ownership from day one. The brief is to invent five original cartoon animals that instantly charm toddlers aged 2-4. Nothing exists yet—no concept art, no mood boards—so you’ll be starting with a blank canvas and shaping the entire look and feel.

The tone I’m after is warm, approachable and age-appropriate: oversized shapes, clear silhouettes, vibrant colours and just enough detail to be memorable without overwhelming little eyes. Think cuddly plush-toy appeal rather than high-detail realism. Each character should have a distinct personality, but they still need to live in the same visual universe and work well together on screen, in print and eventually as toys.

To keep the production pipeline smooth, here’s what I’ll need from you:

• Initial thumbnail sketches and colour explorations for each animal 
• Final turnaround sheets (front, side, back, three-quarter) with approved palettes 
• Fully modelled, UV-unwrapped and textured 3D characters, ready for animation (neutral T-pose) 
• Simple, clean topology appropriate for games or real-time engines, delivered in FBX or OBJ 
• Source files in your preferred software—Maya, Blender, ZBrush, Substance Painter, etc.—plus high-res renders

I’m happy to review work in clear milestones: concepts, modelling, texturing and final polish. Show me a portfolio that highlights stylised animal characters aimed at a preschool audience, and let me know which tools you’re most comfortable with. If you can communicate progress clearly and stay playful in your designs, we’ll be a great match.

full:
LOGO DESIGN & BRAND IDENTITY BRIEF
VASUDEV MILLS PVT. LTD.

1. Project Overview

We are looking for a creative, experienced and thoughtful designer to develop a distinctive logo and visual identity for **Vasudev Mills Pvt. Ltd.**

We want to build a brand identity that reflects quality, trust, sophistication and professionalism while establishing a strong presence in the textile industry.

The objective is to create a logo that is memorable, timeless, premium-looking and capable of representing our company as we grow.

We are looking for a designer who understands branding and visual identity, not just someone who can create a logo.

2. About the Company

Company Name: Vasudev Mills Pvt. Ltd.

Industry: Textile Manufacturing

Fabric Category: Shirting fabrics, woven fabrics and related textile products.

Vasudev Mills Pvt. Ltd. operates in the textile industry, with a focus on fabric quality, consistency, reliability and long-term business relationships.

We want our brand to communicate confidence, credibility and a strong understanding of the textile industry while maintaining a contemporary and professional image.

3. Objective

The objective is to develop a unique and recognisable identity for Vasudev Mills Pvt. Ltd. that:

- Establishes a strong brand presence in the textile industry.
- Reflects quality, trust and reliability.
- Creates a premium and professional perception.
- Is distinctive and memorable.
- Differentiates us from other textile brands.
- Remains relevant and timeless rather than following short-term design trends.
- Has the potential to grow with the business in the future.

4. Creative Direction

We are open to different creative approaches and would like the designer to explore ideas before settling on a final direction.

Our preference is for a logo that feels:

- Sophisticated
- Minimal
- Premium
- Timeless
- Strong
- Professional

We are open to typography-based logos, monograms, abstract symbols, geometric concepts or other creative directions.

The logo does not necessarily need to use literal textile-related imagery such as threads, looms, fabric rolls or weaving patterns. We would prefer a concept that feels distinctive, thoughtfully designed and meaningful to the brand.

We want to avoid generic textile logos, overly complicated graphics, unnecessary detailing and designs that resemble existing brands.

5. Competitors & Brand References

Some brands whose identity, positioning or overall brand presence we recognise include:

- Raymond
- Van Heusen
- Arrow
- Tommy Hilfiger

These brands are shared as market and branding references only. We are not looking to copy their logos, design elements or visual identities.

We would like the designer to understand how established brands create recognition through typography, simplicity, consistency and positioning, and use that understanding to develop an original identity for Vasudev Mills Pvt. Ltd.

6. Scope of Work

The project should include:

- Basic brand understanding and creative research.
- Industry and competitor visual research.
- Exploration of creative logo directions.
- 3 distinct initial logo concepts.
- Presentation of concepts with design rationale.
- Refinement of the selected concept.
- Up to 3 revision rounds on the selected direction.
- Primary logo and alternate logo variations, if required.
- Brand colour palette.
- Typography selection.
- Black-and-white and monochrome versions.
- Basic brand applications and mockups.

7. Final Deliverables

Upon completion, we expect:

- Final approved logo.
- Primary logo and alternate versions.
- Editable vector files (AI and SVG).
- High-resolution PDF files.
- PNG files with transparent background.
- JPG files.
- Colour, black, white and monochrome versions.
- Horizontal and vertical logo variations, if applicable.
- Brand colour codes (HEX, RGB and CMYK).
- Font names and typography details.
- Basic logo usage guidelines.

All final files should be organised and delivered professionally.

8. Logo Applications

The logo should be designed with its real-world applications in mind, including:

- Fabric labels and tags.
- Fabric packaging and roll branding.
- Product presentation.
- Business cards and stationery.
- Invoices and business documents.
- Website and social media.
- Marketing materials.
- Textile exhibitions and trade displays.

The identity should remain clear, recognisable and visually appealing across different sizes, surfaces and applications.

9. Expectations from the Designer

We are looking for someone who:

- Has experience in logo design and brand identity.
- Has a strong portfolio of original work.
- Understands branding, typography and visual communication.
- Can think strategically and creatively.
- Can explain the concept and reasoning behind the logo.
- Can develop a design that is commercially practical.
- Communicates clearly and professionally.
- Provides original designs and editable source files.

10. Timeline

We are looking to complete the project within approximately 2–3 weeks, depending on the design process and revisions.

The designer should share a proposed timeline for research, concept development, feedback, revisions and final delivery.

11. Proposal Requirements

When submitting your proposal, please share:

1. Relevant logo and brand identity projects from your portfolio.
2. Your approach to developing a logo for Vasudev Mills Pvt. Ltd.
3. Your understanding of the textile industry and premium fabric branding.
4. Your design process and the number of concepts you typically provide.

title: Fast-Paced YouTube Business Edits
desc: I run a business coaching practice in Australia. We produce educational YouTube videos for our clients — dental practices, trades businesses, allied health and veterinary clinics. I am looking for one editor to take this on as ongoing, per-video work. This is repeat work, not a o…
full:
I run a business coaching practice in Australia. We produce educational
YouTube videos for our clients — dental practices, trades businesses,
allied health and veterinary clinics. I am looking for one editor to take
this on as ongoing, per-video work.

This is repeat work, not a one-off. If the first video goes well I expect
4 to 12 videos a month, growing from there.

─────────────────────────────────────────
THE WORK
─────────────────────────────────────────

Long-form talking-head educational videos, 8 to 15 minutes finished. One
person speaking to camera, sometimes with a screen recording cut in.

Single camera, one or two takes, filmed by the business owner themselves.
The footage will not be perfect. Part of the job is making an ordinary
recording by a non-presenter watchable.

─────────────────────────────────────────
WHAT YOU RECEIVE WITH EVERY VIDEO
─────────────────────────────────────────

You will not be guessing at any point. Each job arrives with:

• the raw footage
• the final title, so you know exactly what the video promises
• the word-for-word script, with the main sections marked
• the hook for the first 15 seconds
• the call-to-action text and where it goes
• the approved thumbnail, so the edit matches the promise
• a b-roll and on-screen graphics list, keyed to the script
• the target finished length
• the brand kit: fonts, colours, lower-thirds, end-screen frame

If you ever have to ask a question before you can start, tell me. It means
my brief has a gap in it and I want to close it.

─────────────────────────────────────────
WHAT YOU DELIVER
─────────────────────────────────────────

• the finished edit, 1080p MP4, H.264
• captions as a separate SRT file
• chapter timestamps
• one round of revisions included in the price
• delivered to [Google Drive / Dropbox / Frame.io — pick one]

Optional, priced separately — tell me your rate for it:
• 2 to 3 vertical shorts cut from the long-form, 9:16, 30 to 60 seconds

─────────────────────────────────────────
THE STYLE — PLEASE READ THIS PART PROPERLY
─────────────────────────────────────────

The audience is business owners aged 35 to 65. Professional, often
sceptical, short on time. The test I apply to every video is simple:
would a credible accountant forward this to a client without
embarrassment?

What I want:
• tight pacing — cut silences, filler words, false starts, repeated takes
• clean, motivated cuts
• on-screen text for any figure, list or comparison the script makes
• simple b-roll or a graphic where the script makes a specific claim;
 relevance matters more than volume
• a subtle music bed at low level, or no music at all

What I do not want, at all:
• punch-in zooms every few seconds
• meme cutaways, reaction images, stock comedy
• sound effects on cuts — no whooshes, no risers, no boings
• cartoon arrows, circles, exploding text, shake effects
• dramatic music stings
• AI voiceover or AI-generated b-roll of any kind
• anything that would look at home on a channel made for teenagers

If your showreel is fast-cut entertainment editing, this is probably not
the right job for you — and that is completely fine, no hard feelings.

─────────────────────────────────────────
CONFIDENTIALITY
─────────────────────────────────────────

Some clients are regulated healthcare practices. You will sign a short
NDA. Footage and finished videos may not be used in your portfolio
without written permission for that specific client.

─────────────────────────────────────────
HOW THIS STARTS
─────────────────────────────────────────

One paid test video first, at your quoted rate. If it works, we go
ongoing and I will keep you fed with consistent work.

─────────────────────────────────────────
TO BID, ANSWER ALL FIVE — bids that skip these will be ignored
─────────────────────────────────────────

1. Links to two long-form talking-head educational edits you have done
 for a professional or business audience. Not vlogs, not gaming, not
 entertainment.

2. Your flat price per video for the scope above — 8 to 15 minutes
 finished, with SRT and chapters. State separately what you would
 charge for the shorts.

3. Your turnaround in business days, from receiving footage to first cut.

4. What you edit in, and whether you have worked with Descript.

5. In two or three sentences: what would you do differently editing for
 a 55-year-old audience, compared with a general YouTube audience?

Question 5 is the one I read first.

Canva Designer – 10-Page Corporate Capability Statement | Content & Brand Supplied

We are Effective Building Group (EBG), a Western Australian building services contractor seeking an experienced graphic designer to professionally format our company capability statement in Canva.

- Use supplied company photographs and approved logos.
- Create consistent layouts that can be reused for future EBG documents.

**Essential requirements**

The completed document must be fully editable in Canva. Headings, paragraphs, icons, shapes, lines, photo frames and page numbers must remain independently editable.

Flattened images, screenshots of complete pages or PDF-only deliverables will not be accepted.

**Deliverables**

- Editable master design accessible in our Canva account.
- Print-quality and digital PDF exports.
- Two rounds of revisions.

title: Custom Seashell Microphone Cover Design

full:
I'm looking for an experienced 3D designer to create a **high-quality, production-ready 3D model** of a custom branded microphone cover.

I have attached reference images showing exactly how the final product should look. **The goal is to recreate the reference design as accurately as possible, not to create a generic seashell.**

### Design Requirements

- A beautiful, smooth, rounded, dimensional seashell with realistic curves, grooves and inflated shell segments.
- The shell should closely match the shape, proportions and overall appearance of the reference image.
- Raised, rounded purple Hebrew lettering that reads exactly: **גוליגל**
- The lettering must be accurate and positioned like the reference.
- The same seashell design and correctly readable Hebrew lettering must appear on **both the front and back**.
- The seashell and letters must form **one continuous, connected, printable 3D body**, not separate pieces glued together.
- Clean, smooth, professional geometry without visible artifacts or rough surfaces.

### Microphone Integration

This product will be used as a branded cover for a handheld wireless microphone (TRX Audio Airline 1).

The seashell must have an internal vertical opening that allows the microphone to pass through and keeps the cover securely positioned below the microphone head.

Initial estimated dimensions:
- Microphone handle diameter: 32 mm
- Microphone head diameter: 50 mm
- Seashell width: approximately 130 mm
- Seashell height: approximately 100 mm

These microphone dimensions are estimates and must be verified before final production.

**Important:** The microphone opening should be integrated discreetly into the seashell. I do not want a large external tube visible on the front or back.

The designer must ensure the cover can actually be installed on the microphone.

### 3D Printing Requirements

The model must be suitable for FDM printing using a Bambu Lab 3D printer.

Requirements:
- One connected, watertight mesh.
- No floating or disconnected geometry.
- Appropriate wall thickness and structural strength.
- Optimized for printing with minimal supports where practical.
- Suitable for multicolor printing (blue seashell and purple lettering).
- Clean topology and no mesh errors.

### Required Deliverables

1. Final production-ready STL file.
2. Multicolor 3MF file compatible with Bambu Studio.
3. Editable Blender (.blend) or equivalent native project file.
4. High-quality renders showing front, back, side and three-quarter views.
5. Technical cross-section showing the microphone opening.
6. Confirmation that the model has been checked for 3D printability.

### Very Important

**Visual accuracy is my highest priority.**

I have already tried creating this model using AI-generated 3D geometry, but the results were not acceptable.

I need an actual skilled 3D artist who can sculpt and model this professionally.

The finished product should look almost identical to the reference image and be suitable for delivery to a paying customer.

Please include examples of similar organic 3D models or 3D-printing projects you have completed.

Before final delivery, I would like to review renders of the model and approve the design.

Please provide your estimated price and delivery timeframe.

Green, white and black football-themed design.

Club logo, navigation menu, hero banner, player images and clubhouse background.

Five team sections: 1st Team, 2nd Team, 3rd Team, 4th Team and Veterans +60.

Facebook links, supporter group links and sponsor logos.

Fully responsive for desktop, tablet and mobile.

2. DBU football widgets

Our existing website is based on widgets provided by DBU (Danish Football Association).

DBU now allows football clubs to build independent websites and embed their official widgets.

I already have an official DBU iframe code that can be integrated into WordPress.

These widgets automatically update football information such as match results, upcoming fixtures, league tables and schedules.

The developer does NOT need to develop a football statistics system or manually update match results.

The available DBU widget must be integrated, and the website should be prepared for additional widgets when their codes become available.

3. Navigation and submenus

Home

Teams

Matches & Results

League Tables

The Club

Membership

News

Sponsors

Contact

All menus and submenus must function correctly. Relevant content should be transferred from the existing website where possible.

4. WordPress administration

I must be able to update pages, photos, news, sponsor logos and general website content myself without programming knowledge.

5. Hosting

The website will be hosted on One.com.

Budget and proposal
Price is very important, but the design must closely match the provided reference image.

Please provide:

Your fixed total price for the entire website, including subpages and dropdown menus.

Expected delivery time.

Examples of similar WordPress websites you have developed.

Confirmation that you can reproduce the reference design accurately.

Information about any additional theme or plugin costs.

I will provide the homepage reference design, the existing website URL, the available DBU widget code and relevant club material.

Please do not suggest an expensive custom-built football management system. We already have the official DBU widgets.

I am looking for a reliable developer who can create a professional website at a reasonable fixed price.

1. Critical Size Requirement
 * 100% Exact Size Match: The finished dimensions of all three cards must match the reference photo 100% identically (please measure/match the exact format shown in the example image and confirm the final dimensions with me before starting).
2. Three Card Variants Needed

 * Red Card – Rosen Apotheke: Red color theme, featuring the Rosen Apotheke logo and its own matching round point sticker.
 * White Card – Mühlen-Apotheke: White color theme, featuring the Mühlen-Apotheke logo and its own matching round point sticker.
 * Third Card – Apotheke am Neumarkt: A distinct/fitting color theme (to be finalized based on the brand colors/your proposal), featuring the Apotheke am Neumarkt logo and its own matching round point sticker.
3. Folded Loyalty Card Structure (4 Pages: Front, Back & 2 Inside Pages – for all 3 variants)
 * Outside Front: Pharmacy logo, title ("Bonus Karte" / "Bonuskarte"), and a short slogan.
 * Outside Back: Terms of the loyalty program (how to collect points and the reward), contact details, address, and website (without opening hours).

title: Digital Artist Needed for Precise Illustration Retouching — Preserve Original Artwork
desc: I'm looking for a talented digital artist with excellent anatomical drawing and image-retouching skills to help refine illustrations for my Christian illustrated book, Saving Sahara. My number one priority is preserving the original artwork. The illustrations were created using A…
full:
I'm looking for a talented digital artist with excellent anatomical drawing and image-retouching skills to help refine illustrations for my Christian illustrated book, Saving Sahara.

My number one priority is preserving the original artwork.

The illustrations were created using AI, and while I absolutely love their beauty, richness, vibrant colors, intricate details and overall composition, AI-generated artwork sometimes contains anatomical imperfections, particularly involving hands, fingers, arms and their proportions.

I'm not looking to redesign, redraw or repaint these illustrations. Quite the opposite! I want to preserve as much of the original artwork as possible, making only the small, specific corrections necessary to improve anatomical accuracy.

The work will involve:
 • Correcting specific anatomical imperfections, such as malformed hands, incorrect finger counts, disproportionate arms or disconnected limbs.
 • Making small, localized corrections using patches or separate editing layers over the original artwork.
 • Carefully matching the original colors, textures, sharpness and artistic style so that the corrections blend seamlessly into the existing illustrations.
 • Preserving all surrounding details, including faces, clothing, backgrounds, lighting and composition.
 • Leaving every part of the original illustration untouched unless a specific correction has been requested.

Project Scope
The project consists of three main areas of refinement:
1. Minor Anatomical Corrections (Approximately 15–17 Pages)
Approximately 15–17 illustrations require only minor corrections, generally involving one or two hands that need to be redrawn or refined. These are relatively small adjustments that should blend naturally into the existing artwork without affecting the surrounding details.

2. Consistency of Jesus' Nail Prints (Pages 22–42)
Throughout pages 22–42, Jesus' nail prints need to be consistent in their appearance, positioning, size and overall design. The objective is to ensure that the nail prints on both hands maintain the same visual characteristics wherever they appear, while preserving the original appearance of His hands and the surrounding artwork.

3. Three Epic Scenes — Major Anatomical Refinements
The largest and most involved portion of the project concerns three major illustrations:
 • The Rapture Scene: One page.
 • The Worship Scene: A two-page spread.
 • The Heaven Scene: A two-page spread.
These magnificent scenes contain large gatherings of people arranged throughout the foreground, midground and background. Each scene requires approximately a dozen or more carefully targeted anatomical corrections.

Examples include disproportionate arms, hands showing the back when the palm should be visible, arms that are not properly connected to shoulders, and floating or disconnected arms and hands that need to be corrected or removed.

These three scenes represent the bulk of the work and will require particular attention to anatomical accuracy, artistic consistency and preservation of the original details.
I will be happy to walk you through the illustrations one step at a time, identifying every specific correction I'm requesting. I can provide detailed written instructions and visual references so that there is no uncertainty about what needs to be changed and, equally importantly, what must remain untouched.

Please do not regenerate, redraw or repaint the entire illustration. The objective is not to create a new version of the artwork but to carefully refine the existing version.

I cannot overstate how much I value the original illustrations and how important it is to me that their beauty, fullness, extraordinary detail and visual consistency be preserved.

I'm looking for someone who appreciates that sometimes the best artistic work involves making a few carefully executed improvements while leaving everything else exactly as it was.

Ideally, you will have experience with Photoshop or similar professional editing software, including non-destructive, layer-based retouching, along with strong skills in human anatomy and digital painting.

The project will begin with a small paid trial to ensure that we're a good fit before moving forward with additional illustrations.

I value good communication, attention to detail and a collaborative working relationship. I'm happy to provide clear instructions and reference images showing exactly which areas need correction.
Thank you for your interest! I look forward to finding an artist who shares my appreciation for the original artwork and can help me bring these illustrations to their final, polished form.

title: Design a 250 TPH Gold Wash Plant
desc: Mechanical / Mineral Processing Engineer Needed – Complete 250 TPH Gold Wash Plant Design PROJECT OVERVIEW We are seeking an experienced mechanical or mineral processing engineer to design a complete 250-ton-per-hour (TPH) placer gold wash plant utilizing a heavy-duty vibrating s…
full:
Mechanical / Mineral Processing Engineer Needed – Complete 250 TPH Gold Wash Plant Design

PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are seeking an experienced mechanical or mineral processing engineer to design a complete 250-ton-per-hour (TPH) placer gold wash plant utilizing a heavy-duty vibrating shaker deck.

The plant will be fabricated from scratch in Ethiopia using locally available steel and manufacturing capabilities, with specialized mechanical components imported where necessary.

We are looking for an engineer with proven experience designing vibrating screens, aggregate washing plants, mineral processing equipment, or complete gold wash plants.

Our goal is to develop a reliable, efficient, modular wash plant optimized for continuous operation, ease of maintenance, and high gold recovery.

The final design must be independently engineered and suitable for fabrication.

PRELIMINARY PLANT SPECIFICATIONS

Processing capacity: 250 metric tons per hour

Maximum feed rock size: 400 mm (approximately 16 inches)

Material: Alluvial gold-bearing gravel, sand, and rocks with minimal sticky clay

Feeding method: Wheel-loader-fed hopper

Screening system: Heavy-duty vibrating shaker deck with integrated spray bars

Grizzly: Preferably no separate grizzly, subject to engineering evaluation

Screen apertures: Approximately 10–15 mm, subject to optimization

Water requirement: Approximately 3,000 GPM available, with final flow and pressure to be engineered

Gold recovery: Multiple parallel sluice boxes, preliminarily six at approximately 1 m wide × 7 m long

Power: Electric motors supplied by an industrial diesel generator

Operating schedule: Approximately 16 hours per day

Plant configuration: Modular design suitable for disassembly and relocation between mining sites

All preliminary specifications are subject to engineering verification and optimization.

SCOPE OF ENGINEERING WORK

1. COMPLETE PLANT DESIGN

Overall plant configuration and process flow

Loader-fed hopper and material distribution

Vibrating shaker deck and screening system

Spray bars and water distribution

Sluice boxes and gold recovery system

Oversize and tailings discharge

Modular structural supports and assembly connections

2. MECHANICAL AND STRUCTURAL ENGINEERING

Vibrating screen sizing and operating parameters

Exciter, spring, bearing, and motor selection

Dynamic load calculations and vibration isolation

Structural analysis, including fatigue-critical components

Steel frame and support design

Wear-resistant components and replaceable liners

Engineered lifting points and modular connections

The design must account for frequent 400 mm rocks in the feed material.

3. HYDRAULIC AND RECOVERY SYSTEM

Water flow and pressure calculations

Spray-bar and nozzle configuration

Pump and piping specifications

Sluice sizing, slope, and flow distribution

Fine gold recovery optimization

Water collection and discharge arrangements

4. FABRICATION AND ASSEMBLY DOCUMENTATION

We require a complete engineering package suitable for manufacturing by a third-party fabrication workshop.

Deliverables must include:

Complete 3D CAD assembly of the entire wash plant

Detailed 2D fabrication drawings for every manufactured component

Structural and mechanical engineering calculations

Material specifications and steel thicknesses

Welding and bolted-connection details

Complete bill of materials (BOM)

Specifications for purchased components

Steel cutting and fabrication schedules

Modular assembly and installation instructions

Electrical and mechanical equipment specifications

Editable CAD source files (SolidWorks, Inventor, or equivalent)

PDF and DXF manufacturing drawings

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Applicants should have experience with at least one of the following:

Heavy-duty industrial vibrating screens

Mineral processing plant design

Aggregate washing and screening equipment

Placer gold wash plants

Mining equipment manufacturing

Structural and dynamic analysis of vibrating machinery

Preference will be given to engineers who can demonstrate equipment they have personally designed that was successfully fabricated and operated.

PROPOSAL REQUIREMENTS

Please include the following information in your bid:

1. Examples of similar equipment or plants you have designed.

2. Your specific experience with vibrating screen engineering.

3. Whether you can provide complete fabrication-ready drawings and engineering calculations.

4. Your proposed project timeline.

5. Your estimated total project cost and recommended payment milestones.

6. The engineering and CAD software you use.

7. Whether you can provide technical support during fabrication and initial commissioning.

PROJECT OBJECTIVE

Our objective is to obtain a complete, independently engineered, manufacturing-ready design that can be fabricated in Ethiopia without purchasing a complete wash plant from an equipment manufacturer.

We are seeking an experienced engineering professional or team capable of taking the project from initial concept through final fabrication documentation.

This is not a CAD drafting or rendering-only project. Engineering calculations, mechanical design expertise, and practical manufacturing experience are essential.

The client must receive editable source files and the necessary rights to fabricate, modify, repair, and reproduce the custom-designed equipment. Any pre-existing or third-party intellectual property must be disclosed.

2. Schematics and PCB design files ready for fabrication. 
3. Enclosure CAD models optimised for prototyping (SLA/SLS) and eventual mass production. 
4. A brief report outlining component selections, expected RF performance, estimated weight, and assembly method. 

Acceptance criteria 
• Complete design fits within the maximum envelope you propose, documented with precise dimensions. 
• Bluetooth link budget and antenna placement are justified to ensure stable audio at typical phone distance. 
• Retrieval recess is proven usable with standard medical tweezers in a simple bench test or simulation.

If you have experience shrinking wearables, working with miniature speakers and low-power RF, I’m eager to see how small you can make this while keeping it practical and safe. Let’s discuss your initial thoughts and approach.

full:
Python + Gemini API + FFmpeg Developer for 1-Time Local Multimodal AI Auto-Clipping Setup (Google Meet)

Job Description:
I am looking for an experienced Python, Google Gemini API (`google-genai` SDK), and FFmpeg developer for a one-time, complete setup of a local, multimodal AI video auto-clipping pipeline on my computer. The setup and live verification will be completed over a Google Meet session (screen share).

Project Goal:
Build and configure a repeatable local CLI tool where I pass a long-form video file or gaming/podcast VOD URL (e.g., GTA 6 streams or talking-head videos), optionally enter a custom topic prompt, and automatically generate copyright-safe, vertical 9:16 YouTube Shorts/Reels—using Gemini's native multimodal capabilities with minimal API cost and zero paid SaaS subscriptions.

Required Architecture & Features:
1. Video Ingestion & Multimodal Analysis (Gemini File API):
 - Support local video files and `yt-dlp` time-slice downloads (YouTube/Twitch/Kick).
 - Upload long-form video/audio directly via the Gemini File API to analyze both spoken dialogue and visual cues (scene changes, reactions, emotions, on-screen action/slides) without requiring a separate transcription tool.

2. Token & Cost Optimization:
 - Implement Gemini Context Caching so the same uploaded video can be re-queried multiple times (e.g., new topic searches or extra clips) without re-uploading or repaying full input token costs.
 - Configure frame-rate sampling / media resolution settings to keep processing fast and API costs low.

3. AI Highlight, Hook & Copyright-Safe Detection (Gemini 2.5 Pro / Flash):
 - Prompt Gemini to identify the top 5–10 standalone, high-retention clips (30–60 seconds) with exact `HH:MM:SS` start and end timestamps.
 - Include safety filtering (e.g., skipping story cutscenes/spoilers for gaming clips).

4. Structured JSON Outputs (Response Schema):
 - Use Gemini Structured Outputs (Pydantic / Response Schema) so every call returns guaranteed valid JSON containing: start/end timestamps, virality score (1–100), on-screen hook text, reasoning, speaker/subject position tags, metadata, and timestamped captions.

5. Topic-Based Custom Clipping (Prompt Search):
 - Support an optional CLI flag (e.g., `--topic "police chases"` or `--topic "moments discussing pricing"`) so Gemini extracts topic-specific clips on demand from the cached video.

6. Smart Framing & Speaker Location Hints (Dynamic 9:16 FFmpeg Cropping):
 - Use Gemini visual analysis to tag subject/speaker framing (`left`, `center`, `right`, or `split-screen`) per timestamp segment and translate those hints into automated 9:16 (`1080x1920`) FFmpeg crop/layout commands.

7. Timestamped Subtitles, Translation & Auto-Generated Metadata:
 - Extract time-aligned captions from Gemini, burn styled bold subtitles (`.ass`/`.srt`) cleanly into the Shorts safe zone via FFmpeg, and support an optional `--lang` flag for multi-language subtitle translation.
 - Auto-generate scroll-stopping on-screen text hooks, YouTube Shorts/Reels titles, descriptions, and hashtags saved alongside each clip.

8. Copyright Audio Shield (Optional Toggle):
 - Integrate local `Demucs` (toggleable flag like `--strip-music`) to remove copyrighted background/radio music while keeping clean vocals/dialogue for gaming clips.

9. Clean 1-Command CLI & Handoff:
 - Wrap everything into a clean virtual environment with `.env` config so I can run commands like:
 `python clip.py "VIDEO_URL_OR_PATH" --clips 5 --topic "funny fails" --lang en --strip-music`
 - Include a short `README.txt` cheat sheet with all flags and usage examples.

My System: [Enter OS: macOS / Windows 11, RAM, CPU/GPU]
Session Format: One-time live Google Meet session (estimated 2–3 hours; you can pre-write the script beforehand and spend the call installing, tuning, and testing on my machine).
Budget: [Suggested: ₹4,500–₹8,000 / $60–$120 Fixed Price]

Definition of Done (Before Payment Release):
- Clean local setup (`venv`, `.env`, FFmpeg, `yt-dlp`, `google-genai`, `demucs`) with zero missing dependencies.
- Live end-to-end test in a brand-new terminal window processing 1 long-form video via Gemini File API + Context Caching.
- Live test of a second topic-based query against the cached video to verify Context Caching works.
- Successfully outputs ready-to-upload 1080x1920 (`yuv420p`) Shorts with smart framing, synced burned-in captions (plus 1 translated test), on-screen hook text, and metadata files.

To Apply, Please Answer These 3 Questions:
1. Have you built production scripts using the new `google-genai` Python SDK (specifically File API, Context Caching, and Structured Outputs / Response Schema)?
2. How would you handle FFmpeg dynamic cropping (`left`/`center`/`right`/`split-screen`) and ensure accurate caption timing across segment cuts?
3. What is your fixed price and availability to pre-build the script and complete the live Google Meet setup?

desc: I have three completed manuscripts—roughly 875 pages altogether—chronicling the birth, growth, and wild adventures of an international motorcycle club. My goal is a single, tightly written volume of about 450 pages that club members and prospective members can pick up and immedia…
full:
I have three completed manuscripts—roughly 875 pages altogether—chronicling the birth, growth, and wild adventures of an international motorcycle club. My goal is a single, tightly written volume of about 450 pages that club members and prospective members can pick up and immediately understand where we came from, who our key people are, and why our traditions matter.

Every page needs a purposeful place, so I want the fluff gone while the pulse-pounding stories stay. Please preserve:
• The main history and key events that define our timeline 
• The funniest and most exciting stories that show our spirit 
• The important people, individual chapters, and club traditions that give us identity 

The tone I’m after is a balanced mix of history, humor, and excitement—think fast-paced narrative nonfiction that still respects the facts. Continuity has to be rock-solid: events must flow logically, characters must stay consistent, and the overall voice should feel like one storyteller, not three stitched together.

Here’s how I picture the workflow:
1. Receive my Word docs or PDFs and propose a high-level outline for the condensed version. 
2. Perform structural/developmental edits to hit the 450-page target, trimming redundancies and tightening prose while flagging any gaps that need short bridges or clarifications. 
3. Line-edit the new manuscript in Track Changes, smoothing transitions and polishing style without diluting the club’s raw edge or humor. 
4. Deliver a clean .docx ready for layout plus a change log highlighting major cuts, merges, and rewrites.

Confidentiality is essential; these are real stories from real members. If this sounds like the kind of editorial ride you want to take, let’s talk timeline and milestones so we can get this history on the road.

About Kreato Global

At Kreato Global, we believe communication is a fundamental human right. Since 2020, Kreato USA Services LLC has provided professional interpreting across healthcare, legal, financial, customer service and community settings. Our services include over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), video remote interpretation (VRI), on-site interpretation and American Sign Language (ASL).
We’re growing our network of remote ASL interpreters who care about accessibility, accuracy and making a real difference in people’s lives.
The role
As a Remote ASL Interpreter, you’ll make communication possible between Deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals and hearing participants over secure video. About 90% of assignments are medical; the other 10% are general community settings.
What you’ll do

• Interpret ASL ↔ spoken English through our secure VRI platform

• Facilitate accurate, culturally appropriate communication between Deaf and hard-of-hearing patients, their families and healthcare providers

• Follow the RID Code of Professional Conduct, standards of practice and applicable regulations

• Protect patient privacy and comply with HIPAA

• Stay professional, calm and compassionate, including in sensitive or stressful situations

• Complete daily activity logs and required documentation accurately and on time

Requirements

• RID national certification, or another recognized ASL interpreting certification

• State license or registration, if your state requires one

• At least 1 year of professional interpreting experience (medical or VRI experience preferred)

• Strong command of ASL and English, written and spoken

• Comfortable with video technology and basic troubleshooting

• Must live in the United States

Remote setup requirements

• Computer with a webcam and headset

• Reliable high-speed internet (wired connection preferred)

• A private, quiet, well-lit workspace where no one else can see or hear sessions

• A plain, neutral background

You’ll thrive here if you:

• Pay close attention to detail and own the quality of your work

• Handle confidential information with discretion

• Adapt easily to different people, settings and communication needs

• Work well independently and follow established procedures

Why interpreters work with us

• Fully remote, on-demand work: you choose when to log in

• Steady weekday demand in healthcare settings

• Meaningful work that improves access to care

• A team that values your expertise and professionalism

How to apply
Apply through JazzHR with your résumé. Include your certifications and, if applicable, your state license. Credentials are verified, and onboarding must be completed before you can receive assignments.

title: Build Secure Euphoria Ticketing Platform
desc: # PROJECT REQUIREMENT — EUPHORIA 2027 **Project:** Event Ticket Booking & Management Website **Event Name:** EUPHORIA 2027 **Theme:** Luxury Black & Gold **Languages:** English + Hindi **Platform:** Responsive Website (Mobile + Desktop) ## 1. Project Overview We want to develop a…
full:
# PROJECT REQUIREMENT — EUPHORIA 2027

**Project:** Event Ticket Booking & Management Website 
**Event Name:** EUPHORIA 2027 
**Theme:** Luxury Black & Gold 
**Languages:** English + Hindi 
**Platform:** Responsive Website (Mobile + Desktop)

## 1. Project Overview

We want to develop a premium event ticket booking website for our New Year's event, EUPHORIA 2027.

The website should allow customers to explore event details, select ticket categories, book tickets online, make secure payments, receive digital tickets with QR codes, and enter the event through QR scanning.

Along with the customer-facing website, we need a complete Admin Dashboard to manage bookings, payments, ticket inventory, offline sales, staff and event entry.

## 2. Existing Project

We already have a basic React prototype featuring:

- Luxury black-and-gold design.
- English and Hindi language toggle.
- Event landing page.
- Ticket category selection.
- Demo booking modal.
- Starter Supabase database schema.

This is only a prototype. We need a developer to complete the backend and convert it into a secure, production-ready platform.

## 3. Customer Website Features

- Premium, modern and responsive UI.
- Event information, venue, date and timings.
- Artist/performer details and event gallery.
- Ticket categories:
 - General
 - VIP
 - Couple
 - Group
 - Early Bird
- Live ticket availability and pricing.
- Customer details form.
- Secure Razorpay payment integration.
- Booking confirmation.
- Unique QR-based digital tickets.
- Downloadable PDF tickets.
- Automatic email delivery.
- FAQ, Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy and Refund Policy.

## 4. Admin Dashboard

We need a complete admin panel with:

- Total bookings.
- Total tickets sold.
- Total revenue and payment status.
- Category-wise sales.
- Remaining ticket inventory.
- Customer and booking management.
- Refund and cancellation management.
- QR check-in statistics.
- Staff management and permissions.
- Sales reports and CSV/Excel export.

## 5. Offline Ticket Sales System

We also sell tickets physically at counters.

Admin/counter staff should be able to:

- Create offline bookings.
- Enter customer name and mobile number.
- Select ticket category and quantity.
- Record payment method and amount.
- Generate tickets with unique QR codes.
- Track which staff member made each sale.

Online and offline sales must use the same database and inventory so that tickets cannot be oversold.

## 6. QR Scanner & Entry Management

This is a very important feature.

- Mobile camera-based QR scanner.
- Individual QR code for every admission ticket.
- Server-side QR validation.
- One-time entry validation.
- Prevent duplicate entry.
- Show clear VALID, ALREADY USED and INVALID statuses.
- Record entry time and staff member.
- Admin can view all check-in records.

## 7. Technical Requirements

Preferred technology stack:

- Frontend: React / Next.js + TypeScript.
- Styling: Tailwind CSS.
- Backend: Next.js server-side APIs.
- Database: Supabase PostgreSQL.
- Authentication: Supabase Auth.
- Payments: Razorpay.
- QR generation and scanning: QR library / ZXing.
- PDF generation: Server-side PDF generation.
- Email: Resend or equivalent.
- Hosting: Vercel or equivalent.

Developer can suggest a better architecture if it meets all requirements.

## 8. Security Requirements

- Server-side payment signature verification.
- Razorpay webhook verification.
- Secure database permissions and RLS.
- Role-based admin and staff access.
- Unique, unpredictable QR tokens.
- Atomic one-time QR check-in.
- Prevent duplicate bookings and overselling.
- Keep API keys and secrets on the server.
- Maintain payment, booking and check-in audit logs.

## 9. Important Deliverables

We expect:

1. Complete responsive website.
2. Working customer booking system.
3. Razorpay integration.
4. Complete admin dashboard.
5. Offline counter sales module.
6. QR ticket generation and scanning.
7. PDF ticket generation.
8. Email confirmation and resend functionality.
9. Secure database and backend.
10. Production deployment.
11. Source code and setup documentation.
12. Testing and bug fixing before launch.

## 10. Developer Proposal

Please share:

- Your experience with React/Next.js and Supabase.
- Examples of similar projects you have built.
- Estimated development timeline.
- Total development cost with milestone-wise breakdown.
- Hosting and third-party service costs separately.
- Post-launch maintenance and support details.

**Important:** We already have a starter project. We want to build on it rather than unnecessarily redesign everything from scratch.

The final product must be a fully functional, secure and production-ready event ticketing platform, not just a frontend design or demo website.

desc: I have a collection of exclusive evening gowns aimed at the bridal and red-carpet market, and I need those ideas rendered as clean, professional technical sketches. My goal is to translate each design into front- and back-view flats that clearly communicate silhouette, proportion…
full:
I have a collection of exclusive evening gowns aimed at the bridal and red-carpet market, and I need those ideas rendered as clean, professional technical sketches. My goal is to translate each design into front- and back-view flats that clearly communicate silhouette, proportion, and key style lines so I can present them to manufacturers and clients with confidence.

You will receive my rough hand sketches, reference photos, and written notes on fabric choice and embellishment placement. From there, I need you to create precise digital line drawings—Adobe Illustrator or an equivalent vector format is ideal—showing:

• Front and back views of every gown 
• Accurate seams, darts, drape lines, and closures where visible 
• Scalable artwork that stays crisp when printed or embedded in a portfolio

I’m open to your suggestions on line weight, labeling conventions, and file organization so the final package is production-ready. Once we align on the first gown, the remaining pieces should follow the same level of detail and style consistency.

Deliverables
1. Vector files (AI, EPS, or SVG) for each gown, separated by front and back views 
2. High-resolution PDFs suitable for printing and digital presentations 
3. A short handoff note outlining any layer naming or color-coding you used

If you have a portfolio of fashion flats—especially bridal or red-carpet styles—please share it so I can gauge fit. Looking forward to seeing how you bring these gowns to life on paper.

desc: I'm looking for a creative website designer to help us develop a fresh, professional visual design for our home and kitchen products brand. We sell practical products for everyday use, mainly kitchen storage solutions, pantry organizers, and home accessories. We want our website …
full:
I'm looking for a creative website designer to help us develop a fresh, professional visual design for our home and kitchen products brand.

We sell practical products for everyday use, mainly kitchen storage solutions, pantry organizers, and home accessories. We want our website to feel modern, welcoming, and easy to navigate, while giving visitors a clear understanding of what we sell and what makes our products useful.

This project is strictly about website design. We are not looking for a developer or someone to build the website at this stage. I need the visual concept and design layouts prepared so they can be handed over for development separately.

I'd like the designer to create a cohesive visual direction for the website, including the homepage, product listing page, individual product page, About Us page, and Contact page. The product pages are particularly important because they need to present product photography, descriptions, key benefits, and specifications in a clean and attractive way.

I prefer a minimal, premium aesthetic with warm neutral colors, good typography, plenty of breathing room, and carefully selected visual details. The website should look professional without feeling overly corporate or generic. I'm open to creative suggestions if they make the overall shopping experience better.

I'll provide our logo, brand materials, product photography, descriptions, and other relevant content. You'll be responsible for turning these materials into a consistent website design.

I'm looking for someone with a strong portfolio in e-commerce or lifestyle website design. Experience with kitchen, home goods, or consumer product brands would be a plus. Please share examples of websites you've designed and briefly explain which parts of the design you handled.

The final deliverables should include desktop and mobile layouts, editable design source files in Figma, and organized design assets ready for developer handoff. No coding, website setup, hosting, or ongoing maintenance is required.

Project details:

Budget: $450 fixed price for the complete website design.

Timeline: 10–14 days.

Language: English.

Two reasonable revision rounds are included.

The project will begin with the main visual direction and homepage concept, followed by the remaining page layouts once the design direction is approved.

All communication, project discussions, file exchanges, and payments must remain exclusively on Freelancer.com. Payments will be made through agreed Milestone Payments on the platform. No off-platform communication or external payment arrangements.

full:
An example of the contest is this:
The project involves creating illustrations for a rhyming children's picture book about a father and his little daughter enjoying workouts together in their home gym. The book targets children aged 4–6 and requires a soft, dreamy watercolor style with warm colours, playful energy, expressive characters and heartwarming family moments.

Each manuscript page requires a full-page illustration showing movement, joy and the special bond between father and daughter. The characters, their proportions and the colour palette must remain consistent throughout the book. Gym equipment should appear friendly rather than intimidating, and clear spaces must be left for text placement.

The project will begin with character designs, rough sketches and storyboards, followed by clean linework and colour tests for the client's approval. Final deliverables will include high-resolution, print-ready illustrations at 300 DPI in CMYK with bleed, layered PSD or Procreate source files, and RGB versions for digital previews.

The initial sample features a smiling father wearing a blue shirt and dark trousers, exercising alongside his little daughter, who wears a pink shirt, purple leggings and a pink headband. They are sitting on exercise mats in a bright, cosy home gym, lifting colourful dumbbells together.

Before beginning the complete project, the illustrator should review the full manuscript, confirm the number of pages, book dimensions and deadline, and agree on pricing and revisions. The overall goal is to produce beautiful, consistent and engaging watercolor illustrations that bring the father-daughter fitness adventure to life.
Please consider me.

Because I want the ship to appear afloat, please integrate a transparent acrylic stand that sits just below the waterline; it will do the buoyancy work while keeping the model itself watertight.

Key deliverables
• Finished, painted 50 cm × 30 cm 3D-printed model with detachable half-hull 
• Functional LED system (grand staircase, windows, engine room) with concealed power source 
• Clear below-water stand that supports the model in a tank or pool without being visually intrusive 
• Basic assembly/operation guide and wiring diagram

I’ll review progress in stages—unpainted print, lighting test, final assembly—so sharing photos or video updates along the way is important. Once complete, package the ship securely for shipping so none of the printed parts or electronics shift in transit.

Should be in colours of the titanic

title: Amazon Kitchen Product Listing Design
desc: I'm looking for an experienced e-commerce graphic designer to create professional Amazon product listing images for my kitchen accessories store. We sell practical kitchen and home organization products, and I'm currently working on improving how our products are presented on Ama…
full:
I'm looking for an experienced e-commerce graphic designer to create professional Amazon product listing images for my kitchen accessories store.

We sell practical kitchen and home organization products, and I'm currently working on improving how our products are presented on Amazon. The photography is already available, but I need someone who can turn it into attractive, informative listing graphics that help customers understand the product and its benefits at a glance.

For this project, we'll start with 5 products from our kitchen storage collection. These include airtight food storage containers, pantry organizers, and related kitchen accessories.

Each product needs a complete set of 7 listing images. This means one main product image on a pure white background, several supporting images showing product details, dimensions and materials, and infographic-style graphics highlighting the main selling points. I'd also like a few lifestyle compositions showing the products in realistic kitchen environments.

I'm particularly interested in designs that look clean and premium without overcrowding the images with text or decorative elements.

Technical requirements:

5 products, 7 images per product (35 images total).

Image dimensions: 2000 × 2000 px.

Main images must follow Amazon's white-background requirements.

Supporting images should include product dimensions, key features, materials, and practical use cases.

Lifestyle images should show realistic product placement in kitchen interiors.

Final exports in high-quality JPG or PNG.

Editable source files in PSD or AI.

All text, measurements, and product claims must match the information provided.

I'd also like one basic A+ Content layout for one of the products, including a product introduction, feature comparison section, and lifestyle visuals. The design should be prepared according to Amazon's standard A+ Content layout requirements.

I'll provide original product photos, product specifications, measurements, descriptions, and brand materials. You're welcome to suggest creative layouts and visual approaches, but accuracy is important. Please don't add product features or claims that aren't supported by the supplied information.

I'm looking for someone who has actually worked on Amazon listings before and understands how to balance visual appeal with clear product information. Please include examples of Amazon product image sets you've designed, preferably for kitchen, home, or lifestyle products.

Project details:

Budget: $550 fixed price for all 5 products and the A+ Content layout.

Timeline: 10–14 days.

Language: English.

Up to two reasonable revision rounds per product are included.

If the first project goes well, I expect to have additional products that will need the same type of design work.

All communication, project discussions, file exchanges, and payments must remain on Freelancer.com. Payment will be handled exclusively through agreed Milestone Payments on the platform. No external payment arrangements or off-platform communication.

title: Star Wars Futuristic Streetwear Prompts
desc: I need a bank of carefully-crafted text prompts that can be dropped straight into Midjourney, DALL·E, or any comparable image generator to produce realistic, cinematic scenes in a Star Wars–inspired universe. The final images will be published as standalone social-media posts, so…

The clothes should sit front and centre, arranged on invisible mannequins, draped over hover crates, or suspended mid-air with dramatic lighting and deep cinematic shadows. Fabrics, textures, and tech-wear details need to read crisply at feed scroll size yet remain believable at full resolution.

• A quick reference sheet explaining how each prompt ties back to the Star Wars visual language without infringing on trademarks.

I’ll handle the image generation once the prompts are in hand; what I’m looking for from you is the creative phrasing, the environmental storytelling, and the technical prompt structure that consistently yields scroll-stopping, outfit-first visuals. If you’re confident in balancing fashion detail with cinematic sci-fi flair, let’s get started.

full:
# Freelancer Required: Kids Educational E-Books, Activity Worksheets & Colouring Books

**Project:** Kiddory – Children's Educational Learning Platform 
[removed by freelancer admin]
**Project Type:** Fixed-Price | Content Writing, Illustration & PDF Design 
**Target Age Group:** 2–8 Years 
**Hiring:** Experienced Children's Educational Content Creators / Graphic Designers

## Project Overview

We are looking for a creative and experienced freelancer or small team to develop a complete collection of **original, high-quality, printable educational e-books, activity worksheets and colouring books** for our children's learning platform, Kiddory.

All content must be engaging, age-appropriate, visually attractive, educationally meaningful and suitable for digital downloads and professional printing.

## Scope of Work

### Part A: 20 Educational E-Books (Free Collection)

Create 20 separate educational e-books, each containing **10–15 pages**, including the cover.

**Book Categories:**

1. My First ABC Adventure
2. Numbers Are Fun (1–20)
3. Shape Safari
4. My Rainbow Colour Book
5. Happy Farm Friends
6. Wild Animal Explorer
7. Fruits & Vegetables
8. My First Pencil Tracing
9. Patterns & Sequences
10. My Body & Five Senses
11. Things That Move
12. Opposites Everywhere
13. Little Maze Adventures
14. Matching Activities
15. Spot the Difference
16. My First Hindi अक्षर
17. Beginner Addition
18. My First Sight Words
19. Feelings & Good Habits
20. Personalized Name Activity Book

**Expected Output:** Approximately 240–300 pages.

### Part B: Three Complete Age-Based Learning Bundles

**Bundle 1: Little Explorers (Ages 2–4)**

150 pages covering colours, shapes, animals, fruits, tracing, matching, senses, basic identification and colouring activities.

**Bundle 2: Smart Starters (Ages 4–6)**

240 pages covering alphabets, phonics, handwriting, numbers, counting, early mathematics, Hindi अक्षर, patterns, mazes and reasoning.

**Bundle 3: Bright Achievers (Ages 6–8)**

300 pages covering English reading, vocabulary, grammar, addition, subtraction, numbers, time, money, Hindi, environmental science, logical reasoning and creative activities.

**Total:** 690 pages across three bundles.

Each bundle must have a structured, progressive learning sequence, not simply a collection of unrelated worksheets.

### Part C: 100 Original Colouring Pages

Create 10 theme-based colouring collections with 10 pages per theme.

Themes:

1. Jungle Animals
2. Farm Animals
3. Dinosaurs
4. Vehicles & Machines
5. Underwater World
6. Space & Planets
7. Nature & Gardens
8. Indian Festivals
9. Fantasy & Magical Characters
10. Community Helpers

Illustrations should have clear, age-appropriate outlines, appealing original characters and printable white backgrounds.

## Design and Quality Requirements

- Original, professional, child-friendly illustrations and layouts.
- Age-appropriate learning activities with accurate educational content.
- Colourful educational books and printer-friendly activity sheets.
- A4 printable format, preferably 300 DPI or suitable vector quality.
- Attractive individual covers for every book and bundle.
- Consistent Kiddory branding and design style.
- Clear typography, sufficient writing space and easy-to-follow instructions.
- Original content suitable for commercial redistribution and future physical printing.
- No copyrighted characters, copied worksheets, unlicensed stock assets or third-party branding.
- Deliver complete editable source files along with final PDFs.
- Personalizable templates for selected activities, especially name tracing.

## Final Deliverables

- 20 individual educational PDF books.
- 3 complete learning bundles containing 34 mini-books in total.
- 100 original themed colouring pages, arranged into 10 downloadable sets.
- Individual cover designs and product preview images.
- Editable source/design files.
- Answer keys wherever applicable.
- Commercial-use rights documentation and confirmation of originality.

**Estimated total production: 1,047 pages across educational books, bundles and colouring sheets.**

Any content reused between free and premium collections must be clearly disclosed and approved. Premium bundles should provide substantial additional learning material.

## Freelancer Requirements

We prefer candidates with prior experience in preschool worksheets, children's workbooks, kindergarten learning materials, educational illustration or activity-book publishing.

Knowledge of Indian preschool and primary education standards would be an advantage.

## Quotation Requested

Please submit your proposal with:

1. Portfolio showing similar educational books or worksheets.
2. Total fixed-price quotation for the complete project.
3. Separate pricing for Parts A, B and C.
4. Expected delivery schedule with milestones.
5. Software/tools you will use.
6. Details of editable source files provided.
7. Number of revisions included.
8. Confirmation that Kiddory will receive the necessary commercial reproduction, modification, distribution and print rights.
9. Cost for future additional books or pages.

**Selection Process:** Shortlisted freelancers may be asked to prepare a small, mutually agreed sample before the complete project is awarded.

We are looking for a long-term creative partner, as Kiddory plans to expand into personalized storybooks, premium printed activity books and additional educational collections.

**Please share your best quotation, relevant portfolio and proposed timeline.**

– Basic color grading plus light skin retouching in Lightroom/Photoshop (retain natural texture) 
– Web-friendly versions for social media, plus print-ready files at 300 dpi
