Are you a social media detective? Do you love researching people, connecting the dots, finding information, and solving mysteries?

We’re looking for a sharp, resourceful, money-motivated Social Media Researcher & Claimant Outreach Specialist to join our growing surplus funds recovery business!

This is NOT your typical social media job. You won’t be posting selfies or chasing likes. You’ll be using Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other online research tools to help locate people who may be entitled to money they don’t even know exists!

Imagine helping someone discover that they may have $50,000, $100,000, or even more in unclaimed surplus funds!

Your research could help change someone’s financial future — and earn you a serious commission!

COMPENSATION — GET PAID TO RESEARCH!

* Base pay: $3 USD per hour
* Schedule: 40 hours per week
* Weekly base pay: $120
* Two-week base pay: $240
* Commission: 5% of our company’s collected recovery fee on qualifying deals you help originate
* Potential for additional projects and long-term opportunities based on performance

EXAMPLE: ONE $100,000 CLAIM!

Let’s say you help us locate someone entitled to $100,000 in surplus funds.

Our company successfully completes the recovery and collects a 20% fee.

* Total surplus recovered: $100,000
* Company recovery fee: $20,000
* Your 5% commission on that fee: $1,000!

That’s $1,000 in commission from ONE qualifying successful recovery!

Add your $240 base pay for the two-week project, and your potential gross earnings could be $1,240!

Two qualifying recoveries of the same size could mean $2,000 in commissions, plus base pay.

Important: These are illustrative examples, not guaranteed earnings. Commissions are paid only after a qualifying deal successfully closes, the company receives its fee, and the researcher’s contribution has been verified. Recovery cases may take weeks or months to complete.

YOUR MISSION

You will become part of our online research and outreach team.

Your responsibilities include:

1. Social Media Investigation & Research

Use company-authorized accounts and approved research methods to:

* Search Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn for assigned claimants.
* Identify potential matches using publicly available information.
* Research publicly visible family connections, friends, and possible relatives to help verify contact information.
* Investigate publicly available location, employment, and background clues relevant to claimant identification.
* Cross-reference information to avoid contacting the wrong person.
* Organize findings and document useful research sources.

2. Claimant Outreach & Messaging

* Send professional, personalized messages using company-approved scripts and accounts.
* Contact potential claimants through permitted platform messaging channels.
* Explain that they may be entitled to recover unclaimed surplus funds.
* Respond professionally to interested individuals.
* Refer interested claimants to our recovery team.
* Maintain respectful communication and follow up with interested contacts.

3. Follow-Up Management

We don’t want someone who sends one message and disappears!

You’ll be responsible for:

* Monitoring replies and identifying interested claimants.
* Scheduling follow-ups.
* Keeping accurate contact records.
* Updating the team when a claimant responds.
* Following through on assigned leads until they’re transferred, closed, or marked inactive.
* Respecting opt-outs and requests not to be contacted.

4. Daily Research Reports

At the end of EVERY shift, you must submit a detailed report showing:

* Claimants researched
* Potential matches located
* Social media profiles reviewed
* Messages sent
* Replies received
* Interested claimants identified
* Follow-ups completed
* Follow-ups scheduled
* Leads referred to our team
* Challenges encountered
* Next-day action plan

We value productivity, accuracy, and results!

PLATFORMS YOU’LL USE

* Facebook
* Instagram
* LinkedIn
* TikTok
* Google Search
* Company-provided research tools
* Company-approved CRM and tracking systems

Company accounts and necessary instructions will be provided. All activity must follow platform rules, privacy requirements, and our outreach policies. No impersonation, unauthorized account access, misleading claims, or harassment.

WORK SCHEDULE

Monday through Friday — Full-Time

Choose one available shift:

* 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time
* 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time

Project duration: 2 weeks initially

Total expected paid hours: 80, subject to the agreed schedule and applicable break requirements.

We’re looking for someone who can dedicate their full attention during working hours.

Strong performers may be invited to continue working with us after the initial project!

WHO WE WANT

We’re looking for someone who is:

* Naturally curious and resourceful
* Excellent at social media research
* Comfortable navigating multiple platforms
* A strong written English communicator
* Detail-oriented and organized
* Self-motivated and able to work independently
* Persistent without being pushy
* Comfortable following procedures and meeting deadlines

Packing and loading assistance.

Your responsibility will be to work on the existing files, make the necessary improvements and modifications as per my specific instructions, and deliver a fully functional, professionally polished website in ready-to-publish HTML format.

## Scope of Work

The selected freelancer will be required to:

1. **HTML Refinement:** Review, clean, correct and improve the existing HTML files without unnecessarily changing the existing structure or content.

2. **Design & UI Improvements:** Improve the overall appearance, layout, typography, colour combinations, spacing, alignment, headers, footers, navigation menus and other visual elements as instructed.

3. **Content Integration:** Insert the text, information, images, contact details, service descriptions, legal information and other content that I will provide.

4. **CSS & JavaScript Corrections:** Fix existing CSS and JavaScript errors, improve styling and ensure all interactive elements work correctly.

5. **Responsive Design:** Ensure that all website pages function properly on desktops, laptops, tablets and mobile phones.

6. **Navigation & Internal Linking:** Check and correct all internal links, buttons, dropdown menus, hyperlinks and navigation between different HTML pages.

7. **Forms & Functionalities:** Review existing contact forms, enquiry forms, WhatsApp buttons and other interactive features and implement the required corrections.

8. **Consistency Across Pages:** Maintain a uniform design, layout, branding and professional appearance throughout all website pages.

9. **SEO & Technical Optimisation:** Improve basic on-page SEO, page titles, meta descriptions, image alt attributes and HTML structure wherever required.

10. **Final Testing:** Test all pages and functionalities and remove broken links, visual inconsistencies and coding errors before final delivery.

## Important Requirements

- I will provide the existing HTML files and all relevant website materials.
- I will provide specific instructions regarding the changes, content and modifications required.
- The freelancer must work on the existing website rather than independently creating a completely different website.
- All changes must be incorporated into the actual source files.
- The original website's essential structure and functionality should be preserved unless modifications are specifically instructed.
- The final website must be delivered in complete, organised HTML, CSS, JavaScript and associated asset files.
- The final files must be ready to upload to a web hosting server and publish under my domain name.
- The source code must remain fully editable.

## Expected Deliverables

1. Complete revised HTML files for all website pages.
2. Updated CSS and JavaScript files.
3. Properly organised images, icons and other assets.
4. Fully responsive and tested website.
5. Complete source-code folder or ZIP file.
6. A final working version ready for website hosting and publication.

## Ideal Freelancer

The freelancer should have:

- Strong experience in HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript.
- Experience in editing and maintaining existing multi-page websites.
- Good understanding of responsive web design.
- Ability to follow detailed instructions and implement changes accurately.
- Experience in website debugging, optimisation and UI/UX improvements.

## Before Applying

Please share examples of websites you have previously worked on, particularly projects involving the modification, redesign or improvement of existing HTML websites.

I am looking for someone who can carefully understand my instructions, make changes accordingly and deliver a polished, professional and fully functional website ready for publication.

**Note:** This is primarily an existing website refinement and customisation project, not a website development project from scratch.

title: Workout Content Manager
desc: Location: Remote - eligible US locations About the role and about You: Zwift is looking for a Workout Content Manager to join our Content team. In this role, you'll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining Zwift ’s workout library that drives engagement, performanc…
full:
Location: Remote - eligible US locations
About the role and about You:
Zwift is looking for a Workout Content Manager to join our Content team. In this role, you'll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining Zwift’s workout library that drives engagement, performance, and fun across a global community of Zwifters.
You’ll manage the day-to-day creation and refinement of workouts and training plans, ensuring they are grounded in sound training principles and meet Zwift’s high standards for experience and accuracy. You’ll also contribute to broader strategic initiatives supporting personalization, AI/LLM systems, and seasonal campaigns while working cross-functionally with product, engineering, marketing, and our coach community.
We’re looking for someone who can operate independently, execute with precision, and has a deep understanding of structured training. You don’t need to be a coach, but fluency in endurance training concepts and athlete performance data is highly encouraged.
What you’ll do: 

• Own the strategy and execution of structured workout content across Zwift, ensuring it reflects strong training principles and aligns with product and content priorities

• Design and build new workouts and training plans while independently maintaining and evolving existing .zwo libraries

• Conduct regular content audits to ensure clarity, training logic, discoverability and quality across the workout experience

• Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering and Marketing to ensure structured content supports feature launches, campaigns and emerging recommendation systems

• Contribute to long-term planning around how workouts support personalization, AI/LLM-powered systems, and seasonal programming

• Track and report on workout performance, proactively identifying optimization opportunities and presenting findings to stakeholders

What we’re looking for: 

• Experience designing and managing a structured workouts library, preferably using .zwo, XML, or similar formats

• Strong knowledge of endurance training principles, including FTP, power zones, and recovery-based training 

• Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality content independently, with minimal oversight

• Familiarity with performance data tools and ability to translate metrics into purposeful training design

• Clear and confident communicator who can collaborate across cross-functional teams

• Highly detail-oriented with a mindset for QA, content accuracy, and optimization

Bonus points: 

• Certification or experience as a coach (e.g., USA Cycling, British Cycling, TrainingPeaks Level 1+)

• Experience working with Git or CMS tools and comfort navigating structured data formats (XML, JSON, etc.)

• Understanding of personalization and recommendation engines, especially for fitness products

• Experience managing contractors or content creators

If Zwift determines in any stage of our interviews that any AI tools are being used without disclosure or citation, your candidacy will be disqualified.
For All US Based Full-Time Positions:
The base salary for this position ranges between$70,500 to $110,000. The base salary will be based on a number of factors including the role offered, the individual's job-related knowledge, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, Zwift is proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package for all eligible employees which also includes performance bonuses, equity, and a full range of medical, financial, and other perks and benefits.

How to stand out among the rest:

Your resume/CV is enough to show off your skills, accomplishments, and experience. However, if you choose to include a cover letter introducing us to your awesome personality, we will read that too.

We strongly believe that different backgrounds and ideas are a competitive advantage; we hire candidates of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, Veteran status, and any other status. Zwift is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by emailing .

Zwift, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

desc: I’ve wrapped the 120,000-word first draft of my novel, Deity, and now I need a meticulous editor to help me bring it up to publishing quality. Your first focus will be polishing sentence flow, dialogue, and punctuation so every chapter reads smoothly. As we progress, I’ll also lo…
full:
I’ve wrapped the 120,000-word first draft of my novel, Deity, and now I need a meticulous editor to help me bring it up to publishing quality. Your first focus will be polishing sentence flow, dialogue, and punctuation so every chapter reads smoothly. As we progress, I’ll also look to you for:

• Consistent, professional-grade punctuation and line edits 
• Stronger monologues in the opening chapters 
• Honest, detailed feedback on the depth and logic of the world-building 

I already have the ending and major plot points locked in, so your developmental insight should concentrate on how those elements unfold on the page rather than re-plotting the story itself.

Payment starts at $30 per chapter and is issued per chapter—never by the hour—so you’ll always know where you stand. I’m happy to discuss adjustments once we’ve assessed the workload together.

Because Deity is destined for future adaptations, editors who can also illustrate or handle basic website design will move to the front of the line.

When you reply, show me your experience with long novels that feature complex worlds. Link or briefly describe finished projects you’ve guided from rough draft to publication; that track record will tell me far more than a generic proposal ever could.

If you’re ready to dive into a sweeping fantasy and help it shine, I look forward to reading your pitch and, soon after, your first round of edits.

title: GoHighLevel CRM WIZ Needed
desc: I run a home-service business and already have GoHighLevel in place, but the platform still isn’t doing the heavy lifting it should. My immediate priority is crystal-clear: set up leads, pipelines, and follow-ups so every inquiry is routed, tracked, and nurtured automatically. He…
full:
I run a home-service business and already have GoHighLevel in place, but the platform still isn’t doing the heavy lifting it should. My immediate priority is crystal-clear: set up leads, pipelines, and follow-ups so every inquiry is routed, tracked, and nurtured automatically.

Here’s what our collaboration will look like:
• Map and build a full pipeline—from first contact through job completion—inside GoHighLevel. 
• Configure triggers, tags, and smart lists that move prospects between stages without manual work. 
• Design follow-up sequences (email, SMS, voicemail drops) that fire at the right moments, keeping homeowners engaged until they book. 
• Provide snapshot backups and clear documentation so the system is easy to tweak as services or seasons change.

We’ll work together on an ongoing basis: quick sprints for new campaigns, tune-ups after we test, and periodic reviews of the analytics dashboard to spot leaks.

If you’re a GoHighLevel power-user who can translate home-service workflows into clean automations, let’s get started—the sooner this pipeline hums, the faster we grow.

title: Non-Fiction Book Review Writer
desc: I’m looking for a sharp, engaging voice to produce thoughtful reviews of non-fiction titles that will live on my blog and be repurposed across social channels. The emphasis is on how well each author communicates their ideas—tone, flow, clarity, and overall readability—rather tha…
full:
I’m looking for a sharp, engaging voice to produce thoughtful reviews of non-fiction titles that will live on my blog and be repurposed across social channels. The emphasis is on how well each author communicates their ideas—tone, flow, clarity, and overall readability—rather than a deep fact-checking dive. 

You will receive a reading list (business, memoir, and popular science to start), along with basic background on my site’s style and audience profile. Each review should feel conversational yet authoritative, giving visitors a clear sense of whether the book will keep them turning pages, skimming sections, or abandoning it altogether.

Deliverables 
• One polished review per assigned title (approx. 600–800 words) highlighting writing style, pacing, structure, and audience fit 
• A punchy 50-word teaser suitable for Instagram/Facebook captions 
• Two pull-quotes from the book that illustrate the writing quality discussed in the review 

I handle formatting and publishing, so a clean Word or Google Doc is all I need from you. If you love dissecting the craft behind compelling non-fiction and can meet agreed deadlines, let’s chat and get the first title in your hands.

title: Roblox Game Promo Video Campaign
desc: I have a handful of Roblox titles that need a steady flow of fresh players, so the mission is simple: turn raw gameplay into punchy 10-30 second highlight clips and place them where Roblox fans actually watch. The goal is clear—drive new joins to my games. What you’ll do • Captur…
full:
I have a handful of Roblox titles that need a steady flow of fresh players, so the mission is simple: turn raw gameplay into punchy 10-30 second highlight clips and place them where Roblox fans actually watch. The goal is clear—drive new joins to my games.

What you’ll do 
• Capture or request any gameplay you need from me, then edit it into short, high-energy clips that spotlight the most exciting moments. 
• Publish those clips on YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram, cross-posting to relevant Roblox groups and communities. 
• Pitch and place the videos on established YouTube channels that feature Roblox content, negotiating shout-outs or collabs when useful. 
• Track views, click-through rates, and—most important—new players joining the games, refining the approach week by week.

Acceptance criteria 
• Minimum of X short clips delivered weekly (we’ll set X together). 
• Each clip uploaded to all three socials within 24 hours of approval. 
• At least two placements per week on third-party Roblox-focused YouTube channels or group pages. 
• A simple weekly report summarizing watch stats and in-game join growth.

You’re free to use whatever editing tools you love—CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci Resolve—so long as the final videos feel native to each platform and stay under 30 seconds.

If you already have relationships with Roblox influencers or mod groups, tell me; fast access matters. Let’s get new players flooding in.

title: Warm English Voice-Over for Video
desc: I’m putting the finishing touches on a short promotional video and now need an English voice-over that sounds genuinely warm and friendly. The script runs about a minute; I’ll supply the final text as soon as we start. What matters most to me is an approachable tone that feels co…
full:
I’m putting the finishing touches on a short promotional video and now need an English voice-over that sounds genuinely warm and friendly. The script runs about a minute; I’ll supply the final text as soon as we start.

What matters most to me is an approachable tone that feels conversational without losing clarity—something that invites viewers in rather than sells to them. A clean, broadcast-quality recording is essential, so a treated booth and a good mic chain are a must. Please record in 48 kHz/24-bit WAV (I’ll also take an MP3 for quick review) and leave a couple of seconds of room tone at the top for noise reduction if needed.

Here’s how I see the hand-off going:
• You record and edit a first take, removing breaths or mouth clicks as appropriate. 
• I listen and, if any single-line tweaks are needed, you provide up to two quick pickups. 
• Final approved file is delivered via Dropbox, Google Drive, or WeTransfer—whatever’s easiest.

If you have previous work that shows a similar friendly style, feel free to share a link so I can be sure the match is right. Looking forward to hearing your voice bring this video to life.

title: Cozy Christmas Video Edit
desc: I have a finished video that I’d like transformed into a warm, Christmassy piece. Picture soft, glowing lights and gentle snowfall drifting across the frame—the kind of scene that feels like sitting by a fireplace while snow settles outside. I would also like the man sitting down…
full:
I have a finished video that I’d like transformed into a warm, Christmassy piece. Picture soft, glowing lights and gentle snowfall drifting across the frame—the kind of scene that feels like sitting by a fireplace while snow settles outside. I would also like the man sitting down to be dressed in a Santa outfit. 

Here is what I need: 
• Add a realistic falling-snow overlay that never obscures faces or key visuals. 
• Introduce subtle, warm light leaks or bokeh glows to give everything a cozy amber tint. 
• Replace (or layer beneath) the current audio with gentle acoustic Christmas music that features bells, mixing in light festive sound effects so nothing feels jarring. 
• Keep the edit tasteful—no over-the-top graphics or comedic elements; think comforting rather than playful. 
• Deliver the final video in the original resolution and aspect ratio, along with a high-quality export (H.264 or ProRes). If you edit in Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve, please include the project file too.

Acceptance criteria 
1. Snowfall looks natural and loops seamlessly. 
2. Light glows enhance, not wash out, skin tones. 
3. Music is properly leveled so dialogue (if any) remains clear. 
4. Final render is artifact-free and matches the source length to the frame.

I’ll provide the source video and any branding assets as soon as we start. Looking forward to seeing this piece wrapped in holiday warmth!

title: Educational YouTube Video Design
desc: I’m looking for a creative video designer who can craft a modern, visually appealing YouTube-style training video that teaches school-level lessons. The final piece should feel fresh, easy to follow, and perfectly suited for an online classroom environment. Here’s what I need fro…
full:
I’m looking for a creative video designer who can craft a modern, visually appealing YouTube-style training video that teaches school-level lessons. The final piece should feel fresh, easy to follow, and perfectly suited for an online classroom environment.

Here’s what I need from you:
• A complete visual design for the video, including opening and closing graphics, lower-thirds, and any on-screen text or iconography that helps clarify each lesson point. 
• Smooth motion graphics and subtle animations that keep students engaged without distracting from the core material. 
• A consistent design system—fonts, colour palette, and layout—so future lessons can match seamlessly.

I’ll provide the lesson outline, raw screen recordings or slides, and branding assets. You’ll blend those with your own creative touches in Premiere Pro, After Effects, or the tool you’re most comfortable with, then deliver the finished 1080p file plus an editable project file.

The video’s purpose is purely instructional, so clarity and pacing are critical. If you’re excited to turn curriculum content into an engaging, student-friendly presentation, I’d love to see a sample of your past educational work and discuss the timeline.

title: Benefit-Focused Product Testimonials
desc: I need a set of fresh, authentic-sounding testimonials for a physical product we’re about to relaunch. Each quote should read as if it’s coming from an everyday shopper who has actually used the item and is excited about the real-world benefits they experienced—think time saved, …
full:
I need a set of fresh, authentic-sounding testimonials for a physical product we’re about to relaunch. Each quote should read as if it’s coming from an everyday shopper who has actually used the item and is excited about the real-world benefits they experienced—think time saved, money saved, peace of mind, or any other tangible wins that feel natural.

Here’s what will make the work a perfect fit:
• Voice and tone: friendly, conversational, and believable, just like something you’d see on Amazon or in a social media comment. 
• Focus: keep the spotlight on clear results or improvements the customer noticed after using the product; avoid technical deep dives or manufacturing details. 
• Variety: mix up length (one-sentence sound bites through to short paragraphs) so the testimonials don’t all look templated. 
• Format: deliver everything in a single Google Doc or editable Word file, one testimonial per line followed by the first name and city (you can fictionalize lightly to boost realism). 

I’ll provide a brief on the product’s key features and current messaging as soon as we start, then we can agree on the exact number of testimonials—likely 8 to 10. If you’ve written UGC, product reviews, or DTC website copy before, you’ll feel right at home.

title: Romantic Floral Digital Wedding Invitation
desc: The task is to create a single high-resolution image that serves as our digital wedding invitation. I want a romantic, floral aesthetic—think soft botanicals, elegant typography, and a gentle colour palette that feels warm and heartfelt. Once finished, I will be sharing this file…
full:
The task is to create a single high-resolution image that serves as our digital wedding invitation. I want a romantic, floral aesthetic—think soft botanicals, elegant typography, and a gentle colour palette that feels warm and heartfelt. Once finished, I will be sharing this file directly by phone with family and friends, so it must look crisp on both iOS and Android screens.

Key details that need to sit beautifully within the design:
• Our names, wedding date, time, and venue 
• A short RSVP line with the URL or phone number I’ll supply 
• Any dress-code note, discreetly placed

Final deliverable
• 1 static image in PNG and JPEG, 1080-by-1920 px (or your suggested optimal mobile size) 
• A layered source file (PSD or AI) so I can tweak wording last-minute if needed 

Acceptance criteria
• Romantic + floral style is clearly reflected 
• Text remains legible on standard phone brightness 
• No compression artefacts at 100 % zoom 

When sending your bid, please include a concise project proposal outlining concept, timeline, and revision process so I can see exactly how you’ll bring this invitation to life.

full:
Saya ingin meningkatkan pendapatan tambahan dengan membangun kanal media sosial yang aktif. Untuk itu, saya membutuhkan bantuan Anda membuat rangkaian video vertikal berdurasi singkat (maks. 60 detik) khusus untuk TikTok, Reels, dan Shorts.

Apa yang perlu Anda lakukan:
• Riset tren singkat dan menyusun ide konsep yang berpotensi viral. 
• Menyiapkan naskah singkat, visual story-board sederhana, dan memilih backsound populer bebas copyright. 
• Mengedit footage (bisa stok atau kiriman saya) menjadi video 9:16 lengkap dengan caption, efek transisi ringan, dan teks dinamis. 
• Mengirim file akhir format MP4 dan, jika diminta, file proyek asli (CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, atau After Effects). 

Kriteria yang saya cari:
• Terbiasa bekerja online dari rumah secara mandiri. 
• Mahir desain gambar, editing video, dan content creation. 
• Memahami algoritma serta gaya cepat TikTok, Instagram, dan YouTube. 
• Siap komunikasi rutin lewat chat untuk revisi singkat. 

Keberhasilan proyek diukur dari:
• Minimal 3 video siap-unggah per minggu. 
• Kualitas visual tajam, audio jernih, dan pacing menarik. 
• Konten mengikuti tren tanpa melanggar hak cipta atau pedoman komunitas. 

Jika Anda antusias membuat video pendek kreatif yang bisa menarik penonton dan membantu saya menambah penghasilan, kirimkan contoh portofolio terbaik Anda.

full:

Picture quick-cut battle sequences, dynamic camera moves, powerful sound design, and an adrenaline-driven score that hooks viewers in the first few seconds and leaves them craving the full series.

Your task is to craft a short film-style trailer that runs roughly one minute, blending high-energy editing with slick visual effects. I’m counting on you for everything that makes an action trailer pop: dramatic pacing, impactful transitions, and seamless syncing of music, SFX, and dialogue stingers where needed. If you can handle motion graphics for logos or title cards, even better.

Deliverables 
• Final trailer (HD, ready for web and social) 
• Source project files so I can make future tweaks

Once I see a polished cut with the right momentum and cinematic flair, I’ll sign off. Let’s make viewers hit replay and ask when the full show drops.

Saya membutuhkan seseorang yang dapat:
• Merancang strategi pendanaan lengkap (grant proposal, pitch deck, hingga kalender kampanye)

Hasil akhir yang saya harapkan meliputi paket proposal pendanaan siap kirim, file video promosi final (format HD), serta rencana peluncuran terperinci. Jika Anda berpengalaman dalam crowdfunding, penulisan proposal, dan produksi konten kreatif, mari berkolaborasi.

full:
We are looking for an experienced graphic designer to create a professional, modern and premium branding and food packaging collection for a new hospitality business.

We are after a bold, distinctive and visually appealing design that maintains a consistent brand identity across all products.

Requirements:

- Experience in professional logo and food packaging design.
- Modern, creative and premium design approach.
- Consistent branding across all 12 items.
- Realistic 3D mockups for packaging designs.
- Print-ready files suitable for commercial manufacturing.
- Fully editable source files (Adobe Illustrator preferred).
- Revisions included in the project.

We will provide reference images, branding details, packaging specifications and other requirements to the selected freelancer.

When applying, please provide examples of previous packaging design work, your fixed price for all 12 items, estimated turnaround time and the number of revisions included.

Further project details will be shared privately with shortlisted freelancers.

I'm looking for an experienced GTA 6 player who owns a PS5 and can record long hours of high-quality GTA 6 gameplay footage.

- Record GTA 6 gameplay in 1080p or 4K resolution.
- Complete story missions from beginning to end.
- Explore the open world, different locations, and activities.
- Include full gameplay and cutscenes without skipping important parts.
- Record long sessions with clear in-game audio.
- Provide original, raw and unedited gameplay footage.

I'm looking for approximately 20–30 hours of gameplay recording per week. The footage should be continuous and engaging, mainly focused on completing story missions and exploring the game.

**Requirements:**
- Must own a PS5 and GTA 6.
- Must have enough storage for long gameplay recordings.
- Must be able to share large video files through Google Drive or another agreed platform.

**Payment:**

Payment will be hourly and depends on recording quality and experience. This can become a long-term project if everything goes well.

If you're interested, please share:
- Confirmation that you own PS5 and GTA 6.
- Your recording quality (1080p/4K).
- Your availability per week.
- Your expected hourly rate.

Looking forward to working with you!

title: Homestay Booking Website Development
desc: I already have the hosting and domain in place—now I need the full website built for my homestay. Guests must be able to reserve rooms, bundled tour packages, and extra add-ons such as meals or transport from a single, streamlined interface. They should have the choice to pay onl…
full:
I already have the hosting and domain in place—now I need the full website built for my homestay. Guests must be able to reserve rooms, bundled tour packages, and extra add-ons such as meals or transport from a single, streamlined interface. They should have the choice to pay online at the time of booking or settle the bill on arrival, with every transaction reflected in an internal billing dashboard. Please add upcoming tour plan options for participating any influencer or travel agency 

For each room, the site has to display high-quality photos, pricing, facilities, a live availability calendar, and guest reviews, so visitors get all key details before confirming. Behind the scenes I’ll need a booking and check-in/out manager that syncs availability in real time, generates invoices, and triggers automated confirmation and reminder emails.

In addition to lodging, I’d like a small shopping page for local products plus a tour-planning section that lets guests browse and add excursions to their cart during checkout. Everything should be mobile-responsive, SEO-friendly, and easy for me to update later through a clean admin panel.

Deliverables:
• Responsive website with room, tour, and shop modules 
• Integrated booking engine, availability calendar, and dual payment workflow (online or pay-on-arrival) 
• Back-office dashboard for bookings, guest profiles, and billing reports 
• Email templates for confirmations, reminders, and invoices 
• Basic training or hand-off documentation so I can manage content on my own 

If you prefer WordPress with WooCommerce, Laravel, or another proven stack, I’m open—as long as the final product is fast, secure, and user-friendly.

title: YouTube & Instagram Reels Editor
desc: I shoot a mix of lifestyle vlogs, casual gaming clips, and day-to-day moments that need trimming into short-form Reels for both YouTube Shorts and Instagram. The goal is to keep everything feeling natural and easy to follow—quick cuts only where they help the story flow—while add…
full:
I shoot a mix of lifestyle vlogs, casual gaming clips, and day-to-day moments that need trimming into short-form Reels for both YouTube Shorts and Instagram. The goal is to keep everything feeling natural and easy to follow—quick cuts only where they help the story flow—while adding eye-catching, animated captions with key words highlighted so viewers can watch silently and still stay engaged. No memes, reaction inserts, or flashy sound effects; just clean, viewer-friendly edits that let the content speak for itself. 

Here’s what I’ll need from you for each video: 
• A finished vertical MP4 (1080 × 1920) under one minute 
• Animated on-screen captions with color or size emphasis on important words 
• A separate caption file (SRT or similar) for accessibility 
• The editable project file in whatever software you use (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve are all fine) 

Please share links to any previous Reels, Shorts, or TikToks that showcase this straightforward, text-driven style and let me know your usual turnaround time. I’m aiming for an ongoing collaboration once we get the workflow dialed in.

title: Shopify Site for Online coaching Brand
desc: I need a clean, modern Shopify presence that showcases my online personal training brand, builds trust, and funnels visitors toward booking our consultations. The core objective is brand promotion rather than running a large online storefront, so aesthetics, storytelling, and smo…
full:
I need a clean, modern Shopify presence that showcases my online personal training brand, builds trust, and funnels visitors toward booking our consultations. The core objective is brand promotion rather than running a large online storefront, so aesthetics, storytelling, and smooth navigation matter more than complex inventory features.

Here’s what I have in mind:
• A visually soothing theme tailored to wellness, customised with my colours, fonts, and imagery. 
• Clear service pages that highlight benefits, pricing, and a simple call-to-action button that can link to our existing booking app. 
• Space for a small product range (no more than ten skus) presented in a way that complements the service focus. 
• An About section crafted for authority and warmth, plus an easily editable blog for tips on skin, mindfulness, and healthy living. 
• Mobile-first layout, fast loading, on-page SEO basics, and integration of Google Analytics.

Please share examples of previous Shopify sites—especially any in beauty, health, or wellness—and outline what you did on each project. Your experience with theme customisation, Liquid, and basic SEO will help me choose the right partner. Once the draft site is live on my domain and I’m comfortable updating text and images myself, the project is complete.

title: Facebook Content & Ads Awareness Boost
desc: My company is ready to raise its profile on Facebook and I need a marketer who can plan, create, and schedule attention-grabbing posts as well as manage paid ads that focus on brand awareness. The content mix that works best for us is straightforward: striking photos or short vid…
full:
My company is ready to raise its profile on Facebook and I need a marketer who can plan, create, and schedule attention-grabbing posts as well as manage paid ads that focus on brand awareness. 

The content mix that works best for us is straightforward: striking photos or short videos that highlight our products and services, paired with helpful tips and industry facts that position us as a knowledgeable voice. Each post should carry consistent visual styling, a clear message, and a subtle call-to-action aimed at growing our follower base rather than pushing hard sales.

While Facebook is the immediate priority, I would also like guidance on small website touch-ups—think fresh blocks or sections that mirror the social campaigns—so visitors experience the same look and feel when they click through.

Deliverables I will review weekly: 
• A content calendar covering posts and ad concepts for the next seven days 
• Ready-to-publish visuals and copy for each post or story 
• Ad set build-out with audience targeting and budget recommendations 
• Brief report on reach, engagement, and any learning that should shape the following week 
• Suggestions for minor website updates that keep messaging in sync

Please bring experience with Facebook Business Suite or Meta Ads Manager, a solid eye for design, and the ability to translate data into clear next steps. If this sounds like your wheelhouse, let’s talk details and timing.

title: Brand Logo & Promo Designs

full:
I’m ready to give my company a memorable face and need a talented designer to create a complete logo and brand identity. The focus is—exactly as I selected—Logo and brand identity, and every element you craft must help me Promote products or services across today’s most active social channels.

Deliverables must include editable vector/source files (AI or EPS), web-ready PNG/SVG exports, and a concise PDF brand guide. All artwork should be 100 % original, balanced for both print and digital use, and ready for immediate rollout the moment we sign off.

If this fits your skill set, I’d love to see your portfolio and discuss timelines—let’s build a brand that converts browsers into buyers.

title: Manager, Product Design
desc: Headquarters: Remote About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, healt…
full:
Headquarters: Remote

About Carrot: 

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity 

Carrot’s User Experience team is seeking a Manager, Product Design to lead a team of senior product designers building our member-facing products. You’ll lead project work, raise the craft bar through direct feedback, and help our design function evolve as AI tools reshape the boundaries between design, product management, and engineering. You’ll partner with Content Design, Product Management, and Engineering leaders to deliver products that scale our impact to members worldwide.

This is a true player-coach role: roughly half your time goes to hands-on design work, including design system and foundational direction, and half to leading and coaching the team. If you love sharpening experienced designers’ work, designing for a diverse set of member needs across all paths to parenthood, and shaping how a design team works in an AI-enabled future, this role is for you.

What You’ll Own 

In this role, you will:

• Lead design initiatives from strategy to launch, ensuring work meets project goals, timelines, and business priorities.

• Give clear, actionable craft feedback through critiques and design reviews, holding a high bar for quality, consistency, and accessibility.

• Contribute hands-on design, prototypes, or direction on complex, high-visibility initiatives, including design system and foundational work.

• Coach designers to plan and run their own research, from study design through synthesis, and ensure qualitative and quantitative evidence shapes design decisions.

• Partner with Product and Engineering leaders on goals, scope, and delivery, and communicate the team’s results and design rationale to senior stakeholders.

• Drive adoption of AI tools that help designers work faster, more consistently, and with greater capacity, and evaluate what works.

• Help redefine how design works with product and engineering as role boundaries shift, and recommend process changes to the product development lifecycle.

• Hold regular 1:1s and coach designers on craft, influence, and career growth, tied to Carrot’s leveling framework.

• Own performance management, including goal-setting, reviews, and calibration input, and address gaps directly and fairly.

• Build an inclusive, psychologically safe culture where designers feel ownership of their work.

What Success Looks Like  

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

• Delivered design work on high-visibility initiatives that met project goals, timelines, and business priorities.

• Established a critique and design review rhythm that has visibly raised the quality, consistency, and accessibility of what the team ships.

• Introduced AI tools and practices that improved the team’s speed, consistency, or capacity, and helped clarify how design works with product and engineering as roles shift.

• Built a research practice in which designers plan and run their own studies, and evidence shapes design decisions.

• Coached each designer with clear goals, regular feedback, and a development path tied to Carrot’s leveling framework, and built a team culture where designers feel ownership of their work.

About You 

You likely have:

• A Bachelor’s degree

• 10+ years in product design or UX/UI, including 2+ years managing designers.

• A portfolio of shipped, user-centered, member- or consumer-facing digital products, with evidence of leading a team’s output.

• A track record of coaching experienced designers, giving direct craft feedback, and handling performance conversations.

• Hands-on experience using AI tools to prototype and ship design work, and helping a team adapt its practices as roles evolve.

• Experience evolving a design system in collaboration with engineers, ideally across multiple products.

• Strong knowledge of interaction design, visual design, WCAG accessibility, and responsive and mobile design.

• Experience planning and running user research, from interviews and usability testing to quantitative analysis, and coaching designers to do the same.

• Excellent communication skills, including influencing senior stakeholders and articulating design rationale.

• Comfort with ambiguity and change in a fast-paced agile environment, with clear trade-off decisions.

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

• Experience designing configuration-driven products, where rules and settings (such as eligibility or plan rules) determine what each person sees.

• Familiarity with the healthcare industry, insurance, finance, and compliance, alongside sensitivity to the challenges of fertility health and family forming around the world.

• Familiarity with front-end development principles (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to collaborate effectively with engineers.

• Experience managing distributed or global teams across time zones.

## Focus Reset — Minimalist Digital Wellness Ebook

**Focus Reset** is a clean, modern 12-page ebook designed to help readers reduce digital distractions and rebuild a healthier relationship with their phones.

The project is centered around a **7-day digital minimalism plan**, with each day introducing one simple, practical habit—from silencing unnecessary notifications and decluttering the home screen to creating phone-free meals and establishing an evening screen-free routine.

### Project Highlights
- 12-page minimalist ebook design
- Clean black-and-white visual style
- Structured 7-day digital detox/focus challenge
- Daily actionable tasks and habit-building exercises
- 7-day progress tracker
- Clear typography and strong visual hierarchy
- Designed for easy reading and practical use
- Final reflection section to help users create their own long-term phone rules

### My Approach
I focused on creating a **minimal, distraction-free visual experience** that matches the concept of the ebook itself. The layout uses generous spacing, simple typography, consistent page structure, and a restrained visual language to keep the reader focused on the content.

The final page encourages readers to continue at least one habit every day, reinforcing the core idea of protecting attention intentionally.

**Tools/Skills:** Ebook Design · Graphic Design · Typography · Layout Design · Visual Hierarchy · Minimalist Design · Editorial Design

full:
I need a lean, first-release tool that turns a rough sentence or two into ready-to-publish social media posts. The focus is squarely on that “idea-to-post” transformation; scheduling, analytics, and multi-platform planning can wait for a later sprint. 

Here’s what matters right now: 
• A simple input box for the user’s short idea or bullet points. 
• Instant generation of a polished post, complete with hashtags, an engaging hook, and an optional CTA. 
• Clear, uncluttered UI—think single-page web app or lightweight desktop build. 
• Fast performance; I’d like a prototype I can demo within days, not weeks. 

You’re free to tap into OpenAI, Claude, or any comparable LLM as long as the final code is clean, documented, and easy to hand off. RESTful endpoints, React or Vue front-end, and a Git repo handover would be perfect, but I’m flexible if you have a faster stack in mind. 

Deliverable: a working MVP I can share with early testers, along with setup instructions so I can deploy it immediately after review.

title: AI Social Media Editor MVP
desc: I want to build a modern AI-powered photo and video editing platform, mainly for Instagram, TikTok, Reels, YouTube, and other social media platforms, but also for general editing. The platform should include: 1. AI Automatic Editing: Users can upload photos or videos, and AI will…
full:
I want to build a modern AI-powered photo and video editing platform, mainly for Instagram, TikTok, Reels, YouTube, and other social media platforms, but also for general editing.

The platform should include:

1. AI Automatic Editing: Users can upload photos or videos, and AI will automatically edit and improve them.
2. Multiple AI Results: The AI should generate several different editing options so users can choose their favorite.
3. Manual Editing: Users should also be able to edit photos and videos manually, including cropping, trimming, adding text, filters, music, effects, and other basic tools.
4. Social Media Content: Easy creation of Instagram posts, Stories, Reels, TikTok videos, and other content.
5. Multiple Languages: The platform should support several languages, including English and Hebrew, with the option to add more languages.
6. Mobile and Desktop: It must work smoothly on iPhone, Android, tablets, and computers through a responsive website.
7. Modern Design: A beautiful, simple, fast, and professional interface that is easy for beginners to use.

My starting budget is approximately 3,000 ILS (around $800 USD).

I understand that advanced AI features may require a larger budget. I am looking for a developer who can build the best possible first version using existing open-source tools and affordable AI APIs, with the possibility of adding more features later.

Please send me your fixed price, estimated delivery time, examples of previous work, and which features you can realistically include within my budget.

I want full access to the source code and the ability to expand the platform in the future.

full:
I have a batch of product shots that need a clean cut-out and a fresh, natural lifestyle backdrop. Your job is to remove every trace of the original background, keep edges crisp, preserve any realistic shadows, and then place each item into a scene that feels genuine—think everyday countertops, desks, or outdoor surfaces that complement the product without stealing the spotlight.

The deliverable I need from you is a high-resolution PNG for each image, ready for immediate use across web and social. Colour accuracy is essential; please avoid visible halos, harsh filters, or warping that could distort the item’s proportions. Light retouching of dust or minor blemishes is welcome if it helps maintain a polished result.

I’ll start by sending 10 photos as a trial set, with a larger batch waiting once we nail the look and workflow. Let me know your expected turnaround time and share a couple of before/after samples of similar lifestyle composites you’ve created so I can gauge style fit.

Acceptance criteria:
• Precise, artifact-free cut-outs
• Believable natural-light lifestyle background integrated with realistic shadows/reflections
• Final PNGs delivered at original resolution (layered PSDs also acceptable if you prefer)
• Consistent visual tone across the whole set

title: AI Animation Content Creator + Social Media Manager (30-Day Daily Video Series)

full:
I'm launching "The Challengers," a 30-day public build-in-the-open series. Three Lagos creators use AI to sell video and website services and share their real progress every day. The three characters are animated, semi-realistic AI versions of the founders. I need a reliable creator to produce the daily animated videos and run the posting and social media management.

I already have a lot done:

Locked character sheets (turnaround and expressions) for all three characters
Environments and locations (studio, restaurant, house and more)
Voice settings for each character
A shot-by-shot plan for every episode, with exact reference images, prompts, dialogue, camera notes and edit notes

You will turn these plans into finished videos and publish them.

What you will do

Produce one animated vertical video per day (9:16, about 35 to 75 seconds) from my plans. The workflow is ChatGPT images for the reference stills, Google Flow (Gemini Omni Flash, character feature) for the clips, and CapCut for the edit.
Edit each video: captions, text layers, sound design, music and the screen elements I specify.
Publish at the same time every day (7:00 pm WAT) on Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Facebook Reels. LinkedIn is for recap posts only.
Write captions and hashtags from the brief I give you, and schedule each post.
Reply to comments within 24 hours in the brand voice. Send any business inquiry or DM lead to me the same day.
Send me a short weekly report: views, saves, shares, follows and what performed best.
Keep the character look and voices consistent, and tell me early if something drifts.

What I will give you

The full plan for each episode (script, shots, prompts, reference images)
All character sheets, locations and voice settings
Captions, hashtags and the posting schedule
Fast feedback, with a response in 24 hours or less

Requirements

Proven experience with AI video tools, ideally Google Flow, Veo or similar, and with character-consistent animation
Strong CapCut or Premiere editing for vertical short-form video
Experience publishing and managing Instagram and TikTok accounts
Reliable daily delivery. This is a 30-day streak, so missed days hurt.
Good English
A portfolio of animated or AI short videos, ideally with character consistency and lip sync

Important

I will not share account passwords. I will give you delegated access through Meta Business Suite and the platform's own tools, or you will use a scheduling tool.
All finished videos, project files and assets belong to me.
I will share the character files and plans after you are awarded the job and have signed a simple NDA. Some upcoming episodes contain reveals I want kept private.
Please say in your bid whether it includes AI generation credits and tool costs.

Timeline
Start now. The first block is 30 days (Day 1 to Day 30), with the option to continue after that.

title: Design Two Rajasthan Boutique Retreats
desc: Freelance Architect / Farmhouse & Boutique Retreat Designer Required Project Location: Khandela, Sikar, Rajasthan, India We are looking for a talented and experienced Freelance Architect / Hospitality Designer / Landscape Designer to develop two existing private countryside prope…
full:
Freelance Architect / Farmhouse & Boutique Retreat Designer Required

Project Location: Khandela, Sikar, Rajasthan, India

We are looking for a talented and experienced Freelance Architect / Hospitality Designer / Landscape Designer to develop two existing private countryside properties into attractive, comfortable and commercially viable private outhouse retreats.

1. About the Project

We have two properties located in and around Khandela, Rajasthan:

Property 1 – Maji Saab Ki Dhani

- Located on Khandela–Palsana Road.
- Approximately 2–5 bigha of land.
- Existing construction, basic rooms, electricity and water facilities.
- Proposed concept: Premium private countryside retreat for day outings, family gatherings, birthday celebrations, anniversaries, evening parties and overnight stays.

Property 2 – Kerpura Village

- Located in Kerpura, Khandela Tehsil.
- Approximately 2–5 bigha of land.
- Existing construction, basic rooms, electricity and water facilities.
- Proposed concept: Peaceful rural farmhouse experience with traditional Rajasthani aesthetics, garden, outdoor seating, family activities and comfortable overnight accommodation.

2. Scope of Work

We are looking for a professional who can provide practical, aesthetically appealing and budget-conscious development solutions for both properties.

The expected scope includes:

1. Physical site visit, measurement and assessment of existing structures.
2. Overall master planning and optimum utilisation of available land.
3. Architectural design and exterior elevation.
4. Interior design and improvement of existing rooms.
5. Bathroom renovation and modernisation suggestions.
6. Landscaping, lawn, plantation and garden design.
7. Outdoor seating, gazebo, dining and gathering spaces.
8. Lighting, pathways, entrance and boundary aesthetics.
9. Swimming pool feasibility and design, if technically and economically viable.
10. 2D architectural layouts and 3D visualisations.
11. Material specifications and item-wise Bill of Quantities (BOQ).
12. Phased execution plan with estimated construction and development costs.

3. Design Expectations

We want to create two distinctive properties rather than conventional hotels.

- Property 1 should have a premium, attractive and celebration-friendly ambience.
- Property 2 should offer a peaceful, natural and authentic Rajasthani countryside experience.
- Both properties should be photogenic, comfortable, family-friendly and suitable for commercial guest bookings.
- Maximum utilisation of existing construction and infrastructure.
- Preference for economical materials, locally available resources and low-maintenance solutions.

4. Budget Consideration

Our indicative development budget is approximately ₹5–10 lakh per property, depending on feasibility and priorities.

We are particularly interested in professionals who can deliver excellent design, planning and technical solutions at competitive and reasonable professional fees.

We are open to suggestions for phased development, prioritising essential amenities and avoiding unnecessary expenditure.

5. Expected Deliverables

Please quote separately for:

- Site visit and measurements.
- Concept development and master plan.
- 2D architectural drawings.
- Exterior and interior 3D views.
- Landscape and outdoor development design.
- Detailed BOQ and material specifications.
- Optional site supervision and execution assistance.

6. Who Should Apply?

- Freelance architects.
- Farmhouse and resort designers.
- Hospitality and boutique-retreat designers.
- Landscape architects.
- Experienced architectural designers and 3D visualisation professionals.

Professionals with previous farmhouse, resort, homestay, holiday-home or hospitality projects will be preferred.

7. Please Share the Following

1. Your professional profile and experience.
2. Portfolio and photographs of completed projects.
3. Relevant farmhouse, resort or hospitality design projects.
4. Proposed professional fee for both properties.
5. Deliverables included in your quotation.
6. Estimated project completion timeline.
7. Whether you can physically visit both sites in Khandela, Rajasthan.

Important: We are looking for a long-term professional association if the initial assignment is successful. Quality, creativity, practical execution and cost-effectiveness will be the key selection criteria.

Interested professionals are requested to submit their proposals with their best competitive quotation.

Let's transform two existing properties into beautiful and commercially successful countryside destinations!

I need a curated pack of AI image prompts that consistently generate full-body streetwear shots on Instagram-ready proportions. Each prompt should place diverse, everyday models in a polished, clean-city fashion editorial setting—think broad daylight, sharp architecture, muted reflections, and subtle sci-fi touches on the garments. 

The focus is complete outfits, so prompts must call out color palettes, fabric textures, accessories, and any signature futuristic details that elevate the look without tipping into heavy cyberpunk. I’ll be running these through Midjourney and Stable Diffusion, so include the typical command syntax, aspect ratios, and key modifiers that deliver crisp, photorealistic results while keeping file sizes social-media friendly. 

Deliverables 
• A minimum of 40 unique text prompts, each numbered and proof-tested for consistency (one sample render per prompt as reference). 
• A short usage note explaining aspect ratio choices, upscaling steps, and seed handling for repeatability. 

Acceptance criteria 
• Every sample render shows a head-to-toe outfit on a single model, no cut-offs. 
• Models reflect varied ethnicities and body types. 
• Backgrounds remain clean, daylight urban—no neon, no gritty overlays. 
• Prompts copy-paste directly into Midjourney / Stable Diffusion with no additional tweaking needed.

If you are passionate about complex problem solving and motivated by scale, then this is the role for you!

• Proven experience designing engaging product experiences across mobile, desktop, and web, backed by a strong portfolio

• A track record of leading, coaching, and developing designers and researchers, including senior designers

• Hands-on experience in usability testing, UX research methods, and agile and Double Diamond processes

• Professional working proficiency in English and Hungarian, needed to collaborate with team members and stakeholders

• Background in design or a related field, with hands-on knowledge of design and prototyping tools

• Recognised internally as a leader who connects design quality to business goals

• Regarded internally as a coach who helps others learn from mistakes and keeps morale high

• Respected internally for acting without waiting for permission and fixing what is broken

It's great, but not required: 

• Experience with AI-assisted design workflows for exploration, prototyping, and evaluation

• Hands-on experience in design system strategy or governance

• Provides specialized technical input to studies and design for staff's specific area of expertise.

• Approves and signs off on work.

• Collaborates with other engineers and stakeholders to develop specifications and design criteria.

• Provides technical expertise for studies and design efforts.

• Presents complex technical solutions to clients.

• Performs quality control reviews of work developed by others.

• Participates in development of technical proposals.

• Provides estimates for the engineering budget and schedule to meet requirements on large projects.

• Working knowledge of applicable local and national building codes

• Willing to travel as required.

• Knowledge of sustainable plumbing design and basic LEED building practices.

• Relocation is not available for this role

title: Calm Anime Explanation Voiceover
desc: I’m producing a series of short “anime explained” videos aimed at people who are brand-new to the genre, so every script is written in straightforward language and avoids heavy fandom jargon. What I need from you is a calm, clear English narration that guides viewers through each…
full:
I’m producing a series of short “anime explained” videos aimed at people who are brand-new to the genre, so every script is written in straightforward language and avoids heavy fandom jargon. What I need from you is a calm, clear English narration that guides viewers through each plot point without rushing or sounding overly dramatic. Think of it as the friendly teacher who makes a complex story easy to follow.

For every episode I will supply a fully timed script, reference video, and pronunciation notes where needed. You simply record the voiceover, clean it up (noise removal, basic EQ, loudness around –16 LUFS), and deliver a high-quality WAV plus an MP3 version. Typical runtime per video 1hour, and I’m planning an initial batch of five episodes with the possibility of more if we click.

I’m comfortable with either an American or a neutral international accent, as long as the delivery stays relaxed and crystal clear. If you can share a short sample that matches this tone, that will help me lock in the right voice quickly. Turnaround for the first script is three days after hire, with similar timelines for the rest.

Looking forward to hearing how you bring these stories to life for brand-new anime fans!

Headquarters: Atlanta, GA - Hybrid; Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid; Toronto, Ontario - Remote

About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

Gusto’s looking to bring on several Staff Product Designers across our Money and HR Experience product organizations. These teams sit on some of the highest-stakes, most AI-native surfaces at Gusto, where small businesses make financial and people decisions that carry real impact, and where getting the experience right is what builds durable trust. That's exactly why judgment, taste, and craft matter here.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll own experiences end to end within a specific domain, turning ambiguity into clear, trustworthy products and helping define patterns that don't yet exist at Gusto. You'll be deeply embedded in the product quartet, driving design decisions in partnership with Product Managers and Engineers, and demonstrating high craft and storytelling every step of the way.

This is one job posting for five open roles in Gusto Money, Banking, and HR Experiences product orgs. You'll be matched to the opportunity that best fits your strengths and interests. Here are the teams currently hiring:

• Consumer Banking: Consumer Banking builds financial products for the millions of employees paid through Gusto, anchored to Gusto Wallet — spend accounts, savings goals, paycheck splitting, and on-demand access to earned wages. Because Gusto runs payroll, the team sits at the source of income itself, helping workers smooth cash flow between paychecks, save automatically, and avoid predatory alternatives like payday lenders and overdraft fees. One of the fastest-growing engines in Gusto Banking, it moves at a startup pace while incubating 0→1 foundational technology in a regulated space where trust, reliability, and craft are everything.

• 
Gusto Money: MoneyOS is the team within Gusto Money focused on helping small businesses better understand, manage, and improve their financial position. This is an especially exciting moment for the team. The space is still taking shape, which means there’s real room to define the product, the patterns, and the customer expectations. MoneyOS works at the intersection of product strategy, financial systems, customer trust, and emerging AI-native ways of building—making it a strong fit for a designer who wants to have outsized influence on both what we build and how we build it.

• HR Experiences (HRX): HRX helps small businesses get expert HR help right inside the product — a customer simply says what they need, and Gusto takes the action, answers the question, or brings in a human expert when the stakes are high. You'll design AI-native experiences across a two-sided service — the everyday self-serve moments, the AI that guides and does the work, and the human HR experts who step in when it matters most — so it all feels like one Gusto, in a domain where judgment and trust matter enormously.

Here's what you'll do day-to-day:

• Own design end to end in your domain — from framing ambiguous problems to shipping high-craft, accessible experiences that hide the underlying complexity from customers.

• Shape goals, priorities, and roadmap in partnership with your PM and engineering lead, balancing customer trust, business value, and technical realities.

• Translate ambiguous, often 0→1 strategy into clear scopes, flows, and interaction patterns — including patterns that don't yet exist at Gusto.

• Design the experience of AI thoughtfully — representing uncertainty, surfacing errors gracefully, preserving customer agency, and knowing when a human should step in.

• Ground your decisions in customer insight, leading or partnering on research, competitive audits, and hypothesis-driven exploration in high-stakes, sometimes compliance-sensitive domains.

• Raise the craft and systems bar, evolving Gusto's design system where existing patterns fall short.

• Work in fast cycles and use AI tools in your own practice — set a clear target, prototype and ship real things to customers, and let what you learn sharpen the direction.

Here's what we're looking for:

• 6+ years of product design experience owning and shipping end-to-end work, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, or another high-trust domain, with strong craft across web.

• Experience designing AI-enabled or conversational experiences shipped to real users, and you can speak concretely to how you handled uncertainty, errors, and human override.

• Comfort with ambiguity and 0→1, you frame the problem, scope the work, and move forward without waiting for perfect information.

• Strong systems thinking, you use and contribute to a design system and know when to evolve it.

• Judgment to evaluate and direct AI outputs, when to use them, when to override them, and how to raise the bar, especially where the cost of being wrong is high.

• Strong collaboration and communication across design, product, engineering, and data.

Bonus points

• Experience in a high-stakes or regulated domain, fintech, financial services, HR, compliance, legal, or healthcare…

title: Service Booking Website & Admin Dashboard
desc: I run a small team that handles cleaning, moving, furniture assembly, delivery, and gardening jobs. I need a modern, mobile-friendly website that makes it effortless for visitors to land on the homepage, understand what we do at a glance, and book the help they need. Core user fl…
full: I run a small team that handles cleaning, moving, furniture assembly, delivery, and gardening jobs. I need a modern, mobile-friendly website that makes it effortless for visitors to land on the homepage, understand what we do at a glance, and book the help they need. Core user flow • Visitors arrive on a polished landing page, pick a service, complete a simple booking form, choose a date and time, upload any helpful photos, and pay online and an option to pay cash. • They can just as easily request a quote when details are unclear. • Once the booking is placed, customers create (or log in to) an account where they can track job status in real time and review past orders. Back-office requirements On my side I want a clean dashboard—accessible from any device—to view, edit, and assign incoming jobs, update progress, issue invoices or refunds, and export basic reports. Staff logins with role-based permissions are essential so the team only sees what they need. Key expectations – Sleek, fast UI that feels current rather than templated. – Secure payment integration (Stripe or similar). – Responsive design and clear calls to action. – SEO-ready structure and Google Analytics connected. – Training or concise documentation so my team can add services, prices, and promotions without developer help. Tech stack is open; WordPress with custom plugins, Laravel + Vue, or a React/Node build are all fine as long as performance, security, and future scalability are covered. Deliverables 1. Live website hosted on our domain, HTTPS enabled. 2. Admin dashboard with role controls and job management. 3. Payment gateway fully tested in production mode. 4. One-page guide (or short screen-share session) explaining routine updates. If you have previous examples of service-booking portals or dashboards you built, share the links so I can gauge fit. Let’s create a site that impresses at first click and keeps operations tidy behind the scenes.

title: PIR-Activated SAMD21 LED Control
desc: Project Description, PIR to SAMD21 to LED COB A schematic was designed to turn on a 12 volt COB strip (BTF-LIGHTING UL Listed FCOB COB LED Strip Light Warm White 3000K DC12V) with a PIR (AM312). When the PIR motion detector is triggered a signal is sent to a microprocessor, SEEED…
full:
Project Description, PIR to SAMD21 to LED COB

A schematic was designed to turn on a 12 volt COB strip
(BTF-LIGHTING UL Listed FCOB COB LED Strip Light Warm White 3000K
DC12V) with a PIR (AM312). When the PIR motion detector is
triggered a signal is sent to a microprocessor, SEEED SAMD21,
which is programmed to stay on for five minutes.

Closet_SEED_XIAO_schematic_240920.jpg

A PCB was designed from the schematic.

closet_xiao_PCB_top_layer_b_&_w_240930.jpg

In testing the system works in turning on the LED strip.
But in turning off the light it has three behaviors.
1. Sometimes, but rarely, the system operates as designed.
That is, the light comes on when the PIR is triggered,
stays on for five minutes and then goes off.
2. More often, the light comes on when triggered
and after five minutes the light goes off for
a split second and comes back on.
3. In other tests the system comes on and never goes
off.

The PIR has been tested and operates normally. The
tests demonstrate that the PIR, when triggered
sends a 3.2 volt signal for 3 seconds and then
returns to 0 volts.

A test at pin 3 of the SAMD21 shows that the
output of the microprocessor is the same as the
the three behaviors of the LEDs described above.

A test at the Gate of the transistor is also the same as the
the three behaviors of the LEDs described above.

The project has three parts:
1. Either rework the existing schematic or draft
a new schematic that will operate the LED strip
as intended and described in the first two
sentences of this text.

2. After the schematic by contractor is delivered to
Allen Pitts, Allen Pitts will design a PCB in
software DipTrace based on the schematic by contractor.
A JPG of the PCB, similar
to the JPG marked 'Closet XIAO 240930',
will be delivered to the contractor The second part
of project is for the contractor to review the
PCB and advise Allen Pitts that the PCB
design is consistent with the schematic
by contractor. If the PCB
design is not consistent with the schematic
by contractor, the contractor will
make recommendations for rework of
the PCB by Allen Pitts and the reworked
PCB will be delivered to the contractor
for review and advice.

3. When the PCB is received by Allen Pitts
from the manufacturer the PCB will be tested by
Allen Pitts and the result of the tests
will be presented to the contractor.

The project is split into three parts
because after the schematic by contractor
is received by Allen Pitts it will take
some days to translate the schematic
by contractor into a PCB. And after
the PCB is reviewed and approved
it can take weeks for the PCB to
be delivered by the manufacturer.

Because of this project timeline
there will be four payments:
1. Project acceptance and initiation.
2. Schematic by contractor delivered.
3. PCB reviewed and approved.
4. PCB tested for normal operation.
Although the microprocessor sketch is
not an item in the project the sketch is attached
herewith to provide context.
