ABOUT THE COMPANY: 
The company is a Melbourne-based landscape design studio founded by Drew Burns, specialising in native and climate-adaptive gardens for residential clients across Melbourne and the Mornington Peninsula. The client's philosophy is simple: every project starts with a clear plan that resolves layout, levels, materials, and planting before anything is built - so construction happens without guesswork, miscommunication, or costly rework.
The studio's process runs in two stages: a concept report developed locally with the client, followed by detailed construction drawings. We're growing our team to bring the construction drawing stage in-house on an offshore basis, freeing up our local design team to focus on new client work while drawings progress in the background.

ROLE OVERVIEW:
We're looking for a skilled CAD draftsperson to take finalised landscape design concepts and turn them into accurate, buildable construction drawing sets. This is a genuine long-term team role, not a one-off gig - we're investing in someone who wants to grow with the business, not just complete tasks.
The ideal candidate is confident in producing both construction drawings and photorealistic renders, giving us a single point of contact who can carry a project from concept through to construction-ready documentation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Convert approved concept designs into detailed, accurate construction drawing sets (setout plans, levels, sections, details, planting plans, and material schedules).
• Work primarily in Vectorworks to ensure drawings are consistent with the client's existing file standards and templates.
• Produce photorealistic or presentation-quality renders to support client approvals, where required.
• Liaise with Drew and the local design team to clarify design intent, resolve details, and incorporate feedback.
• Maintain drawing accuracy for levels, drainage falls, and material junctions so drawings are genuinely buildable on site.
• Manage your own workflow and deadlines across multiple concurrent projects, flagging risks or delays early.
• Keep drawing files, layers, and naming conventions organised and consistent across projects.

• Proven, verifiable proficiency in Vectorworks is strongly preferred.
• Candidates with strong experience in SketchUp, Revit, or AutoCAD will also be considered - we're open to supporting a transition to Vectorworks.
• Background in landscape architecture, landscape design, or architectural drafting, ideally with residential project experience.
• Understanding of construction documentation: setout, levels, sections, details, and materials - not just drafting for visual presentation.
• Rendering skills (e.g, Enscape, D5) are a strong advantage.
• Strong written English for clear communication with the Australian-based team.
• Reliable internet connection and the ability to work overlapping hours with an Australian (Melbourne, AEST/AEDT) team.
What We're Looking For
Technical skill matters, but it's not the only thing we're hiring for. We value:
• Genuine attention to detail - drawings that are accurate the first time, not just "close enough."
• Strong work ethic and reliability - someone who owns their workload and communicates proactively.
• A long-term mindset - we're looking to invest in this role and grow it over time, not treat it as disposable outsourced labour.
• Honesty about your actual skill level and software experience - we'd rather know upfront than discover gaps later.

title: GTA SA Realistic Drift Mod
desc: Naghahanap ako ng developer na makakatulong gumawa ng drift mod para sa single-player GTA San Andreas sa PC. Ang pangunahing layunin ko ay gawing mas realistic ang handling at pag-slide ng mga sasakyan—gusto kong maramdaman ang tamang bigat, tire grip, at inertia kapag nag-di-dri…
full:
Naghahanap ako ng developer na makakatulong gumawa ng drift mod para sa single-player GTA San Andreas sa PC. Ang pangunahing layunin ko ay gawing mas realistic ang handling at pag-slide ng mga sasakyan—gusto kong maramdaman ang tamang bigat, tire grip, at inertia kapag nag-di-drift, hindi lang simpleng “ice physics.”

Ano ang inaasahan kong makuha:
• Tuned handling.cfg at vehicle.ide lines, o scripted solution (CLEO / ASM / plugin-based) na magdadala ng tunay na drift dynamics—controlled oversteer, throttle-steer, at smooth transitions.
• Adjustable parameters para madaling i-fine-tune ang grip, suspension, at steering lock nang hindi na kailangang i-recompile ang buong mod.
• Dokumentasyon o short guide kung paano i-install, i-activate, at i-customize ang mod sa vanilla PC version ng GTA San Andreas.
• Compatibility testing sa karaniwang 1.0 US executable; ilista kung may kailangan na limit adjusters o modloader requirements.

Hindi ko kailangan ng drift points system o bagong kotse sa ngayon—puro physics at feel muna ang focus. Kung gumagamit ka ng CLEO, SilentPatch, o custom ASI plugins, banggitin mo upang siguradong pareho tayo ng setup.

Ipadala mo ang:
1. Work-in-progress build (para ma-test ko agad ang handling).
2. Final compiled files + source/configs.
3. Step-by-step install guide.

Kung may demo video o GIF para ipakita ang resulta, malaking plus iyon. Interesado rin ako sa mga suhestiyon mo para sa future update ngunit immediate goal ko ay isang stable, masayang i-drift na base game experience.

title: Diagnose Shopify Store Issues- Shopify Expert
desc: How to Identify the Bug Follow these steps in order to pinpoint whether the fault comes from Shopify, an app, your theme, or a payment setting: • Check Shopify’s server status. Visit the Shopify Status Page to verify if Shopify’s checkout, admin, or storefront is experiencing an …
full:
How to Identify the Bug

Follow these steps in order to pinpoint whether the fault comes from Shopify, an app, your theme, or a payment setting:
• Check Shopify’s server status. Visit the Shopify Status Page to verify if Shopify’s checkout, admin, or storefront is experiencing an outage. (If you use an Indian payment gateway like Razorpay or Pine Labs, check their status pages too.)
• Test in an Incognito/Private browser window. Open your store in an incognito window and test the broken feature. If it works there, the issue is caused by your browser cache or a browser extension.
• Inspect browser console errors. On a desktop browser (Chrome/Edge), right-click the broken page, select Inspect, and click the Console tab. Red error messages will often name the exact script or app breaking buttons like "Add to Cart".
• Audit recent apps and theme edits. Think back over the last 48 hours. If you installed a new app, disable it temporarily or remove its app embeds in Online Store > Themes > Customize > App embeds to see if the bug disappears.
• Test an unmodified backup theme. Go to Online Store > Themes, click the ... (three dots) next to a clean, unedited Shopify theme (like Dawn), and click Preview. If the bug disappears in the preview, the fault is inside your current theme's code.
• Verify checkout and payment settings. Go to Settings > Payments to ensure your payment gateway API keys are active and verified. Check Settings > Shipping and delivery to confirm shipping rates cover your customer's pin code or region.

• Structural layout, member sizing and connection details for columns, rafters, bracing and purlins 
• Crane runway beams, columns, brackets, end stops and rail details designed for fatigue and impact loads 
• Foundation plan with footing reactions, anchor bolt schedules and soil bearing checks 
• Fabrication drawings in DWG/PDF, plus a concise calculation report (STAAD Pro / ETABS or equivalent) showing load combinations, deflection and code compliance

I will review against AISC/IS codes for strength and serviceability, 250 mm maximum crane beam deflection span/750, and clear dimension checks. Deliver all source files so my local fabricator can issue shop tickets straight away.

Company Overview:
Our client is a small, founder-led consumer brand based in Austin, TX, that makes a regulated nicotine product (tobacco-free pouches) and sells it direct-to-consumer in the UK. Because Meta, Google, and TikTok all prohibit nicotine advertising, there is no ad budget this company can spend to buy growth — every channel that's left (search, owned email and SMS, subscription retention, referral, retail and trade, athlete and podcast partnerships, field sampling) has to be built and wired together by hand. That constraint is the whole shape of this job.
Your Role:
This role exists because the easy version of growth marketing isn't available here — someone has to build the campaign machinery, not just brief it. You'll spend real time each week directing Claude Code to connect APIs, enrich lists, and automate recurring work, and the rest of your time running campaigns alongside the people actually knocking on doors: sales, field, and partnerships. This is the one non-negotiable requirement on this list, and it's tested directly in the interview process; nearly everything else here is trainable

• 3+ years hands-on in marketing— the profile that fits typically started in a coordinator-type role, got tired of waiting on others to pull data or wire up tools, and taught themselves to do it

• Cold outbound you've run yourself, start to finish: built the list, wrote the sequence, watched the reply rate, fixed deliverability when it broke, using Apollo or an equivalent plus at least one sequencer

• Comfortable with data — you read a CSV without flinching, write SQL or get there with help, and know why a bad join can quietly double your numbers

• Working scripting ability in Python or JavaScript (or a track record of directing AI to write and debug it while keeping it honest), and you use git

• A genuine eye for marketing — you can tell a good offer from a weak one, spot a broken page, and write an email a retail buyer will actually answer — and you write plainly, in specific, filler-free sentences

Bonus Points:

I'm looking for an experienced senior WordPress developer or technical consultant to conduct an independent technical assessment and consultation with me to discuss my existing website: https://www.platinum-healing.com/

My website is currently hosted and managed by HealthHosts https://www.healthhosts.com/ using their proprietary WordPress theme (HealthHosts Web49). I have restricted WordPress access, with no access to plugins, server configuration or full administrator settings.

I require a paid technical consultation with me to investigate:

WordPress architecture: Identify the existing theme, framework, plugins, custom code, dependencies and potential limitations of the proprietary HealthHosts system.

PHP compatibility: Assess whether the website can be upgraded to PHP 8.3 or newer, identify potential compatibility issues and determine whether these could be resolved without a complete rebuild.

Website migration: Establish whether the existing WordPress installation can be migrated to an independent hosting provider, including the database, media library, content, theme and functionality.

Proprietary theme restrictions: Determine whether the HealthHosts theme is technically portable and what licensing or ownership restrictions would need clarification.

Access requirements: Identify exactly what I need to request from HealthHosts, including WordPress administrator access, SFTP/FTP, database exports, hosting control panel access, backups and theme files.

Alternative technical solutions: Evaluate whether the existing website could be upgraded, migrated, have its theme replaced while retaining the current design, or require a partial or complete rebuild.

SEO and functionality preservation: Assess how to preserve existing URLs, page structures, metadata, redirects, search rankings, forms and other website functionality during migration.

Hosting independence: Recommend a suitable independent WordPress hosting arrangement where I retain ownership and administrative control of my website.

Costs and feasibility: Provide an objective comparison of the technical work, estimated costs, risks and practical implications of each option.

What I require initially:

A one-to-one video consultation with screen sharing, a preliminary technical review recommended options and next steps.

Please explain what you can assess through publicly available information and my existing WordPress access, and what would require additional server or administrator access.

I am specifically seeking an independent technical assessment, not a quotation for a new website or a sales pitch for redesign services.

Please confirm your relevant experience with legacy WordPress installations, proprietary themes, PHP upgrades and migrations away from managed website providers, together with your consultation fee.

desc: The system must accept mixed or recycled plastic waste, feed it through size-reduction, Washer, drying, and a robust extruder, then finish with downstream equipment able to deliver consistent plastic sheets or profiles. Because the feedstock is variable, the screw geometry, filtr…

The system must accept mixed or recycled plastic waste, feed it through size-reduction, Washer, drying, and a robust extruder, then finish with downstream equipment able to deliver consistent plastic sheets or profiles. Because the feedstock is variable, the screw geometry, filtration stages, and temperature zones need careful thermal and structural analysis, and the hydraulic press or calibrator station has to maintain tight dimensional tolerances.

I’m looking for a mechanical designer who is comfortable taking ownership of every machine in the line—shredder, conveyors, extruder, screen changer, cooling bath, haul-off, cutter or press—and integrating them into a single layout with realistic maintenance envelopes and safety guarding. Finite-element checks on high-load parts such as the screw, barrel, gearbox mounts, and press frame are essential; CFD or extrusion-specific simulation to predict melt flow and residence time would be a plus.

Deliverables I will need:
• 3D CAD assemblies and fully detailed part drawings (SolidWorks, Inventor, or similar) 
• FEA reports for critical components and welded frames 
• A single-line layout with utilities, footprint, and operator flow 
• Bill of materials with specified off-the-shelf components 
• Exploded views and simple assembly instructions for the shop floor 

If you’ve already designed extrusion or hydraulic press equipment and can show calculations or test results, that will weigh heavily in your favor. Let me know which CAD and analysis packages you prefer, your estimated timeline, and anything you need from me to start.

desc: Project Title: Manual Vector Line Art Tracing for 6 Macrame Knot Tutorials (SVG + PNG) Project Description: I am looking for a skilled vector illustrator to manually trace clean, minimalist black-and-white instructional line diagrams for 6 basic macrame knots (approx. 15–18 small…
full:
Project Title: Manual Vector Line Art Tracing for 6 Macrame Knot Tutorials (SVG + PNG)
Project Description:
I am looking for a skilled vector illustrator to manually trace clean, minimalist black-and-white instructional line diagrams for 6 basic macrame knots (approx. 15–18 small step-by-step illustrations in total).
I will provide clear overhead reference photos of every single knot step, so you do not need any macrame knowledge—just trace smooth, uniform vector lines over my photos.
The 6 Knots Needed:
1. Lark's Head Knot (2 steps)
2. Square Knot (3 steps)
3. Half Hitch Knot (2 steps)
4. Double Half Hitch Knot (3 steps)
5. Wrapping / Gathering Knot (3 steps)
6. Crown Knot (3 steps)
Style & Technical Requirements:
• 100% Manual Pen-Tool Tracing: No auto-trace or AI vectorization—curves must be clean and smooth.
• Visual Style: Minimalist black line art on a transparent background (no shading or colour), uniform stroke thickness across every file, clear white gaps where cords cross over/under, and simple directional arrows showing where to pull the cord.
• File Formats: Individual scalable .SVG vector files AND high-resolution transparent .PNG files (2000×2000 px, 300 DPI) for each knot/step.
• Ownership: Full commercial rights / copyright ownership transfers to me upon final payment so I can use these in my craft kits and sell commercial licences to other crafters.
How to Bid:
Please start your proposal with the word MACRAME so I know you have read the full brief, and share 1–2 examples of clean vector line art you have created. I would like to start with 1 sample knot first to confirm the line style before completing the remaining 5 knots.

I’ve written a rhyming picture book about my little girl joining me for workouts in our home gym, and now I’m ready to turn those moments into soft, dreamy visuals that speak to children ages 4–6. The entire story will be illustrated in a gentle watercolor story-book style—think warm washes, playful energy, and expressive characters that make kids want to flip the page.

I’ll need a full-page illustration for every page of the manuscript (I’ll share the final page count once we start). Each scene should capture movement, joy, and the special parent–child bond at the heart of the story, while making gym equipment feel friendly rather than intimidating.

Here’s how I imagine our collaboration:

• Rough thumbnails or a quick storyboard so we can lock the pacing and character designs early 
• Clean linework and color tests for approval before you dive into final art 
• Final high-resolution, print-ready files (300 dpi CMYK with bleed) plus layered source files in PSD or Procreate for any future tweaks 
• A lightweight RGB version for digital previews

Consistency in palette and character proportions will be our key acceptance criteria, along with keeping any placeholder text areas clear and safe for my book designer.

If you love painting cozy watercolor scenes and can turn lively workouts into heart-warming spreads, I’d love to see your portfolio and discuss timelines. Let’s bring this father-daughter fitness adventure to life!

title: Mobile Detailing CRM & Web Integration
desc: I run a mobile detailing service and need a single, cohesive system that doubles as my public-facing website and my internal CRM. On the front end I want a clean portfolio page that shows off recent jobs, then funnels visitors straight into an online scheduling flow. Customers mu…
full:
I run a mobile detailing service and need a single, cohesive system that doubles as my public-facing website and my internal CRM. On the front end I want a clean portfolio page that shows off recent jobs, then funnels visitors straight into an online scheduling flow. Customers must be able to pick a service, select their preferred date and time, and pay by credit card—ideally all without ever feeling they’ve left the site.

Behind the scenes the booking calendar should automatically assign each request based on the customer’s service address so my team is routed efficiently within our coverage areas. Once a booking is confirmed, the same platform should store customer data, service history, and payment status so I’m not bouncing between multiple tools.

If you’ve worked with systems like Jobber, Housecall Pro, Zoho, HubSpot, or you can build a custom stack that combines a responsive website with CRM, calendar logic, and Stripe (or similar) payments, let’s talk. My priority is a seamless, branded experience from portfolio browse to completed appointment, with all data living in one place and accessible on mobile.

title: Nostalgic Baseball Inspiration Poster
desc: I’m putting together a surprise for my adult daughter: a warm, old-time–baseball-style poster that reminds her how fearless she was when she played against the boys. The heart of the design is this exact quote: “The boys only throw hard at you because they want you to quit. They’…
full:
I’m putting together a surprise for my adult daughter: a warm, old-time–baseball-style poster that reminds her how fearless she was when she played against the boys. The heart of the design is this exact quote:

“The boys only throw hard at you because they want you to quit. They’re afraid you'll be better than them.”

Visual Direction 
• Overall feel: cosy, family-album nostalgia rather than a loud sports graphic—muted, sun-washed colours, maybe a little grain or vintage paper texture. 
• Main image: a young girl in full motion on the diamond, standing ready with her glove, confident and unflinching. I picture something that instantly brings back those little-league Saturdays. 
• Composition: let the illustration or photo tell the story, but give the quote pride of place—legible from a few feet away without overpowering the artwork. Hand-script or classic score-board typography could work well.

Deliverables 
• Print-ready poster file (minimum 300 dpi, CMYK, 18×24 in or similar) 
• Layered source file (PSD, AI, or comparable) so I can tweak colours or size later 
• A web-optimised JPG/PNG for sharing

Acceptance 
The job is complete once the artwork captures that nostalgic baseball mood, showcases the girl poised with her glove, and the quote is spelled and formatted exactly as above. Looking forward to seeing your creative take on this special keepsake!

full:
I’m putting together a short animated video and need a single, low-poly 3D mascot to serve as the main on-screen “host.” The look I’m after is deliberately simple and stylized—clean geometry, minimal textures, and an inviting silhouette that will read well at small sizes. 

Here’s what will make the model usable for me:
• A fully modeled character in a neutral pose, delivered in an industry-standard file such as FBX or OBJ 
• Basic, efficient UVs and flat, low-detail textures (no 8K maps or photoreal shaders) 
• A lightweight rig with clear naming so I can drop the asset straight into Blender or Maya for animation 
• Scale set to real-world units and origin at ground level for easy scene placement

I have a rough storyboard and reference sketches to guide proportion, color palette, and personality, and I’ll share those as soon as we connect. If you’ve built similar mascot-style assets before, links or small clips of your work will help me see how you handle topology and rig controls.

Once the mesh, rig, and a quick playblast test look good, the project is complete. Looking forward to collaborating and getting this mascot on screen.

I want to boost sales by turning my social channels into steady customer-generating machines. To make that happen, I need a bank of sharp, scroll-stopping ideas for both organic posts and paid ads that speak directly to my target audience.

Here’s what I expect:

Data-backed thinking and a knack for persuasive wording are critical; tools like Meta Ads Manager insights or past campaign benchmarks are welcome for validation.

title: Senior Graphic Designer (m/f/d)
desc: responsibilities The Senior Graphic Designer owns and evolves the Exaktera brand and creates the visual content that sales and marketing use directly with customers. The role turns technical products and applications into clear visuals across digital, print and trade show formats…
full:
responsibilities
The Senior Graphic Designer owns and evolves the Exaktera brand and creates the visual content that sales and marketing use directly with customers. The role turns technical products and applications into clear visuals across digital, print and trade show formats, using AI tools where they add value. Specialised production work, such as 3D animation and video shoots, is supported by external agencies. It exists to give the group a single brand owner who leads the move from legacy product brands to Exaktera and keeps every output consistent with it. The position is predominantly remote in Germany, with occasional travel to company locations when required.

• Own, evolve and protect the Exaktera brand identity, guidelines and visual language, and lead the transition from legacy brands such as Z-LASER.

• Create visual content for marketing and sales: application images, campaign visuals, newsletter graphics, social media content, icons and illustrations (approx. 60% of the role).

• Turn technical applications into clear visuals using isometric illustration, edited stock, AI-generated images and renderings, checking AI results for technical plausibility.

• Design print and trade show materials, including booth walls, roll-ups, flyers, datasheets, catalogs and business cards, working with print shops and booth builders.

• Create short videos for social media and trade shows and edit existing footage such as webinars and interviews, where capacity allows; specialist video production is commissioned from external agencies.

• Brief and manage external agencies and freelancers for specialist production, including complex 3D rendering, animation and video shoots, and create simple product renders from supplied CAD models where skills allow.

• Prioritize requests from several stakeholders, question briefs to find the real need, and pick the medium that gives the most value for the effort.

• Plan assets and deadlines with the marketing team.

• Create and maintain a central visual content library, keeping design files and asset libraries organized.

your job profile

• Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years’ professional experience as a graphic or media designer, in-house or agency. Experience with industrial or technical products preferred.

• Proven experience developing and owning a brand identity.

• Portfolio showing range across brand, print and digital content.

• Advanced skills in Adobe Creative Cloud: Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign.

• Hands-on experience with AI tools for image generation and editing, including prompting.

• Strong digital content skills, including social media graphics, newsletter and web visuals.

• Confident with print layouts for datasheets, brochures, ads and trade show materials.

• Strong eye for typography, layout, color and composition.

• Good written and spoken English. German is not required.

• Desirable: video editing (Premiere Pro) for short social media clips and edits from existing footage, 3D and CAD product rendering (KeyShot, Blender or similar), animation and motion graphics (After Effects), basic filming for simple in-house video, AI video tools, trade show and booth design, agency management, isometric illustration, product photography, interest in lasers, optics and industrial processes.

• Creativity and creative problem-solving

• Brand management

• Stakeholder engagement and collaboration

• Technical curiosity

• Prioritisation, including questioning briefs and judging effort against value (80/20)

• Independence and initiative

desc: I need a complete e-commerce website for **Urban Stitch Custom Creations**, my veteran-owned business specializing in custom apparel, personalized gifts, and awareness designs. Customers should be able to shop ready-made designs, personalize products, preview their own artwork, a…
full:
I need a complete e-commerce website for **Urban Stitch Custom Creations**, my veteran-owned business specializing in custom apparel, personalized gifts, and awareness designs. Customers should be able to shop ready-made designs, personalize products, preview their own artwork, and request quotes for custom or bulk orders.

I want a bold, patriotic look with a black or midnight navy background, muted red accents, and warm white text. Use my logo, large product photos, and the tagline **“Creating Awareness One Design at a Time.”** The site should be easy to browse and buy from on a phone.

### Homepage and storefront

The homepage should give visitors four clear ways to get started: **Shop Ready-Made Designs, Personalize a Product, Request a Free Quote, and Explore Monthly Awareness.** Feature popular products, seasonal gift bundles, and the current awareness campaign. Include a short introduction to the business and a simple explanation of how custom ordering works.

Organize the shop into categories such as apparel, drinkware, blankets, home décor, puzzles, ornaments, and gift bundles. Product pages should show photos, pricing, sizes, colors, personalization options, estimated production and shipping times, and care instructions where applicable. Include search, product filters, a shopping cart, secure checkout, and order confirmation emails.

### Interactive product customizer

I want customers to be able to **upload their own artwork onto a blank product and see a live preview before purchasing**. They should be able to add text, move and resize their design, and see where the printable area ends. The editor should work across multiple product types, including shirts, hoodies, mugs, tumblers, and tote bags, with product-specific print areas. Save the original artwork, placement details, and preview with the order so I can produce what the customer approved.

### Custom orders and design services

Create a **Request a Free Quote** page for bulk orders, events, teams, businesses, and projects that need design help. Collect the customer’s name, email, product type, quantity, needed-by date, project details, and any inspiration files. desc: Project Overview: Seeking a skilled AI filmmaker to direct and produce La Trinidad de la Nochebuena, a 10–12 minute generational and sensory drama tracing how family love is passed down through heirlooms and food across 20th-century Mexico. Tone & Visual Style: Warm, nostalgic, a…
full:
Project Overview: Seeking a skilled AI filmmaker to direct and produce La Trinidad de la Nochebuena, a 10–12 minute generational and sensory drama tracing how family love is passed down through heirlooms and food across 20th-century Mexico.

Tone & Visual Style: Warm, nostalgic, and deeply tactile—inspired by Like Water for Chocolate and the films of Giuseppe Tornatore. Requires golden lighting, rich period textures (from a historic hacienda in San Felipe to a traditional kitchen in Tlaxcala), and emotionally expressive character performances.

Story Structure:

Opening: Intimate, sensory close-ups of elderly hands cooking traditional Bacalao a la Vizcaína—simmering olive oil, slicing chiles güeros, and preparing olives.

Three Interwoven Flashbacks: Memory vignettes anchored by three family symbols: a young girl rescuing a bishop's portrait from a greedy relative, a father gifting his daughter a ceramic Baby Jesus to create a home out of nothing, and a lonely young man from Bilbao being welcomed into the family over a Christmas Eve meal.

Climax: A bustling present-day Christmas Eve gathering uniting all three objects, closing on an elderly couple sharing a quiet glance amid their children and grandchildren.

Key Requirements: Strong character and object consistency across aging timelines, cinematic camera movement and color grading, rich sensory sound design (kitchen ASMR and nostalgic score), and seamless pacing around a reflective voice-over narration.

Read-only SEO baseline audit of 30 pages of riverinadentalalbury.com.au (WordPress, Yoast SEO), before the site's pages are restyled. Fixed fee AUD $600.

Spreadsheet (Excel or Google Sheet), one row per page, covering all 30 approved pages, with a separate column for each of:
a. Full URL
b. SEO title
c. Meta description
d. Focus keyphrase (Yoast)
e. Canonical URL
f. H1 heading, exactly as on the page
g. All H2 headings, in page order
h. Number of internal links
i. Number of external links
j. Number of images

full:
Learning Designer
Rasmussen University
Online/Remote
Learning Design at Rasmussen University is integral to enhancing the educational experiences of our online students. This position is focused on developing, implementing, and refining instructional materials and courses that support the diverse learning needs of our students. The Learning Designer collaborates closely with subject matter experts and programmatic ownership, leveraging educational technologies and applying instructional design principles to create effective, engaging, and accessible online learning solutions that align with Rasmussen University's commitment to student success and academic excellence.
Responsibilities:
Interested in Joining Rasmussen University as a Learning Designer? As a Learning Designer you will:

• Design and develop assigned courses using modern learning theories and applying instructional design principles and methodologies.

• Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) to create engaging and effective learning materials.

• Create multimedia content, including videos, interactive activities, simulations, and assessments.

• Utilize e-learning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate Storyline) to develop interactive content.

• Ensure content is accessible and adheres to best practices in online education.

• Use learning management systems (LMS) to build and organize course materials.

• Integrate various educational technologies and platforms to enhance the learning experience.

• Analyze learner data and feedback to identify areas for improvement in course design.

• Review and revise course materials to ensure accuracy, clarity, and alignment with the course competencies.

• Provide course content support to students and faculty as needed.

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery of course content.

• Maintain clear and consistent communication with team members and stakeholders.

• Conduct training sessions for faculty on best practices in online teaching and course design.

• Stay current with the trends and advancements in online education, educational technology. and instructional design.

Reporting Relationships:
The Learning Designer reports directly to the Learning Design Manager. This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but may provide informal leadership and guidance to other team members and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams.
Requirements:

title: Videotutorial profesional para Tallerix -- 4
desc: INSTRUCCIONES DE PRODUCCIÓN – TALLERIX Video 1: Recepción del vehículo Presupuesto para este primer video: USD 12 Tiempo máximo de entrega: 2 días. 1. Objetivo del proyecto Crear un videotutorial profesional para Tallerix, una plataforma de gestión para talleres mecánicos. Este p…
full:
INSTRUCCIONES DE PRODUCCIÓN – TALLERIX

Video 1: Recepción del vehículo

Presupuesto para este primer video: USD 12
Tiempo máximo de entrega: 2 días.

1. Objetivo del proyecto

Crear un videotutorial profesional para Tallerix, una plataforma de gestión para talleres mecánicos.

Este primer video será una prueba de calidad. Si el cliente aprueba el resultado, continuaremos con los otros cinco tutoriales, cada uno con su correspondiente versión en inglés.

El objetivo es enseñar al usuario cómo realizar la recepción de un vehículo dentro del software, de manera sencilla, visual y dinámica.

2. Estilo audiovisual que buscamos

El cliente quiere un resultado:

- Limpio, moderno y profesional.
- Dinámico, pero sin exceso de efectos.
- Visualmente atractivo y fácil de comprender.
- Con apariencia de producción audiovisual profesional, no de video genérico generado por IA.
- Con transiciones suaves y movimientos de cámara digitales bien utilizados.
- Con una narración humana en español latino neutro.

Importante: Evitar plantillas genéricas, efectos innecesarios, animaciones exageradas y elementos que distraigan de la explicación.

La prioridad es que el usuario entienda perfectamente lo que está viendo.

3. Estructura del primer tutorial

Duración objetivo: entre 45 y 60 segundos.

El video debe explicar el proceso de recepción de un vehículo siguiendo el orden real de utilización de la plataforma.

Secuencia de contenido:

1. Introducción breve con el logotipo de Tallerix.
2. Mostrar el inicio del proceso de recepción del vehículo.
3. Enseñar cómo registrar la placa del automóvil.
4. Mostrar cómo asociar el vehículo con el cliente.
5. Explicar el registro de los daños y las observaciones.
6. Mostrar la parte más importante: las fotografías del vehículo.
7. Enseñar cómo guardar la recepción y finalizar el proceso.

4. Escena más importante: fotografías del vehículo

Esta parte requiere especial atención.

El cliente quiere que se muestre una persona real tomando las siete fotografías del automóvil en el orden solicitado por la aplicación.

La secuencia debe comunicar visualmente lo siguiente:

- Una persona toma las siete fotografías del vehículo.
- Se muestra cómo se van incorporando las fotografías a la aplicación.
- Se visualiza cómo se completa cada espacio.
- Se termina mostrando la cuadrícula final con las siete fotografías organizadas.

Esta escena debe quedar especialmente bien integrada con la grabación de pantalla. No debe parecer una simple presentación de imágenes.

5. Grabación y edición de pantalla

Se debe trabajar directamente con la cuenta demo de Tallerix.

Durante la grabación:

- Mostrar claramente cada acción.
- Mantener el cursor visible.
- Aplicar zoom en botones y campos importantes.
- Utilizar resaltados para orientar al usuario.
- Evitar movimientos bruscos.
- No mostrar información innecesaria.
- Mantener una buena legibilidad de los textos de la aplicación.

La edición debe seguir exactamente los pasos documentados por el cliente, respetando los nombres de los botones y las funcionalidades.

6. Narración y subtítulos

Para este primer video:

- Voz en off humana en español latino neutro.
- Tono profesional, natural y explicativo.
- Narración sincronizada con cada acción.
- Subtítulos en español correctamente sincronizados.
- Música de fondo discreta, sin competir con la voz.

No utilizar voz artificial en esta primera versión.

7. Identidad de marca

Incluir:

- Introducción breve con el logotipo de Tallerix.
- Colores y elementos gráficos de su identidad corporativa.
- Cierre breve con el logotipo.
- Mensaje obligatorio: «Prueba gratis 14 días en tallerix.app».

Mantener una identidad visual consistente durante todo el tutorial.

8. Cierre del proceso

Al finalizar la recepción, el cliente quiere que se muestre cómo, al guardar el registro, el propietario del vehículo recibe por WhatsApp:

- La hoja de recepción en PDF.
- Su enlace de seguimiento.

Es importante representar este resultado de manera clara y comprensible.

9. Entregables

Para esta primera prueba:

- Video final en español.
- Formato horizontal 16:9.
- Adaptación vertical 9:16.
- Archivo MP4.
- Archivo editable del proyecto.
- Subtítulos sincronizados.

La versión en inglés se realizará después de la aprobación del cliente.

10. Condiciones de producción

- Tiempo máximo: 2 días.
- Presupuesto: USD 12.
- Respetar las indicaciones y funcionalidades reales de Tallerix.
- Cuidar especialmente la calidad de la narración, la sincronización y la presentación visual.
- No inventar pasos ni funcionalidades.
- Priorizar la claridad y la calidad sobre la cantidad de efectos.

11. Proyección del proyecto

Este es el primer video de una serie de seis tutoriales.

Si el cliente aprueba esta primera pieza, continuaremos con:

- Adaptación del primer video al inglés.
- Producción de los otros cinco tutoriales.
- Versiones en español e inglés de cada uno.
- Adaptaciones horizontales y verticales.

IMPORTANTE: Este primer video es nuestra oportunidad para demostrar calidad y conseguir la continuidad del proyecto. Necesitamos entregar una pieza que realmente destaque por su presentación, claridad y acabado profesional.

title: Website for Local Pet Shop
desc: I'm looking for a web developer to create a modern, well-designed website for a small independent pet shop based in the UK. We're a local business selling pet food, treats, toys, grooming products and accessories, mainly for dogs and cats. At the moment, we don't have a proper we…
full:
I'm looking for a web developer to create a modern, well-designed website for a small independent pet shop based in the UK. We're a local business selling pet food, treats, toys, grooming products and accessories, mainly for dogs and cats.

At the moment, we don't have a proper website, and I'd like to change that. I'm not looking for a large online store or anything particularly complicated. I just want a professional website that represents the shop properly, looks trustworthy and makes it easier for local customers to find us and see what we offer.

**What I have in mind**

The homepage should give visitors a good first impression of the business. I'd like a nice header with the shop's name, a simple navigation menu and a main section with a relevant pet-related image and a short introduction. Below that, there could be a few sections highlighting our main product categories, a short description of the shop and a clear way to find our contact details.

For the products section, I'd like customers to be able to browse the types of products we sell. We mainly focus on dog food, cat food, treats, toys, collars, leads, beds and basic grooming supplies. These don't need individual product pages or prices for now. A simple layout with images, category names and short descriptions would be enough.

I'd prefer the products to be arranged in a way that doesn't make the website feel cluttered. For example, customers could select a category and see a few relevant products underneath. I don't mind whether this is done using separate pages or a simple filtering system, as long as it's easy to use.

I'd also like an About Us section. Nothing too long, just some information about the business and the fact that we're an independent local pet shop. I think this would help make the website feel a little more personal rather than looking like a generic online shop.

The contact page is quite important. It should display our address, telephone number and opening hours clearly. I'd also like a Google Maps link or an embedded map so customers can easily find the shop. A simple contact form would be useful too, allowing people to send us a message with their name, email address and enquiry.

**Design and appearance**

I don't have an exact design prepared, so I'm open to suggestions from the developer. However, I do have a general idea of how I'd like it to look.

I'd prefer a fairly modern and clean design, with natural colours such as green, beige, white or other colours that suit a pet-related business. Nothing too bright or childish. The website should feel friendly and welcoming, but still professional.

I'd also like some good-quality images of dogs, cats and pet products throughout the website. These don't need to be custom photographs, and suitable royalty-free images would be perfectly fine.

The layout should have enough space between sections, readable text and consistent styling across all pages. I don't want excessive animations, pop-ups or anything that makes the website unnecessarily complicated.

It's particularly important that the website works properly on mobile phones. I expect quite a few customers will be visiting from their phones, so the navigation, images and text should adapt to smaller screens without issues.

**Technical requirements**

I'm not particularly concerned about which technology is used. HTML, CSS and JavaScript would be fine, but I'm open to other suggestions if there's a good reason to use them.

The website should load reasonably quickly, have working navigation and include basic SEO elements such as page titles, descriptions and appropriate headings.

I don't need user accounts, online payments, shopping carts, inventory management or any advanced backend functionality.

For the contact form, I'd like to discuss a simple way of handling messages. I'm open to a basic email form service if that makes more sense than building a backend.

I'd also appreciate it if the code was reasonably organised, so making changes later wouldn't be too difficult.

**What I expect to receive**

Once the website is finished, I'd like to receive all the source files, including the HTML, CSS, JavaScript and any other files used in the project.

I'd also like a short explanation of how to run the website locally and how to change basic information such as opening hours, phone numbers, text and images.

Hosting and domain registration are not required at this stage. I may arrange those separately once I'm happy with the finished website.

Before considering the project complete, I'd like to see the website working on both desktop and mobile, check that all links work and make sure the contact form behaves as expected.

1. Project Overview

I am looking for an experienced full-stack developer or professional development agency to build a premium gaming website.

My strategy is to develop the website first, establish the complete frontend, backend, user system and admin dashboard, and integrate third-party casino or sportsbook APIs at a later stage.

I do not want to purchase any gaming API during the initial development phase.

The website must be developed with a scalable architecture so that gaming APIs can be integrated easily in the future without rebuilding the entire platform.

I am also looking for someone who can help me launch and grow the business, with an initial target of 100 genuine, eligible customers.

2. Website Development Requirements

Frontend

Create a premium, modern and mobile-friendly gaming website.

Required pages:

* Homepage
* Games
* Featured Games
* Popular Games
* Categories
* Promotions
* Registration
* Login
* User Profile
* Wallet
* Deposit
* Withdrawal
* Transaction History
* Customer Support
* About Us
* Terms and Conditions
* Privacy Policy

The design should be inspired by the general user experience of established gaming platforms, with original branding, graphics and code.

3. User Account System

* User registration
* Login and logout
* Secure password management
* User dashboard
* Profile management
* Account status
* Verification status
* Transaction history
* Gaming history
* Referral system, if legally permitted

4. Admin Dashboard

I need a powerful and easy-to-use admin panel.

Features:

* View and manage registered users
* Activate or suspend accounts
* User verification management
* Deposit management
* Withdrawal management
* Payment settings
* Transaction history
* Promotional settings
* Referral management
* Website content management
* Reports and analytics

* Admin roles and permissions
* Audit logs

Any financial adjustment must be authorised and fully recorded.

5. Wallet Architecture

Build the wallet infrastructure so it can support future authorised gaming integrations.

Requirements:

* User balance display
* Transaction ledger
* Unique transaction IDs
* Deposit records
* Withdrawal records
* Pending and completed statuses
* Admin approval workflow
* Reconciliation reports
* Secure balance calculations

Do not enable real-money deposits, withdrawals or wagering until the relevant legal and provider approvals are in place.

6. Payment System – Future Ready

The system should be designed to support future payment integrations.

Potential methods:

* UPI
* Bank transfer
* BTC
* USDT
* ETH
* LTC

For the initial phase, the developer should build the payment-management interface and integration architecture. Actual payment processing will be activated only after appropriate approvals.

7. Future Gaming API Integration

No gaming API is required in the first phase.

However, the backend must be API-ready.

The developer should prepare:

* Modular API architecture
* Provider integration layer
* Game catalogue management
* Game launch interface
* User authentication handoff
* Wallet integration interface
* Bet and win transaction callbacks
* Transaction reconciliation
* Game history
* Provider configuration in admin panel

The system should be capable of adding multiple authorised providers later.

Preferred technologies:

* AWS or equivalent cloud hosting

* Docker

* Encrypted sensitive information
* Role-based access
* Secure authentication
* API security
* Audit logging
* Backup and recovery
* Age and identity verification readiness
* Geo-restriction readiness
* Responsible gaming controls

The platform must be designed for operation only in jurisdictions where the business has the necessary legal authorization.

10. Business Growth and Marketing

I am not looking for someone who only builds a website.

I want a long-term partner who can also help grow the business.

Expected responsibilities:

* Business launch strategy
* Brand positioning
* SEO
* Website optimisation
* Social media strategy
* Content marketing
* Permitted advertising
* Affiliate strategy
* Customer acquisition funnel
* Customer retention strategy
* Analytics and reporting

My initial goal is to acquire the first 100 genuine, eligible customers after the business is legally authorised to operate.

I expect the freelancer to provide:

* A 30-day launch strategy
* Customer acquisition plan
* Marketing budget recommendation
* Target market research
* Conversion optimisation

* Weekly performance reports

title: Head of Design
desc: Headquarters: US - Remote Elation Health exists to enable every patient to experience the highest quality care wherever they go in the healthcare system. We build technology for independent primary care practices and the physicians, clinicians, and teams who care for their patien…
full:
Headquarters: US - Remote

Elation Health exists to enable every patient to experience the highest quality care wherever they go in the healthcare system. We build technology for independent primary care practices and the physicians, clinicians, and teams who care for their patients every day.

Our platform brings together a clinical-first EHR, intelligent automation, billing, patient engagement, and the workflows that help primary care practices deliver excellent care and build sustainable businesses. The work is consequential: when our products are clear, trustworthy, and well designed, clinicians can spend more time focused on patients and less time fighting their tools.

Primary care is foundational to a healthy healthcare system, yet the technology supporting it is often fragmented, burdensome, and disconnected from the realities of clinical work. At Elation, Design has the opportunity to make the experience of practicing medicine meaningfully better—while helping independent primary care remain strong, sustainable, and human. 

We are seeking a passionate Design leader to drive our design strategy, build a strongly capable Design organization, raise the quality and coherence of the product experience, and use AI-native ways of working to deliver more intuitive, trusted, and impactful experiences for clinicians and practices at scale. If you’re excited about shaping the next generation of AI-native primary care technology, this role is for you.

The opportunity

As Head of Design, you will set the vision, standards, and operating model for Design at Elation. You will lead a talented team of product designers and design partners, work closely with Product and Engineering leadership, and bring a strong design point of view to company strategy and product decisions.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between the strategic and the concrete: defining a coherent experience across a complex product, coaching designers through difficult problems, raising the quality bar, and ensuring the details hold up in the hands of real clinicians.

You will report to the Chief Product Officer and serve as a senior voice in the Product Development organization. The title and scope will be calibrated to the experience and demonstrated impact of the person we hire.

What you’ll do

• Set and communicate a clear design vision for Elation’s product experience, grounded in our clinical-first principles and the realities of primary care.

• Lead and shape an AI-native Design organization with a durable operating model for how designers, agents, and cross-functional teams work together to create higher-quality experiences at greater speed. Elation is already well on this journey, with AI-native product strategy, evolving design systems, and emerging AI-assisted design-review practices.

• Build a high-performing Design function: clarify roles and responsibilities, establish effective operating rhythms, create growth paths, and hire and retain exceptional design talent.

• Partner with the CPO, product leaders, engineering leaders, and executive stakeholders to translate company strategy into a focused product experience strategy and roadmap.

• Raise the quality bar across the end-to-end user experience, including research, service design, product strategy, interaction design, visual design, content, accessibility, and customer enablement.

• Strengthen the systems that allow design to scale: principles, patterns, documentation, design systems, research practices, reusable frameworks, and the connection between design artifacts and shipped product. Implement a practical design-review culture that improves decisions early, creates shared standards, protects team velocity, and makes quality everyone’s responsibility.

• Foster deep empathy for clinicians and practice teams by embedding a rigorous culture of user research across product development—engaging directly with clinical and billing experts through co-design, workflow observation, and qualitative and quantitative insights.

• Help teams solve the right problems before they move quickly on the wrong ones. Create clarity in ambiguous spaces and make tradeoffs explicit.

• Partner closely with Engineering to ensure that design intent survives implementation and that the finished experience is reliable, coherent, accessible, and delightful to use.

• Develop designers as leaders and active contributors to product direction—not simply as owners of screens or deliverables.

• Represent the customer and the design perspective in senior leadership discussions, product prioritization, launch decisions, and company-wide conversations about quality.

• Create an environment where designers can do their best work: one that is candid, collaborative, intellectually curious, and accountable for impact.

What success looks like

We will measure success through a combination of customer impact, product quality, organizational health, and operating leverage. In particular, we expect this leader to improve:

• Clinician and practice-team experience, including usability, consistency, and confidence in Elation’s products.

• Design quality and product coherence, with fewer late-stage design issues and less avoidable rework.

• The quality and consistency of customer insight used in product decisions.

• Design team health, retention, hiring, growth, and clarity of ownership.

• Product Development velocity through stronger design systems, review practices, reusable patterns, and AI-native ways of working.

What we’re looking for

• Significant experience leading product design in a complex, multi-surface, or highly regulated environment. Experience in healthcare, health technology, enterprise SaaS, or another domain where trust and workflow quality matter is especially valuable.

• A track record of building, scaling, or materially strengthening a design organization, including hiring, coaching, org design, and talent development.

Fast-paced cuts, dynamic text, smooth motion graphics, and on-trend sound design are essential—the vibe is cinematic but never stiff.

• Licensed or royalty-free music and SFX, volume-balanced to dialogue

title: Service Booking Website with Dashboard
desc: I run a small team that handles cleaning, moving, furniture assembly, delivery, and gardening jobs. I need a modern, mobile-friendly website that makes it effortless for visitors to land on the homepage, understand what we do at a glance, and book the help they need. Core user fl…
full:
I run a small team that handles cleaning, moving, furniture assembly, delivery, and gardening jobs. I need a modern, mobile-friendly website that makes it effortless for visitors to land on the homepage, understand what we do at a glance, and book the help they need.

Core user flow 
• Visitors arrive on a polished landing page, pick a service, complete a simple booking form, choose a date and time, upload any helpful photos, and pay online and an option to pay cash.
• They can just as easily request a quote when details are unclear. 
• Once the booking is placed, customers create (or log in to) an account where they can track job status in real time and review past orders.

Back-office requirements 
On my side I want a clean dashboard—accessible from any device—to view, edit, and assign incoming jobs, update progress, issue invoices or refunds, and export basic reports. Staff logins with role-based permissions are essential so the team only sees what they need.

Key expectations 
– Sleek, fast UI that feels current rather than templated. 
– Secure payment integration (Stripe or similar). 
– Responsive design and clear calls to action. 
– SEO-ready structure and Google Analytics connected. 
– Training or concise documentation so my team can add services, prices, and promotions without developer help.

Tech stack is open; WordPress with custom plugins, Laravel + Vue, or a React/Node build are all fine as long as performance, security, and future scalability are covered.

Deliverables 
1. Live website hosted on our domain, HTTPS enabled. 
2. Admin dashboard with role controls and job management. 
3. Payment gateway fully tested in production mode. 
4. One-page guide (or short screen-share session) explaining routine updates.

If you have previous examples of service-booking portals or dashboards you built, share the links so I can gauge fit. Let’s create a site that impresses at first click and keeps operations tidy behind the scenes.

title: Chola Dynasty Game Art Direction
desc: I’m building a 2D-isometric mobile strategy game set in the era of the Chola Empire and need an Art Director who can establish, document, and supervise a cohesive visual style. The core look I want is a detailed, cinematic fantasy that still feels unmistakably South Indian—think …
full:
I’m building a 2D-isometric mobile strategy game set in the era of the Chola Empire and need an Art Director who can establish, document, and supervise a cohesive visual style. The core look I want is a detailed, cinematic fantasy that still feels unmistakably South Indian—think bronze-toned temples, ornate gopurams, vibrant silks, and dramatic monsoon skies—translated into a format that reads crisply on small screens.

Highest on the art priority list are the maps, landscapes, and moment-to-moment battle scenes. These will do most of the storytelling, so I’ll rely on you to define terrain palettes, lighting moods, and compositional rules that make every skirmish feel like a living painting. While other areas will come later, the first production sprint is all about nailing these environments.

Because many of our campaigns unfold along the Coromandel Coast, I expect a strong visual library of coastal ports, beaches, and large-scale naval engagements: stone piers stacked with amphorae, palmyra groves whipping in the salt wind, and warships cutting through turquoise water. You’ll set style guides for water rendering, surf spray, weather layers, and how ships and fortifications integrate with the shoreline.

Your main deliverables: 
• A master art bible (PDF + layered PSDs) covering palettes, material call-outs, and ornamentation motifs 
• Modular environment mock-ups for coastal, beach, and naval combat tiles (isometric 512×512 base) 
• Annotated paint-overs for two key battle scenarios that show camera angles, FX layers, and unit readability 
• An asset review checklist the team can follow as we produce buildings, characters, and UI later on

Pipeline is currently Photoshop, Krita, and Spine for animations; the build runs through Unity. If you have a preferred workflow that slots into Unity’s 2D URP setup, let me know—there’s flexibility as long as we keep performance in mind.

I’ll review portfolios that demonstrate world-building, strong color direction, and experience guiding other artists. Once the art bible is approved we can discuss ongoing oversight for character and building sets.

I’m putting together a photo-video piece purely for my own enjoyment—something I can share with family and friends and look back on years from now. I have a collection of raw photos and short clips; what I need is an experienced creative who can help me shape them into a polished final product.

Here’s the scope as I see it:
• Review the existing footage and stills with me, suggest a storyline or flow, then organise the assets accordingly. 
• Edit everything into a smooth sequence—basic trimming, colour correction, light retouching on key photos, and tasteful transitions. 
• Add fitting background music and subtle text where it enhances the story (titles, dates, short captions). 
• Provide the finished piece as an HD video file plus a social-media-friendly version.

I’m flexible on tools—Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, even After Effects for motion graphics are all fine as long as the final output looks clean and professional.

If you’re confident with photo retouching, video editing, and pacing a short personal story, let’s chat. I’d love to see a couple of samples that match this intimate, keepsake style before we begin.

title: 25-Minute 2D Moral Animation
desc: I need a 25- to 30-minute 2D animated story that resonates with teens and families and leaves them reflecting on kindness and helping others. From concept to final master, the project should feel cinematic yet relatable—strong characters, expressive motion, and pacing that keeps …
full:
I need a 25- to 30-minute 2D animated story that resonates with teens and families and leaves them reflecting on kindness and helping others. From concept to final master, the project should feel cinematic yet relatable—strong characters, expressive motion, and pacing that keeps older kids and parents equally engaged.

Here is how I see the workflow unfolding:

• Script & Storyboard 
 Develop an original narrative where the theme of helping others drives the plot. I’ll review and approve both the full script and a scene-by-scene storyboard before animation begins.

• Design & Pre-production 
 Create distinctive character sheets, background art, and a colour palette that balance maturity with warmth. Adobe Animate, Toon Boom Harmony, After Effects, or comparable tools are all fine as long as the visuals are clean and ready for HD delivery.

• Animation & Sound 
 Produce fluid, on-model animation with thoughtful camera moves and transitions. Voice acting, sound design, and a supportive score should heighten the emotional beats without feeling childish.

• Review Rounds & Revisions 
 A rough cut comes first so I can flag timing or story concerns. Two additional feedback passes should be enough to land on the final cut.

Acceptance criteria 
— Runtime between 25 and 30 minutes 
— Moral of kindness and helping others is clear and integral 
— Suitable for mixed-age family viewing (no extreme violence or adult humour) 
— Final export: 1920×1080 MP4 (H.264) plus separate dialogue, music, and effects stems 
— All artwork, audio, and footage must be original or fully licensed

Once the finished file passes these checks, we’ll wrap and release.

full:
INSTRUCCIONES DE PRODUCCIÓN – TALLERIX

Video 1: Recepción del vehículo

Presupuesto para este primer video: USD 12
Tiempo máximo de entrega: 2 días.

1. Objetivo del proyecto

Crear un videotutorial profesional para Tallerix, una plataforma de gestión para talleres mecánicos.

Este primer video será una prueba de calidad. Si el cliente aprueba el resultado, continuaremos con los otros cinco tutoriales, cada uno con su correspondiente versión en inglés.

El objetivo es enseñar al usuario cómo realizar la recepción de un vehículo dentro del software, de manera sencilla, visual y dinámica.

2. Estilo audiovisual que buscamos

El cliente quiere un resultado:

- Limpio, moderno y profesional.
- Dinámico, pero sin exceso de efectos.
- Visualmente atractivo y fácil de comprender.
- Con apariencia de producción audiovisual profesional, no de video genérico generado por IA.
- Con transiciones suaves y movimientos de cámara digitales bien utilizados.
- Con una narración humana en español latino neutro.

Importante: Evitar plantillas genéricas, efectos innecesarios, animaciones exageradas y elementos que distraigan de la explicación.

La prioridad es que el usuario entienda perfectamente lo que está viendo.

3. Estructura del primer tutorial

Duración objetivo: entre 45 y 60 segundos.

El video debe explicar el proceso de recepción de un vehículo siguiendo el orden real de utilización de la plataforma.

Secuencia de contenido:

1. Introducción breve con el logotipo de Tallerix.
2. Mostrar el inicio del proceso de recepción del vehículo.
3. Enseñar cómo registrar la placa del automóvil.
4. Mostrar cómo asociar el vehículo con el cliente.
5. Explicar el registro de los daños y las observaciones.
6. Mostrar la parte más importante: las fotografías del vehículo.
7. Enseñar cómo guardar la recepción y finalizar el proceso.

4. Escena más importante: fotografías del vehículo

Esta parte requiere especial atención.

El cliente quiere que se muestre una persona real tomando las siete fotografías del automóvil en el orden solicitado por la aplicación.

La secuencia debe comunicar visualmente lo siguiente:

- Una persona toma las siete fotografías del vehículo.
- Se muestra cómo se van incorporando las fotografías a la aplicación.
- Se visualiza cómo se completa cada espacio.
- Se termina mostrando la cuadrícula final con las siete fotografías organizadas.

Esta escena debe quedar especialmente bien integrada con la grabación de pantalla. No debe parecer una simple presentación de imágenes.

5. Grabación y edición de pantalla

Se debe trabajar directamente con la cuenta demo de Tallerix.

Durante la grabación:

- Mostrar claramente cada acción.
- Mantener el cursor visible.
- Aplicar zoom en botones y campos importantes.
- Utilizar resaltados para orientar al usuario.
- Evitar movimientos bruscos.
- No mostrar información innecesaria.
- Mantener una buena legibilidad de los textos de la aplicación.

La edición debe seguir exactamente los pasos documentados por el cliente, respetando los nombres de los botones y las funcionalidades.

6. Narración y subtítulos

Para este primer video:

- Voz en off humana en español latino neutro.
- Tono profesional, natural y explicativo.
- Narración sincronizada con cada acción.
- Subtítulos en español correctamente sincronizados.
- Música de fondo discreta, sin competir con la voz.

No utilizar voz artificial en esta primera versión.

7. Identidad de marca

Incluir:

- Introducción breve con el logotipo de Tallerix.
- Colores y elementos gráficos de su identidad corporativa.
- Cierre breve con el logotipo.
- Mensaje obligatorio: «Prueba gratis 14 días en tallerix.app».

Mantener una identidad visual consistente durante todo el tutorial.

8. Cierre del proceso

Al finalizar la recepción, el cliente quiere que se muestre cómo, al guardar el registro, el propietario del vehículo recibe por WhatsApp:

- La hoja de recepción en PDF.
- Su enlace de seguimiento.

Es importante representar este resultado de manera clara y comprensible.

9. Entregables

Para esta primera prueba:

- Video final en español.
- Formato horizontal 16:9.
- Adaptación vertical 9:16.
- Archivo MP4.
- Archivo editable del proyecto.
- Subtítulos sincronizados.

La versión en inglés se realizará después de la aprobación del cliente.

10. Condiciones de producción

- Tiempo máximo: 2 días.
- Presupuesto: USD 12.
- Respetar las indicaciones y funcionalidades reales de Tallerix.
- Cuidar especialmente la calidad de la narración, la sincronización y la presentación visual.
- No inventar pasos ni funcionalidades.
- Priorizar la claridad y la calidad sobre la cantidad de efectos.

11. Proyección del proyecto

Este es el primer video de una serie de seis tutoriales.

Si el cliente aprueba esta primera pieza, continuaremos con:

- Adaptación del primer video al inglés.
- Producción de los otros cinco tutoriales.
- Versiones en español e inglés de cada uno.
- Adaptaciones horizontales y verticales.

IMPORTANTE: Este primer video es nuestra oportunidad para demostrar calidad y conseguir la continuidad del proyecto. Necesitamos entregar una pieza que realmente destaque por su presentación, claridad y acabado profesional.

full:
[PAID] Pixel Artist for Underwater 2D Game – Creatures, NPCs & Boss ($1,000, milestones)

Hi! I’m a solo hobby developer working on Nautheris, a 2D side-view underwater sandbox game (Godot 4, PC) about exploring, mining, building and fighting through 15 underwater areas, from sunny coral reefs to a deep trench and a volcanic underworld.

The game is fully playable, but all characters still use placeholder art. I’m looking for a pixel artist to turn them into final, consistent pixel art with simple animations.

What needs to be done

68 creatures (48 hostile, 20 peaceful), sorted by area
4 NPCs: an ancient shark-man guide, an octopus-folk merchant, a sunken-city trader and a ghost pirate
Boss 1: a large ghost ship, its captain and two crew members

All creatures already exist as placeholders, so ideas, sizes and colors are set. You’ll get a ZIP with every sprite, an overview sheet and a README with sizes, rules and animations.

Style

Side view, crisp pixel art without anti-aliasing.
16x16 tiles; the player is about 48 px tall.
Cozy to dark mood, with strong use of glow and bioluminescence.
Its own look, no Terraria clone.

Animations (kept simple)

Peaceful animals: swim (4–6 frames)
Hostile mobs: move (6), attack (4), hurt (2)
NPCs: idle, walk, swim, greet
Boss: a few attack and damage animations (details in the README)

Budget and milestones (fixed price, USD)

# Content Price
1 Paid test: 3 creatures $30
2 4 NPCs + Reef and Kelp Forest creatures $230
3 6 more areas (caves, ice, glow caves, ship graveyard) $265
4 Boss 1 + 4 deeper areas $320
5 Last 3 areas (trench, astral forest, underworld) $155
 Total $1,000
We start with the paid test only. If we’re both happy, we continue milestone by milestone.
Up to 2 revision rounds per milestone.
Payment is released after each delivered milestone.
Total timeline: about 3 months, part-time is fine.

Please send me

Your portfolio (animated pixel art, ideally creatures or monsters)
Whether the budget works for you, or a counter-offer per milestone
When you could start

Thanks for reading. I’m happy to answer questions and share screenshots of the game!

## About the Project

I'm an upcoming gaming content creator building a brand across YouTube, Twitch, and Kick. My goal isn't just to upload videos; I want to build a strong gaming community, create engaging content, and scale into a recognised gaming brand.

I'm looking for someone who is passionate about content creation, hungry to grow, full of creative ideas, and ready to put in the effort to build something meaningful together.

**I'm not looking for someone who just edits videos. I'm looking for someone who wants to be part of the journey.**

## What You'll Be Responsible For

- Editing engaging YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and other short-form content.
- Editing high-quality long-form gaming videos.
- Creating attention-grabbing intros, transitions, subtitles, memes, sound effects, and engaging cuts.
- Identifying viral moments and turning livestream highlights into entertaining content.
- Suggesting creative video ideas, titles, thumbnails, and content strategies.
- Understanding gaming trends and helping improve audience engagement and retention.
- Helping develop a consistent content strategy across YouTube, Twitch, and Kick.
- Bringing your own ideas to the table instead of simply waiting for instructions.

## What I'm Looking For

- Someone passionate about gaming and content creation.
- Strong video-editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or similar).
- Someone who understands YouTube algorithms, Shorts, and audience retention.
- A creative mindset with the ability to identify engaging moments.
- Someone self-motivated, consistent, disciplined, and hungry to achieve something big.
- Someone who thinks like a creator, not just an editor.
- A person interested in building a long-term working relationship.

Experience is important, but hunger, creativity, consistency, and the willingness to learn and grow matter just as much.

## Revenue-Sharing Opportunity

I believe in growing together and rewarding people who contribute to the journey.

Here's what I'm offering:

- **30% of channel revenue** from YouTube, Twitch, Kick, and other agreed content-related platforms.
- Revenue sharing will begin as soon as the channels start generating earnings.
- This arrangement will initially run for the first 4–5 months of monetisation.
- The exact revenue calculation, payment schedule, and responsibilities will be mutually agreed upon before starting.

This is an opportunity to build something from the ground up rather than simply take up another editing project.

## Content We Create

- BGMI
- Minecraft
- GTA V / GTA VI
- Among Us
- Multiplayer and group gaming content
- Livestream highlights, challenges, funny moments, and gaming Shorts.

## How to Apply

If you think you have the creativity, dedication, and hunger to grow with an upcoming creator, I'd love to hear from you.

Please share:
1. Your video-editing portfolio or previous work.
2. Your experience with gaming content.
3. The software you use.
4. Any ideas you have for growing a gaming YouTube channel.
5. Why you think you'd be a good fit for this journey.

**One last thing:**

I'm not looking for someone who just wants to complete tasks and collect payments. I want someone who sees potential, takes ownership, brings ideas, and is genuinely excited about building something big.

Let's start small, stay consistent, grow together, and make something worth remembering.

**If you're hungry for growth, let's build something together!**

• HIPAA-grade video powered by WebRTC (or another secure stack you prefer) with adaptive quality for low-bandwidth areas. 
• Push notifications, SMS and email reminders keep both sides informed. 
• A lightweight admin panel or API hooks must let us onboard new doctors, nurses and diagnostic partners quickly.
