title: Drive Bookings for Sicily Sunset Venue
desc: **Help us turn online attention into real guests at Kairos Stagnone.** Kairos Stagnone is a seasonal venue in Marsala, Sicily, where guests enjoy sunset aperitivo among vineyard rows. We opened in May 2026 and are reopening in **April 2027** with a new design led by an architect.…
full:
**Help us turn online attention into real guests at Kairos Stagnone.**

Kairos Stagnone is a seasonal venue in Marsala, Sicily, where guests enjoy sunset aperitivo among vineyard rows. We opened in May 2026 and are reopening in **April 2027** with a new design led by an architect. We want people in the area to hear about the reopening, find us when they search for somewhere to go, and book a table or come visit. **Our website is currently in development and will go live soon.**

We’re looking for a hands-on paid advertising specialist who has helped a restaurant, bar, venue, or tourism business attract customers in person. **We shoot and supply the photos and videos. You tell us what to film for the campaigns, write the ad copy, and handle campaign setup, testing, and ongoing optimization.** This is a remote role. Customer-facing ads must read naturally in Italian.

**What you’ll do**

- **Instagram and Facebook Ads.** Make Instagram our main advertising channel. Test different videos, messages, and audiences on Meta. Before reopening, build awareness around Marsala and the surrounding area. Once bookings open, run campaigns that drive reservation enquiries. Quote TikTok Ads as an optional test if you see a clear opportunity.
- **Google Search Ads.** Research what locals and visitors actually search for, starting with phrases such as *aperitivo in vigna Marsala* and *aperitivo al tramonto Stagnone*. Build and manage campaigns around relevant searches, review the terms that trigger our ads, and send people to a clear booking or contact page.
- **Google Maps and local SEO.** Improve our existing Google Business Profile, including photos, contact details, directions, booking links, and opening hours at launch. Review how our website appears in relevant local searches and identify the changes that would help people find us.
- **Track results that matter to the venue.** Send a short weekly update with spend, what worked, and what you’ll change next. During pre-launch, track local reach, video views, and profile visits. Once bookings open, track enquiries, confirmed bookings, and cost per enquiry. Work with our team on a simple way to record how guests heard about us, including walk-ins.

**How we’ll start**

We’re offering a **paid 30-day trial** covering an account and tracking review, a Meta test using two of our videos, local keyword research, and a launch plan for April. If it’s a good fit, we’d like to continue through the summer season. Campaigns will run in Kairos-owned accounts, with ad spend paid directly by us.

**To apply**

1. Share one relevant case study from a venue or tourism business. Include what you personally managed, the timeframe, the ad spend, and the enquiries, bookings, or visits you could verify.
2. Look at **@kairos_stagnone** and tell us what you’d test first using our footage, who you’d target, and how you’d judge whether it worked.
3. Quote your **30-day trial fee**, **ongoing monthly management fee**, and **recommended advertising budget** separately.

title: Write BeBe & Ha Storybook
desc: I’m developing a brand-new children’s storybook that follows two lively characters, BeBe and Ha. The book is aimed squarely at readers ages 4–7, so the language must be simple, rhythmic, and engaging while still offering enough plot to keep early readers—and the adults reading al…
full:
I’m developing a brand-new children’s storybook that follows two lively characters, BeBe and Ha. The book is aimed squarely at readers ages 4–7, so the language must be simple, rhythmic, and engaging while still offering enough plot to keep early readers—and the adults reading aloud—captivated. 

The first adventure needs to center on the theme of being brave and trying new things. I’d like the story to model healthy risk-taking, gentle problem-solving, and a reassuring resolution that leaves kids feeling inspired rather than lectured. Humor and heart are both welcome; what matters most is that bravery feels attainable and fun. 

For deliverables, I’ll need: 
• A complete, polished manuscript ready for layout (Word or Google Doc). 
• Brief illustration notes beside each scene or page break so an artist can visualize key moments and character emotions. 

I’m open to your creative ideas on setting, side characters, and story length, provided the pacing stays tight for young attention spans. If you’ve written early-reader picture books before—or if you understand the nuances of child psychology and readability levels—that experience would be a bonus. 

Please share a short sample of children’s prose or a link to previous work when you respond, and let me know your estimated turnaround time. I’m excited to see BeBe and Ha take their first brave leap together.

title: AC-Powered Variable Supply & Current Frequency Design
desc: I need a complete circuit design that lets me take standard wall-outlet AC and deliver an adjustable power output whose voltage, frequency, and current I can dial in for experiments. The final solution will run electronic test setups only—no motors or heaters—so efficiency, stabi…
full:
I need a complete circuit design that lets me take standard wall-outlet AC and deliver an adjustable power output whose voltage, frequency, and current I can dial in for experiments. The final solution will run electronic test setups only—no motors or heaters—so efficiency, stability, and safety matter more than raw wattage.

Here’s what I expect: 
• Schematic and brief theory of operation showing how the incoming 230 V AC is converted, regulated, and made variable. 
• Bill of materials with part numbers that are actually purchasable today. 
• Simulation files (LTspice, Proteus, or equivalent) proving it meets basic specs we’ll agree on together. 
• PCB layout in KiCad, Altium, or Eagle and any microcontroller firmware if the design uses digital control.

title: Drive Bookings for Sicilian Sunset Venue
desc: **Help us turn online attention into real guests at Kairos Stagnone.** Kairos Stagnone is a seasonal venue in Marsala, Sicily, where guests enjoy sunset aperitivo among vineyard rows. We opened in May 2026 and are reopening in **April 2027** with a new design led by an architect.…
full:
**Help us turn online attention into real guests at Kairos Stagnone.**

Kairos Stagnone is a seasonal venue in Marsala, Sicily, where guests enjoy sunset aperitivo among vineyard rows. We opened in May 2026 and are reopening in **April 2027** with a new design led by an architect. We want people in the area to hear about the reopening, find us when they search for somewhere to go, and book a table or come visit. **Our website is currently in development and will go live soon.**

We’re looking for a hands-on paid advertising specialist who has helped a restaurant, bar, venue, or tourism business attract customers in person. **We shoot and supply the photos and videos. You tell us what to film for the campaigns, write the ad copy, and handle campaign setup, testing, and ongoing optimization.** This is a remote role. Customer-facing ads must read naturally in Italian.

**What you’ll do**

- **Instagram and Facebook Ads.** Make Instagram our main advertising channel. Test different videos, messages, and audiences on Meta. Before reopening, build awareness around Marsala and the surrounding area. Once bookings open, run campaigns that drive reservation enquiries. Quote TikTok Ads as an optional test if you see a clear opportunity.
- **Google Search Ads.** Research what locals and visitors actually search for, starting with phrases such as *aperitivo in vigna Marsala* and *aperitivo al tramonto Stagnone*. Build and manage campaigns around relevant searches, review the terms that trigger our ads, and send people to a clear booking or contact page.
- **Google Maps and local SEO.** Improve our existing Google Business Profile, including photos, contact details, directions, booking links, and opening hours at launch. Review how our website appears in relevant local searches and identify the changes that would help people find us.
- **Track results that matter to the venue.** Send a short weekly update with spend, what worked, and what you’ll change next. During pre-launch, track local reach, video views, and profile visits. Once bookings open, track enquiries, confirmed bookings, and cost per enquiry. Work with our team on a simple way to record how guests heard about us, including walk-ins.

**How we’ll start**

We’re offering a **paid 30-day trial** covering an account and tracking review, a Meta test using two of our videos, local keyword research, and a launch plan for April. If it’s a good fit, we’d like to continue through the summer season. Campaigns will run in Kairos-owned accounts, with ad spend paid directly by us.

**To apply**

1. Share one relevant case study from a venue or tourism business. Include what you personally managed, the timeframe, the ad spend, and the enquiries, bookings, or visits you could verify.
2. Look at **@kairos_stagnone** and tell us what you’d test first using our footage, who you’d target, and how you’d judge whether it worked.
3. Quote your **30-day trial fee**, **ongoing monthly management fee**, and **recommended advertising budget** separately.

full:
this is the full brief "Assignment Task

There are two main activities for you to complete:
1. Create UML Sequence Diagrams for the behavioural design of the software system.
2. Complete a task related to the topic of Design Patterns. 

There are four documents associated with this brief, all available on My...:
- System description
- Sequence Diagrams task description
- Design Pattern task description
- Submission Template

Component 1: UML Sequence Diagrams (75%)
You will already have analysed the classes that exist for the design of the system described in the associated documentation – the system description is available on My... . You are now going to utilise these classes to produce a behavioural design for the system in the form of UML Sequence Diagrams. There are THREE sequence diagrams that you need to create and submit using the provided template . These documents serve two purposes: (i) they describe what you need to do; (ii) they contain spaces for you to insert the ‘answers’ to the assignments you are completing. You can use a UML tool to create your diagrams. You can copy and paste the diagrams that you create directly into the relevant spaces of this document. You will be resubmitting this same document back to My... once it is complete along with the content for Component 2 below. For each sequence diagram that is described in the document, you should do the following:
1. Read through the general summary of the use case that you are creating the sequence diagram for
2. Identify any relevant actors that will be required for the sequence diagram.
3. Identify any relevant classes / objects that will be required for the sequence diagram.
4. Create messages between the actors and objects in the diagram that show how the step-by-step functionality of the use case is being addressed in a detailed and logical order.
5. Make use of ‘reply’ messages to reinforce the flow of control and structure of the diagram.
6. Consider additional UML notation where required, e.g., to show loops, conditions, object creation. 
7. Consider design principles such as ‘Information Expert’ to ensure the quality of your design. 
8. For extra marks, consider any additional ‘alternative’ flows for the use case, e.g., different choices that could have been made, things that might go wrong, etc. 
9. Copy and paste your completed diagram into the relevant section(s) of the ‘Assessment Submission Template’ document.

Component 2: Design Patterns Task (25%)
We will briefly discuss the topic of Design Patterns during the module. To demonstrate your understanding of design patterns, you will be asked to complete a design patterns task. My name is Michael, and I am an entrepreneur based in South Africa.

I am looking for a professional AI animation studio to partner with me in creating a premium-quality animated children’s Bible series, covering the entire Bible from Genesis to Revelation.

OUR VISION

We want to create a beautiful, entertaining and educational animated Bible series for children aged 4–12, which we intend to distribute and sell internationally.

Our preferred animation style is high-quality, Disney/Pixar-inspired 3D animation, featuring expressive characters, beautiful environments, cinematic lighting and engaging storytelling.

The animation must be visually consistent, with characters maintaining the same appearance throughout the episodes.

EPISODE REQUIREMENTS
 • Approximately 5–7 minutes per episode.
 • Biblical stories presented accurately and in an age-appropriate manner.
 • Characters speaking naturally to one another, supported by professional narration.
 • High-quality animation, realistic movements and expressive facial features.
 • Professional voice acting, background music and sound effects.
 • Full HD or 4K final video quality.
 • Consistent characters and animation quality across the entire series.

We would like to begin with the Book of Genesis, starting with the story of Creation, and gradually work through the entire Bible.

LONG-TERM BUSINESS OPPORTUNITY

Our intention is to produce a complete series of potentially 100–150 episodes.

We plan to begin with a small number of episodes, market and sell them internationally, and reinvest the revenue into producing additional episodes.

We are therefore looking for an affordable, reliable, long-term animation partner.

COMMERCIAL RIGHTS

As this is a commercial project, we require full commercial distribution rights, including the ability to sell downloadable episodes worldwide, use our own branding, and translate or dub the series into multiple languages.

Ideally, we would like ownership of the original characters, artwork and completed productions.

QUOTATION REQUEST

Could you please provide:
 1. Your estimated production cost for a complete 5-minute episode.
 2. Your pricing for a series of 5, 10 or more episodes.
 3. Examples of your highest-quality 3D animated children’s productions.
 4. Your estimated production time per episode.
 5. Details regarding commercial ownership and distribution rights.
 6. Whether you offer a short paid sample before committing to a complete episode.

We have an initial production budget and are looking for competitive pricing, as our objective is to establish a sustainable long-term partnership.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,

Michael Bruwer
South Africa

full:
# Growth Marketer Needed for Discord Server Boosting Business

I run a Discord Server Boosting business that provides users, server owners, and online communities with reliable Discord server boosts at competitive prices. Our goal is simple: attract a consistent flow of customers looking to boost their Discord servers and turn that traffic into recurring paying customers.

We already have the service, infrastructure, and advertising budget ready. What we need is an experienced growth marketer who can build and execute a full-funnel marketing strategy focused on driving sales, increasing brand awareness, and scaling revenue.

You should be comfortable running Google Ads, Meta campaigns, TikTok and YouTube promotions, securing placements in relevant Telegram channels, and building organic exposure across Discord communities, Reddit, and other gaming-related platforms.

Strong SEO knowledge is also essential. We want to rank for high-intent searches related to Discord server boosts, cheap Discord boosts, Discord Nitro, server boost packages, and other relevant keywords that bring in customers actively looking to purchase.

## Key Responsibilities

- **Growth Strategy:** Develop a channel-by-channel marketing roadmap focused on generating paying customers and increasing recurring revenue.
- **Paid Advertising:** Set up, manage, and optimise Google Ads and Meta campaigns, including ad creatives, audience targeting, conversion tracking, and retargeting.
- **TikTok & YouTube Marketing:** Run promotional campaigns and work with relevant gaming and Discord-focused creators to drive targeted traffic.
- **Telegram Marketing:** Identify high-quality Telegram channels and communities for promotional placements, negotiate deals, and optimise ad copy for conversions while following platform rules.
- **SEO:** Improve on-page and off-page SEO to rank for high-intent keywords such as "Discord server boosts", "buy Discord boosts", and related search terms.
- **Community Marketing:** Build brand awareness and generate referrals through legitimate outreach, partnerships, and engagement in relevant Discord communities, Reddit forums, and gaming hubs.
- **Conversion Optimisation:** Improve landing pages, pricing presentation, offers, and checkout flows to increase the percentage of visitors who become paying customers.
- **Analytics & Reporting:** Track customer acquisition cost (CAC), return on ad spend (ROAS), conversion rates, repeat purchases, and customer retention.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A clear growth roadmap with channel-specific strategies, budgets, and KPIs tied to revenue and customer acquisition targets.
2. Live and optimised marketing campaigns across at least three primary channels within the first 30 days.
3. Measurable growth in paid Discord boost orders, with performance compared against our existing baseline.
4. Consistent reporting covering CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, revenue, and repeat customer trends.
5. A scalable acquisition strategy that can consistently bring in new customers while maintaining profitable advertising costs.

## Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with proven experience scaling digital services, gaming-related businesses, Discord-focused products, or subscription-based services.

Experience marketing Discord server boosts, Nitro-related services, gaming communities, or other digital products is a major advantage.

We want someone who understands where Discord server owners and community managers spend their time, how to reach customers actively looking for boosts, and how to convert that demand into sales.

If you've previously scaled a similar business, please share:

- Examples of campaigns you've managed.
- Previous results, including CAC, ROAS, and conversion rates.
- Which marketing channels delivered the best results.
- Your proposed strategy for scaling a Discord Server Boosting business.

We're ready to invest in growth and are looking for someone who can take ownership of marketing, execute consistently, and turn our Discord boosting service into a scalable and profitable business.

**Let's build a consistent stream of customers and scale this business together.**

desc: About the Role Abnormal is built to look and feel like nothing else in security: precision-engineered, a little rebellious, and a few steps ahead of now. We protect more than 5,000 customers, including 30% of the Fortune 500, with a platform that stops the attacks everyone else m…
full:
About the Role

Abnormal is built to look and feel like nothing else in security: precision-engineered, a little rebellious, and a few steps ahead of now. We protect more than 5,000 customers, including 30% of the Fortune 500, with a platform that stops the attacks everyone else misses. We need someone to make it look like the future it is.

We're looking for an Art Director who is first and foremost an artist. This is not a creative production role. You will own Abnormal's aesthetic direction, a singular visual identity with a bold and cinematic sensibility, and communicate that vision clearly to every team, vendor, and collaborator who executes creative work. You'll work closely with our CEO, CMO, VP of Product Marketing, and VP of Revenue Marketing to internalize Abnormal's worldview, then make it your own, ideally pushing it further than we imagined.

This role is distinct from our creative services function, which runs the production engine. Your job is to set the vision, protect its integrity, and elevate it. At Abnormal, you'll do the most exciting work of your career because you'll be shaping how the future of cybersecurity is seen, in a company where AI is at the core of the product and the way we work.

The ideal candidate is a concept artist at heart, someone who has spent their career in sci-fi film, cyberpunk or sci-fi video games, or similarly high-craft visual storytelling environments. Specifically, we want someone who knows how to design computer interfaces, holograms, and imagined future worlds, with the kind of detail that maps to a visionary technology company and its products: the in-world UI of a sci-fi game or film, the readout on a futuristic digital weapon, the menu architecture of a spacecraft. Not characters. Not atmospheric environments. Designed systems and objects with detail and intention. You see and express vision. You don't just execute.

What You Will Do

• Define and own Abnormal's visual aesthetic direction

• Lead visual ideation for high-stakes moments: major product launches, experiential events (RSA, Black Hat), and brand campaigns

• Contribute hands-on concept work when the moment demands it. This is a vision-first role, but your craft should be evident

• Build a shared creative language across the org so the aesthetic direction scales without bottlenecking through you

• Serve as the creative authority and taste-setter for all visual output, from brand identity to campaigns to experiential environments

• Translate the CEO's and leadership's vision into a clear, communicable aesthetic that others can execute without needing you in every room

• Partner with creative services to keep production output style-consistent, setting guardrails and reviewing work rather than running the factory

• Develop mood boards, concept art, and visual references that define "in the zone" creative for recruiter screening, vendor briefs, and internal alignment

Must Haves

• 10+ years of experience in concept art, visual design, or art direction, with a body of work that shows artistic progression and a distinct point of view

• Shipped credits on AAA game titles, major film productions, or equivalent high-craft visual projects in sci-fi, cyberpunk, or adjacent genres, with work focused on interface design, in-world UI/UX, holographic displays, or designed objects (virtual weapons, vehicles, technology systems) rather than characters, creatures, or natural environments

• A portfolio that demonstrates genuine aesthetic vision, not just execution. Your work should show world-building expressed through designed objects and systems: architecture, vehicles, digital weapons, futuristic technology, UI. Detailed, intentional, engineered creative work. Painterly or landscape-driven portfolios are not the profile we're hiring

• Experience as the sole or lead visual voice on at least one significant project: not just a contributor, but the person who owned the aesthetic direction end to end

• Ability to articulate and document a visual language clearly enough that others can execute it without you present

• Experience collaborating directly with senior leadership or creative directors and translating their vision into something tangible

• Craft fluency across visual mediums: digital, environmental, editorial, motion

• Proven ability to work as an individual contributor in a fast-moving tech company. You operate with autonomy, take feedback, and collaborate cross-functionally. You want to stay close to the work, and you're here to bring the vision, not manage a team

• Strong communication and presentation skills. You can defend and sell a creative direction with clarity and confidence

Nice to Haves

• Experience in B2B tech, cybersecurity, or enterprise software, or a demonstrated ability to quickly internalize a technical domain and translate it visually

• Familiarity with experiential or event design (large-format, spatial, environmental)

• Experience working alongside or managing a creative production team

• Comfort with AI-assisted design and prototyping tools

full:
FREELANCER WANTED – ONLINE BUSINESS RESEARCH & DIRECTORY LISTINGS

SupportingSmallBusiness.com (SSB)

Ongoing Opportunity | Worldwide | Remote Work

ABOUT THE PROJECT

SupportingSmallBusiness.com (SSB) is building a global online business directory designed to help small businesses gain greater online exposure, promote their products and services, and access additional business opportunities.

We are seeking a reliable, motivated freelancer to help identify genuine small businesses, create their listings on our website and introduce business owners to the SSB network.

This is an ongoing opportunity for the right participant.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Your daily tasks will involve:

1. Finding Small Businesses

Search Google and other online resources to identify genuine small businesses that:

Do not have their own website.

Have little or no social media presence.

Have limited marketing or advertising exposure.

Have no suitable online tools to promote or sell their products.

Could benefit from greater online visibility.

2. Collecting Business Details

For each business identified, record:

Business name.

Telephone number.

Email address, where available.

Business location.

Business category.

Brief description of the business and its products or services.

3. Creating Business Listings

Create a listing for each business on:

www.SupportingSmallBusiness.com

Listings must be accurate, professionally presented and placed in the appropriate category.

Each listing will be made available for the business owner to claim.

4. Contacting Business Owners

After creating each listing, send an introductory email to the business owner explaining:

That their business has been listed on SSB.

What SupportingSmallBusiness.com offers.

The benefits of joining the SSB network.

How they can claim and manage their listing.

The objective is to encourage business owners to become active SSB participants.

DAILY PERFORMANCE TARGETS

We expect the successful freelancer to achieve:

10 genuine business listings per day.

50 genuine business listings per week.

An introductory email sent to each business owner where a valid email address is available.

Consistency and accuracy are essential.

STRICT QUALITY REQUIREMENTS

All businesses must be genuine and independently verifiable.

SSB will conduct random audits of listings.

Fake or invented businesses are unacceptable.

Duplicate listings will not count.

Fabricated telephone numbers or email addresses are unacceptable.

Incorrect or misleading information will be rejected.

IMPORTANT: Any listing found to be deliberately fake or fraudulent will be disqualified. No payment will be made for fraudulent work, subject to the applicable Freelancer engagement and payment terms.

REQUIRED SKILLS

Applicants should have:

Good internet research skills.

Basic computer and data-entry knowledge.

Familiarity with Google Search.

Good written English.

Ability to identify genuine businesses.

Basic email communication skills.

Attention to detail.

Ability to work independently and meet daily targets.

Previous experience in lead generation, online research, data entry or business directory management is an advantage.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are particularly interested in someone who is:

Reliable and self-motivated.

Interested in an ongoing working relationship.

Capable of meeting agreed production targets.

Interested in helping small businesses gain greater online exposure.

HOW TO APPLY

Please provide the following in your application:

A brief introduction about yourself.

Your previous experience in online research or lead generation.

Your availability and working hours.

Your proposed price for completing 50 genuine business listings per week.

Confirmation that you can also create listings and send introductory emails.

We are looking to establish a long-term relationship with the right freelancer.

SupportingSmallBusiness.com

Helping Small Businesses Grow Together.

desc: Headquarters: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only) We're transforming the grocery industry At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a …
full:
Headquarters: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team 

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

The Advertiser Optimization team is the decision-making engine of Instacart's $1B+ ads business. We own the systems responsible for Bidding, Pacing, Budgeting, Targeting and advertiser-facing recommendations - converting stated advertiser goals into real-time auction actions. Our mission is to maximize realized Advertiser Value by deciding when to participate, how much to bid, and how fast to spend, all while carefully balancing User Experience and Platform Revenue.

We are looking for an Applied Research Scientist II with a strong quantitative background to join our team. In this role, you will apply your expertise in operational research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field to help build and refine the algorithmic systems that power how Instacart's advertising marketplace operates. You'll work alongside a talented team of scientists and engineers, contributing to production systems that have real, measurable impact on a scaled ads platform. If you're excited by the intersection of rigorous quantitative thinking and large-scale engineering, this is the role for you.

About the Job

• Develop and evaluate models and algorithms for ads bidding, pacing, and budgeting, applying your training in operational research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related quantitative discipline to solve complex marketplace problems at scale.

• Collaborate closely with senior scientists, engineers and product managers to translate well-defined marketplace questions into mathematical formulations, implement analyses and prototypes, design experiments, and interpret results using large-scale data.

• Contribute to production systems through algorithm implementation, validation, and monitoring, progressively taking ownership of well-scoped projects from initial hypothesis through measurable impact.

• Operate in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment where the ads marketplace shifts quickly — you'll need to balance rigor with speed, and thrive when priorities change and new challenges emerge.

• Communicate assumptions, findings, and limitations clearly to both technical and cross-functional partners, helping the team make better decisions through transparency and analytical clarity.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

• PhD in operations research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related quantitative discipline, with a strong foundation in at least one of the following areas: optimization, probability, statistical modeling, econometrics, or control theory.

• Proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated ability to translate quantitative concepts into analyses, algorithm implementations, and experiments.

• Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to explain assumptions, methodologies, results, and limitations to both technical and cross-functional audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• 2+ years of software engineering experience, particularly in applying quantitative methods to production systems.

• Familiarity with ads systems, auction theory, or related marketplace optimization problems.

• Experience working with large-scale data pipelines and real-time decision systems.

• Familiarity with machine learning techniques and applying machine learning in production systems.

full:
I run a channel built around competitive gameplay and impressive plays, and I’m ready to hand the short-form side of the workload to an editor who can match the pace of the action. Every clip needs to land as a fast-paced punchline, packed with memes, well-timed sound effects, quick zooms, and everything else that keeps viewers glued to YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels.

Here’s how the workflow usually looks: I’ll supply raw VOD segments or time-stamped highlights; you’ll cut them down to bite-sized 15–60 second vertical videos (9:16), weave in energetic hooks during the first three seconds, layer readable captions, subtitles, or emojis where they add value, and polish the audio so crowd noise or background music never drowns out the moment of triumph. The final export should be crisp, no black bars, and ready to upload on both platforms without extra tweaking on my end.

I value consistency, quick communication, and an eye for what’s trending in the gaming sphere. If you already keep up with meta memes, patch-day jokes, or speed-run hype, you’ll feel right at home here. Proven experience with Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or a comparable editor is essential; I don’t mind which tool you use as long as the result holds viewer retention.

Deliverables for each assignment: 
• One vertically formatted (9:16) MP4/MOV up to 60 s, hard-coded captions included 
• A catchy on-screen opening hook within the first three seconds 
• Subtle but clear branding tag at the end (I’ll provide assets) 
• Project file or edit sequence on request for quick revisions

Turnaround is typically 24–48 hours per clip, and the volume will grow if we click. If you’d like an ongoing partnership built around gaming content that actually excites you, send over a portfolio or links to shorts that match this vibe and let’s get started.

full:
We are looking for a developer or small team to build the software and 3D content for an interactive kids’ exhibit at an upcoming event in Oman.

The experience
A large wall-screen (6 m × 3 m) shows a playful, game-like 3D world with friendly characters in Omani outfit.
Children stand in front of the screen. Their body movements and gestures (waving, jumping, raising arms, moving left and right) make the characters react in real time.
Beside the wall sits a floor-standing kiosk screen for e-payment donations. When a donation succeeds, the 3D characters on the wall react with a special celebration or interaction. The goal is to encourage kids to donate in a fun, interactive way.

What we provide
All hardware at the event: wall-screen, kiosk, PC/media player, and camera/sensor.
The payment gateway account and its API will be handled by us. Your 3D world will listen for a success payment message in order to trigger an event/animation.

What you deliver
Interactive wall application (Unity)
Real-time body/gesture tracking from a camera.
Support for multiple children at once (state the number you can reliably track).

3D digital content
A themed 3D environment and 2-3 animated characters (rigged, with idle, reaction, and celebration animations).
Gesture-triggered reactions and a distinct donation celebration sequence.

Required skills / procedures
Unity (C#) engine
Computer vision, pose estimation, or gesture tracking
3D modeling, rigging, and animation (Blender or similar)
Experience with children’s content
Arabic and English UI text.
All assets must be original or properly licensed for commercial and public use.

title: Video Promotion - Naked Tuth
desc: In brief A 12-second vertical video (minimum 10s, maximum 15s) designed to spark interest in "Naked Truth"—a multiplayer Truth or Dare-style game played on smartphones (available at nakedtruth.fun). The primary edit is in a 9:16 aspect ratio, adapted for TikTok, Facebook (Reels),…
full:
In brief
A 12-second vertical video (minimum 10s, maximum 15s) designed to spark interest in "Naked Truth"—a multiplayer Truth or Dare-style game played on smartphones (available at nakedtruth.fun). The primary edit is in a 9:16 aspect ratio, adapted for TikTok, Facebook (Reels), YouTube Shorts, and WhatsApp Status.
• Objective: To get the viewer to click the link and start the free demo.
• Core concept: Friends, each using their own phone; a card flips over; reactions ensue—"Truth or Dare, phone-style."
• Target audience: Adults aged 18–35 who host social gatherings with friends or partners.
• Language: The primary edit is in French. English and Spanish versions will use the same footage (with only the on-screen text translated).
Storyboard (12s)
The hook comes first: within the first 2 seconds, the viewer must understand that this is a party game. No single shot should exceed 3 seconds.
Time
Visual
On-screen text
Audio
0:00–0:02
Dark purple background. A glowing card flips over and fills the screen.
"TRUTH or DARE?" (large, centered)
Sharp bass hit as the card flips
0:02–0:05
3 or 4 friends on a sofa, each with their own phone. Close-up shots: an outburst of laughter, a hand covering a mouth, someone saying, "No, not me!"
"Everyone on their own phone"
Music builds, authentic laughter
0:05–0:09
Screen recording of the game (see provided files): sharing the room code, players joining, the wheel spinning, a card appearing. Fast-paced editing, cuts synced to the rhythm.
"A code. "Everyone’s playing."
A subtle sound effect at each cut
0:09–0:11
A scrolling banner showing the "vibes": Fun, Soft, Hot. Uses the site’s color palette; no suggestive imagery.
"From family-friendly to spicy"
Music at full volume
0:11–0:12
End screen: logo, URL, "Try for free" button. Keep as a clear, static image for 1.5 seconds.
"nakedtruth.fun · Free demo" + "18+ for 'Hot' levels" (in small print)
Complete silence on the final frame
The 0:09–0:11 segment may be trimmed if the total edit exceeds 13 seconds; never cut the hook or the end screen.
Optional voiceover variant: "Truth… or dare? Everyone grabs their phone, enters a code, and the night begins. Try it for free at nakedtruth.fun." Approximately 9 seconds at a natural pace.
Technical Specifications
A single master edit, exported with the same settings for all platforms (with the exception of file size for WhatsApp).
Setting
Required Value
Format
Vertical 9:16, 1080 × 1920 px
Frame rate
30 fps (or 60 fps if screen captures are fluid)
Duration
Target 12 seconds; must be between 10 and 15 seconds
File type
MP4, H.264, AAC stereo audio
File size
Maximum 50 MB WhatsApp version: 16 MB maximum.
Safe zones:
Avoid placing important text within 250 px from the bottom, 150 px from the top, or 120 px from the right; these areas may be covered by platform-specific buttons or UI elements.
Subtitles:
Embedded in the video and large (most people watch without sound).
Looping:
The final frame must transition seamlessly into the first frame.
Deliverables:
One version per platform (TikTok, Facebook/Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, WhatsApp Status). If the budget allows, provide versions in French, English, and Spanish. Only the on-screen text changes between versions; the working file must keep text on separate layers so the client can edit it.
Safe zones and file size limits are standard guidelines; the editor should verify these against the official templates for each platform before the final export.
Brand, tone, and content guidelines:
Tone: Engaging, humorous, and fast-paced. The goal is to elicit genuine laughter, not awkwardness. The viewer should think, "I want to try this with my friends."
Brand colors:
Usage
Code
Dark background
#0D0A13
Brand purple
#B03FE8
Fun (yellow)
#F2AE3D
Soft (green)
#3DD9A0
Hot (pink)
#FF4C86
Light text
#F3EEF9
Font: Use the font from the website (the client will provide the file or the exact name). Visual style: Dark background, purple glow, flipping cards, rounded corners.
Content guidelines (essential for platform approval):
• The game includes levels restricted to users aged 18 and older. The promotional video must be suitable for all audiences: no nudity, no suggestive gestures or attire, and no sexually explicit questions displayed on screen.
• All actors must be over 18 years of age (with a signed image release form for each, or footage sourced from a stock library with a commercial license).
• Only the "Fun," "Soft," and "Hot" levels may be shown—indicated by their names and colors—without ever displaying the text from the more explicit cards.
• The end screen must clearly state "18+ for 'Hot' levels."
• The video must not contain any specific numerical promises or mentions of pricing.
Music: Must be a royalty-free track with a commercial license (covering paid advertising), with a tempo of approximately 120–128 beats per minute. The editor must provide proof of the license. No commercially released (mainstream) music, even if "trending," is permitted.

title: ArcaneLogix RPG Module Icon Interface
desc: I’m looking for a graphic designer to create a cohesive visual design for ArcaneLogix, a collection of tools for tabletop roleplaying games and Foundry VTT. The attached reference image shows the general concept: our wizard mascot surrounded by individual module icons. The finish…
full:
I’m looking for a graphic designer to create a cohesive visual design for ArcaneLogix, a collection of tools for tabletop roleplaying games and Foundry VTT.
The attached reference image shows the general concept: our wizard mascot surrounded by individual module icons. The finished artwork will be used on our website and in promotional posts.
I already have the wizard artwork and will supply it. Creating or redesigning the wizard is NOT part of this job. Your work will focus on the module icons, their frames, and the overall composition around the existing wizard.
Creative Direction
The attached image is a starting point. I want your original ideas and design judgment, rather than a traced recreation.
I like the orange symbols, ivory borders, dark background, and clear module identities. Hexagons fit the tabletop gaming theme, but I’m open to different framing or layout ideas if they improve the design. I’m looking for your inspiration and not the that of Ai. 
The result should feel simple, polished, readable, and cohesive with the supplied wizard. Each module should be recognizable individually while clearly belonging to the same family.
Scope: 14 Module Icons
Create a coordinated icon set for the following modules. These descriptions explain their purpose; you are welcome to propose better symbols than those shown in the reference.
1. TableOS — A Foundry VTT interface for in-person games, putting character actions, movement, and combat controls around a shared tabletop display.
2. Scry — Gives players character information and touch controls on their own phone or tablet.
3. Expedition — Manages overland hex exploration, shared fog, terrain costs, travel time, exhaustion, and required rests.
4. Shut-eye — Handles camping, rests, watches, interruptions, and camp activities such as foraging, hunting, and crafting.
5. ADS — Automated Discovery & Senses runs discovery checks and reveals configured hidden doors, traps, clues, and other secrets.
6. Ensemble — Brings music, sound effects, and layered ambient audio together in a scene soundboard.
7. DM Utilities — Helps game masters organize Foundry folders, browse and manage art assets, and access practical preparation tools.
8. Loot & Ledgers — Runs shops, buying, selling, haggling, loot distribution, and item and currency transfers.
9. Fate Dice — A private game-master dice tray for building dice pools, rolling, or entering results from physical dice.
10. Vellichor — Presents campaign journals, character books, letters, scrolls, handouts, and maps as interactive reading material.
11. Luckwright — Hosts dice games with players and non-player characters, managing wagers, rounds, pots, and payouts.
12. Lottery of Fate — Runs shared number draws with contestants, game-master controls, and winner reveals.
13. Gramarye — Manages crafting recipes, tools, materials, checks, and projects that progress over in-game days.
14. MA-CHASE — Manages chase encounters, tracking pursuers, quarry, distance gaps, hazards, and round-by-round chase actions. This module is not pictured in the reference; its icon needs a new concept suggesting pursuit or movement.
Overall Composition
Combine the individual module graphics with my supplied wizard and ArcaneLogix branding.
TableOS, Scry, Expedition, and Shut-eye should have strong visual prominence. The modules do not need to appear alphabetically.
Please consider balance, spacing, readable names, consistent icon weight, and how the design can accommodate additional modules later.
Website Use
The artwork will serve as interactive navigation on our website:
• Hovering over a module will show a short description.
• Clicking it will open that module’s page.
• Icons, frames, and labels must be available as separate elements.
• The composition should support desktop and mobile layouts.
Website coding is outside this project. My developer will implement the interactions. I need artwork that makes that implementation practical, rather than only one flattened image.
Promotional Use
I also need a complete composition suitable for promotional posts, with landscape, square, and portrait arrangements.
The artwork should remain clear at smaller sizes. Please avoid fine details that disappear when scaled down.
Deliverables
• Editable vector source files for all 14 new icons and frames, with clearly named layers.
• Individual SVG and transparent PNG exports for each module, with and without its name.
• Separate frames and labels so the elements can be rearranged for the website.
• The complete composition incorporating the supplied wizard and branding.
• Landscape, square, and portrait layouts, with export dimensions agreed before production.
• A brief style guide covering colors, typography, spacing, and icon treatment so future modules can match.
• Font and third-party asset licensing details, with commercial usage rights for the final work.
• Art work must be original and be able to show human providence. With Ai files delivered as proof.
Supply you basic idea or concept with the bid

Please preserve the supplied ArcaneLogix brand styling, including the angle brackets and orange dot over the “i,” unless we agree on a change. I will provide the available branding, font information, and wizard source files.
What to Include in Your Proposal
Please provide:
• Relevant examples of icon sets, brand graphics, or website hero designs.
• Your initial thoughts on improving the reference concept.
• Your total price and estimated timeline.
• The number of initial concepts and revision rounds included.
• The editable source formats and export formats you will deliver.
• Details of any stock assets or AI-generated elements you propose using.
I’m looking for a designer who can contribute thoughtful ideas and create a consistent visual system we can use across the website, individual module pages, and promotional material.

full:
My novel’s paperback is already live on Amazon, but after a recent edit the page count dropped by a little over ten percent, so the spine no longer lines up with the existing print-on-demand cover Esteban created for me. I can give you the full editable files for that cover; all I need is the spine and wrap adjusted so the art and type sit perfectly with the new, thinner block. 

While we are in there, I also want to add a hardcover edition. That means laying out a complete dust-jacket (front, spine, back and flaps) that carries the same visual language as the paperback, sized to KDP’s hardback template. I will supply the ISBN and any other specs you need the moment we start. 

The book opens with three location maps. The originals look dated now, so I have produced fresh drafts in PDF and JPEG—colour, with clearer labeling and cleaner line work. I’d like those drafts turned into final, high-resolution, full-colour illustrations that drop straight into the interior file and also stand alone as separate images for marketing. I’m looking for a talented AI animation filmmaker or small creative studio to produce a high-quality, cinematic Christmas animated short film for a luxury Parisian haircare brand.

The film celebrates the opening of a new Paris salon on December 1.

The story follows a famous Parisian hairstylist, his real white bull terrier, and the extraordinary decorative animals from his salon: a large ostrich, white peacocks, and a leopard.

On a magical Christmas night, the decorative animals secretly come alive and join the dog on an enchanting adventure through snowy Paris, ending at the beautiful new salon.

Visual style:

Traditional Disney-inspired 2D hand-drawn animation, similar to classic animated films such as The Aristocats and 101 Dalmatians, with the sophisticated cinematic atmosphere of luxury Christmas advertisements by Dior, Prada and Coca-Cola.

I want elegant character animation, beautiful hand-painted Parisian backgrounds, warm Christmas lighting, expressive animals and consistent character designs.

Deliverables:

* A complete 30–45-second animated Christmas film
* Consistent animated characters based on real photographs
* Professional cinematic animation and storytelling
* Background music and sound effects with commercial usage rights
* Professional editing and colour grading
* Final video in vertical 9:16 format, minimum 1080p
* One or two rounds of revisions

AI-assisted production using tools such as Kling, Runway, Midjourney or similar is welcome.

I will provide the story, character photographs, salon references and visual inspiration.

Important: I am looking for a complete finished film, not just character illustrations or static AI images.

Please share examples of previous AI-animated films in a similar 2D style, your fixed total price, and your estimated delivery time.

I would prefer to begin with a paid 5-second animation test before proceeding with the full project.

This is a private creative concept and should remain confidential.

- Animaciones fluidas.

desc: Job Title: High-Quality Photo Upscaling (Topaz Gigapixel) & Apparel Brand Logo Update (Photoshop) – ~200 Images Budget: $300.00 USD Maximum (Fixed Price) Project Description: We are looking for a detail-oriented photo editor to update our brand logo across approximately 200 activ…
full:
Job Title: High-Quality Photo Upscaling (Topaz Gigapixel) & Apparel Brand Logo Update (Photoshop) – ~200 Images
Budget: $300.00 USD Maximum (Fixed Price)
Project Description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented photo editor to update our brand logo across approximately 200 activewear studio photos (all provided photos feature the existing logo to be updated).
Please read the full description carefully before applying. Our maximum budget for the entire project is strictly $300.00 USD (including revisions as needed). Kindly do not submit proposals above $300.00 or automated bids that ignore these requirements, as we want to respect everyone's time.
Quality is our #1 priority. Because the original files are standard JPEGs and the logo sits at a small scale directly on the clothing, applying our updated logo onto un-upscaled images causes severe pixelation when zoomed in or enlarged. To ensure crisp, realistic results, the old logo must be removed first, each image must be upsized 4x in Topaz Gigapixel, and then the updated logo must be applied in Photoshop. The final logo must look naturally printed onto the fabric and match the photo's resolution so there is zero artificial pixelation when zoomed in.
Scope of Work:
1. Remove Old Logo First (Photoshop): Open the original JPEG images in Adobe Photoshop and cleanly retouch out/remove the previous brand logo from the clothing so the fabric texture looks completely clean and untouched.
2. Image Upscaling Second (Topaz Gigapixel): Run all ~200 cleaned images through Topaz Gigapixel AI at 4x resolution, creating clean fabric texture and enough pixel density to keep small logo lines and text sharp. Keep Face Recovery OFF (or at minimal settings) so the model’s face, skin, and details remain completely natural and true to the original.
3. Apply Updated Logo Third (Photoshop): Open the 4x upsized images in Adobe Photoshop and place our updated brand logo as a Vector Smart Object (or high-res Smart Object).
4. Realistic Fabric Alignment, Wrapping & Blending: Rotate and slightly warp the logo to match the angle of the seams and natural curve of the body/fabric. Where a logo sits near an outer edge (such as the curve of a hip or leg), cleanly mask/clip the wrapping edge so it follows the contour naturally instead of looking pasted on flat. Match the lighting and contrast of the clothing so the logo looks naturally printed on the garment.
5. Preserve Original Photo & Model: Do not alter the colors, lighting, skin tones, or appearance of the model, clothing, or background in any way. Only the resolution and brand logo should be updated.
6. Match Photo Sharpness & Zoom Behavior: Zoom in closely on every finished image to verify that the logo's sharpness matches the fabric and photo itself. When zoomed in, the logo and the photo must soften or lose detail naturally together—the logo should never break into harsh pixel blocks faster than the rest of the image.
7. Revisions Included: Revisions must be provided as needed at no additional cost until all images meet our placement, blending, and sharpness standards.
What We Will Provide:
• ~200 original JPEG activewear photos (organized in folders)
• High-resolution updated brand logo files (Vector .AI / .SVG / .EPS and/or .PNG)
• Brand placement guidelines (or reference examples)
Deliverables:
• ~200 finished, 4x upscaled images saved as High-Quality JPEGs (Quality 10–12), maintaining the exact original file names, extensions, and folder structure.
Budget & Payment Milestones ($300.00 USD Maximum – Revisions Included):
• Milestone 1 ($20.00): Complete and pass approval on a 10-image test sample (including any revisions needed) before starting the full batch.
• Milestone 2 ($140.00): Delivery and approval of the next 100 finished images (including any revisions needed).
• Milestone 3 ($140.00): Delivery and approval of the remaining 90 finished images (including any revisions needed).
Mandatory Requirements:
• Topaz Gigapixel (Required): Must own and use Topaz Gigapixel AI (4x upscale with Face Recovery turned off).
• Adobe Photoshop (Required): Must use Adobe Photoshop with Smart Objects, Warp/Transform, and Layer Masks for natural apparel placement (no basic online editors or mobile apps).
• Zero Pixelation Standard: Submissions showing pixelated logos, jagged thin lines, blurry edges, or compression artifacts will not be accepted.
• Strict Color & Subject Preservation: Must maintain exact original colors and make zero edits or retouching to the model or background.
• Revisions Policy: Must include revisions as needed to fix any alignment, warping, or quality issues prior to milestone release.
• File & Folder Integrity: Must preserve exact file names and folder organization.
To Apply:
Please reply with:
1. Confirmation that you accept the $300.00 USD fixed budget, milestone structure, and revisions as needed.
2. Confirmation that you have active access to both Topaz Gigapixel and Adobe Photoshop.
3. Confirmation that you understand the 3-step workflow (remove old logo → 4x Topaz upscale → apply updated logo) and apparel warping/edge-masking requirements.
4. Your estimated turnaround time for 200 images and a brief example of similar apparel/product photo editing work.

I'm looking for an experienced YouTube Shorts creator who understands what makes videos go viral and knows how to turn gaming content into highly engaging, high-performing Shorts.

Researching viral YouTube Shorts in the gaming niche, especially GTA and Roblox content.

Studying successful creators and analyzing what makes their videos perform well.

Identifying viral trends, formats, hooks, titles, and editing styles that can be adapted into original content.

Finding the most entertaining, funny, surprising, or attention-grabbing moments from KreekCraft's GTA 6 gameplay.

Creating strong hooks within the first 1–2 seconds to capture viewers' attention.

Editing Shorts to maximize audience retention, engagement, and replayability.

Writing optimized titles, descriptions, and relevant hashtags.

Understanding YouTube SEO and how to position videos for maximum discoverability.

Constantly researching what's currently working and adapting the content strategy accordingly.

Required Experience

Proven experience creating or editing successful YouTube Shorts.

Strong understanding of YouTube Shorts growth and algorithm optimization.

Excellent knowledge of audience retention, storytelling, and viewer psychology.

Ability to research viral videos and identify patterns behind their success.

Experience with gaming content is highly preferred.

Creative thinking and the ability to recognize viral opportunities in raw gameplay footage.

Important

I'm NOT looking for someone who simply adds captions, cuts clips, and uploads videos.

I want someone who actively researches, studies successful videos, understands why they went viral, and applies those strategies to create content with viral potential.

You should be constantly looking for ways to improve performance rather than repeatedly using the same editing formula.

When Applying, Please Include:

Examples of YouTube Shorts you've edited or helped grow.

Any channels you've worked with and their results.

Your experience with YouTube SEO and Shorts optimization.

How you research and analyze viral videos.

What strategies you would use to grow a GTA 6 gaming Shorts channel.

The goal: Build a successful YouTube Shorts channel by consistently producing highly engaging content with strong viral potential.

MUST INCLUDE: 

Every clip must include KreekCraft's overlay and drive viewers back to his livestream!

Only use KreekCraft's official GTA 6 livestreams and stream replays. Content from unrelated games or other creators is prohibited.

Every post must include #GTA6 #KreekCraft #GrandTheftAutoVI.

At least 40% of viewers must come from the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, or Australia.

Every clip must maintain at least a 0.8% engagement rate. Likes must remain publicly visible.

Clips must be entertaining, properly edited, and feature strong hooks within the first 1–2 seconds. Low-effort screen recordings and random gameplay are prohibited.

Only submit original edits. Stolen clips, reuploads, fabricated context, fake reactions, and misleading titles are prohibited.

Do not post the same or nearly identical clip more than 5 times. Story boosting, artificial views, and engagement manipulation are prohibited.

Every clip must remain publicly available for at least 30 days.

Only TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts are eligible.

full:
Public Relations Strategist - Broadband/Public Sector (Award-Contingent, Part-Time Retainer). Individual consultants or small PR/marketing agencies welcome.

About the client: Samson Global Solutions LLC (SGS), a Virginia small business (SDVOSB, SWaM-certified) based in Culpeper County, VA.

This is an award-contingent teaming position. SGS is preparing a proposal for a public-sector public relations and marketing contract on the Eastern Shore of Virginia. If SGS is awarded the contract, the selected professional will work part-time on a monthly retainer basis for a 3-year term with up to two 1-year renewals. No work or pay is guaranteed unless and until the contract is awarded and a separate written agreement is signed.

By applying, you agree that SGS may name you, with your permission, as proposed key personnel and include your resume and the work samples you designate in the proposal.

End client: a public broadband authority on the Eastern Shore of Virginia. Remote work is fine. Occasional on-site meetings on the Eastern Shore (Accomack/Northampton counties, VA) are a plus.

SCOPE (IF AWARDED)
- Annual strategic communications plan
- Press releases, editorial columns and executive talking points
- Media relations
- Crisis communications and rapid messaging during network outages and restoration
- Paid digital campaigns (Google Ads, Meta/Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn) with monthly analytics
- Print/direct-mail campaign copy
- Informational briefs, decks and white papers for town councils and county boards of supervisors

REQUIRED
- 5+ years of public relations or strategic communications experience
- Documented PR, marketing or copywriting work for a telecommunications, broadband, public utility, municipal or other public-authority client
- Experience with media relations and crisis communications

STRONGLY PREFERRED
- Knowledge of the Eastern Shore of Virginia (Accomack and Northampton counties): communities, local media, rural demographics, local government
- Fiber/FTTH or rural broadband adoption campaigns; digital ad campaign management and reporting
- A small agency that can provide a client list of public and private entities (preferably Virginia) served in the last 5 years

HOW TO APPLY - send everything in your first bid/proposal on this project (do not send materials by email):
- Resume or CV (attach to your bid)
- Portfolio or work-sample links (requested)
- 3 client references from the last 3 years (entity, service provided, contact person, phone or email). The proposal requires them.
- Answers to these screening questions:
 a) Describe your telecom, broadband, utility or municipal communications work (client, years, what you did).
 b) Describe your familiarity with the Eastern Shore of Virginia.
- Availability (hours per month over a 3-year term)
- Proposed hourly rate

The hourly range shown is a posting placeholder only, not a rate commitment or offer; the final rate is agreed later.

Application deadline: November 28, 2026. SGS will make its selection by November 30, 2026.

• 24 finished story illustrations, plus front cover, back cover, and endpaper design

• Up to two rounds of revisions per spread to fine-tune details and ensure safety steps are shown correctly 

Final acceptance hinges on the artwork being both engaging for the target age group and technically accurate in depicting: waiting at the bus stop, boarding and riding, and crossing close to the bus—elements that will appear across the series. 

If you love bringing friendly characters to life and are comfortable refining work through constructive feedback, this project sets the foundation for a long-term collaboration on the rest of the Billy Rides the Bus series.

full:
INSTRUCCIONES DE PRODUCCIÓN – TALLERIX

Video 1: Recepción del vehículo

Presupuesto para este primer video: USD 12
Tiempo máximo de entrega: 2 días.

1. Objetivo del proyecto

Crear un videotutorial profesional para Tallerix, una plataforma de gestión para talleres mecánicos.

Este primer video será una prueba de calidad. Si el cliente aprueba el resultado, continuaremos con los otros cinco tutoriales, cada uno con su correspondiente versión en inglés.

El objetivo es enseñar al usuario cómo realizar la recepción de un vehículo dentro del software, de manera sencilla, visual y dinámica.

2. Estilo audiovisual que buscamos

El cliente quiere un resultado:

- Limpio, moderno y profesional.
- Dinámico, pero sin exceso de efectos.
- Visualmente atractivo y fácil de comprender.
- Con apariencia de producción audiovisual profesional, no de video genérico generado por IA.
- Con transiciones suaves y movimientos de cámara digitales bien utilizados.
- Con una narración humana en español latino neutro.

Importante: Evitar plantillas genéricas, efectos innecesarios, animaciones exageradas y elementos que distraigan de la explicación.

La prioridad es que el usuario entienda perfectamente lo que está viendo.

3. Estructura del primer tutorial

Duración objetivo: entre 45 y 60 segundos.

El video debe explicar el proceso de recepción de un vehículo siguiendo el orden real de utilización de la plataforma.

Secuencia de contenido:

1. Introducción breve con el logotipo de Tallerix.
2. Mostrar el inicio del proceso de recepción del vehículo.
3. Enseñar cómo registrar la placa del automóvil.
4. Mostrar cómo asociar el vehículo con el cliente.
5. Explicar el registro de los daños y las observaciones.
6. Mostrar la parte más importante: las fotografías del vehículo.
7. Enseñar cómo guardar la recepción y finalizar el proceso.

4. Escena más importante: fotografías del vehículo

Esta parte requiere especial atención.

El cliente quiere que se muestre una persona real tomando las siete fotografías del automóvil en el orden solicitado por la aplicación.

La secuencia debe comunicar visualmente lo siguiente:

- Una persona toma las siete fotografías del vehículo.
- Se muestra cómo se van incorporando las fotografías a la aplicación.
- Se visualiza cómo se completa cada espacio.
- Se termina mostrando la cuadrícula final con las siete fotografías organizadas.

Esta escena debe quedar especialmente bien integrada con la grabación de pantalla. No debe parecer una simple presentación de imágenes.

5. Grabación y edición de pantalla

Se debe trabajar directamente con la cuenta demo de Tallerix.

Durante la grabación:

- Mostrar claramente cada acción.
- Mantener el cursor visible.
- Aplicar zoom en botones y campos importantes.
- Utilizar resaltados para orientar al usuario.
- Evitar movimientos bruscos.
- No mostrar información innecesaria.
- Mantener una buena legibilidad de los textos de la aplicación.

La edición debe seguir exactamente los pasos documentados por el cliente, respetando los nombres de los botones y las funcionalidades.

6. Narración y subtítulos

Para este primer video:

- Voz en off humana en español latino neutro.
- Tono profesional, natural y explicativo.
- Narración sincronizada con cada acción.
- Subtítulos en español correctamente sincronizados.
- Música de fondo discreta, sin competir con la voz.

No utilizar voz artificial en esta primera versión.

7. Identidad de marca

Incluir:

- Introducción breve con el logotipo de Tallerix.
- Colores y elementos gráficos de su identidad corporativa.
- Cierre breve con el logotipo.
- Mensaje obligatorio: «Prueba gratis 14 días en tallerix.app».

Mantener una identidad visual consistente durante todo el tutorial.

8. Cierre del proceso

Al finalizar la recepción, el cliente quiere que se muestre cómo, al guardar el registro, el propietario del vehículo recibe por WhatsApp:

- La hoja de recepción en PDF.
- Su enlace de seguimiento.

Es importante representar este resultado de manera clara y comprensible.

9. Entregables

Para esta primera prueba:

- Video final en español.
- Formato horizontal 16:9.
- Adaptación vertical 9:16.
- Archivo MP4.

full:
I’m growing a YouTube channel built entirely around faceless documentary storytelling and I need a seasoned editor who can give each episode a true cinematic touch. For every video I will supply a finished script and the full voice-over track; your role is to turn that raw material into an 8–12-minute mini-doc that feels worthy of a streaming platform.

Here’s the flow I have in mind: you sync the VO, curate or create fitting b-roll, archival clips, photos, maps, and subtle motion graphics, then layer everything with dramatic, royalty-free music and precise sound design. Smooth transitions, tasteful lower thirds, well-timed text callouts, colour grading, and polished audio mixing are essential. The end product should draw viewers in visually while allowing the narration to lead the story.

Typical schedule is one video to start and, if we click, two to three releases each week. Turnaround of about five days per episode with up to two revision passes keeps us on track.

Deliverables
• Final master in 4K and 1080p .mp4 
• Project file (Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve preferred) 
• Separate stems for VO, music, and SFX 
• Thumbnail concept if you enjoy that side of the craft 

If you have past work that shows a cinematic, dramatic style—especially on faceless projects—please send links and note the software you use. Looking forward to collaborating and bringing these documentaries to life.

full:
We’re producing a premium hardbound art book: a ~250-page satirical “corporate field manual” from a fictional sci-fi megacorporation, launching internationally on Kickstarter. It’s a very visual book, and every page has a graphic or illustration: technical diagrams, infographics, corporate forms, warning signs, schematics, maps and in-world propaganda.

The writing is final and many graphics are already drafted. We need a strong graphic designer to refine the existing visuals and create new ones so the book has one consistent, polished look. You’ll work side by side with the creator at a WeWork for a full 8-hour day, with direct feedback and quick decisions. If you love world-building, sci-fi aesthetics and detailed graphic work, this is a rare chance to help shape the look of a real published book.

What you’ll do

Refine and polish the existing graphics for around 200 pages, which are 50–70% done: cleaner linework, a consistent style, better colour and finer detail
Create new graphics and illustrations for around 50 pages from finished text and briefs
Design in-world visual elements such as technical diagrams, infographics, icons, schematics, corporate forms, warning labels, maps and propaganda-style posters
Build and maintain a reusable visual system in Figma (components, icon sets, colour and type styles) so every page looks like it comes from the same “corporation”
Make fast changes based on feedback during the day
Keep Figma files organised and well named so they’re ready for final page layout and print later

Skills you’ll use
Figma · Adobe Illustrator · Adobe Photoshop · Vector Illustration · Infographics & Data Visualisation · Iconography · Technical / Diagrammatic Illustration · Colour Theory · Typography · Visual Consistency

Who can apply

A portfolio with graphics and illustration work is a must: infographics, diagrams, icon sets, posters, game or UI art, or world-building pieces
Comfortable working in Adobe Illustrator and Figma (components, styles and auto layout are a plus)
Strong eye for detail, and able to keep one consistent style across a large volume of graphics
Interest in sci-fi, games, retro-futurism or dark satire is a big plus

I’m putting together a short intro video to present our new church, and I have two reference clips that capture the pace and look I enjoy. The finished piece should feel warm and welcoming from the very first frame—inviting viewers into our community rather than simply telling them about it.

To ground the story in our mission and vision, I’d like to weave together scenes of people worshipping and praying, families sharing everyday moments at church events, and hands-on outreach such as feeding homeless neighbors and helping anyone in need. The camera should move fluidly between those moments so we see a mix of church members, families, and people from the wider community all in one narrative flow.

I’ll supply the sample links, our logo, brand colors, and any wording you need. You’ll combine that material with stock or original footage (whichever works best) and craft a concise edit—music-bed, simple lower-thirds, and a tasteful end-screen with service times.

Deliverables
• 3–4 minutes finished video in 1080p (H.264) 
• Project file so we can update text in the future 
• One round of tweaks after the first draft

If you have experience shaping faith-based or nonprofit stories and can start soon, I’d love to see a brief reel or link to work in a similar style.

Position Summary

6sense is seeking an Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner to help transform how business functions leverage AI, automation, and enterprise technology to achieve their goals.

This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, AI solution design, automation engineering, and value realization. You will partner with teams across Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Legal, Finance, and Partner Operations to identify opportunities where AI and automation can simplify work, improve user experiences, reduce costs, and accelerate business outcomes.

Unlike a traditional Business Systems Analyst or Business Solution Partner, this role is expected to move beyond requirements gathering. You will evaluate business processes, build proof-of-concepts, create AI agents, develop low-code automations, and validate business value before solutions are scaled into production. Working closely with the Enterprise AI Engineering team, you will translate complex business challenges into technical requirements and implementation plans while independently delivering design prototypes and lightweight solutions using platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Workato, and other approved enterprise AI technologies.

A successful candidate combines strong business analysis skills with hands-on technical aptitude. They can engage stakeholders, map workflows, build basic automations, create AI-powered solutions, measure outcomes, and communicate recommendations to both business and technical audiences.

This is a growth role within a new Enterprise AI career track. You will work under the guidance of the Lead Enterprise AI Business Solutions Engineer and will be measured on business outcomes, including adoption, productivity gains, automation impact, cost avoidance, and process improvements. • Track renewal dates and flag every contract at least 120 days before the notice date so a build-vs-buy decision can be made in time.

• Run discovery interviews and working sessions with stakeholders to understand how work actually gets done, and surface the business problem behind the requested feature.

• Map current processes and estimate the time spent, the number of people involved and the frequency, so every opportunity has a baseline.

Build-vs-Buy Analysis & Business Cases

• Prepare the inputs for build-vs-buy analysis: what the tool does, how deeply it is integrated, compliance burden, usage compared with cost, and realistic replacement scope.

• Contribute to business cases that compare three-year build, run and support cost with vendor cost, working with the Lead and with Enterprise AI Engineers on the build side.

• Agree baselines with business owners before work starts and record their sign-off, so savings and hours returned can be validated later.

• Recommend which candidates to pursue first, using renewal timing, savings potential and build feasibility.

Prototyping & Applied AI

• Build prototypes and simple agents with Claude and Copilot to test whether a tool, or part of a workflow, can be replaced or improved.

• Write clear, build-ready context for Enterprise AI Engineers: the process, the data involved, example inputs and outputs, acceptance criteria and edge cases.

• Help define evaluation criteria, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and escalation paths before anything reaches production.

• Design the process around the AI: what changes for the seller, agent or analyst, what training is needed and how exceptions are handled.

• Bring AI fluency to stakeholders: help non-technical teams understand what these tools can and cannot reliably do, and set realistic expectations.

Stakeholder Partnership

• Serve as the named Business Solutions Partner for your assigned function, and the point of contact for intake, priorities and status.

• Translate business needs into clear, buildable stories and acceptance criteria, and translate technical trade-offs back into language stakeholders can act on.

• Keep stakeholders informed on what is changing, what is being built and what may move more slowly during the transition.

• Escalate misalignment, scope drift and risk early to the Lead before they become executive issues.

Hands-On Salesforce & Delivery

- Strong product-focused layouts.
- Large, high-quality lifestyle and product imagery.
- Clean typography and intuitive navigation.
- Well-structured product categories.
- A polished and seamless shopping experience.

- Ability to deliver a polished, production-ready storefront.
