full:
Hiring an Art Director for a mobile 2D isometric strategy game teaching Chola / Chozha dynasty history (c. 985-1070 CE) for ages 10-14. India-first launch, freemium, built on Defold.

**Before the full spike we need test samples we can drop into our Defold build.** Shortlisted candidates are paid a small fee to produce samples; the winning sample extends to a £1,500-£2,500 spike, and the spike extends to a 3-4 month full production contract (~500 sprites).

**Samples we need (approx. 1-2 days of work):**

1. One isometric building sprite — paddy field hut, tier 1, 256×192 px, PNG RGBA, transparent background, pivot bottom-centre.
2. One unit idle animation — spearman, 4 frames, 128×128 px each, PNG RGBA, pivot feet-centre.
3. One-paragraph style note explaining your technique choice (hand-drawn, 3D-rendered-to-2D, or hybrid) and one primary historical source you referenced (bronze, relief, or inscription).

**Visual direction (locked):** historically realistic, 2:1 isometric, period-accurate armour and buildings referenced from Chola bronzes and temple reliefs (Brihadisvara, Gangaikondacholisvarar). Not stylised, not chibi. Child-appropriate — no blood, no gore, no civilian battlefield characters, no sexualised armour, no caricature.

**Hard constraints:**
- Original work only. No reference from Clash of Clans / Lords Mobile / Rise of Kingdoms / Age of Empires Mobile.
- AI for moodboard only. **No AI-generated art ships.**
- Every delivered sprite must pass a historian review and a child-safety review.

One addition to the sample delivery. Because historical accuracy is a hard release gate on our side, we also need to see your working process alongside the final PNGs. **This applies equally to every shortlisted candidate.** Please include the following with the sample ZIP:

**1. Source file (your native format).**

Deliver the editable working file you used to produce the sprites. One of:

- **Blender:** `.blend` with the model, rig, lighting, and camera preserved. If you used a hybrid workflow with 2D touchup, include the touchup source too.
- **Photoshop:** `.psd` with **all layers preserved, unflattened**. Named layers preferred.
- **Procreate:** `.procreate` file (includes native time-lapse — good, keep it).
- **Krita / Clip Studio / Affinity Photo:** native format with layers preserved.

A flat 2-layer PSD at 2048×2048 downscaled is not a working file; it's an export. We need the real one.

**2. Short process recording.**

A **30-60 second screen recording** of any touchup pass on one frame — early sketch, cleanup, colour pass, shading — whichever moment best shows your workflow. Any of these is fine:

- Procreate time-lapse export (the built-in one is perfect — turn it on before you start)
- OBS / QuickTime / Loom screen capture while you work
- A short Instagram-reel-style over-the-shoulder phone recording of your iPad/tablet

Narration is welcome but not required. Upload unlisted to YouTube / Vimeo / Loom and send the link. Purpose: we want to see your decision-making process, not a polished presentation.

**3. 15-minute call with our historian.**

Once the sample ZIP arrives, we schedule a short **Google Meet or Zoom** with our historian reviewer. They'll ask you to walk through the primary source you cited — which specific bronze or temple relief, what you drew from it, what you changed and why. Comes with the territory because every shipped sprite will need historian sign-off; this is the first one. Please share **three 30-minute windows in your calendar over the next 7 working days** so we can match a slot.

**Why we ask:** our brief commits every shipped sprite to a named primary source (bronze, relief, inscription). Reviewing the working file, the process recording, and your source walkthrough together is how we verify the citation is real rather than retrofitted. It's standard for us; please flag now if any of the three is a problem on your end.

Everything else from the previous sample spec stands.

**In your bid, include:**
1. 2-3 portfolio links to shipped mobile 2D game art.
2. Your proposed technique and why.
3. Days to produce the sample set.
4. **One specific question you have about the direction after reading this post.** Bids without a specific question are not shortlisted.

Full art direction brief and technical pipeline doc shared with shortlisted candidates under NDA.

full:

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/2NbDRiTU8do3haEgHLjLGC/jobs-at-lokal-app

Role - Video Editor 
 Work Location - Work From Home 
About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising. 
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like: 

Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV) 
Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony) 
Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
 Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs) 
Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app) 
Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze) 
Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal) 
Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more 

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital 
About the role : 
We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join the marketing/product team of Lokal. The role involves crafting short-form and mid-length video content such as social media reels, promos, and branded content. The candidate will leverage storytelling, editing trends, and cultural nuances to produce videos that drive engagement and impact. 
Key Responsibilities:
 ● Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers. 
● Implement engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, and a strong narrative rhythm to maximize viewer retention.
 ● Tailor editing styles to suit platform-specific behaviors (e.g., fast cuts for Instagram, scroll-stopping openers for YouTube Shorts). 
● Enhance video quality through thoughtful color grading, text animations, transitions, and immersive sound design.
 ● Collaborate closely with writers, designers, and creative leads to bring scripts and visual concepts to life.
 ● Stay updated on current editing trends, meme formats, cultural references, and audio trends to keep content fresh and relatable. 
● Analyze ad performance metrics and apply learnings to improve edits for better click-through and completion rates. 
● Edit videos in the required languages, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and strong storytelling for the target audience. 

What You’ll Bring 
● 1–2 years of experience in video editing for social media or digital content.
 ● Proficiency in editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar. 
● Any Bachelor’s degree. 
● Strong portfolio of short-form content (reels, ads, promos). 
● Good understanding of social platform algorithms and engagement tactics.
 ● Strong storytelling instincts, visual creativity, and sound design skills.

title: Genesis 9 Cuff Trim Morph Calibration
desc: Title: 3D Costume Artist: Modular Uniform Cuff Trim & Morph Calibration (Fan Art Project) Pipeline: Blender + Daz Studio 4.24 (Genesis 9) Upfront Verification (Required to Be Considered) To be considered for this project, you must include a screenshot from inside Daz Studio 4.24 …
full:
Title: 3D Costume Artist: Modular Uniform Cuff Trim & Morph Calibration (Fan Art Project)

Pipeline: Blender + Daz Studio 4.24 (Genesis 9)

Upfront Verification (Required to Be Considered)
To be considered for this project, you must include a screenshot from inside Daz Studio 4.24 with your proposal showing work relevant to this milestone—specifically a Genesis 9 clothing/accessory asset in the viewport with the Parameters pane (showing custom fitting/adjustment morph sliders), Scene pane (showing rigged Wearable Presets/Smoothing Modifier), or Morph Loader Pro visible. Proposals without a Daz Studio screenshot will not be considered.

Project Overview
Five sleeve rank trim assets (01–05) are already modeled, UV-mapped, textured for Iray, and rigged for Genesis 9, currently shaped to a straight cylindrical sleeve. My live dForce uniform dress has a subtle forearm taper and a slight flare at the hemmed cuff, causing the existing trims to clip into the fabric.

The goal of this project is to conform the resting geometry of all 5 trims to the live dress mesh and add clean, non-destructive fitting morphs in Daz Studio 4.24 so they sit cleanly during posing and dForce simulation.

Files Provided
Source .blend file containing the 5 rank trim variations.

Existing 5 Genesis 9 .duf Wearable Presets (01–05) along with their data folder and 4K PBR/Iray texture maps.

Dress_Live_Fit_Ref.obj — Reference export of the live dForce uniform dress (DAZ Studio 1 unit = 1cm scale) showing the exact forearm taper and cuff flare.

Scope of Work & Technical Requirements
Conform Resting Geometry to Live Dress Mesh

Reshape/conform the resting cuffs of all 5 rank trim variations in Blender to follow the exact forearm taper and cuff flare of Dress_Live_Fit_Ref.obj.

Leave a clean, even resting clearance over the sleeve surface with zero clipping.

Important: Preserve the crisp woven bullion thread thickness and silhouette—do not use a blanket inflation/Push deformation that bloats the individual cords.

Add Fitting Morph Sliders (via Morph Loader Pro)

Export morph targets from Blender (maintaining exact vertex order) and import them into Daz Studio 4.24 via Morph Loader Pro for all 5 presets, saved cleanly as morph assets in the data folder:

Expand Cuff (Radial) (Required): Expands the trim rings radially outward from the forearm axis by up to ~3–5 mm to clear dForce folds or different character forearm shapes, without inflating thread thickness or sliding the trim down the arm.

Slide Forearm (Up / Down) (Required): Shifts the trim cleanly up or down along the forearm axis (approx. ±1–1.5 cm) to accommodate minor sleeve pull during posing.

Flare Cuff (Recommended): Subtly flares the wrist-side edge outward relative to the upper edge to accommodate wider cuff draping during dForce simulations.

Daz Studio 4.24 Rigging, Smoothing & File Hygiene

Keep all existing Genesis 9 rigging, auto-follow compatibility, UV maps, and Iray materials intact.

Add a Smoothing Modifier to each trim (defaulting to low Smoothing Iterations 1–2 and moderate Collision Iterations 3–5, so it can track minor dress surface changes without softening the fine woven detail).

Maintain a clean, portable Daz content directory structure (data/ + Wearable Presets) with relative texture paths and no absolute local file paths.

Final Deliverables & Verification
5 updated .duf Wearable Presets (01–05) verified in Daz Studio 4.24 + updated data folder (including the new morph .dsf files).

Updated source .blend file containing the conformed resting meshes and shape keys.

Verification screenshots from Daz Studio 4.24 showing:

Zero clipping against Dress_Live_Fit_Ref.obj in resting A-pose.

Clean deformation with the Genesis 9 elbow bent (~45°–90°).

The new Expand Cuff and Slide Forearm morph sliders visible in the Parameters pane and functioning cleanly.

desc: We are looking for an experienced freelancer to help us find and onboard small businesses onto **LokalNeeds**. Website: https://lokalneeds.in LokalNeeds helps businesses create their own direct ordering link without needing a separate website. Example: https://lokalneeds.in/your-…
full:
We are looking for an experienced freelancer to help us find and onboard small businesses onto **LokalNeeds**.

Website: https://lokalneeds.in

LokalNeeds helps businesses create their own direct ordering link without needing a separate website.

Example: https://lokalneeds.in/your-business-name

Businesses can manage products, receive customer orders, offer pickup or delivery, and manage deliveries using our platform.

**Our goal is to acquire real businesses that actively use LokalNeeds, not just increase social media followers or engagement.**

## Responsibilities

1. Find small businesses, restaurants, home kitchens, bakeries, and WhatsApp sellers through Instagram and Facebook.
2. Identify businesses that don't have their own online ordering websites.
3. Contact business owners through Instagram DMs, Facebook, WhatsApp, or phone.
4. Explain how LokalNeeds works and its benefits.
5. Encourage interested businesses to register for a free business link.
6. Assist businesses with onboarding, adding products, and setting up their ordering pages.
7. Follow up with businesses to encourage actual usage.
8. Maintain a Google Sheet tracking leads, conversations, registrations, and active shops.

## Initial Pilot

We want to start with a small pilot to evaluate results.

**Target:**
- Identify and contact 50–100 relevant businesses.
- Generate genuine interested leads.
- Onboard 5–10 real businesses.
- Help businesses activate their ordering links.

These are pilot targets, not guaranteed outcomes.

## Budget

₹3,000–₹5,000 for the initial pilot.

We are open to discussing performance-based incentives for successfully onboarded and activated businesses.

Long-term opportunities are available based on results.

## Preferred Skills

- Social Media Lead Generation
- Instagram & Facebook Outreach
- Business Development
- Sales and Marketing
- Merchant / Restaurant Onboarding
- WhatsApp Marketing
- Hindi or regional Indian language communication

## Important

We are NOT looking for someone who only creates social media posts, reels, or graphics.

We need someone who can directly approach business owners, generate qualified leads, and help them start using LokalNeeds.

## When Applying

Please answer:

1. Have you previously onboarded restaurants, shops, or small businesses onto a digital platform?
2. How would you find businesses that don't have an online ordering website?
3. Can you directly contact business owners and help them register?
4. How many businesses can you realistically onboard during a 7–14 day pilot?
5. What is your proposed pilot cost?

Please share examples of similar work if available.

full:
BID PRICE ONLY ACCEPTED - IF WE TALK AND YOU TELL ME YOUR BID WAS PRICED WRONG I WILL NOT WORK WITH YOU.
Hi! I’m looking for an AI video creator to produce one 3-minute-30-second YouTube episode for Cooking Marcy**, my cooking series hosted by a playful brick-style girl chef. I’ll provide the complete script and Marcy’s character reference.

Please match the reference closely and keep Marcy’s appearance consistent throughout. Build a kitchen, props, and plated dish in the same realistic LEGO-style brick aesthetic. Animate Marcy with natural gestures, blinking, facial expressions, and lip movements synced to an energetic, playful female AI voice.

Marcy introduces herself, reveals the finished dish, and walks viewers through the recipe using the supplied script. Keep Marcy and the plated dish at the center of the episode, and use close-ups and clear, numbered on-screen graphics to illustrate each step as she explains it. There’s no need to animate every cooking action. End with Marcy’s signature line, **“See you next whisk!”**

Deliverables

- One upload-ready 16:9 MP4 in 4K or the highest HD resolution you can deliver
- A final runtime of 3:25–3:35, aiming for 3:30

# Cooking Marcy and Grandma’s Secret Cookbook
### Blueberry & Nutella Toast · 3:30

Marcy sings to open the cookbook, then follows Grandma’s three recipe steps. Keep the finished toast beside her while she explains each step, with close-ups when she points out a detail.

### 0:00–0:40 · Grandma’s secret cookbook

*[Marcy pulls a cookbook from under a pile of tea towels. A little gold lock holds it shut.]*

**MARCY:** “Look what I found! Grandma’s secret cookbook. I used to watch her make breakfast, but I never knew where she kept her recipes. There’s a note tucked under the lock. Let’s see what it says. ‘Sing your favourite fruit three times, and the book will open.’ Well, that’s easy. My favourite fruit is blueberry. Ready?”

**MARCY, singing:** “Blueberry… blueberry… blueberry!”

*[She sings the last one a little higher. The lock clicks open.]*

**MARCY:** “It worked! Let’s see what Grandma picked for us today.”

### 0:40–1:10 · Today’s recipe

*[The page reads “Blueberry & Nutella Toast.” Marcy slides the finished toast into view.]*

**MARCY:** “Blueberry and Nutella toast! This looks just like the toast Grandma used to make me. See the golden edges, the chocolatey middle, and all those blueberries on top? To make one slice, you’ll need a slice of bread, a spoonful of Nutella, and a small handful of blueberries. Wash your blueberries and pat them dry so they’re ready to go.”

### 1:10–1:50 · Step 1 — Toast the bread

*[Show the first recipe card, then cut close to the golden edge of the finished toast.]*

**MARCY:** “First, ask a grown-up to toast your bread until it’s golden. Grandma always showed me how to check the colour. She’d say, ‘Look for the colour of a biscuit.’ See it right here, along the edge? That’s the bit that goes crunch. Let the toast cool for a moment before you spread anything on it. While we wait, can you make your best toast crunch?”

*[Pause for kids to join in.]*

**MARCY:** “Crunch! Okay, our toast is ready.”

### 1:50–2:30 · Step 2 — Spread the Nutella

*[A simple overhead graphic shows a spoonful of Nutella in the middle of a slice of toast.]*

**MARCY:** “Put a spoonful of Nutella in the middle. Use the back of your spoon to spread it out towards the edges. Grandma showed me how to do it in circles. Start with a little circle in the middle, then make it bigger as you go. Try drawing one in the air with me. Little circle… bigger circle… all the way around. I leave a tiny border of toast showing. That way, I’ve got a little spot to hold when I pick it up.”

### 2:30–3:10 · Step 3 — Add the blueberries

*[Cut back to the finished toast. The camera moves closer so kids can see where Marcy placed the berries.]*

**MARCY:** “Now for my favourite part. Place your blueberries right on top of the Nutella. I like to put a few down the middle first, then fill in the spaces on each side. Can you spot a place where one more blueberry would fit?”

*[Pause. Marcy points to an open spot near the corner and adds one berry.]*

**MARCY:** “There! Press each berry in just a little so it stays put when you pick up your toast. You can make a row like mine or put blueberries all over. And that’s Grandma’s blueberry and Nutella toast, ready to eat!”

### 3:10–3:30 · The first bite

*[Marcy takes a bite. Leave a beat for the crunch.]*

**MARCY:** “Mmm. Crunchy toast, chocolatey Nutella, and a juicy blueberry in the same bite. I’m saving this page so we can make it again. Bye, little chefs. **See you next whisk!**”

Marcy tucks a ribbon into the recipe page and waves. Hold on Marcy and the toast through 3:30.

full:
About Norm
Norm builds AI-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale.
Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services.
Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management.
Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters.

AI Fluency:
Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

This Role
We are hiring a hands-on Tech Lead for Norm Compliance, the team that owns Norm's compliance platform for asset managers: the product behind marketing and content review at some of the largest financial institutions in the US. You are an IC-style engineer who can also set an engineering roadmap and lead a team; you will lead up to seven engineers, own every technical decision inside the platform, and ship code yourself at least half of the week.
The platform has been shipping for years. You will ramp with the engineers who know it best, then set its direction.

How You'll Work
The team is fully remote in the US and reports to the General Manager of Norm Compliance. You set the platform's technical direction, from architecture and standards to a roadmap you shape with the product manager and the General Manager. The team owns the platform end to end, including the infrastructure it runs on. Day to day you work with a product manager who owns the backlog and our commitments to clients, and with a client engagement/deployment strategy team that owns the relationships: you decide how the work gets done and how long it takes, they decide what we take on and when, and nothing reaches a client without both. The team runs its own on-call.
You Will
• Own architecture, technical standards and code review for the platform, and contribute production code every week.

• Set the engineering roadmap for the platform with the product manager and the General Manager.

• Hire, onboard and grow a team of Staff and Senior engineers.

• Run on-call escalation.

• Answer clients' technical questions, in writing or through meetings, along the client engagement/deployment strategy team.

• Learn the platform with the engineers who run it today, ship with their review, then own it.

Skills & Experience - Core
• Bachelor's or Master's in computer science or an equivalent field, or equivalent practical experience

• 8+ years building production software, including 3+ years leading a team of four to eight engineers while still shipping code

• Python and TypeScript in production; Postgres or similar; AWS

• Experience taking over a large codebase built by others and running it

• Experience setting and delivering a technical roadmap for a product with enterprise clients

• Experience on client calls, answering hard technical questions without over-promising

• Clear, brief writing

Skills & Experience - Pluses
• Clients in financial services or another regulated industry

• Experience with LLM-backed products, Terraform, or a workflow engine such as Temporal

• Experience splitting a release pipeline or a shared repository, or hiring a team from zero

What Success Looks Like - 90 Days
• You know the platform's architecture and its largest clients, and have shipped with code review from the team

• You own the platform's technical decisions and run on-call escalation

• The team has run an incident end to end, and you, the team and the product manager have a written way of working

Comp and Benefits
$220,000 - $290,000 a year plus equity.

The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills (as uncovered during the interview process), experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed here reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity or benefits. We offer a competitive salary along with equity compensation. Our comprehensive benefits package includes a 401(k) plan with an employer match. Employees enjoy top-tier insurance coverage, encompassing health, dental, hospital, accident, and vision plans. You'll thrive in our fast-paced learning environment where professional growth is constant.

This role is fully remote within the United States, with core hours on US Eastern time. You will start in our New York office at One World Trade Center. Norm employment, US residency and work performed from the US are conditions of the role; because our clients are financial institutions, offers are conditional on a background check, including E-Verify. Visa sponsorship or transfer is not available for this position.

If you're interested in the role but aren't sure whether you're a good fit, we'd still like to hear from you.
To learn more about Norm, visit our website.

But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

title: Isometric 2D Vineyard Tile Set
desc: Project: "Der Weingärtner" (working title) – a vineyard management sim (WISIM) for PC/Steam, built in Godot 4 by a solo developer. Setting: A fictional wine village on the Neckar river in southern Germany, starting in 1985. The player runs a small family vineyard: pruning, tying,…
full:
Project: "Der Weingärtner" (working title) – a vineyard management sim (WISIM) for PC/Steam, built in Godot 4 by a solo developer.

Setting: A fictional wine village on the Neckar river in southern Germany, starting in 1985. The player runs a small family vineyard: pruning, tying, spraying, harvesting, selling grapes to the cooperative. The map shows the village, the farm, and the vineyard plots as isometric tiles. The look should be clean, colorful, and slightly retro – friendly and readable, not photorealistic.

WHAT I NEED (INITIAL PAID SET)
Vineyard ground tiles in three terrain types, each in four seasons:
1. Flat vineyard (rows on level ground)
2. Slope vineyard (rows running down a hillside)
3. Steep terrace vineyard (narrow terraces held by dry-stone walls, with small stone stairs between them – typical for the Neckar valley)

Seasons for each terrain type:
- Winter: bare, pruned vines, brown wood, canes bent onto the wire, bare or frosted ground
- Spring: first light-green shoots, buds breaking, some grass between rows
- Summer: full green canopy, small green grape clusters
- Autumn: yellow/orange leaves, ripe dark-blue grape clusters

= 12 tiles in total. If the price is too high, start with the slope vineyard in all four seasons (4 tiles) as a test.

PERIOD DETAILS (IMPORTANT)
The game is set in 1985 in a German wine region, so please avoid the modern / American vineyard look:
- Wooden posts (weathered, grey-brown) with wire trellis – no white metal or concrete posts
- No fences around the plots; borders are a narrow dirt/grass path, a low stone wall or simply the next plot
- Rows close together (narrow-track tractors fit between them)
- Grass strips between the rows are fine but no modern drip irrigation

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
- Isometric projection 2:1 (e.g., 128×64 px base diamond; vines and posts may extend above, so canvas e.g., 128×128). Open to your suggestion for the best size – please tell me what you'd recommend.
- Tiles must connect seamlessly to neighboring tiles of the same type (rows continue across tile borders).
- Rows always run in the same direction on all tiles.
- Consistent light direction (top-left) and a consistent limited palette across all seasons so they can be swapped without the map "jumping."
- Must stay readable when zoomed out: The player should recognize the season and terrain type at a glance.
- Transparent PNG exports + layered source files (PSD, Krita or Aseprite).
- Please keep posts/wires, vines, grapes and ground on separate layers. Later I want to show states such as "posts broken," "harvested" or "overgrown" by changing single layers.

LICENSE
- Full commercial rights for use in the game trailers store page and marketing.
- Exclusive: The tiles must not be resold as stock assets.
- Credit in-game credits is of course offered.
- Hand-made art only please (no AI-generated images) – required for Steam store disclosure.

POSSIBLE FOLLOW-UP WORK
If the test goes well there will be more work over months:
1. Additional vineyard states like harvested damaged posts frost damage overgrown neglected newly planted.
2. Farm and village buildings like farmhouse barn wine cellar town hall cooperative church etc.
3. Small characters vehicles like grape pickers narrow vineyard tractor trailer etc.
4. Character portraits for family members event messages UI icons tools diesel wire posts grapes money etc.

**Title: Social Media Templates, Loyalty Card & Promotional Materials for SecondShift**

### About the Business
SecondShift is a student-focused second-hand marketplace based in Athlone, Ireland. The business allows students and locals to buy, sell and reuse second-hand items such as clothing, textbooks, electronics, furniture and other everyday essentials.

Our tagline is **“Buy. Sell. Reuse.”**

We are looking for a creative freelancer to help establish a consistent, modern brand identity across our social media platforms and physical promotional materials.

### Project Requirements

We require a design package consisting of:

- **12 social media templates** for Instagram posts, Instagram Stories and TikTok covers.
- **1 loyalty card design**, front and back, incorporating our rewards system.
- **1 A3 promotional poster** for advertising SecondShift around college and locally.
- All designs must be consistent with our existing brand identity and suitable for a student audience.

### Design Style
We want a clean, modern, recognisable and professional design that appeals primarily to college students and young adults.

Our brand colours are:
- Green: `#70992e`
- Black: `#111111`
- White: `#FFFFFF`

The designs should feel fresh, eye-catching and easy to recognise when scrolling through social media. They should not look overly corporate or cluttered.

### Social Media Templates
The 12 templates should be editable and suitable for different types of content, including:

- Promoting products for sale.
- Advertising new listings.
- Buy and sell promotions.
- Student discounts and loyalty rewards.
- Second-hand shopping and sustainability.
- Freshers' week promotions.
- Move-out and end-of-year clear-out campaigns.
- General brand awareness and promotional posts.

The templates should be reusable, allowing us to easily change photos, text, prices and product information without needing a designer every time.

### Loyalty Card
Design a physical loyalty card that reflects the SecondShift brand and rewards customers for using the marketplace. Include details about earning points through both buying and selling items on the platform. Highlight how these points can be redeemed for discounts or other rewards to encourage engagement with the system.

The card should be attractive, easy to understand and practical to print. It should reflect our loyalty scheme clearly while maintaining consistency with our branding guidelines.

### Promotional Poster
Design an A3 poster suitable for display around TUS Athlone, student accommodation and other local locations. 
The poster should clearly communicate:
- What SecondShift is.
- What customers can buy and sell.
- Our tagline: Buy. Sell. Reuse.
- Why students should use the platform.
- A clear call to action encouraging people to join.
Include any style references or examples of similar posters you admire that align with your vision for this project.

full:
Project Brief: Bilingual Editorial Website & Online Shop

**Overview**
I am looking to bring my floral and creative studio online with a bilingual (**English / Spanish**) website that feels like an art-directed digital publication rather than a standard agency template. The experience should be pared-back, photography-driven, and luxuriously spacious—defined by generous negative space, expressive typographic hierarchies, and fluid transitions that let our botanical work breathe.

**Visual & Aesthetic Reference**
For layout pacing, typography, and minimalist restraint, see: `[https://tulipstudio.hr/en](https://tulipstudio.hr/en)`

**Core Objective**
To present our studio, bespoke floral services, and curated shop with quiet confidence and clarity. Visitors should seamlessly switch between English and Spanish and move effortlessly from our brand story into our services, online shop, press features, and inquiry flow.

**Site Architecture & Navigation**

* **Global Header:** Minimalist navigation bar featuring our logo, an **EN / ES language switcher**, and the exact 5 main menu items:
1. **Shop** *(Tienda)* – Streamlined e-commerce storefront to purchase physical floral goods/objects directly (with cart, checkout, and shipping), plus a short inquiry form for bespoke/custom orders.
2. **Services** *(Servicios)* – Editorial presentation of our signature offerings (e.g., *The Flower Bar – Interactive Floral Experiences for Celebrations*), structured with refined copy, process notes, high-res photography, and a direct booking/inquiry trigger.
3. **Contact** *(Contacto)* – Streamlined inquiry form for events and custom requests, alongside direct contact details, location, and social links.
4. **Studio** *(Estudio)* – Our brand narrative, creative philosophy, and behind-the-scenes/team imagery.
5. **Publicity** *(Publicidad)* – Clean editorial archive of press clippings, interviews, and media features.

*(Note: The **Home** page should act as an editorial entry point introducing the brand statement, full-bleed hero imagery, and curated previews leading into Services, Shop, and Studio.)*

**Design & Interaction Requirements**

Please share **1–2 live links** that demonstrate your ability to balance strict minimalism with fluid, tactile motion, along with your **recommended tech stack** (specifically addressing bilingual + e-commerce handling), **estimated timeline**, and **ballpark investment**. title: Automated Tile-to-Stair Visualization Pipeline
desc: AI pipeline: apply a tile from a raw photo onto existing stair images using masks (no 3D rendering) We make stairs clad with porcelain/ceramic tiles. We have about 42 stair images (different designs and angles). We do NOT want to render the tile in Blender. We need an AI pipeline…
full:
AI pipeline: apply a tile from a raw photo onto existing stair images using masks (no 3D rendering)
We make stairs clad with porcelain/ceramic tiles. We have about 42 stair images (different designs and angles). We do NOT want to render the tile in Blender. We need an AI pipeline that puts the tile onto our existing stair images, using masks.
Input:
A raw, real-life tile photo. It is not cropped or scanned: shot at an angle, uneven light, reflections, background, low resolution.
Base stair images (~42), plus masks for each surface: treads, risers and nosings/edges. If needed, we can also export extra passes from Blender: UV, depth, normal, object/material ID.
What the AI must do:
Extract the tile from the photo: find it, fix the perspective, crop it, and remove glare, shadows and noise.
Recreate the tile in high quality while keeping it identical to the original: same pattern, veining, structure and colour distribution. No reinterpretation.
Apply the tile inside the masks with correct perspective, real-world scale (e.g. 60×120 cm), realistic tile layout and grout lines, and correct cuts on treads, risers and nosings.
Keep the stair geometry, edges, lighting, shadows and reflections of the base image. The result must look like a real photo of the stairs.
Process all ~42 images automatically for each new tile.
Key requirement:
The tile face must be exactly the same across all ~42 images. It's the same tile, not 42 variations. The pattern must not change or drift between images. Colour can be fine-tuned on our side; the tile face is the priority.
Deliverables:
A working tool I can run myself: ComfyUI workflow or Python script, local or API-based. Input = tile photo; output = 42 finished images.
Documentation and a handover session.
Acceptance test on 5 of our real tile photos.
Ideal candidate:
Strong ComfyUI / Stable Diffusion / Flux experience: ControlNet, IP-Adapter, inpainting, relighting, upscaling
Texture projection/warping onto masked surfaces using UV or depth
Portfolio showing AI that preserves product details (product placement, material swaps, interior visualization)
In your proposal, please include:
Your approach: how will you keep the tile pattern identical across all images and avoid AI hallucination?
Relevant examples (material swap / product-preserving work)
Timeline, budget and hardware requirements

title: Blender Character — Near-Infrared (NIR) Skin, Eyes & Modular Accessories for Synthetic Face Dataset -- 2
desc: OVERVIEW We are building a synthetic human face dataset in Blender using the open-source Google GNM parametric head extension: https://www.reddit.com/r/blender/comments/1uzaxc3/google_gnm_open_source_parametric_head_released/ Please note: We will not be sending pre-made .blend fi…
full:
OVERVIEW
We are building a synthetic human face dataset in Blender using the open-source Google GNM parametric head extension:
https://www.reddit.com/r/blender/comments/1uzaxc3/google_gnm_open_source_parametric_head_released/

Please note: We will not be sending pre-made .blend files upfront. You can download and install the free Google GNM Blender extension directly and build all materials, eye shaders, hair, and accessories around the standard GNM head setup. Everything you deliver must plug cleanly and easily into our existing Google GNM Blender workflow.

Our goal is to use an automated Python rendering pipeline to randomize face shapes, skin profiles, hairstyles, facial hair, glasses, and headwear—generating diverse synthetic human portraits (similar in variety and framing to Microsoft’s FaceSynthetics dataset: https://github.com/microsoft/FaceSynthetics/blob/main/docs/img/dataset_samples.jpg), rendered to match real Near-Infrared (NIR) camera imagery.

Target IR Output & Eyeball References:
- Sample IR Face Output: https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11263-021-01432-4
- High-Resolution NIR Eye & Iris Reference: https://www.researchgate.net/figure/High-resolution-NIR-face-images-and-corresponding-face-and-iris-images-a-High_fig1_221383633

(These links—along with additional sample IR images we will share with you—serve as our visual target. We will iterate together on your initial sample renders to fine-tune the look so it closely matches our actual camera output.)

We are looking for an experienced Blender look-dev / character artist to deliver:
1. An IR-accurate skin, eye, and mouth material library tailored to the Google GNM head.
2. A modular library of hair and accessories that fit cleanly across Google GNM head variations.
3. A calibrated lighting/render setup inside Blender that reproduces real NIR image characteristics.

------------------------------------------------------------

1. IR-ACCURATE SKIN, EYE & MOUTH MATERIAL LIBRARY
- IR Skin Tones & Ages: Distinct skin profiles covering very fair to very deep tones (referencing the Monk Skin Tone Scale) plus age variations (smoother skin for younger faces, fine lines/pores/sunspots for older faces), calibrated specifically for how melanin, subsurface scattering, and skin reflectance behave in monochrome Near-Infrared imagery.
- Close-Up Detail & Visible Skin Marks: High-resolution (2K minimum) PBR textures that hold up in tight portrait close-ups—ensuring pores, fine lines, and natural skin marks (moles, freckles, blemishes, scars, and light stubble shadow) remain clearly and accurately visible under IR illumination, with zero seams or stretching on the GNM head mesh.
- Script-Friendly Master Shader: A single master skin shader with clearly exposed, easy-to-script controls for skin tone/IR reflectance, roughness/shine, subsurface scattering, freckle/mole/blemish intensity, and stubble shadow, alongside pre-configured presets for all profiles.
- IR Eyeball & Iris Physics (Priority):
 * Eyeballs must accurately replicate real Near-Infrared optical behavior (matching the NIR eye reference link above):
 - Deep black pupil with a sharp white glint/dot (corneal specular reflection) when looking toward the camera.
 - Clearly defined grey iris with realistic iris pattern/texture and natural IR reflectance across different iris shades.
 - Bright white sclera with realistic wetness and a subtle tear line.
 * Natural IR-tuned materials for lips, eyebrows, eyelashes, and interior mouth parts (teeth, gums, tongue) on the GNM mesh.

------------------------------------------------------------

2. MODULAR ACCESSORY LIBRARY (COMPATIBLE WITH GOOGLE GNM HEADS)
We need a comprehensive library of modular, mix-and-match assets built at real-world scale with clean topology and PBR materials, designed to maximize visual variety and generate a wide range of unique synthetic combinations:
- Head Hair & Eyebrows: A wide variety of hairstyles (short, medium, long, straight, wavy, curly, coily, tied back, shaved/buzz, etc.) plus diverse eyebrow shapes and densities in multiple natural shades (including grey and white).
- Facial Hair: A broad selection of styles (light and heavy stubble, short beards, full beards, moustaches, goatees, sideburns, etc.) across multiple shades.
- Eyewear: A diverse collection of prescription glasses (thin metal, thick acetate, rimless, half-rim) with clear refractive lenses, alongside sunglasses (aviator, square, round, wrap-around, oversized) with tinted, gradient, and mirrored lenses that behave realistically in IR.
- Headwear & Face Coverings: A wide assortment of headwear options (caps, beanies, wide-brim hats, headscarves, turbans, hoods, etc.) plus various surgical and cloth face masks.

GNM Compatibility & Automation Requirements:
- Parametric Fit: Because Google GNM generates varying face shapes, head sizes, and expressions, accessories must adapt/fit cleanly to generated GNM heads with zero clipping or floating gaps (e.g., bound via surface/mesh deformers or rig/shape-key compatible setups so they follow head shape changes automatically).
- Clean Layering: Accessories must combine together (for example, wearing glasses, a cap, and a beard simultaneously) without intersecting each other.
- Automation-Ready Structure: Because we will randomize combinations via a Python script, all objects, collections, materials, and shader parameters must follow a strict, consistent naming convention and clean hierarchy.

------------------------------------------------------------

TECHNICAL & LICENSING REQUIREMENTS
- Built and tested in Blender (Cycles) using native Blender tools and the free Google GNM extension—no paid add-ons required to open or render.
- Textures saved with relative paths or packed cleanly into the .blend files.
- Usage Rights: All work must be original or properly licensed so we have unrestricted rights to use the 3D assets internally to generate and use synthetic 2D image datasets commercially.

Junior Account Executive Benelux (Dutch-speaking)Location: Remote (Within +/- 2 hours of CET)
Contract type: Full-time
Salary: Starting from €40,000 OTE per annum gross (60% base / 40% bonus), subject to location, skills and experience.

Not Your Typical Workplace…Great talent doesn't stop at borders, and neither do the companies we work with.
At WorkMotion, we're building the future of work: helping ambitious companies hire, onboard and manage the best people anywhere in the world, through smart, flexible workforce solutions.
Remote-first, fast-paced, people-driven and globally connected, we empower businesses to build teams beyond borders. And we're looking for people who want to win while doing it.

More Than a RoleThe Benelux market is full of ambitious companies trapped by hiring borders.
An Amsterdam scale-up has found the perfect engineer in Lisbon but doesn't know how to employ her compliantly. An Antwerp founder wants to put fresh funding into expanding to three countries by next quarter.
As our Junior Account Executive Benelux, your mission is powerful: Open up the world's talent pool to Dutch, Belgian and Luxembourgish companies.
This is a Junior AE role, built for a top-performer who's ready to close their own deals, not by pushing a product, but by advising with substance and closing with confidence.
You're confident in front of decision-makers, curious enough to ask the questions others don't, and ambitious about your numbers: hitting target is the minimum, outperforming it is what drives you.
Your energy shows in your can-do attitude and follow-through, day in, day out.

Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity:• Command Your Territory: Own the full sales cycle in the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg, from first conversation to onboarded talent.
• Curious Questioner: Ask the second and third question. Uncover where, why and how fast a company is hiring, and what's at stake if compliance goes wrong.
• Champion Builder: Equip your HR champion with the arguments Finance, Legal and leadership care about, so decision-makers see the value, not just the price.
• Deal Momentum: Create urgency, negotiate with confidence and keep deals moving.
• Self-Made Pipeline: Roll your sleeves up and team up with the BDRs to go after the biggest opportunities in your territory.

What It Takes to Make an Impact Here:• Your Background: BDR/SDR experience in B2B SaaS, or another target-driven, customer-facing role. You're self-driven, learn fast and know your numbers.
• Discovery Experience: You've led conversations to uncover a prospect's or client's needs, and you're eager to take them all the way to a signed deal.
• Outbound DNA: A cold call is a chance, not a threat. You know how to get a busy founder's attention, from a well-timed call after a funding round to a voice note they actually listen to.
• AI-Savvy & Organized: AI is a natural part of how you work, making you faster and sharper every day. And your HubSpot (or similar CRM) is always up to date.
• Coachable: You ask for feedback and put it into action the same day.
• Dutch Native: Native-level Dutch and business-fluent English.
Bonus Points If You Bring• Experience with HR tech, payroll, EOR or other compliance-heavy solutions.
• First closing experience, for example running your own demos or closing smaller deals.
• Creativity in getting your foot in the door: find a smart way to reach the hiring managers directly, and show them why you're the right person for this role.

Not Your Typical Team:We're a team of 26 sales minds, from BDRs, AEs and Team Leads to our CRM, Sales Enablement and Campaign Manager, based across Europe, Africa and the Middle East, a motivated, fully distributed crew that proves "remote" doesn't mean "disconnected."
We don't just work together, we push, challenge and grow together.
We share what works, celebrate each other's successes, learn from every win and loss, and jump in when a colleague needs a second voice to get a deal over the line.
If you're looking for an environment where your ideas are welcomed, your voice is heard, and bold strategies thrive on collective brainpower and high-energy teamwork, you'll feel right at home.

The Perks of Being Here…• Global, remote, and thriving: We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours.
• Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day, a full day off just to recharge and relax.
• Get fit and stay active: Whether it's yoga, weightlifting, or a quick jog, work out on your terms, at a discount with our subsidised gym memberships.
• Learn, grow, and develop: We believe in constant growth. With our Training & Development Allowance, you'll have all the opportunities you need to keep expanding your skills and knowledge.
• Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups!
• Diversity is our superpower: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations. 
At WorkMotion, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, just let our Recruitment Team know at Jobs@WorkMotion.com. We're here to support you every step of the way!

full:
Headquarters: Yerevan, Remote, Armenia

URL: http://capslock.global

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

﻿Role overview 

Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly.
You’ll be working with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow.
If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process.

Responsibilities

Task & Pipeline Management
• Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system).
• Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member
• Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch
• Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage

Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up
• Communicate daily with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers
• Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline
• Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them
• Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed

Quality Control
• Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications
• Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live
• Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context
• Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals

Reporting & Documentation
• Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned
• Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools
• Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards

Process Improvement & AI
• Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow
• Help scale the pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy
• Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes

Creative Collaboration
• Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas
• Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks
• Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time
 Must-Have Skills
• Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking
• Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks
• Confidence in following up with many people across teams while keeping things friendly
• Sharp eye for detail when reviewing images, videos and ad copy
• Genuine interest in creative marketing and ad content

Technical Skills
• 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination or process management
• Hands-on experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, monday.com, Asana or Trello
• Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to streamline work
• Experience in a marketing agency, creative production or e-commerce environment is a plus
• Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher

Soft Skills
• Thrives on structure and turning chaos into reliable systems
• Proactive, reliable and consistent with deadlines
• Clear, professional communicator
• Adaptable to shifting priorities in a fast-paced team
• Curious, with the initiative to improve processes and contribute ideas

What we offer

• Remote Work - We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
• Paid vacations - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge
• Unlimited Sick Days - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
• Ongoing Learning - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
• Home Office - We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
• Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
• Fun Stuff - There is never a shortage of fun stuff

full:
Headquarters: New York, New York, United States

URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/

About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling
SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale.
About the role
We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch.
This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend.
What you will do
• Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research.

• Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency.

• Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad.

• Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad.

• Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named.

• Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round.

• Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows.

What we are looking for
• Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them.

• A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations.

• Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses.

• AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how.

• Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads.

• Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed.

• Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here.

Pay and structure
• Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience.

• Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads.

• Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales.

Our hiring process (exactly how it works)
• Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow).

• Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete.

• Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario.

• Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more.

• Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30.

We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

full:
Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered.

Job Overview
Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.

About us
Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.
We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.
We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.

What you'll do
• Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
• Write video scripts and outlines.
• Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
• Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.

What we're looking for
• Native-level written and spoken English
• Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
• Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
• Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
• AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
• High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
• Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
• Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
• Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
• A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
• Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
• Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada

Nice to have
• Previous experience creating educational video content
• Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about

Working at Metics Media

full:
Headquarters: Flower Mound, TX, USA

Own Your Catalog Like a Business, and Win on Amazon.

Hadley Designs is seeking an Amazon Brand Manager to take full ownership of a multi-million dollar group of our products on Amazon, as the product manager, the merchandiser, and the CEO of that catalog. This is a high-impact role for an e-commerce brand builder who brings real judgment, reads a market quickly, and knows how to grow net profit, not just sales.

You will report to the leader of our Amazon channel and work as part of a small, high-performing Amazon team. While this role operates deeply within Amazon, we welcome candidates who have built brands across e-commerce, DTC, or marketplace environments and are excited to bring that experience to a scaled Amazon catalog.

How You'll Win at Hadley Designs

You bring the judgment. We bring the brand, the catalog, and the team.

• Learn our brand. Get to know our brand, our expectations, your catalog group, and the standards and SOPs our team runs on.

• Run your catalog as its CEO. Make the calls on pricing, listings, imagery, promotions, and inventory, and own the net profit that results.

• Challenge the status quo. Bring better ideas, back them with a clear point of view, and help us raise the bar.

We are looking for thinkers who are coachable and confident, not people waiting for a playbook.

What You'll Own

• End-to-end ownership of your catalog group's performance, including revenue, net profit, pricing, advertising, and inventory

• Reading the competitive landscape, from merchandising and listings to imagery and pricing, and responding with strategy rather than reacting to every price drop

• Finding inspiration outside Amazon, on Etsy, TikTok, Pinterest, and in wider trends, and turning it into product and format ideas

• Product and format relaunches that lift your catalog

• How your products look and compete on the page, from main images to packaging and format

• Elevating our brand experience on Amazon so your catalog protects its margin and earns a higher price

• Advertising, listings, experiments, and inventory planning with our supply chain team, used as levers toward profit

• AI workflows that handle the routine work, so your time goes to the decisions that grow the catalog

• Clear weekly reporting on results, risks, and next moves

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will:

• Learn our brand, expectations, catalog group, and SOPs, and share a clear read of your competitive landscape

• Own your catalog's weekly numbers and make the first judgment calls that protect margin and lift results

• Bring forward product and format ideas, including ones inspired from outside Amazon, with at least one relaunch in motion

• Challenge at least one way we do things with a better one, and be measured on the net profit you deliver

Requirements

Who You Are

• 3+ years of experience owning a product line or catalog on Amazon, in e-commerce, or in marketplaces, end to end as a business

• A strong visual eye, and you see what wins on the page, not only in the data

• You read competitors and markets and can explain your reasoning, not just the answer

• You find ideas outside Amazon and know how to turn a trend into a product or format

• You know the tactics that grow net profit and you have protected margin and price

• Deep, hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and Amazon advertising

• AI capability, a CRM and documented SOPs. You use AI every day to get more done with less, which is a must-have here and a capability rather than any one tool, and you are excited to build how we use all three now and going forward

• Very organized and buttoned up, and you follow through until the job is done

• Clear, confident spoken and written English

• Coachable and quick to learn our way, and confident enough to challenge it

This is an ownership role for an experienced brand builder, not a virtual assistant position.

Benefits

Why You'll Thrive Here

• Own a multi-million dollar Amazon catalog with a team that's got the tools and trust to help you scale

• Join a high-growth crew that lives for innovation, data, and collective wins

• Remote full-time work with a flexible schedule

• Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO

• Personal development and autonomy over your time

• An established company, 10+ years strong, ready to soar higher with you onboard

full:
Headquarters: 

URL: http://www.thrivemarket.com

ABOUT THRIVE MARKET 

Thrive Market was founded in 2014 with a mission to make healthy and sustainable living easy and affordable for everyone. As an online, membership-based market, we deliver the highest quality healthy, and sustainable products at member-only prices, while matching every paid membership with a free one for someone in need. Every day, we leverage innovative technology and member-first thinking to help our over 1,700,000+ members find better products, support better brands, and build a better world in the process. We are also a Certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation, and a Climate Neutral Certified company.

Join us as we bring healthy and sustainable living to millions of Americans in the years to come.

THE ROLE

A contractor (30-40 hrs per week) who helps keep the paid social performance creative engine running: first-round ad review, QA and delivery, performance data, builds and decks, and ad hoc support for our creative strategist.

RESPONSIBILITIES

1. First-round creative review

• Review ads against the brief: does the concept, message, and offer answer what was asked?

• Assess engagement potential (hook, first 3 seconds, clarity of CTA, platform-native feel)

• Give team concise first-round feedback and flag what needs a closer look before it goes further

2. Creative QA & delivery

• Check aspect ratios (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, etc.) and file specs (format, size, video length, safe zones, captions)

• Check ad naming against convention

• Confirm all assets are in (nothing missing) and the correct, approved version is used

• Deliver to channel managers with a standard handoff note (batch contents, launch date, links)

3. Coordination & Workload Balance

•  Keep track of what is due, what is ready, and what is at risk in Wrike and build out a 8-12 week rolling calendar

•  Balance competing projects and flag blockers or slipping deadlines early

•  Proactively contact the right people when a new project starts (designers, editors, copywriters, channel managers, brand/legal)

•  Move work along on Sabrina's behalf (follow-ups, nudges), with signoff as described below

4. Ad hoc support

•  Slot in last-minute asks and triage them by urgency, telling Sabrina what gets bumped

•  Own small edit and resize requests end to end without Sabrina stepping in: no editing skills required, but coordinate with the project manager to find bandwidth on the editing team, brief the editor, and track the request through delivery

5. Performance data & reporting

•  Pull performance data (Motion, Meta Ads Manager) and build recurring reports (top and bottom performers, spend by concept)

•  Tag and categorize creatives (hook, format, angle, offer)

•  Keep a testing learnings log

•  Surface early takeaways to inform briefs and next rounds

6. Decks & strategy support

•  Help build decks: test readouts, performance recaps, creative reviews

•  Research competitor and inspiration ads

•  Draft first-pass briefs or test summaries for Sabrina to review

QUALIFICATIONS

Core competencies

• Proactive mindset; balances strategic objectives with day-to-day tactical execution  

• Maintains timelines and prioritizes tasks for smooth workflows and timely delivery of creative assets  

• Comfortable wearing multiple hats and shifting between review, data, and coordination work

Must-have

• Background in performance creative (paid social preferred), with a trained eye for what makes ads engaging and on-brief

• Strong attention to detail (specs, naming, completeness)

• Clear written communication, able to give concise, constructive feedback

• Organized and self-directed; comfortable with fast-changing priorities

• Basic data pulling and deck-building skills

BELONG TO A BETTER COMPANY

We're a community of more than 1 Million + members who are united by a singular belief: It should be easy to find better products, support better brands, make better choices, and build a better world in the process.

At Thrive Market, we believe in building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic culture. If you are excited about this role along with our mission and values, we encourage you to apply.

Thrive Market is an EEO/Veterans/Disabled/LGBTQ employer

At Thrive Market, our goal is to be a diverse and inclusive workplace that is representative, at all job levels, of the members we serve and the communities we operate in. Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Overview

We are looking for a driven and passionate Marketing Designer to join our creative team at our agency. In this role, you will be responsible for designing high-quality, visually appealing digital assets and campaigns for a variety of clients. Your designs will be used across a range of platforms, including compelling static and animated social ads, marketing emails, and landing pages for a variety of exciting brands.

You are a creative powerhouse with a deep understanding of digital platforms, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to push boundaries while meeting client objectives. As a Marketing Designer, you will take ownership of your work—from concept to execution—and collaborate closely with strategy, content, and digital teams to bring bold, effective ideas to life.

About Anchour

Anchour is a creative agency of 38 and growing, focused on building unforgettable brands and digital experiences that help businesses punch above their weight. Headquartered in Maine, we specialize in serving SMBs and startups across industries like consumer goods, home services, financial services, retail, and professional services.

As a full-service agency, we offer strategy, branding, website design, development, copywriting, and performance marketing solutions. At Anchour, we believe in cultivating an inclusive environment where creativity, curiosity, and collaboration thrive.

What You’ll Do

Create Scroll-Stopping Ads: Develop innovative and high-performing static and animated Meta ads that captivate audiences and drive conversions, using tools like Figma, CapCut, Canva, and After Effects.

Ideate & Conceptualize: Collaborate with strategists and marketers to brainstorm and execute fresh, bold creative ideas for ads and campaigns that stand out in crowded digital spaces.

Craft Engaging Emails: Design visually compelling email templates and campaigns, ensuring they align with best practices for performance and user engagement.

Support Multi-Channel Campaigns: Design assets for additional platforms like Google Display and landing pages, ensuring consistency and alignment with brand guidelines.

Keep Creative Fresh: Regularly refresh and optimize high-performing creative based on campaign performance data, ensuring ads and emails remain relevant and effective.

Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with strategists, copywriters, and marketers to align creative direction with campaign goals and audience needs.

Bring Motion to Life: Add animation and motion to ads and creative assets, leveraging tools like CapCut, Figma, Canva, and After Effects to bring dynamic ideas to life.

Experiment & Innovate: Test new concepts, visual styles, and creative approaches to discover what resonates with audiences and drives results.

Present & Refine Designs: Confidently share your creative work with clients, articulate your thinking, and incorporate feedback to deliver polished final assets.

Manage Your Workflow: Stay organized and manage your time effectively to meet deadlines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Stay Ahead of Trends: Keep up with design and platform trends, exploring new creative ideas that elevate our work and push boundaries.

What We’d Like To See

• Proven Expertise: 3+ years of experience in a design role focused on Meta ads, email marketing, or performance-driven campaigns, preferably in an agency or for high-performing brands.

• Figma Mastery: Extensive experience designing in Figma, including creating templates, prototypes, and layouts for both ads and emails.

• CapCut Proficiency: Familiarity with CapCut to create and refine light animations for Meta ads and short-form digital content.

• Strong Adobe Skills: Working knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects for secondary design tasks.

• Email Expertise: A strong understanding of email marketing best practices, responsive design principles, and user-centric layouts.

• Meta Advertising Know-How: Deep familiarity with Meta ad formats, specs, and design best practices for performance marketing.

• Portfolio of Results-Driven Work: A portfolio showcasing your ability to create engaging digital designs that meet campaign objectives and drive results.

• Detail-Oriented & Strategic: A keen eye for detail, typography, composition, and hierarchy, paired with the ability to think strategically about design’s role in achieving performance goals.

• Adaptable & Curious: A growth-oriented mindset, with a willingness to learn new tools, trends, and techniques.

• Team Player: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, working seamlessly with strategists, copywriters, and marketers to bring ideas to life.

What You’ll Get

• Competitive Salary.

• Work remotely. Live and work wherever you like.

• Retirement. Savings plan with a 4% company match.

• Premium Insurance. Premium health, dental, vision, and life insurance with generous coverage for our US-based team members.

• Optional HSA. An optional health savings account (HSA) for employees to set aside money on a pre-tax basis for medical expenses.

• Home Office Setup. Get a laptop + 50% reimbursement for home office equipment.

• Paid & Flexible Holidays. 12 paid holidays throughout the year, including three flexible holidays.

• Paid Time Off. Minimum three weeks of paid time off per year.

• Paid Leaves. Paid parental, medical, bereavement, and other types of leave.

• Flexible & Summer Fridays. Half-day Fridays throughout the summer, and a get-it-done-and-go mindset year-round.

• Lifelong Learners Fund. Cash for professional development (books, conferences, courses), and team bonding fun times.

• Baby Bonding Bucks. $500 bonus to cover diapers, meals, or other baby-related expenses for any employee welcoming a new child
